issues.description:
## Goal

Warehouse managers and the agent can catalogue every kind of equipment and stock the company holds, with how it is tracked and what it is made of.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> sections 4 to 6 (Product, Kit). Proposed until Jonathan approves the F6 decisions.
* Tracking modes: `serialised` (each unit is an Asset, F6.3), `bulk` (counted quantity, such as cables), `consumable` (used up, such as tape or haze fluid).
* Images use <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> when it exists; until then the product has no image field.

## Scope

1. Tables `inventory_product` and `inventory_kit_component` (Drizzle, Postgres and SQLite, `org_id` guard from <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />). Fields per <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> section 5: name, sku (unique per org), category, tracking, unit, weight, dimensions, power draw, replacement value, required inspection types (list of codes, used by F6.7).
2. Actions `inventory.product.create`, `update`, `archive`, `list`, `get` and `inventory.kit.define` (<issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> contract): Effect Schema input and output, typed errors (`DuplicateSku`, `KitCycle`, `ProductArchived`), permission `inventory:catalogue:read` or `write`.
3. Kits: a kit is a product whose components are other products with quantities and an optional flag; nested kits allowed, cycles rejected.
4. Screens Catalogue and Product detail from Rambo-UI, each declaring its <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection (visible products, filters, selection; product with components) and binding every control to its action.
5. Offline: product and kit rows sync to warehouse devices; per-field last writer wins with audit, kit components replaced as a whole.

## Acceptance criteria

* Creating a product with a duplicate sku in the same org fails with `DuplicateSku`; the same sku in another org succeeds (tenant test).
* A kit that contains itself, directly or through another kit, fails with `KitCycle`.
* The agent lists products by category and creates a kit by request through the same actions, verified by an `@effect/vitest` test calling the inventory.
* Two offline edits to different fields of one product both survive after sync; the same field resolves to the later write and the audit log holds both.
* <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> unbound-control check passes for both screens.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; behind flag `f6-inventory` (default off); no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, tests green, and a comment here listing the actions and screens shipped.

## Planning decision D6-7 - supplier-backed product specifications and catalogue evidence for equivalence (2026-11-13; coordinates D5-14)

### Goal

Use F6 inventory/catalogue data as the authoritative **technical evidence source** for comparing products proposed in F5 supplier quotes, and as the basis for supplier capacity and hiring availability checks. Suppliers can choose a known product or add one, so catalogue coverage grows as the directory and quote system are used.

### Model / data ownership

* Maintain distinct identities and provenance for **reference product/model** (manufacturer, model, variant, specification, dimensions/weight/power/operating limits and evidence), **tenant/supplier-owned catalogue entry** (supplier SKU, stock item, substitutions, price notes, claims), **physical or bulk stock quantities/locations/condition**, **reservations/hire-out and returns**, **supplier quotation version/line**, and **F1 requirement ID/version**. Do not conflate product specifications with stock or assume that a supplier catalogue entry proves ownership or availability.
* Preserve the existing F6 tenant-scoped inventory Product, Kit, Asset, ledger and availability boundaries. A shared manufacturer/model reference layer may help deduplicate equivalent products, but must not expose private supplier inventory/valuation or overwrite tenant-owned stock records. Reference identity can be linked by model/variant IDs with provenance and confidence; similar names are not enough to merge products.
* Structured, category-specific technical fields with typed units and semantics, rather than only a free-text description: manufacturer/model/variant, product category and intended applications, key performance/compatibility characteristics, dimensions/weight/footprint, electrical/power/RF where applicable, interfaces, accessories, kit/bundle composition and safety/compliance/inspection attributes. Record which fields are hard requirements per use case instead of enforcing one generic checklist across all equipment classes.
* Each spec claim must record origin (manufacturer datasheet/manual, supplier-submitted document, supplier assertion, organiser correction), time/version, original source link/file, units and evidence/verification status. A manufacturer's marketed use case may suggest a functional match, not certify technical suitability for a particular event.

### Supplier-driven catalogue enrichment

* A supplier responding to an enquiry or creating a quotation can **search/select an existing product/model** and link its own inventory Product/SKU, or **create/import a new model** with fields/specification/datasheets, images, supporting documents and a proposed matching category. Offer bulk import where useful, with field mapping and validation.
* Identify likely duplicate manufacturer/model variants and prompt match-versus-create review; never silently merge mismatched models or let untrusted uploaded documents become accepted facts. Extracted/spec-reconciled fields remain proposals until verified or accepted by an authorised catalogue workflow. Preserve original uploaded evidence and correction history. Avoid requiring a complete enriched catalogue as a precondition to quote submission: allow 'specifications incomplete - review needed' so sourcing continues.
* Propose a controlled correction process for supplier and other authorised users to contribute to a shared reference record; supplier updates to their own stock and pricing stay private by default. Existing quote/sent requirement snapshots remain immutable when the catalogue changes; flag affected evaluations for re-check instead of silently changing historic outcomes.

### Rental and availability linkage

* Supplier F6 manages stock via existing serialized/bulk/consumable inventory, kits, reservations/holds, dispatched hire-outs, returns, maintenance/quarantine and condition status. Availability is **date/time window + required quantity + location/transport/setup constraints + commitment state + condition**; available stock is calculated from relevant quantities minus confirmed commitments, not a static catalogue boolean.
* Enable suppliers to publish **permission-controlled, freshness-labelled availability projections** to F5 (e.g. offers category/product, can potentially fulfil quantity/window, availability unknown/tentative/available/unavailable). The supplier chooses what is shareable; raw serial numbers, warehouse locations, other clients' events, margins, private supplier data and exact unapproved counts are not leaked.
* F5 discovery and recommendation uses candidate product/kit suitability against F1 exact/functional criteria, then supplier-declared capability and permitted availability signal for event window. Explain technical fit, covered quantities, travel/service area, gaps, substitutions and what is unverified. No automated award or assumption that a search result guarantees stock. Before commitment, require a fresh authorised availability/hold or supplier confirmation; recheck if timestamps go stale or stock changes.
* Hire-out, reserve, release, collect/return and maintenance updates flow through F6 shared agent-native actions and update eligible supplier-side availability projections, which F5 can re-rank on the next evaluation. No external commitments or supplier messages without already agreed approval gates.

### Validation

* Supplier selects a shared reference microphone model from catalogue, links its SKU/stock, and quotes it against an F1 functional microphone requirement; comparison shows model specs and cited evidence, an outcome-based fit status, and availability freshness for the event dates.
* A second supplier uploads an unknown model/datasheet: import proposes mapped fields and detects potential duplicate; quote is preserved and marked pending verification until accepted evidence. One supplier's stock figures, exact location and margins are hidden from competing tenants.
* Two manufacturers' products meet verified functional criteria for a speaking microphone and can be compared; an incompatible connector or missing required wireless capability prevents 'verified equivalent'. A rider-exact model substitution still requires an organiser waiver (D5-13).
* One supplier has ten units but eight are reserved for overlapping dates: a request for five must not be confidently shown as available; stock returned/asset quarantined changes derived signals after proper F6 state transitions. Expired or stale projections become unknown/confirmation required, not automatically green.
* A reference spec is corrected after Round 1: historical quote remains unchanged, new evaluation references the updated evidence version and prompts review. No double-counting bundled kits.

### Out of scope / open decisions

Planning only; do not expose all tenants' stock globally, assert real-time certainty from cached records, or auto-award/requote. To decide: tenant opt-in defaults and exactly what the directory may reveal about stock quantity versus only capacity/availability summaries; curator/verification responsibilities and how to maintain manufacturer reference data. F6 remains owner of actual stock, F5 of discovery/comparison. Linked <issue id="eaa9fbf7-7a3c-4c1c-9470-a76edd5316ff" label="EVE-81" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-81/f61-build-the-equipment-catalogue-products-tracking-modes-and-kits" />, <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" />, <issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" />, <issue id="f08bafe4-f32d-4906-9e87-5d69df56d6a0" label="EVE-124" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-124/f58-build-quotes-quote-comparison-and-the-acceptance-handoff-to-the" /> and <issue id="03bd23d1-9da5-4272-8f2e-0b0bf4f7f846" label="EVE-119" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-119/f57-build-cross-tenant-enquiries-rfps-and-private-message-threads" />.

### Planning coordination D6-8 - rich private catalogue, restricted publication (2026-11-13)

Suppliers may enrich their own product catalogue with model identifiers, structured specifications, datasheets, quantities and kit/availability data regardless of their directory visibility setting. Distinguish permitted shared manufacturer/model specifications from tenant-private inventory/SKUs and commercial information. Exposing a product reference for contextual equivalence must not publish the owning supplier's private quantities or data lineage without authorisation. Capture provenance and verification status and do not use a supplier's uploaded data to train a shared AI model by default. Directory settings detailed/dates-only/private and default-enabled, expressly opt-out-able cross-tenant recommendation processing (D5-16/D6-9 supersession) are coordinated in <issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" /> D5-15 and <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> D6-8; 'private-but-matchable' is approved by default subject to truthful generic copy, supplier notice and an explicit opt-out. No raw supplier stock disclosure or shared model training is authorised. Planning only.

### Planning coordination D6-9 - catalogue use for default-on recommendations (2026-11-13)

Catalogue and inventory may be used in Eventiva's scoped cross-tenant supplier-matching process by default, subject to transparent supplier notice/terms and a straightforward explicit opt-out (<issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" /> D5-16, <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> D6-9). This does not publish supplier-private SKU/quantities/stock, and it does not authorise shared model training or additional unrelated purposes. A hidden inventory visibility preference affects buyer-facing information only, while a matching opt-out independently excludes private stock from ranking and candidate generation. Only published general listing attributes may explain a generic hidden-inventory supplier recommendation; do not expose manufacturer/model association without publication permission. Planning only.

issues.title: F12.1 Build pay rules, rate cards and pay profiles
issues.description:
## Goal

A payroll administrator defines how every worker is paid (hourly, day rate, fixed fee, overtime, allowances, holiday accrual) once, versioned by effective date, and the same rules drive every later pay run.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-61](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets>) (F12 Payroll), sections 4 and 5.
* Workers and their Engagement (type, payBasis, individual rate, contractedHours, offPayrollStatus) are F13's (<issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />); an Engagement rate overrides the rate card for that worker. PayProfile holds only pay schedule, rate card and provider worker ref. events and phases are F1's Event and Phase. Do not redefine them; reference by id.
* Actions follow [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema>); storage and tenant guards follow [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state>); roles follow [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and>).

## Scope

1. A `payroll` extension package with Effect Schema definitions through the shared schema package (<issue id="c31b6b08-1532-4a7a-945f-24a70bbab765" label="EVE-23" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23/split-core-into-portable-contracts-and-backend-runtime-with-a-shared" />) for PayRule, RateCard and PayProfile (fields as in <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" /> section 5). Money as integer minor units plus ISO currency.
2. A pure rule evaluator (plain TypeScript, no IO): given a rule, a rate card and a list of worked intervals, return pay lines with quantity, rate and amount. Kinds: hourly, day rate (with a threshold for half day), fixed fee per engagement, overtime (after N hours per day or per week, multiplier), allowance (flat or per unit), deduction (flat), holiday accrual (percentage or hours-based; values supplied as parameters).
3. Versioning: a rule or rate card used by a locked run is never edited in place; an upsert creates a new version with an effective-from date.
4. Actions `payroll.payRule.upsert`, `payroll.rateCard.upsert`, `payroll.rateCard.list`, `payroll.worker.setPayProfile` with permissions and approval policies from <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" /> section 4.
5. Screen "Pay rules and rate cards" from Rambo-UI with its screen-context projection and every control bound to an action (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> contract; stub the registry if <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> is not yet merged and note it here).

## Acceptance criteria

* Property tests for the evaluator: overtime never double counts; day-rate threshold boundary cases; zero-length and overnight intervals across a DST change.
* A fixture of 10 rules gives pay lines matching a hand-checked table to the minor unit.
* Editing a rule used by a locked run creates a version and leaves the old one unchanged, in a test.
* Permission tests: a worker cannot read rate cards; a payroll admin can, on HTTP and MCP.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules (`Data.TaggedError`, `Context.Tag`, Schema, `@effect/vitest`); no zod; no floats for money; new behaviour behind the `payroll` flag (default off); no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Package on main, tests green, a comment listing the public actions and the evaluator API.

issues.title: F12.2 Build time capture: clock in and out and time entries, offline
issues.description:
## Goal

Crew clock in and out on site from a phone, including with no signal, and every worked interval is recorded once against the right shift, event and phase.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" />, sections 4, 5, 6 and 11.
* Shifts come from F2 (Shift, Roster assignment on <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />); events and phases from F1. A time entry without a shift is allowed (walk-on crew) but needs an Event.
* Offline record sync is <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> with the engine chosen in <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> (S4).

## Scope

1. TimeEntry entity (<issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" /> section 5) and append-only ClockEvent (in, out, break start, break end) with device time, server receive time and source (clock, manual, roster draft, agent).
2. TimeEntry is derived from ClockEvents, so two devices clocking the same worker never overwrite each other; duplicates with the same idempotency key collapse.
3. Actions `time.clock.in`, `time.clock.out`, `time.entry.upsert` with the permissions in <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" /> section 4.
4. Optional location at clock in and out only, behind the `payroll-clock-location` flag and the org setting (decision D5); no tracking between.
5. "My shift" mobile screen: shift card, clock button, break toggle, offline badge showing queued writes; screen-context projection and action bindings (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />).
6. Device clock skew: store both times; flag entries where skew exceeds 5 minutes for the approver.

## Acceptance criteria

* On a real Android device in airplane mode: clock in, break, clock out, restart the app, reconnect; exactly one TimeEntry appears on the server with the right duration.
* Two devices clock the same worker out at different times while offline; on reconnect both events are kept, the entry uses the later, and the conflict is flagged.
* The agent clocks a worker in through MCP and the same audit record appears as for the UI.
* No location is stored when the flag or org setting is off, in a test.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; behind the `payroll` flag; location is personal data (<issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" /> section 11): stored only at the two moments, retention as configured; no new dependency without approval on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Device run recorded with commands and evidence in a comment, tests green on main.

issues.title: F3.4 Build event-relative due dates, task templates and reschedule cascade
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08, <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decisions). Planning only until Jonathan asks for implementation.

## Goal

An organiser applies a template to an Event and gets every task, checklist and dependency with dates relative to that Event; when the Event moves, the tasks move with it.

## Context

* Parent spec: [EVE-62](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event>) sections 4 (`template.*`, `task.reschedule`), 5 (relative due shape, TaskTemplate), 3 (event tools move checklist dates when the event is rescheduled).
* Anchors are F1 dates referenced by name: Event starts_at and ends_at, Phase start and end, Segment time (of a RunOfShow), ItineraryItem time (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> section 5). F3 reads them; F1 owns them.

## Scope

1. Relative date type: `{ anchor: AnchorRef, offsetMinutes, businessDaysOnly? }`, resolved against the anchor in the Event's time zone, DST-safe (reuse [EVE-33](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters>) helpers where they exist).
2. TaskTemplate and TemplateTask tables holding tasks, subtasks, checklists, dependencies and assignee roles mapped on apply to F1 TeamMember roles and Departments (for example "lighting lead"), with relative dates.
3. Actions `template.create`, `template.update`, `template.archive`, `template.apply` (maps template roles to people and template Phases to the Event's Phases; confirm above 25 tasks), and `template.fromList` to save an existing list as a template.
4. `task.reschedule`: on an F1 anchor change event, compute the change set for every relative task; preview mode returns the diff; cascade mode applies it (confirm). Absolute-date tasks are never moved. Completed tasks are not moved.
5. Offline: devices resolve relative dates locally; on reconnect the server result wins and the device shows a "dates updated" notice.
6. Flag `tasks-templates`, default off.

## Acceptance criteria

* Apply a 30-task template to an Event: preview lists 30 tasks with resolved dates; confirm creates them with dependencies and checklists intact.
* Move the Event start by 7 days: preview shows every relative open task moved by 7 days, absolute and completed tasks unchanged; confirm applies it in one undoable change.
* A task anchored to a Segment moves when only that Segment moves.
* DST: a task anchored "2 days before 09:00 Event start" keeps 09:00 local across a clock change.
* The agent applies a template and reschedules through the same actions, with the same confirms.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; pure date resolution stays plain TypeScript; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the apply, reschedule and DST tests green.

## Blockers

[EVE-64](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-64/f31-build-task-lists-and-tasks-as-synced-records-with-actions>) (F3.1), [EVE-72](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-72/f33-build-subtasks-and-finish-to-start-dependencies-with-blocker>) (F3.3); F1 anchor change events (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />); [EVE-33](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters>) date helpers if available, otherwise local helpers moved there later.

issues.title: F12.3 Build timesheets: draft from roster, submit and approve
issues.description:
## Goal

Each worker's hours for a period are gathered into one timesheet, drafted from their roster, checked against what they actually clocked, and approved by the right person before anything is paid.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" />, sections 4 to 6 and 9. Builds on F12.2 time entries and F12.1 pay profiles (pay frequency sets the period).
* Rosters and shifts are F2's (<issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />). State machines come from <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />; scoped roles (crew chief per event or team) from <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />; change notifications use <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" /> and, once ported, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.

## Scope

1. Timesheet entity with a state machine: draft, submitted, approved, rejected, locked. Only a run lock (F12.4) moves it to locked.
2. `time.timesheet.draftFromRoster`: build draft entries from rostered shifts for a worker or team and period, marked source = roster draft, merged with clocked entries (clocked wins, roster kept as the expected value).
3. Variance per entry and per timesheet: clocked versus rostered, with an org threshold (default 15 minutes) that marks it for review.
4. `time.timesheet.submit`, `time.timesheet.approve`, `time.timesheet.reject` (reason required), `payroll.allowance.add`; approver scope is the event or team the entries belong to; a timesheet spanning two events needs each event's approver for its entries.
5. Offline: draft and submit work offline; an approval queued offline against a timesheet that changed since is rejected on sync and shown to the approver.
6. Screens "My timesheet" and "Team approvals" (grouped by event and team, diff against roster, bulk approve) with projections and action bindings (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />).

## Acceptance criteria

* A roster of 5 shifts drafts 5 entries; a 30-minute late finish shows as a variance; the crew chief approves it and adds a late-finish allowance.
* A crew chief for event A cannot approve entries for event B, on UI, HTTP and MCP.
* The offline stale-approval case is rejected and flagged, in a test.
* Bulk approve of 50 timesheets is one action call per timesheet with one audit receipt each.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; behind the `payroll` flag; no new dependency without approval on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Tests green on main; a comment with the state diagram and the action list.

issues.title: F3.5 Build the task screens with screen projections on web and mobile
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08, <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decisions). Planning only until Jonathan asks for implementation.

## Goal

People see and work their tasks on any device, and the agent sees exactly what they see and can press every button they can.

## Context

* Parent spec: <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> section 6 (screens, Rambo-UI parts, projections, control-to-action map) and section 9 (what each role sees).
* Screen awareness contract from <issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> and <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />: every control binds an action id, every screen declares an Effect Schema projection, navigation is an action.
* UI from Rambo-UI only; Rambo-UI has no components yet, so the needed parts (list, board, sheet, checkbox, date picker, assignee picker, rich text editor, timeline) are requested there.

## Scope

1. Screens: My tasks, Event tasks (list and board), Task detail sheet, Checklist run (mobile first, large targets, offline badge, pending-sync count), Dependencies and timeline (wide screens; blockers list on mobile), Templates library and editor.
2. A screen-context projection per screen as listed in <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> section 6, filtered by the viewer's permissions.
3. Every control bound to its action; the unbound-element check (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />) passes.
4. Navigation actions: `nav.open` for a Task, a TaskList and My tasks.
5. Comments and mentions on the Task detail through <issue id="b7f17f15-c893-46e9-9b3b-2aefae473802" label="EVE-27" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-27/port-comments-mentions-and-review-suggestions-on-any-resource" />.
6. Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA; every drag has a menu and keyboard alternative; sync and offline state announced.
7. The task screens ship as a federated module per <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" /> with a bundled fallback.

## Acceptance criteria

* On web and Android: the agent answers "what tasks am I looking at" from the projection and completes a visible task by action id with the same result as a tap.
* The unbound-element check fails on a fixture button and passes on the real screens.
* axe (web) shows no serious or critical issues on each screen; keyboard-only move of a card between board columns works.
* Checklist run works in airplane mode with the offline badge and pending count correct.
* A guest sees only the My tasks screen with their tasks.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 for IO; Rambo-UI components only, no local component library; whitelabel ASCII copy; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the web and Android checks recorded and axe results attached.

## Blockers

<issue id="d63643eb-423b-4502-b0a5-e4b99c887f54" label="EVE-64" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-64/f31-build-task-lists-and-tasks-as-synced-records-with-actions" />, <issue id="f941b8f6-0309-45e0-9d56-60feddd2f985" label="EVE-70" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-70/f32-build-checklists-with-photo-evidence-and-sign-off-that-work" />, <issue id="b092122b-6aea-4fec-b8c4-e1baf084c342" label="EVE-72" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-72/f33-build-subtasks-and-finish-to-start-dependencies-with-blocker" /> (F3.1 to F3.3), <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />, <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" />, <issue id="b7f17f15-c893-46e9-9b3b-2aefae473802" label="EVE-27" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-27/port-comments-mentions-and-review-suggestions-on-any-resource" />; Rambo-UI components listed above.

issues.title: F12.4 Build pay run calculation on durable runs
issues.description:
## Goal

A payroll administrator opens a pay period, calculates gross pay for every worker from approved timesheets, reviews exceptions, and locks the run so it can never change silently.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-61](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets>), sections 4, 5, 6 and 12. Uses the F12.1 evaluator and approved, locked timesheets from F2's `timesheet.export` (<issue id="522cf0df-8126-444d-8833-1e31bf21345e" label="EVE-138" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-138/f29-build-time-capture-and-timesheets" />, a versioned idempotent batch per period). F2 owns time capture and timesheets.
* Durable execution on Effect Cluster per [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow>) and the sharding decisions in [EVE-18](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and>); audit from [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and>).

## Scope

1. PayPeriod and PayRun entities with states draft, locked, submitted, completed, reversed; PayLine with cost centre (F1 Event and Phase) and source refs to rules, rates and time entries.
2. `payroll.period.open`, `payroll.run.calculate` (idempotent; recalculating a draft replaces its lines), `payroll.run.lock` (approval always; locks the included timesheets through F2's action), `payroll.run.reverse` (creates correcting lines in the next open run, leaves the locked run unchanged).
3. Calculation runs as a durable workflow sharded by org; a run of 2,000 workers survives a runner restart mid-run without duplicate lines.
4. Exceptions list: unapproved timesheets in the period, workers without a pay profile, effective hourly pay below the configured statutory minimum, working-time limit breaches, variance above threshold; each exception links to the action that resolves it.
5. `payroll.run.explainLine`: returns rule, rate, version and source entries for any line, used identically by the UI drawer and the agent.
6. Optional two-person approval as an org setting (decision D4): the person who calculated cannot lock.
7. "Pay run" stepper screen plus `payroll.allowance.add` (meal, travel, late finish; approval confirm, permission `time:approve`) for allowances against a worker and event with projection and bindings ([EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>)).

## Acceptance criteria

* The 50-worker fixture in <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" /> section 12 matches to the minor unit.
* Killing a runner during a 2,000-worker calculation and restarting gives the same totals and no duplicate lines.
* A lock attempt by the agent without human approval fails with a typed error and an audit entry.
* Reverse plus next run nets to the corrected amount, with the original run byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; integer money; behind the `payroll` flag; OTel spans per run and per worker batch with no amounts or names in attributes; no new dependency without approval on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Tests and the runner-loss scenario recorded in a comment; on main.

issues.title: F12.5 Build the payroll provider port and the first adapter
issues.description:
## Goal

A locked pay run is sent to a recognised payroll provider that calculates net pay, files tax and returns payslips, without Eventiva holding tax codes or bank details, and the provider can be switched by composition alone.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" />, sections 8, 11 and decision D1. This issue assumes D1 option A (provider calculates net and files). If Jonathan picks B or C, this issue is rewritten before work starts.
* Credentials and secrets via <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />; payslip documents stored with <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.
* UK filing (PAYE RTI) requires HMRC PAYE recognition: [https://www.gov.uk/guidance/paye-recognition-for-payroll-software-developers](<https://www.gov.uk/guidance/paye-recognition-for-payroll-software-developers>)

## Scope

1. A neutral `PayrollProvider` Effect service (`Context.Tag`) in its own integration contract: `syncWorkers`, `submitRun` (gross lines per worker, pensionable pay, period), `getSubmission`, `fetchPayslips`; typed errors for rejected worker, rejected run, provider unavailable, auth expired.
2. A file adapter first (CSV in the provider-neutral shape, versioned), so payroll works with any provider by import before any API adapter exists.
3. One API adapter for the provider Jonathan approves on this issue (candidate: an HMRC-recognised payroll API such as Staffology; no sign-up until approved), in its own integration package.
4. Actions `payroll.run.submitToProvider` (approval always) and `payroll.run.importResults`; submissions carry an idempotency key and request hash so a retry never double submits.
5. Tax and NI ids and bank details come from F13's encrypted SensitiveProfile (<issue id="636f7592-553b-41f2-adb0-9a336d0188e3" label="EVE-116" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-116/f132-build-the-sensitive-profile-with-field-masking-reveal-audit-and" />) at submission time and are sent to the provider; F12 tables keep only provider references.

## Acceptance criteria

* The file adapter output for the 50-worker fixture matches a committed snapshot.
* A contract test suite runs against the file adapter and a fake API adapter; the real adapter passes it in a sandbox account once approved.
* A retried submit after a timeout produces one submission, in a test.
* No tax code, NI number or bank detail appears in F12 tables, telemetry or agent prompts (grep test over schemas and a telemetry capture).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; vendor code only in the integration package with `// effect-boundary:` on the one wrapping call; no vendor sign-up and no new dependency until Jonathan approves on this issue; behind the `payroll` flag; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Port and file adapter on main; provider choice recorded here; API adapter merged after approval.

issues.title: F3.6 Build task reminders, watchers and notifications
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08, <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decisions). Planning only until Jonathan asks for implementation.

## Goal

People hear about the tasks that matter to them (assigned, due soon, overdue, unblocked, commented) on the channel they choose, without duplicates.

## Context

* Parent spec: <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> sections 4 (`reminder.*`, `task.watch`), 8 (notifications through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />).
* Task events come from <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />; durable timers from <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" /> (Effect Cluster and Workflow).

## Scope

1. Tables Reminder and TaskWatch; assignees and creators watch by default.
2. Actions `reminder.set`, `reminder.clear`, `task.watch`, `task.unwatch`.
3. A durable reminder scheduler on Effect Cluster that fires once per reminder, survives runner loss (<issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" /> behaviour) and re-arms when a due date changes.
4. Notification rules: assigned to you, due in 24 hours (default, user-changeable), overdue, unblocked, mentioned, completed (for watchers). Sent through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> with a per-user channel and quiet hours setting.
5. Offline devices raise local reminders for synced tasks and suppress the server push when the local one already fired (dedupe key per reminder).
6. Flag: part of `tasks`.

## Acceptance criteria

* A reminder fires once when the runner holding it is killed before the fire time.
* Changing a due date re-arms its relative reminder; clearing it cancels it.
* A phone offline at fire time shows the local reminder and gets no duplicate push on reconnect.
* Watchers get one notification per completed task; quiet hours delay non-urgent sends.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; channels behind <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> ports, no vendor coupling; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the runner-kill and dedupe tests green.

## Blockers

<issue id="d63643eb-423b-4502-b0a5-e4b99c887f54" label="EVE-64" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-64/f31-build-task-lists-and-tasks-as-synced-records-with-actions" /> (F3.1), <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />.

issues.title: F11.2 Build posting rules that turn sales, stock and payroll events into journals
issues.description:
## Goal

Every money event from another feature set posts to the ledger exactly once, through editable posting rules, with no feature set writing journals itself.

## Context

* Parent [EVE-69](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax>) sections 4 and 8. Builds on F11.1 ([EVE-74](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-74/f111-build-the-ledger-port-chart-of-accounts-journals-and-periods>)) and the change feed ([EVE-45](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change>)). Durable consumption runs on Effect Cluster ([EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow>)); sharding decisions from [EVE-18](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and>) apply.
* Agreed inputs from other sets (2026-11-01):
  * F9 sales: `sales:order_paid`, `sales:refund_completed`, `sales:payment_fee_recorded`, `sales:payout_settled`, `sales:register_session_closed` (cash over or short). Each carries order id, F1 Event id, channel, lines with net, F11 tax code id and tax amount in integer minor units, currency and provider payout id.
  * F6 warehousing ([EVE-63](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing>)): `inventory:goods_received` per receipt (PO line ids, quantities, unit cost, F1 Event id, supplier) and `inventory:valuation_exported` per period (depreciation, average-cost movements, asset additions and retirements, write-offs).
  * F8 ticketing: ticket sales arrive through F9 orders unless F8 states otherwise on its parent issue.
  * F12 payroll (<issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" />, emitted by <issue id="a060ed52-422b-4a20-ba8e-cc47ca2a79de" label="EVE-96" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-96/f127-build-the-payments-file-and-the-pay-run-events-for-accounting" />, agreed 2026-11-01): `payroll:run_approved` once per run when it completes, idempotency key = run id, with pay date, period, and per F1 Event, Phase and Department the gross pay, employer NI, employer pension, employee deductions (PAYE, employee NI, pension, student loan, other) and net pay in integer minor units with currency, plus a separate freelancer self-bill totals block. `payroll:run_reversed` carries correcting amounts in the same shape and posts as a reversal. F12 posts no journals; RTI filing sits with the payroll provider, not F11 or F12.

## Scope

1. `PostingRule` entity, versioned, mapping source event type and conditions (channel, product category, tax code) to debit and credit accounts and dimension values (F1 Event, F1 Event phase).
2. Consumer per source event type, idempotent by source event id: a replayed event posts nothing new. Failures go to a posting exceptions queue with the typed reason (`NoMatchingRule`, `PeriodLocked`, `LedgerUnavailable`).
3. Default rules for a UK event business: ticket revenue, merchandise revenue, deferred revenue for tickets to future events (recognised on the F1 Event date), payment processor fees, payouts to bank clearing, cash over and short, GRNI, depreciation, payroll control accounts (wages expense, employer NI, pension, PAYE and NI liability, net wages control), freelancer self-bill payables.
4. Actions: `accounting.postingRule.list` / `update` (approval always), `accounting.postingException.list` / `retry` / `resolve`.
5. Settings screen for posting rules and an exceptions list, both with projections and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* Replay of the same 500 events twice produces the same ledger balances as one pass (idempotency test).
* A ticket sold for a future F1 Event posts to deferred revenue, then moves to revenue on the event date by a scheduled job.
* An event with no matching rule lands in exceptions and posts after a rule is added and the exception retried.
* Runner loss mid-batch (two runners, as in <issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" />) loses and duplicates nothing.

## Posting integrity clarifications (2026-11-16)

These clarify the existing F11.2 scope; they do not introduce a new ledger engine, provider integration, dependency, or event type.

* At posting time, persist the resolved account IDs, dimensions, source event ID, applied posting-rule ID/version, and entry kind on the immutable journal/posting audit record. Later rule edits or account renames must not rewrite posted history; corrections use the existing reversal mechanism.
* Before atomic persistence, validate that debit and credit totals balance exactly in currency-specific integer minor units, with no floating-point conversion. Preserve <issue id="f12d2c25-0d77-425f-b610-f66d2ad99b32" label="EVE-74" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-74/f111-build-the-ledger-port-chart-of-accounts-journals-and-periods" />'s multi-currency precision model (including zero- and three-decimal currencies). Enforce durable, tenant-scoped uniqueness of the logical posting effect by source event and entry kind, including rule-revision/retry races; rule version is audit metadata, not a way to permit reposting the same effect. Legitimate distinct entries and reversals must remain possible with stable identities.
* Preserve separate journal lines or traceable allocations for gross receipts, tax liabilities, processor fees, refunds and clearing/bank settlements, so net payouts can be reconciled to underlying source transactions across orders and periods. Keep jurisdiction-specific tax reporting and external accounting exports in their existing feature scopes.

Additional acceptance checks:

* Editing a posting rule or renaming an account after posting leaves historical account references, amounts, dimensions and balances unchanged; an explicit reversal remains auditable.
* Concurrent duplicate deliveries, retries after runner loss, and posting-rule version changes produce no duplicate logical postings; all generated journals balance exactly, including GBP, JPY and BHD precision cases.
* A payout spanning multiple orders and accounting periods, with fees, tax and refunds, reconciles gross source amounts to net bank settlement without an unexplained residual.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no new dependency; posting runs server-side only; flag `f11-accounting`; ship to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the idempotency and runner-loss tests green, and the default rule table posted here as a comment.

comments.body:
Keeping posting rules declarative outside individual feature sets is the cleanest way to avoid scattered, un-auditable journal writes.

A few patterns that make editable posting-rule engines resilient in production:

1. **Immutable account-ID snapshots**: Store the resolved `clearing_account_id` / GL target on each generated journal batch at post time (so editing a posting rule or renaming a GL account next quarter never retroactively rewrites historical closed journals).
2. **Exact integer-cents balance assertion**: Require every rule output bundle to satisfy `sum(debits_cents) == sum(credits_cents)` plus an explicit `(source_event_id, rule_version, entry_kind)` idempotency constraint before persisting.
3. **Separate gross, fee, tax, and cutoff lines**: Keep gross revenue, platform fees, withheld taxes, and payout deposits distinct so downstream `Form 1099-K Box 1a` / bank-feed reconciliations tie out without manual journal adjustments.

If a deterministic multi-channel clearing reference helps as you design CSV/API journal outputs (`QBO` / `Xero`):

* Integer-cent tie-out Gist: [https://gist.github.com/hadesloc/5a0977bbf9945ab6f70588af372fd587](<https://gist.github.com/hadesloc/5a0977bbf9945ab6f70588af372fd587>)
* Local CLI (`v1.4.0`): `npx --yes --package=https://github.com/hadesloc/pdfua-ada-checker/releases/download/v1.4.0/clearstream-1099k-cli-1.4.0.tgz clearstream-1099k --help`
* Free browser template reference: [https://hadesloc.github.io/pdfua-partner-desk/ebay-etsy-1099-k-clearing-account-template/](<https://hadesloc.github.io/pdfua-partner-desk/ebay-etsy-1099-k-clearing-account-template/>) (offline kit 50% off w/ `EARLY50`: [https://pdfuapartnerdesk.gumroad.com/l/tiktok-1099k-clearing-kit/EARLY50?wanted=true](<https://pdfuapartnerdesk.gumroad.com/l/tiktok-1099k-clearing-kit/EARLY50?wanted=true>)).

*(Pure-software engineering comment — deterministic ledger formatting software only, not CPA, accounting, or legal advice.)*
comments.author: GitHub

comments.body:
Thanks @hadesloc for taking the time to review the F11.2 posting-rule design. Your technical observations were useful.

For transparency, we're replacing the original comment with this project-maintained summary because it combined architectural feedback with links to an executable third-party package, external templates and a commercial offer. We keep issue discussions focused on reviewable requirements and avoid promoting unvetted software or purchase links. This is a repository-hygiene decision, not a dismissal of your contribution.

**Technical excerpts from your feedback (promotional links omitted):**
> “Immutable account-ID snapshots”
>
> “Exact integer-cents balance assertion”
>
> “Separate gross, fee, tax, and cutoff lines”

**What we incorporated into [EVE-90](https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-90):**
1. Persist resolved account IDs, dimensions and applied posting-rule version with immutable posting history, so later account renames or rule changes cannot alter closed journals.
2. Strengthen exact debit/credit balancing and durable idempotency tests across concurrent deliveries, rule revisions, retries and reversals. We use currency-aware integer *minor units*, not fixed cents, to retain the existing GBP/JPY/BHD model. Importantly, rule version is audit metadata rather than part of a uniqueness key that could permit the same logical posting twice.
3. Add gross-to-net reconciliation acceptance checks covering tax, processor fees, refunds, clearing and payouts spanning multiple orders or accounting periods.

These are scoped clarifications to the already approved F11.2/F11.1 ledger architecture, not new feature sets or dependencies. The US-specific Form 1099-K treatment, external CLI, templates and paid materials are not being adopted.

Thank you again for the constructive engineering input — it has directly improved the precision of our acceptance criteria.

issues.title: F4.2 Link contacts to events with roles and to each other with relationships
issues.description:
## Goal

Every event shows who the client, venue contact, vendors and artists are, crew can reach them from their phone offline, and people can be linked to each other (assistant of, agent for).

## Context

* Parent [EVE-65](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history>) sections 5 (EventRole, Relationship), 6 (Event contacts tab, Mobile event contact sheet) and 9 (event scoped access).
* Event is an F1 entity; this issue references it by id and does not redefine it. The tab mounts inside the F1 event screen through the module registration in [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>) (federated modules register on activation).
* Crew assignment to shifts stays in F2; EventRole is the business contact role only.
* F1 names are fixed in <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> section 5. The primary client is `Event.client_ref` (F1 owns it); the tab shows it first, read from F1, and EventRole has no client role. F1 TeamMember `contact_ref` (internal event team) and Rider performer `contact_ref` (artist) point to Party ids; keep them stable and register them as reference owners for merge (F4.4).

## Scope

1. Tables `event_role` (event id, party id, role enum without client, notes, on-site flag) and `relationship` (from, to, type, label).
2. Actions `crm.eventRole.assign` / `unassign` / `list`, `crm.relationship.add` / `remove` / `list`, with undo.
3. Authorization rule: read on an Event grants read of the business fields (name, role, organisation, work email, work phone) of parties holding an EventRole on it; personal contact points stay masked.
4. Sync scope rule for [EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and>): a device syncs EventRoles and business fields for events the member is on within the next 30 days.
5. Screens: Event contacts tab, Person and Organisation detail Events tab, Mobile event contact sheet with call and message buttons bound to actions (`crm.interaction.log` is called after a call when F4.3 exists; until then the button only dials).

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: a crew member with event read and no `crm:read` sees the venue contact's work phone and not their personal phone; removing the member from the event removes access on next sync.
* Android offline: the contact sheet for tomorrow's event opens in airplane mode with the venue contact listed.
* The agent answers "who is the venue contact for this event" on the event screen and assigns a vendor role by action.
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; WCAG 2.2 AA; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the tests green and the offline Android check recorded.

## Blockers

<issue id="d71c315c-52d0-4e04-b37a-88b4e1db7827" label="EVE-68" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68/f41-build-people-organisations-and-contact-points-as-crm-actions" /> (F4.1), <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> for the offline part, F1 Event entity for the tab.

issues.title: F12.6 Build freelancer self-billing and worker status records
issues.description:
## Goal

Freelancers and agencies are paid from the same approved hours as employees, through self-billed invoices, with their engagement status and self-billing agreement on record before the first payment.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" />, sections 2, 4, 11 and decision D3 (self-billing recommended).
* Freelancers trading as companies are F4 Organisations; their people are F13 Workers. Agreements and invoices are files (<issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />); "invoice issued" notifications use <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.
* Off-payroll working rules (IR35): Eventiva records the determination, it does not decide it.

## Scope

1. Read engagement type and offPayrollStatus from F13's Engagement (<issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />); F12 keeps no separate status record. A freelancer whose Engagement has no offPayrollStatus is a pay run exception.
2. SelfBillingAgreement record: freelancer, start, end, signed file ref; required before `payroll.selfBill.issue` succeeds.
3. `payroll.selfBill.issue` (approval always): one invoice per freelancer per run, sequential numbering per org, VAT treatment from the freelancer's profile, PDF stored as a file, freelancer notified.
4. Freelancer view: their invoices and payment status, read-only.
5. Freelancer lines are excluded from the PayrollProvider submission and included in the payment file (F12.7) and journals.

## Acceptance criteria

* Issuing a self-bill for a freelancer without a current agreement fails with a typed error naming the missing agreement.
* Invoice numbers are gap-free and unique per org under concurrent issue, in a test.
* A freelancer cannot see another freelancer's invoices on any interface.
* A run with 10 employees and 5 freelancers sends 10 to the provider and 5 to self-billing.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no zod; behind the `payroll` flag; invoice text whitelabel and ASCII; no new dependency (PDF rendering uses whatever <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> provides, or ask on this issue); ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Tests green on main; sample invoice PDF attached here.

issues.title: F3.7 Build recurring tasks on the shared scheduling rules
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08, <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decisions). Planning only until Jonathan asks for implementation.

## Goal

Repeating work (weekly kit checks, monthly vehicle inspections, daily show-ready checks during a run) creates itself on schedule without anyone remembering.

## Context

* Parent spec: <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> sections 4 (`recurrence.*`) and 5 (Recurrence).
* Recurrence rules and DST-safe expansion come from <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />; F3 does not build its own.

## Scope

1. Recurrence table linking a template Task to an <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" /> rule (daily, weekly, monthly, every show day of an Event, until a date or count).
2. Actions `recurrence.set`, `recurrence.clear`, plus `recurrence.preview` (next 10 occurrences).
3. Generation: the next occurrence is created when the previous one is completed or at a lead time before its due date (default 7 days), never more than one open occurrence ahead; generation is a durable job, idempotent per occurrence key.
4. Editing the series changes future occurrences only; editing one occurrence detaches it.
5. "Every show day" resolves against the F1 Event's show days.
6. Flag: part of `tasks`.

## Acceptance criteria

* A weekly task completed early creates exactly one next occurrence on the right date.
* Running the generator twice creates no duplicate.
* A daily show-ready check on a 3-day run creates 3 occurrences and stops.
* DST does not move a 09:00 local recurrence.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; reuse <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" /> rules, no second recurrence engine; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the occurrence, idempotency and DST tests green.

## Blockers

<issue id="d63643eb-423b-4502-b0a5-e4b99c887f54" label="EVE-64" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-64/f31-build-task-lists-and-tasks-as-synced-records-with-actions" /> (F3.1), <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />.

issues.title: F7.1 Build the vehicle register: vehicles, types and documents
issues.description:
## Goal

A fleet manager, or the agent on their behalf, can register every owned, hired or lent vehicle with its type and legal documents, and see at a glance which vehicles are on road and which documents expire soon.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) sections 4 (fleet.vehicle.*, fleet.vehicleType.define, fleet.document.*), 5 (Vehicle, VehicleType, VehicleDocument) and 6 (Fleet list, Vehicle detail, Fleet settings).
* Owner organisation of a hired vehicle is an F4 Organisation, referenced by id.
* Documents are files from [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25>); until it lands, store a file reference field and leave upload behind the same port.

## Scope

1. Fleet extension package with Effect Schema for Vehicle, VehicleType, VehicleDocument (Drizzle tables via the shared schema package, tenant-scoped).
2. Actions: `fleet.vehicle.create`, `update`, `archive`, `get`, `list` (filters: type, road status, base, ownership), `fleet.vehicleType.define`, `fleet.document.attach`, `fleet.document.expire`. Typed errors: DuplicateRegistration, VehicleNotFound, DocumentOverlap.
3. Document versions: attaching a new insurance document closes the previous one; nothing is overwritten.
4. Derived fields: `documentsExpiringWithin(days)` projection used by the list and by F7.12.
5. Screens: Fleet list, Vehicle detail (documents tab), Fleet settings (vehicle types), each with its screen-context projection and every control bound to an action.
6. Offline: vehicles and types readable offline; vehicle edits sync with per-field last writer wins.

## Acceptance criteria

* Create, update, archive and list work from UI, HTTP, MCP and the agent; parity check passes.
* Registering the same registration twice in one tenant returns DuplicateRegistration; the same registration in another tenant succeeds.
* A second insurance document closes the first; history shows both.
* A user of tenant A cannot read tenant B vehicles through any surface (negative test).
* The agent reads the Vehicle detail projection and reports the same expiry dates the screen shows.
* Offline edit of a vehicle name on two devices converges to the later write.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI components; behind `eventiva-fleet`, default off; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; people and agent docs; graph refreshed; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here; whitelabel ASCII copy.

## Done signal

Merged to main behind the flag, tests green, a comment here listing the actions and a screenshot of the Fleet list.

## Blockers

[EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42>), [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43>), [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50>); soft: [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25>) for uploads.

issues.title: F4.3 Build the activity timeline: interactions, notes and history from other sets
issues.description:
## Goal

Opening a person or organisation shows everything that has happened with them, in time order, from calls and notes to orders and invoices, and the agent can read and add to it.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" /> sections 5 (Interaction, Note, timeline projection) and 7 (agent behaviour).
* Other sets publish domain events on the change feed (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />) that name a party; the timeline subscribes, it does not own those records.
* Notes are Yjs documents embedded in the Party record (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />).

## Scope

1. Table `interaction` (kinds call, meeting, email, message, visit, note; direction; occurred at; duration; summary; source; external message id; links to Event (F1), Opportunity, Task (F3)) with many-to-many `interaction_party`.
2. Actions `crm.interaction.log` / `update` / `delete`, `crm.note.create` / `update`, `crm.timeline.get` (filter by kind, source, date; cursor paging).
3. A timeline projection service that merges local rows with change feed entries registered by other sets through a `TimelineContributor` contract (kind, party ids, title, link action). F4 ships contributors for its own entities; other sets add theirs.
4. `lastInteractionAt` per party, maintained from the projection, used by F4.10 suggestions.
5. Screens: Timeline component on Person and Organisation detail; Log interaction dialog; Note editor (Rambo-UI RichTextEditor on Yjs).
6. Voice: when <issue id="7bd596ca-10db-4e11-bced-7aa22fc64269" label="EVE-31" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-31/port-voice-input-and-transcription-for-the-agent" /> exists, the log dialog accepts dictation; until then text only.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: log, edit and delete with undo; timeline paging stable under concurrent inserts; a fake contributor's event appears for the right party and not for others; a member without read on the source record does not see that entry.
* Two devices edit the same note offline and converge after reconnect (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> harness).
* The agent answers "when did we last speak to this client and about what" with the interaction cited.
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no note text in telemetry or logs; WCAG 2.2 AA; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green, the contributor contract documented in ai-docs for other feature sets, and the offline note check recorded.

issues.title: F12.7 Build the payments file and the pay run events for accounting
issues.description:
## Goal

After a run is submitted, finance downloads one payment file for every net payment, and accounting receives one event per run with every cost on its event, phase and department.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-61](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets>), sections 4 and 8. Net figures come from F12.5 results; freelancer amounts from F12.6.
* Boundary agreed with F11 (<issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />) on 2026-11-01: F12 does not post journals. It emits change-feed events (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />); F11 maps them to accounts (<issue id="0a4ea4c5-5ab9-4f19-acf4-0b5e66767a62" label="EVE-90" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-90/f112-build-posting-rules-that-turn-sales-stock-and-payroll-events-into" />) and reconciles the net wages payment (<issue id="2c2a9287-a031-45ab-9b4c-b32a11def2b5" label="EVE-157" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-157/f116-build-bank-import-feeds-matching-and-reconciliation" />).

## Scope

1. `PaymentRail` neutral port with a file adapter only in this issue: UK Bacs Standard 18 layout (verify the current specification at build time), plus a generic CSV. No payment provider API.
2. `payroll.payment.prepare` (approval always): build a PaymentBatch from a completed run; bank details are read from F13's encrypted SensitiveProfile (<issue id="636f7592-553b-41f2-adb0-9a336d0188e3" label="EVE-116" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-116/f132-build-the-sensitive-profile-with-field-masking-reveal-audit-and" />) only at file generation and never stored in F12.
3. Emit `payroll:run_approved` once per run when it reaches completed (net results imported): pay run id, pay date, period, and per cost dimension (F1 Event, Phase, Department where known) gross pay, employer NI, employer pension, employee deductions (PAYE, employee NI, pension, student loan, other) and net pay, plus freelancer self-bill totals separately; integer minor units with currency. Idempotency key = run id.
4. Emit `payroll:run_reversed` with the correcting amounts in the same shape when a run is reversed. Account mapping lives in F11 ([EVE-90](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-90/f112-build-posting-rules-that-turn-sales-stock-and-payroll-events-into>)), not here.
5. Steps added to the pay run stepper with projections and bindings ([EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>)).

## Acceptance criteria

* Payment file for the fixture matches a committed snapshot and totals to net pay.
* The event's per-dimension gross sums to the run gross and its net to the payment file total.
* Replaying the change feed delivers the event for a run once per consumer (same idempotency key), in a test.
* Bank details are absent from storage after the file is generated (test).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no zod; behind the `payroll` flag; no new dependency without approval on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Tests green on main; comment with the event schema, shared with the F11 posting issue (<issue id="0a4ea4c5-5ab9-4f19-acf4-0b5e66767a62" label="EVE-90" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-90/f112-build-posting-rules-that-turn-sales-stock-and-payroll-events-into" />).
