issues.title: F7.2 Build driver eligibility checks from staff qualifications
issues.description:
## Goal

Before a person is allocated to drive a vehicle, Eventiva says whether they are eligible on that date and why not, using the licence and qualification records held once in staff records.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>), action `fleet.driver.checkEligibility`, decision D5 (recommended: F13 owns licences as Qualifications; F7 only reads).
* VehicleType from F7.1 carries the licence categories it needs (for example UK B, C1, D1) and optional extra qualifications (for example forklift, 4x4 training).
* F13 (<issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />) Worker and Qualification of a QualificationType are referenced, not redefined. The `QualificationReader` port is built by F13 in <issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" /> and shared with F2: per person and date it returns qualifications (type key, category, validFrom, expiresAt, restrictions as codes plus text, verified), age band and contract type. UK licence categories B, C1, C, D1, D and extras such as 4x4 and forklift are seeded as qualification types. Until <issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" /> lands, use an in-memory test layer of that port.

## Scope

1. Consume the <issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" /> `QualificationReader` port (do not define a second one); provide an in-memory test layer with fixtures.
2. Action `fleet.driver.checkEligibility(worker, vehicleOrType, date)` returning `{ eligible, reasons[] }` with reasons: MissingCategory, Expired, ExpiresBeforeBookingEnds, MissingExtraQualification, Restricted, Unverified, WorkerInactive (status left or failed right to work).
3. Eligibility shown wherever a driver is picked (F7.3 booking, F7.6 unit form) as a badge with reasons.
4. If D5 is answered (b) instead, this issue adds a DriverLicence entity in F7 with the same check; the action contract does not change.

## Acceptance criteria

* Table tests cover each reason, including a licence expiring mid-booking.
* The check is a read action reachable from every surface; the agent can explain why a driver is not eligible.
* No licence numbers or dates appear in telemetry or logs.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; behind `eventiva-fleet`; personal data stays in F13 (UK GDPR minimisation); no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, reason table tests green, comment here with the action schema.

## Blockers

[EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43>); F7.1 (vehicle types); <issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" /> QualificationReader (or the test layer above).

issues.title: F13.1 Build worker records, engagements and organisation structure
issues.description:
## Goal

Every employee, freelancer, volunteer and agency crew member in a tenant has one Worker record with versioned engagement terms, a department, a position and a manager, created and changed through actions that people and the agent share.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />, sections 4 (Workers and organisation), 5 and 9. Status Proposed until Jonathan approves decisions 1 and 2 on <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />.
* A Worker is the HR view of an F4 Person within one tenant; F4 owns name and contact details and is not redefined here. Agency crew link to an F4 Organisation through supplierOrgId.
* Storage and tenant guards from <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />; schema helpers from the shared schema package (<issue id="c31b6b08-1532-4a7a-945f-24a70bbab765" label="EVE-23" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23/split-core-into-portable-contracts-and-backend-runtime-with-a-shared" />); actions from <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />; authorization and audit from <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />.

## Scope

1. `hr` extension package with Drizzle tables for Worker, Engagement (append-only versions with effectiveFrom), Department, Position, ReportingLine (effective-dated), all tenant-scoped.
2. Actions: `hr.workers.create`, `.update`, `.get`, `.list`, `.archive`; `hr.engagements.create`, `.update`, `.end`; `hr.departments.*`; `hr.positions.*`; `hr.reportingLines.set`; `hr.orgChart.get`, with the inputs, outputs, permissions and approvals in [EVE-80](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave>) section 4.
3. Worker status machine (candidate, onboarding, active, suspended, left) as an [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state>) state machine; only actions change status.
4. Reporting line cycle detection rejects a change with a typed `ReportingCycle` error.
5. Permission grants hr:workers:*, hr:engagements:*, hr:org:\* registered with [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and>), and the default role mapping in [EVE-80](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave>) section 9.
6. Offline sync rules from [EVE-80](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave>) section 5 for these entities (field-level last writer wins on profile fields, server-authoritative status, versioned engagements).
7. CSV import and export of workers through an `HrImport` port (no vendor).
8. Worker references the F4 Person by party id (<issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" />) and holds employment data only; F13 registers as a PartyReferenceOwner (<issue id="7692d04c-3444-4989-b2aa-b73a1a69ab02" label="EVE-99" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-99/f44-find-and-merge-duplicate-contacts-and-import-and-export-them" />) so a Person merge rewrites Worker references, with a test that merges two Persons and keeps one Worker per tenant.

## Acceptance criteria

* Create an employee, a freelancer and a volunteer from existing F4 Persons; each has one Worker per tenant; a second tenant cannot read them (negative test).
* Two offline edits to an engagement produce two versions; the later effectiveFrom wins and both are kept and flagged.
* Making A report to B and B report to A fails with `ReportingCycle`.
* `hr.engagements.end` does not run until a second HR admin approves.
* Every action is in the inventory, passes the <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> parity target and writes one audit row.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules (Schema input, `Data.TaggedError`, services as `Context.Tag`, `@effect/vitest`); no zod; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; behind the `hr-module` flag defaulting off; ship to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Extension merged to main, tests green, and a comment here listing the actions and tables.

## Blockers

<issue id="c31b6b08-1532-4a7a-945f-24a70bbab765" label="EVE-23" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23/split-core-into-portable-contracts-and-backend-runtime-with-a-shared" />, <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />, <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />; F4 Person and Organisation entities.

issues.title: F4.4 Find and merge duplicate contacts, and import and export them
issues.description:
## Goal

A tenant can bring its existing contacts in from a file without creating duplicates, merge the duplicates that do exist safely, and take its data out again.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" /> sections 4 (duplicate, merge, import, export actions), 7 and decision D5 (suggest, merge on confirm, unmerge; recommended).
* Files come through <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />; long imports run as durable jobs (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />).
* Merge must rewrite references owned by other sets (EventRole, Task (F3), orders, invoices), so it uses a `PartyReferenceOwner` contract each set registers.

## Scope

1. Duplicate scoring: exact email or phone (normalised E.164), then name similarity plus shared organisation or domain. Pure function, unit tested; thresholds in tenant settings (<issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />), defaults suggest at 0.8.
2. Actions `crm.duplicate.find`, `crm.duplicate.dismiss`, `crm.party.merge` (confirm), `crm.party.unmerge` (within 30 days), `crm.import.start`, `crm.import.preview`, `crm.import.commit` (confirm), `crm.export.run` (confirm).
3. Merge record with field choices and reference rewrites; unmerge replays it in reverse. Merged parties keep `merged_into` so old links resolve.
4. Import formats: CSV with column mapping and vCard 3 and 4, written in-house (no library without approval here). Preview shows creates, updates and duplicate candidates before commit.
5. Export: CSV and vCard, filtered, as a file in <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />, logged in audit.
6. Screens: Duplicates review, Import wizard; merge and export are online only and disabled offline with the reason.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: merge moves every registered reference and unmerge restores it; merging across tenants is impossible; an import of 1,000 rows with 50 known duplicates creates 950 and suggests 50; an import interrupted mid-job resumes without double creates.
* The agent proposes duplicates after an import and merges a pair only after the user confirms.
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; merge and import run on the server only; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green, the `PartyReferenceOwner` contract documented for other sets, and the 1,000 row import evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

<issue id="d71c315c-52d0-4e04-b37a-88b4e1db7827" label="EVE-68" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68/f41-build-people-organisations-and-contact-points-as-crm-actions" /> (F4.1), <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />.

issues.title: F7.3 Build vehicle bookings and allocation to events without clashes
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser requests vehicles for an F1 Event or Phase, a fleet manager allocates owned vehicles or hires them in, and Eventiva never lets the same vehicle be booked twice for overlapping times.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) actions `fleet.booking.*`, `fleet.hire.requestFromVendor`; entity VehicleBooking; screen Fleet calendar; journeys J1 and J2.
* Builds on the booking primitives of [EVE-33](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33>) (availability, bookings). F1 entities per [EVE-73](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73>) section 5: a booking attaches to an Event, optionally a Phase (load in, load out) and a Space (dock or yard), and may fulfil an EquipmentRequirement (event, phase, department, catalogue ref, quantity, needed from/to). Moving people is F1 ItineraryItem kind travel, not a vehicle booking.
* Bookings are written online only; the server is authoritative and a clash is a typed error, never a merge.

## Scope

1. VehicleBooking on top of <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" /> bookings, with states requested, vendor pending, allocated, released (state machine from [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42>)).
2. Actions: `fleet.booking.request` (by vehicle or by type), `allocate`, `release`, `reassign`, `listConflicts`; `fleet.hire.requestFromVendor` creates a vendor-pending booking and a task for the hire company (F4 Organisation). Typed errors: BookingClash, VehicleOffRoad, DriverNotEligible (from F7.2), VendorNotLinked.
3. Allocation checks: overlap, road status (F7.4), driver eligibility (F7.2), vehicle capacity against the request.
4. Fleet calendar screen: rows per vehicle, bars per booking, clash highlighting; projection includes visible range, rows and clashes.
5. Hire company external view: sees only bookings of its own vehicles and can confirm or decline.
6. Approvals: agent `fleet.hire.requestFromVendor` always needs approval; `reassign` on an event that is live asks confirm.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two concurrent `allocate` calls for overlapping times on one vehicle: exactly one succeeds, the other gets BookingClash (concurrency test).
* Allocating an off-road vehicle fails with VehicleOffRoad.
* A hire company user sees only its vehicles' bookings (negative test).
* The agent can plan vehicles for an event from its Phases and transport EquipmentRequirements and present proposed allocations without writing until approved.
* Changes appear on other open calendars through the change feed within 2 seconds in the local test stack.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-fleet`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, clash test green, comment here with a calendar screenshot and the action list.

## Blockers

[EVE-33](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33>), [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42>), [EVE-45](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45>); F7.1, F7.2; F1 Event and Phase.

issues.title: F12.8 Build labour cost reporting per event and phase
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser sees what crew and staff cost for each event and phase against budget, from rostered (forecast) through approved (accrued) to paid (actual), without seeing any individual's pay.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" />, sections 4, 6 and 9. Events and phases are F1's; budget lines are F11's.
* Charts and saved dashboards come from <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" /> once ported; until then a Rambo-UI table and chart.

## Scope

1. `payroll.report.labourCost`: group by event, phase, role, department or period; three columns: forecast (rostered shifts times rate card), accrued (approved timesheets), actual (locked runs).
2. Aggregation hides individuals: groups of fewer than 3 workers are merged for viewers without `payroll:read`.
3. "Labour cost" screen with projection and bindings; the agent reads the same projection.
4. Export to CSV through the same action.

## Acceptance criteria

* For the fixture, actual by event sums to the run gross and matches the F12.7 journal.
* An organiser asking the agent "what did crew cost for the load-out" gets the phase total and cannot get a per-person figure.
* Forecast updates when a shift is added to the roster (change feed), in a test.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no zod; behind the `payroll` flag; no new dependency without approval on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Screen and action on main with tests; screenshot attached here.

issues.title: F4.5 Organise contacts with tags, lists and smart lists
issues.description:
## Goal

People can group contacts by tag, hand-picked list or saved filter, and other sets (ticketing, sales, a later marketing set) can use those groups as audiences.

## Context

* Parent [EVE-65](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history>) sections 4 and 5 (Tag, List, SmartList).
* Search across resources is [EVE-26](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-26/port-search-and-embeddings-across-every-resource>); smart lists use structured filters on F4 fields and do not need embeddings.

## Scope

1. Tables `tag`, `party_tag`, `list`, `list_member`, `smart_list` (named SmartList, not Segment, which is an F1 run of show entity; Effect Schema filter definition over Party, Person, Organisation, EventRole, consent state and `lastInteractionAt`).
2. Actions `crm.tag.create` / `rename` / `delete` / `apply` / `remove`, `crm.list.create` / `update` / `delete` / `addMembers` / `removeMembers`, `crm.smartList.create` / `update` / `delete` / `evaluate`.
3. SmartList evaluation runs on Postgres online and on SQLite offline over the locally synced subset, with a flag in the result saying which.
4. An `Audience` contract (list or smart list id to party ids, respecting consent purpose) exported for other sets.
5. Screens: FilterBar save-as-smart-list on Contacts list, Lists page, tag chips on detail pages.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: tag set merge offline follows the add-wins rule; smart list results equal on Postgres and SQLite for the same data; Audience excludes parties without consent for the requested purpose.
* The agent builds "venue contacts in Manchester we have not spoken to this year" as a smart list from that sentence.
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; WCAG 2.2 AA; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green and the Audience contract documented in ai-docs.

## Blockers

<issue id="d71c315c-52d0-4e04-b37a-88b4e1db7827" label="EVE-68" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68/f41-build-people-organisations-and-contact-points-as-crm-actions" /> (F4.1); F4.8 for consent-aware Audience (the contract can land first with consent filtering stubbed to deny).

issues.title: F6.2 Build locations and the append-only stock movement ledger
issues.description:
## Goal

Every quantity of every product has a place, and every change to stock is one recorded movement that people, agents and offline devices can add without conflicting.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> decision D1 (recommended): append-only movement ledger with derived levels, modelled on double-entry moves between locations (including virtual locations), as in the market check.
* Offline record sync comes from <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> on the engine <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> selects; movement ids are client-generated UUIDv7 and idempotent (<issue id="1b79a257-9ea0-40b5-a8f7-23e1c09221be" label="EVE-39" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39/make-every-entity-action-idempotent-and-persisted-by-default" />).
* Domain events go on the change feed (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />) so the shortage detector (F6.12) and F11 can react.

## Scope

1. Tables `inventory_location` (tree: `warehouse`, `zone`, `bin`, `vehicle` referencing an F7 Vehicle, `event-site` referencing an F1 Event, `supplier`, `customer`, `repair`, `virtual` for adjustment, lost and scrap) and `inventory_movement` (product, optional asset, qty, from, to, reason, refs, actor person or agent, device, occurred_at, recorded_at). Movements are insert only; no update or delete path exists.
2. A derived `StockLevel` projection per product and location, rebuilt on device and server from movements; never written directly.
3. Actions `inventory.location.create`, `update`, `archive`; `inventory.stock.move`; `inventory.stock.adjust` (to or from the virtual adjustment location, approval confirm above an org threshold from <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> settings); `inventory.stock.levels` with an as-of time.
4. A negative level after merge raises a `negative-stock` Discrepancy (table owned by F6.6; until F6.6 lands, write a domain event `inventory:negative_stock`).
5. Domain events `inventory:stock_moved` and `inventory:stock_adjusted` on the change feed.
6. Screen Locations (Rambo-UI Tree and DataTable) with its <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection and bound controls.
7. Sync scopes: a device receives movements for the warehouses and events it is scoped to.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two offline devices each record 10 moves of the same bulk product; after reconnect both devices and the server show identical levels and 20 movements, with no conflict prompts.
* Replaying the same movement id twice stores it once.
* An adjustment above the threshold requires confirm when called by a person or by the agent (approval test).
* A level going negative after merge emits `inventory:negative_stock`.
* `inventory.stock.levels` as of a past time returns the level at that time.
* Archiving a location that holds stock fails with `LocationNotEmpty`.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-inventory`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the two-device convergence test green and its output pasted here.

issues.title: F12.9 Build the payroll agent: explanations, anomaly suggestions and approval gates
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent can do every payroll step a person can, explains any pay figure in plain words, and spots likely mistakes before a run is locked, while never locking, submitting or paying without a human.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="335d2890-1b10-44eb-89f0-b9a032afacfa" label="EVE-61" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-61/f12-payroll-pay-staff-and-crew-from-rosters-and-approved-timesheets" />, section 7. All F12 actions already exist from F12.1 to F12.8; this issue adds agent skills, proactive checks and evaluations, not new business logic.
* Agent loop <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />, durable runs <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />, screen awareness <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />, evaluations <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" />.

## Scope

1. A payroll skill for the agent: how to prepare a run, read exceptions, use `payroll.run.explainLine`, and which actions need approval.
2. Proactive suggestions behind `payroll-agent-suggestions` (default off), each a suggestion card the user accepts or dismisses: hours versus roster over threshold, missing clock-out, working-time limit, below-minimum effective rate, freelancer without engagement status, run total versus last comparable run over threshold (default 20 percent).
3. Approval gates: confirm that every `always` action fails for the agent without a recorded human approval, across UI chat, MCP inbound (<issue id="37c126a9-64e0-4235-88f0-494533c8e3a2" label="EVE-48" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-48/p19-build-inbound-mcp-from-the-action-inventory" />) and ACP inbound (<issue id="937d4311-ff71-4bd1-b167-846d08afc64f" label="EVE-49" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-49/p110-build-inbound-acp-so-editors-can-drive-eventivas-agent" />).
4. Evaluation set: 20 questions ("why is Sam's pay higher this week", "what did night crew cost on event X") with expected answers, linked to PostHog datasets via <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" />.
5. Privacy: the agent acting for a worker sees only that worker; prompts and telemetry carry no amounts or names by default.

## Acceptance criteria

* The agent prepares a run for the fixture and stops at lock with an approval request.
* Each proactive check fires on a seeded case and stays silent on a clean one.
* The evaluation set passes at 90 percent or better and is wired into CI as a report, not a gate.
* A worker's agent asking for another worker's pay gets a permission error on every interface.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no zod; behind the flags above; no new model provider or dependency without approval on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Skill, checks and evaluation report on main; results pasted here.

issues.title: F4.8 Record consent and fulfil privacy requests for contacts
issues.description:
## Goal

Eventiva knows, for every person, what they agreed to and on what legal basis, blocks any send they did not agree to, and lets a tenant answer access and erasure requests on time.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" /> sections 5 (ConsentRecord, PrivacyRequest), 11 (compliance: UK and EU GDPR, PECR, CAN-SPAM, CCPA/CPRA) and 7 (erasure always needs human approval).
* Sends go through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />; this issue adds a consent check that <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> calls before any marketing send.
* Erasure must reach records other sets own, through the `PartyReferenceOwner` contract from F4.4, and keep legally required finance records (F11) as tombstones.

## Scope

1. Append-only `consent_record` (purpose, channel, lawful basis, state, source, captured at, evidence) and `privacy_request` (kind, status, due at, fulfilled by, result file).
2. Actions `crm.consent.record` / `withdraw` / `get`, `crm.consent.check` (purpose, channel, party; used by senders), `crm.privacy.requestExport` / `requestErasure` / `requestRectification` / `fulfil` (`always` approval for erasure) / `list`.
3. Export bundle: every record about the party across registered owners, as JSON plus a readable summary, stored via <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.
4. Erasure job (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />): removes personal fields, replaces with a tombstone where a set declares a legal hold, writes one audit row per owner touched.
5. Due-date tracking (one month from receipt by default, tenant setting) with a notification at 7 days left (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />).
6. Tenant retention policy settings (defaults in the parent, section 11) and a scheduled purge of archived parties past retention.
7. Screens: Consent tab on Person detail, Consent and privacy admin page.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: a withdrawal recorded offline and synced before a queued send blocks that send; erasure leaves no personal field in any registered owner except legal holds; an erasure cannot run without a human approval even when the agent requests it; export contains records from at least two owners.
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no personal data in telemetry; legal wording reviewed by Jonathan before customer release; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green and a compliance note in the people docs listing what is and is not covered.

## Blockers

<issue id="d71c315c-52d0-4e04-b37a-88b4e1db7827" label="EVE-68" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-68/f41-build-people-organisations-and-contact-points-as-crm-actions" /> (F4.1), <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />; <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> for the send check; F4.4 for the reference owner contract.

issues.title: F7.4 Build offline walkaround inspections and defect reporting
issues.description:
## Goal

A driver completes a vehicle walkaround check on their phone with no signal, reports defects with photos, and a serious defect takes the vehicle off road and flags its bookings.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) actions `fleet.inspection.*`, `fleet.defect.*`, `fleet.vehicle.setRoadStatus`, `fleet.odometer.record`; entities InspectionTemplate, Inspection, Defect; journey J2.
* Supports operators' daily check duties (for example DVSA walkaround guidance) without claiming certification (parent section 11).
* Offline writes use the sync engine chosen in [EVE-17](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17>).

## Scope

1. InspectionTemplate per VehicleType, versioned: items, required photos, severity if failed (advisory, fix soon, off road). A default template ships for van, minibus and HGV, editable by the tenant.
2. Actions: `fleet.inspection.start`, `submit` (answers, photos, odometer, device time), `fleet.defect.raise`, `triage`, `close`, `fleet.vehicle.setRoadStatus`. Inspections and defects are append-only and created offline.
3. Defect state machine: open, triaged, in repair, closed; illegal transitions replayed from offline are rejected with a typed error and the author is told.
4. Off-road rule: a failed item with severity off road sets the vehicle off road on the server, and every future booking of that vehicle gets a warning for F7.3 and F7.12.
5. Mobile Inspection screen with Checklist, camera and odometer input; projection includes template, answers so far and offline state.
6. Returning a vehicle to on road asks confirm and records who did it.

## Acceptance criteria

* In airplane mode, a full inspection with two photos and one off-road defect is stored; on reconnect it syncs, the vehicle goes off road and its bookings show the warning.
* A defect closed on the server while an offline device adds a note: the note is kept as a new entry, the closed state stands.
* Odometer lower than the last reading is flagged, not stored as current.
* The agent can submit an inspection from a spoken or typed checklist only for the signed-in driver.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-fleet`; photos through [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25>) files; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, offline test green on web and Android (device run recorded), comment here with the run evidence.

## Blockers

[EVE-17](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17>), [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42>), [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50>), [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25>); F7.1.

issues.title: F9 Online and in-person sales: storefront, point of sale, orders, payments, fulfilment and refunds
issues.description:
Status: Decisions approved (Jonathan, 2026-11-08: D1 to D7 all as recommended). Still planning only: no code until implementation is requested, and each new dependency and the vendor account are approved on the child issue that adds them. Follows the [Feature set spec template](<https://linear.app/resnovas/document/feature-set-spec-template-and-list-26b9f78cf17a>).

## 1. Goal

An organiser sells products, services and tickets for an event online and in person, from one catalogue and one order list, takes payment even when the venue loses connectivity, and fulfils, refunds and reconciles every sale without leaving Eventiva.

## 2. Users and jobs

| User | Jobs |
| -- | -- |
| Organiser or sales manager | Build the catalogue, set prices per event and channel, open sales channels (online store, booths, box office), set offline limits, watch sales live, approve refunds |
| Cashier (crew on a phone, tablet or desktop) | Open a register session with a cash float, ring up sales fast, take card or cash, print or send a receipt, keep selling offline, close the session and count cash |
| Fulfilment staff | Pick and pack shipped orders, hand over click-and-collect and on-site collection orders, mark digital items delivered |
| Finance | See payouts, fees, refunds and cash variances; export to accounting (F11) |
| Attendee or customer | Browse the store, pay as a guest or signed in, see order history, get receipts, request a refund |
| Vendor (F5 directory listing) | Sell its own products at an organiser's event under the organiser's rules, receive its share (slice F9.12) |
| Agent | Everything a person with the same permissions can do: draft catalogues from a supplier list, answer "what sold at booth 3", prepare refunds for approval, flag reconciliation gaps |

## 3. Market check

Checked 2026-11-01 against vendor documentation. Names stay out of customer-facing copy.

* **Shopify (online store plus POS).** One catalogue, customer list and order list across online and in-person. Offline card payments on supported readers only, with a per-device daily limit and a per-order limit set by the merchant; payments are captured on reconnect, reconnecting within 24 hours is recommended, and declines are found only after reconnect. Tap to Pay and manual card entry do not work offline. ([help](<https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/selling-offline/offline-payments>))
* **Square POS.** Offline payments must be uploaded within 72 hours (24 recommended) or they expire unrecoverably; the seller sets a per-transaction maximum and bears expired, declined and disputed offline payments. Tap to Pay, gift cards and keyed cards are not supported offline. ([help](<https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7777>))
* **Stripe Terminal (payment platform, the likely first adapter).** Store-and-forward offline payments on Bluetooth readers and smart readers through the iOS, Android and React Native SDKs; Tap to Pay on Android has no offline mode, Tap to Pay on iPhone offline is in private preview; in the EEA offline payments need chip and PIN. ([docs](<https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/operate-offline/overview>))

Where Eventiva matches: one catalogue and order list for every channel; offline card sales with explicit per-device and per-order limits and a visible risk; cash always works offline.

Where Eventiva differs: channels are scoped to an F1 Event and Phase (a booth, a box office, the online store for that event) rather than to a shop; tickets (F8), stock (F6) and bookable services (F2) plug into one checkout through a line provider contract; cashiers use the same app as every other role, unlocked by permission; every operation is an action an agent can call (<issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> parity rule), including refunds under approval.

## 4. Capabilities as actions

Every action follows <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />: Effect Schema input and output, typed errors, one permission, approval policy, side-effect class and receipt. Money is always `{ amountMinor: integer, currency: ISO 4217 }`. Permissions are `sales:<resource>:<verb>` scoped to the org and optionally an F1 Event.

| Action | Input | Output | Permission | Approval |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| sales.product.create / update / archive | name, kind (physical, digital, service, fee, donation, hire), variants, tax category, F6 Product id, images ([EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import>)), event ids | Product | sales:catalogue:write | none |
| sales.product.list / get | filters, channel | Product\[\] | sales:catalogue:read (public on an open channel) | none |
| sales.price.set | product or variant, price list, amount, valid from/to | Price | sales:catalogue:write | confirm when an open channel is affected |
| sales.priceList.create | name, currency, tax inclusive flag, channel ids | PriceList | sales:catalogue:write | none |
| sales.taxRate.resolve | product tax category, channel region, date | F11 tax code id and rate | system | none |
| sales.channel.create / open / close | kind (online, register, box office, booth), F1 Event id, optional F1 Phase and Space ids, price list, payment methods, offline limits | Channel | sales:channel:write | confirm on open |
| sales.lineProvider.register | line kind, reserve, commit, release action names, offline mode (online only, allocation, deltas) | Registration | system (module activation) | none |
| sales.cart.create / addLine / updateLine / removeLine | channel, line kind, reference id, quantity, modifiers | Cart with totals | sales:cart:write (own cart for customers) | none |
| sales.cart.applyDiscount | cart, code or discount id | Cart | sales:cart:write | none |
| sales.checkout.start | cart, customer (F4 contact or guest email), fulfilment choice | Checkout with payment session | sales:cart:write | none |
| [sales.order.place](<http://sales.order.place>) | checkout or offline cart, client order id, idempotency key | Order | sales:order:write | none |
| sales.order.list / get | filters | Order\[\] | sales:order:read (own orders for customers) | none |
| sales.order.cancel | order, reason | Order | sales:order:write | confirm |
| sales.order.addCharge | order, reason (damage, late return, extra), amount | Order with charge line | sales:order:write | confirm |
| sales.order.invoiceOnAccount | order, F4 organisation | Order handed to F11 | sales:order:write and finance | always |
| sales.payment.create | order, method (card online, card present, cash, voucher, gift card, on account), amount | Payment | sales:payment:write | none |
| sales.payment.capture / void | payment | Payment | sales:payment:write | confirm on void |
| sales.payment.recordWebhook | provider event (verified signature) | Payment | system | none |
| sales.refund.request | order, lines, amounts, reason, restock flag | Refund (requested) | sales:refund:request (customers on own orders) | none |
| sales.refund.approve / reject | refund | Refund | sales:refund:approve | always for agents; confirm for people |
| sales.fulfilment.create / pack / ship / handOver / deliverDigital | order lines, method, tracking | Fulfilment | sales:fulfilment:write | none |
| sales.register.pair / unpair | device, channel | Register | sales:register:admin | confirm |
| [sales.registerSession.open](<http://sales.registerSession.open>) / close | register, opening float / counted cash | RegisterSession with variance | sales:register:operate | close needs confirm |
| sales.cashMovement.record | session, in or out, amount, reason | CashMovement | sales:register:operate | none |
| [sales.reader.discover](<http://sales.reader.discover>) / connect / disconnect | register, reader id | Reader | sales:register:operate | none |
| sales.receipt.send / print | order, channel (email, SMS, printer) | Receipt | sales:order:read | none |
| sales.discount.create / update / archive | kind (percent, fixed, buy x get y, bundle), scope, codes, limits, dates | Discount | sales:catalogue:write | none |
| sales.giftCard.issue / adjust / redeem | amount, code, expiry | GiftCard | sales:giftcard:write | adjust needs confirm |
| sales.payout.list / get | provider period | Payout with fees | sales:finance:read | none |
| [sales.reconciliation.run](<http://sales.reconciliation.run>) | channel or period | Report of mismatches | sales:finance:read | none |
| sales.report.summary | event, channel, period, group by | Sales figures | sales:report:read | none |
| sales.quote.create / revise / send / accept / decline | customer, F1 Event, lines (including hire lines with a period), valid until | Quote; accept returns Order | sales:quote:write (customers accept their own) | send needs confirm |
| sales.split.configure | channel, vendor (F5), commission rule | SplitRule | sales:channel:write | always |
| sales.settings.connectProvider / disconnectProvider | provider kind, onboarding return URL | Connection status | sales:settings:admin | always |

Navigation to each screen is an action too (`sales.screen.open`, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />).

## 5. Data model

All tables carry `org_id` and are tenant guarded (<issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />). Ids are client-generated UUIDv7 so offline creation never collides.

| Entity | Key fields | Relations | Offline sync | Conflict rule |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Product | name, kind, status, tax category, description (Yjs rich text, [EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and>)) | variants, images, F6 Product (serialised, bulk or consumable), F1 Events | read on registers; edit offline allowed | last writer wins per field; description merges as Yjs |
| Variant | sku, barcode, options | Product | read | per field LWW |
| PriceList, Price | currency, inclusive flag, amount, validity | Channel, Variant | read | server authoritative; offline sale snapshots the price it used |
| TaxCategory | name (standard, reduced, zero, exempt), mapping to F11 tax code ids by region | Product, OrderLine | read | server authoritative; F11 owns tax codes ([EVE-69](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax>)) |
| Channel | kind, F1 Event, optional F1 Phase and F1 Space (bar, stall, box office location), payment methods, offline limits | Registers, PriceList | read | server authoritative |
| Register, RegisterSession | device, opening float, counted cash, status | Channel, CashMovement | write offline | session owned by one device; append only |
| CashMovement | amount, reason | RegisterSession | write offline | append only |
| Cart | lines, totals, expires at | Channel, F4 Contact | local only for POS; server for online | single owner |
| Order | number, status machine (draft, placed, paid, partially refunded, refunded, cancelled), totals, client order id | lines, payments, fulfilments, refunds, F4 Contact, F1 Event | write offline (POS) | append only; status changes only through actions; server rejects duplicates by idempotency key |
| OrderLine | kind, reference id, reservation id, quantity, hire period (hire lines), unit price snapshot, F11 tax code id and tax amount snapshot | Order | with order | immutable after payment |
| Quote | number, status (draft, sent, accepted, declined, expired), valid until, lines as OrderLine drafts | F4 Contact or organisation, F1 Event, Order on accept | online edit, read offline | per field LWW while draft; immutable once sent (new revision instead) |
| Payment | method, amount, provider ref, status (pending, authorised, captured, failed, offline stored, offline forwarded, declined after forward) | Order | write offline (stored offline) | provider is the authority on status; webhooks win |
| Refund | lines, amount, status, approver | Order, Payment | online only | server authoritative |
| Fulfilment | method, status, tracking, collected by | Order lines | write offline for on-site hand over | append only |
| Discount, DiscountCode | rule, limits, usage count | Channel | read; usage counts synced as deltas | usage limit enforced on server; offline over-use flagged |
| GiftCard | code hash, balance | Payments | online only | server authoritative |
| SplitRule, VendorShare | F5 vendor, commission | Channel, OrderLine | read | server authoritative |
| Payout | provider period, gross, fees, net | Payments | read | provider authoritative |

Documents embedded in records: only product descriptions (Yjs text, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />). Everything that moves money is record-synced, append only, and never merged as a document.

## 6. Screens

Rambo-UI has no components yet (<issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" />); the component names below are the ones F9 asks Rambo-UI for. Each screen declares a screen-context projection (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />) and every control binds to an action.

| Screen | Components | Projection | Controls and actions |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Catalogue | DataTable, FilterBar, Tag | visible products, filters, selection | create, archive, bulk price (sales.product.\*, sales.price.set) |
| Product editor | Form, RichText, ImageUploader, VariantGrid | product draft, dirty fields | save, add variant, link stock item |
| Channels | List, StatusBadge, Sheet | channels for the event with status | create, open, close, set offline limits |
| Register (POS) | ProductTileGrid, SearchField, BarcodeInput, CartPanel, NumberPad, PaymentSheet | cart lines, totals, connectivity, reader state, offline queue size | add line, discount, take payment, park sale, receipt |
| Register session | Form, CashCount | session float, expected vs counted | open, cash in/out, close |
| Storefront (web, public) | ProductCard, CartDrawer, CheckoutForm, hosted payment field | products shown, cart | add to cart, checkout, pay |
| Orders | DataTable, StatusBadge | orders in view, filters | open order |
| Order detail | Timeline, LineList, PaymentList | order, payments, fulfilments, refunds | cancel, refund request or approve, fulfil, resend receipt |
| Fulfilment queue | KanbanBoard, ScanInput | pending fulfilments | pack, ship, hand over |
| Discounts and gift cards | DataTable, Form | rules in view | create, archive, issue |
| Sales dashboard | Chart, StatTile (<issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" /> widgets) | figures shown, period | change period, drill into orders |
| Payments settings | Form, ConnectButton | provider connection status (no secrets) | connect, disconnect, tax tables, receipt template |

## 7. Agent behaviour

* When asked: create catalogues from a pasted list or file, set prices, open a channel, answer sales questions from sales.report.summary, prepare refunds, chase failed offline payments by drafting customer messages.
* Proactively (behind the flag, as suggestions in the agent thread, never silent changes): warn when an open channel has products without stock, a register is near its offline limit, an offline batch has not forwarded within 12 hours, a register session closed with a cash variance, or reconciliation finds a mismatch.
* Approval: refunds and payment voids always need a person (`always` for agents); price changes on an open channel, channel opening, provider connection and split rules need confirmation. The agent can never move money out (payouts are provider-driven) and never sees card data or provider secrets.
* Offline: the agent on a register can read the local catalogue and queue an offline sale like a cashier; it says plainly that payment confirmation waits for connectivity.

## 8. Integrations

Each vendor sits behind a neutral Effect service in its own integration package; switching vendor changes composition only.

| Port | Purpose | First adapter (needs approval) | Notes |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| PaymentGateway | online payments, hosted fields, 3DS, refunds, webhooks, payouts, connected accounts | Stripe (Payments, Connect) | Decision D2 |
| CardTerminal | card-present payments, reader discovery, offline store and forward | Stripe Terminal React Native SDK | needs an Expo development build (native module); Tap to Pay offline is iPhone only and in private preview |
| TaxCalculator | tax lines for a cart | built-in calculator over F11 tax codes (<issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />) | Decision D4; external engine later behind the same port |
| ShippingCarrier | rates and labels | none in phase 1 (manual tracking) | F9.7 defines the port |
| ReceiptPrinter, CashDrawer, BarcodeScanner | POS peripherals | ESC/POS over network or Bluetooth; scanners as keyboard input | F9.6 |
| Notifications | receipts and order emails or SMS | [EVE-24](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email>) |  |
| Accounting | journal posting | F11 via domain events | no direct vendor |

Desktop and web registers drive smart readers over the internet (server-driven readers); Bluetooth readers need the native app. This is from memory of the provider's documentation and is verified in F9.6 before any build.

## 9. Permissions and roles

| Role | Can |
| -- | -- |
| Org owner | everything, including provider connection and split rules |
| Sales manager | catalogue, channels, discounts, approve refunds, reports |
| Cashier | operate registers they are assigned to, request refunds, see own sessions |
| Fulfilment | fulfilment queue and order detail read |
| Finance | reports, payouts, reconciliation, approve refunds, invoice on account |
| Vendor (external) | own products and sales on channels it is invited to |
| Customer or attendee | public catalogue, own carts, orders, receipts and refund requests |
| Agent | the delegating user's permissions, with the approval rules in section 7 |

Event scoping: a permission can be limited to one F1 Event, so booth crew at one event cannot see another event's sales. Revocation takes effect at sync (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />); a revoked cashier's queued offline sales still upload but are flagged for review.

## 10. Telemetry and flags

* Flag: `f9-sales` (default off), plus `f9-pos-offline-card` (default off) and `f9-vendor-splits` (default off).
* PostHog events: `sales_product_created`, `sales_channel_opened`, `sales_cart_created`, `sales_checkout_started`, `sales_order_placed` (channel, online or offline), `sales_payment_failed`, `sales_offline_payment_forwarded`, `sales_offline_payment_declined`, `sales_refund_approved`, `sales_register_session_closed` (variance bucket). No amounts per person, no card data, no emails in properties.
* Spans on every action (<issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />) with channel and register attributes; offline queue size as a bounded metric per register.
* Success metrics: online checkout conversion (checkout started to order paid); median POS sale time under 20 seconds for a single-line card sale; 100 percent of offline payments forwarded within 24 hours; zero unreconciled payments older than 7 days.

## 11. Compliance

* **Card data (PCI DSS):** Eventiva never sees or stores card numbers. Online uses the provider's hosted fields (aim SAQ A); card-present uses provider-certified readers. No card data in logs, telemetry, actions or agent context.
* **Strong customer authentication (UK and EEA):** online card payments support 3DS through the provider; offline EEA card payments need chip and PIN.
* **Consumer law:** UK and EU distance selling gives a 14-day cancellation right for goods; dated leisure services and tickets are exempt. Per-product refund policy fields and checkout text must say which applies.
* **Tax:** prices for consumers shown tax inclusive where required; receipts show tax rate and amount; VAT receipts on request. Records kept 6 years (UK) or the tenant's configured period.
* **Age-restricted products** (alcohol at events): product flag that forces an age check prompt on the register and blocks online sale unless enabled.
* **Personal data (UK GDPR):** guest checkout collects only what fulfilment needs; marketing consent separate and unticked; customer data lives in F4 contacts.
* **Merchant of record:** each tenant is the merchant of record through a connected account (D2), so chargebacks, offline declines and tax belong to the tenant, stated in onboarding.

## 12. Acceptance

* An organiser creates a product, opens an online channel and a register channel for one F1 Event, and sells the same product in both; both orders appear in one list with correct tax.
* A register sells offline (cash and card on a supported reader) through a simulated outage, the device restarts, and on reconnect every sale uploads once, payments forward, stock deltas reach F6 and one simulated decline surfaces as a task for the organiser.
* Per-device and per-order offline limits block a sale that would exceed them.
* A ticket line (F8) and a stock line (F6) in one cart reserve, commit on payment and release on cancel through the line provider contract.
* A refund requested by the agent waits for a person's approval and then refunds through the provider and restocks.
* Every action in section 4 is in the inventory and passes the parity check; every screen in section 6 has a projection and no unbound control.
* Tenant isolation: a cashier in org A cannot read org B's orders by any surface (UI, HTTP, MCP).
* Webhooks are signature checked and idempotent; replaying one changes nothing.

## 13. Out of scope

* Ticket types, capacity, holds, issued tickets and scanning (F8; F9 sells them through the line provider contract).
* Stock levels, locations and kits (F6). Ledgers, invoices on credit terms and tax returns (F11). Storefront page building (F14 supplies blocks around F9's checkout).
* Closed-loop cashless wristbands and RFID top-ups (decision D7).
* Cryptocurrency, buy now pay later, recurring subscriptions and memberships.
* Restaurant table service and kitchen display.

## 14. Dependencies

* Phase 1: [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema>) actions, [EVE-41](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials>) config and secrets, [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state>) storage, state machines and tenant guards, [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and>) identity, access and audit, [EVE-44](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor>) telemetry, [EVE-45](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change>) change feed, [EVE-46](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action>) HTTP API (webhooks, public storefront), [EVE-48](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-48/p19-build-inbound-mcp-from-the-action-inventory>) MCP, [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>) screen awareness, [EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and>) collaboration and sync, [EVE-52](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools>) and [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow>) agent loop and durable runs; [EVE-17](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and>) sync engine choice; [EVE-39](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39/make-every-entity-action-idempotent-and-persisted-by-default>) idempotent actions; [EVE-16](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web>) runtime module loading (register as a module).
* Port later: [EVE-24](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email>) notifications (receipts), [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import>) files (product images), [EVE-26](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-26/port-search-and-embeddings-across-every-resource>) search (catalogue search), [EVE-28](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-28/port-localization-for-people-and-for-the-agent>) localization (currency and number formats), [EVE-30](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits>) dashboards, [EVE-33](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters>) scheduling (bookable services).
* Feature sets: F1 Event, Phase and Space from <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> (channels and orders attach to them; F9 does not redefine them), F2 bookings, F4 contacts and organisations (customers), F5 vendors (splits), F6 stock items and reservations, F8 ticket types and holds, F11 accounting events, F14 storefront blocks.

## 15. Decisions for Jonathan

Approved 2026-11-08 by Jonathan: every decision below as recommended.

1. **D1 Order core ownership.** Recommended: F9 owns cart, checkout, orders, payments, refunds, discounts, tax lines and receipts; tickets, stock and services plug in as line providers (agreed with the F8 thread). Alternative: ticketing keeps its own checkout.
2. **D2 First payment provider and money flow.** Recommended: Stripe behind the PaymentGateway and CardTerminal ports, with Connect so each tenant is the merchant of record and receives payouts directly. Alternatives: Eventiva as merchant of record (Eventiva carries tax and chargeback liability), or a different provider. No sign-up until approved.
3. **D3 Offline card payments.** Recommended: allowed on supported readers only, behind `f9-pos-offline-card`, with per-device daily and per-order limits the organiser sets (default 0, so off until set) and an onboarding notice that the tenant bears offline declines; cash always works offline. Alternative: cash only offline in phase 1.
4. **D4 Tax.** Recommended: F11 owns tax codes and rates (agreed with the F11 thread, <issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />); F9 maps product tax categories to F11 codes and calculates with a built-in calculator behind the TaxCalculator port (UK and EU VAT, inclusive pricing); an external tax engine later behind the same port. Alternative: external tax engine from day one.
5. **D5 Vendor sales at events.** Recommended: spec now as F9.12 (split payments to F5 vendors through connected accounts), build after F9.3. Alternative: organiser-only selling.
6. **D6 Offline capacity for tickets and stock.** Recommended: providers choose per kind; tickets use a pre-allocated per-device allocation, stock accepts deltas and flags oversell. Alternative: tickets and stock online only.
7. **D7 Cashless wristbands.** Recommended: not in F9; add as its own feature set later if wanted. Alternative: add a closed-loop wallet slice to F9 now.

## 16. Child issues

Build order:

 1. <issue id="e55754d3-8af2-475b-b490-e7b20cae65d1" label="EVE-170" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-170/f91-build-money-tax-categories-and-the-sales-catalogue" /> F9.1 Money, tax categories and the sales catalogue
 2. <issue id="abed6fe8-6b29-4b7e-a000-1c86807a8f2c" label="EVE-172" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-172/f92-build-carts-orders-and-the-line-provider-contract" /> F9.2 Carts, orders and the line provider contract
 3. <issue id="382cab34-de6b-4524-8a47-241353c76b2b" label="EVE-174" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-174/f93-build-the-payment-gateway-port-and-online-card-payments" /> F9.3 Payment gateway port and online card payments
 4. <issue id="103d5051-73d7-4e57-8f7d-1d0fc94a91c2" label="EVE-175" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-175/f94-build-the-online-storefront-and-checkout" /> F9.4 Online storefront and checkout
 5. <issue id="4d5d9722-8038-4ed7-b9d3-856fda167c1b" label="EVE-176" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-176/f95-build-the-point-of-sale-register-cash-sessions-and-offline-sales" /> F9.5 Point of sale register, cash sessions and offline sales
 6. <issue id="7d7d9605-7484-434c-a7f4-94ae60cb29f7" label="EVE-213" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-213/f96-build-card-readers-offline-card-payments-and-pos-peripherals" /> F9.6 Card readers, offline card payments and POS peripherals
 7. <issue id="e6d138a5-3414-4a9e-be12-b0ea7c6912c4" label="EVE-214" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-214/f97-build-fulfilment-for-shipping-collection-on-site-hand-over-and" /> F9.7 Fulfilment for shipping, collection, on-site hand over and digital items
 8. <issue id="cc848306-1827-4682-a18a-e5c255970dd3" label="EVE-215" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-215/f98-build-refunds-cancellations-exchanges-and-disputes" /> F9.8 Refunds, cancellations, exchanges and disputes
 9. <issue id="57dd2b4b-8a5b-4378-8572-612882aa0aaa" label="EVE-216" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-216/f99-build-discounts-vouchers-and-gift-cards" /> F9.9 Discounts, vouchers and gift cards
10. <issue id="f8a0c220-fbb9-4ea9-9cdc-1a7eb1a26d65" label="EVE-218" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-218/f910-build-bookable-services-sold-through-checkout" /> F9.10 Bookable services sold through checkout
11. <issue id="5a243280-5cb5-4b48-affd-917d0c670b89" label="EVE-222" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-222/f911-build-receipts-reconciliation-sales-reporting-and-accounting" /> F9.11 Receipts, reconciliation, sales reporting and accounting events
12. <issue id="05f45c5a-d89d-44e3-b726-e3a04db95a21" label="EVE-223" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-223/f912-build-vendor-sales-at-events-with-split-payments" /> F9.12 Vendor sales at events with split payments
13. <issue id="0269d0d3-7024-4049-9a91-c905c60bfb90" label="EVE-224" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-224/f913-build-the-sales-agent-behaviours-and-approvals" /> F9.13 Sales agent behaviours and approvals
14. <issue id="cfb28085-7680-4a9c-95c3-c85b34c97459" label="EVE-225" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-225/f914-build-quotes-deposits-and-equipment-hire-orders" /> F9.14 Quotes, deposits and equipment hire orders

F9.3 and F9.5 can run in parallel after F9.2; F9.7, F9.9, F9.10 and F9.14 can run in parallel after F9.3.

Agreed with other feature sets on 2026-11-01: F8 ticketing implements line kind `ticket` (ticketing.hold.create, ticketing.ticket.issueForOrder, ticketing.ticket.void); F6 ([EVE-63](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing>)) implements kind `stock` and `hire` (inventory.reservation.create, commit, release; offline sales are commutative movements, oversell shows as a negative-stock Discrepancy); F11 ([EVE-69](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax>)) consumes sales:order_paid, sales:refund_completed, sales:payment_fee_recorded, sales:payout_settled and sales:register_session_closed, takes invoiceOnAccount into F11.4 and emits accounting:invoice_settled back; F11 owns tax codes. F4 (<issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" />): buyers are F4 Persons by Party id, order events name the party for the contact timeline (<issue id="c3695c62-5106-4bd6-8ce1-c7dff1d14427" label="EVE-95" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-95/f43-build-the-activity-timeline-interactions-notes-and-history-from" />), marketing sends call crm.consent.check (<issue id="4b6f8805-b1b2-40f7-99e9-089c9adb8002" label="EVE-105" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-105/f48-record-consent-and-fulfil-privacy-requests-for-contacts" />), enquiries and opportunities stay in F4 while quotes and deposits are F9. F1 (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />): channels and orders attach to Event, optional Phase and Space.

issues.title: F10 Interactive site maps
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only; no implementation until Jonathan asks. Spec template: [Feature set spec template and list](<https://linear.app/resnovas/document/feature-set-spec-template-and-list-26b9f78cf17a>). F1 (events and production planning, <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />) entities are referenced by name (Event, Phase, Space, ProductionPlan, DesignElement, RunOfShow, Itinerary) and not redefined here. F1 stores `Space.site_map_zone_ref` (a Zone id here) and uses a SiteMap as the base map of a ProductionPlan; F7 (<issue id="37310611-807d-43de-a5fb-ff53dc3a494e" label="EVE-71" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71/f7-fleet-and-live-operations-vehicles-maintenance-units-dispatch-and" />) stores Zone ids on incidents and registers a live unit-positions layer.

## 1. Goal

An organiser draws an accurate, to-scale map of any site once (an outdoor field or festival, an arena, a conference centre, a theatre, a custom-built structure, or a blank plan with no street map at all), plans every event phase on it with the real equipment, vehicles, gates and people it uses, shares it safely with crew, authorities and attendees, and watches it live on the day, on web, desktop and mobile, offline where it can be.

## 2. Users and jobs

| User | Jobs |
| -- | -- |
| Organiser / production manager | Create a site from satellite imagery or an uploaded plan; lay out stages, tents, fencing, toilets, power, routes and zones per phase (build, show, break); check capacity and clashes; issue revisions for approval; print at scale. |
| Venue manager | Keep a reusable, multi-level plan of their building (walls, rooms, doors, stairs, lifts, seating bowls, services) that every event at the venue starts from. |
| Site crew and stewards | See the layers for their role on a phone, offline; find their post and the nearest facility; report where something actually is. |
| Vendors and contractors | See their plot and its constraints; place their own items inside their plot only. |
| Safety officer and authorities (fire, police, council) | Review an issued revision through a view-only, expiring link; comment; approve or reject. |
| Attendees | Use a published public map in the app or on the event website for wayfinding and facilities, offline once loaded. |
| Finance and logistics | Read the bill of quantities (fence metres, item counts) generated from the plan to drive hire, picking and costs. |
| Agent | Do everything a person can through the same actions: draft a layout from a brief, place and move items, compute quantities and capacity, flag clashes, answer "where is X", and prepare revisions for a person to issue. |

## 3. Market check

Vendor names stay out of customer-facing copy.

| Tool | What it does | Where Eventiva matches or differs |
| -- | -- | -- |
| OnePlan | Browser-based outdoor site planning on an Esri GIS satellite base; to-scale object library; real-time multi-user editing with owner, admin and member roles; area, perimeter, standing-capacity and arrival/exit calculators; bill of quantities export to CSV or Excel; prints up to A0; password-protected view-only links for authorities. No native mobile or desktop apps are listed and offline use is not documented. CAD import is on the paid Pro (from GBP 75 a month) and Team plans; the free plan allows one event and 25 objects. | Eventiva matches the outdoor GIS base, to-scale library, calculators, BoQ, print and authority sharing. It differs by linking placed items to real records (inventory F6, fleet F7, gates F8, sales points F9, posts F2, tasks F3), by offline-first mobile use, live positions, a public attendee map, and full agent parity. |
| Cvent Event Diagramming (formerly Social Tables; absorbed Prismm, formerly Allseated) | Indoor venue diagrams, seating and table plans, 3D walkthroughs, tied to Cvent registration. Prismm is being retired: every event on or after 1 October 2026 must be built in Cvent Event Diagramming, and Prismm events become view-only on that date. Event Diagramming now drafts diagrams with AI and accepts uploaded venue floor plans. | Indoor venues are covered in 2D as multi-level building plans with walls, rooms, doors, vertical connectors and seating bowls (<issue id="7a4bb64d-c3c5-44aa-9209-9fc139348225" label="EVE-238" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-238/f1012-venue-and-building-plans-arenas-halls-custom-structures-and" />); seat inventory is F8. 3D walkthroughs are out of scope for F10 (section 13). The Prismm retirement is an opening for teams that need to move. |
| Vectorworks Spotlight | Desktop CAD/BIM for entertainment: precise 2D/3D drafting, trusses and rigging, lighting plots and paperwork; file-based collaboration for expert users. | Eventiva does not replace production CAD. It imports CAD (DXF) and PDF drawings as calibrated reference layers and places stage footprints that link to F1 production records. |

Added 2026-11-08 after verification:

| Tool | What it does | Where Eventiva matches or differs |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Mappedin | Enterprise indoor maps and wayfinding for malls, airports, stadiums and arenas; maps built from PDF, CAD and floor plan images (with AI help); multi-floor routing; IMDF export; JavaScript, iOS and Android SDKs. | It is the bar for the venue and public map (<issue id="7a4bb64d-c3c5-44aa-9209-9fc139348225" label="EVE-238" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-238/f1012-venue-and-building-plans-arenas-halls-custom-structures-and" />, <issue id="cadefb17-f505-4ddc-9238-ad3d83926bf3" label="EVE-207" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-207/f1010-public-attendee-map-and-website-embed" />): multi-level plans, IMDF import and a public wayfinding map. Eventiva differs by tying the venue plan to event layouts, crew, quantities and revisions; turn-by-turn indoor routing stays out of scope. |

Sources: [OnePlan comparison article](<https://oneplan.io/articles/best-event-floor-plan-software>) (vendor-written, dated 2026), [Cvent acquires Prismm](<https://www.northstarmeetingsgroup.com/Planning-Tips-and-Trends/Event-Planning/Event-Technology/Cvent-acquires-Prismm>), [Vectorworks Spotlight event design guide](<https://app-help.vectorworks.net/2025/eng/VW2025_Guide/EventDesign1/Designing_events.htm>). OnePlan offline/mobile and Spotlight collaboration limits are from the vendors' published pages and were not tested. Verified 2026-11-08: [Prismm migration FAQ](<https://community.cvent.com/solution-evolution/prismm-migration-faq>), [OnePlan listing with plans and prices](<https://www.getapp.co.uk/software/2081374/oneplan-1>), [Mappedin product summary](<https://www.mappedin.com/llms.txt>).

## 4. Capabilities as actions
