## 5. Data model

All tables carry `tenant_id` and are guarded by <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" /> tenant guards.

| Entity | Key fields | Relations | Offline sync | Conflict rule |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Site | name, kind (outdoor, venue, plan), boundary, optional anchor point (a `plan` site has none until anchored), timezone, status | optional Venue (F5); has many SiteLevel, BaseLayer, SiteMap | yes, to everyone with read | per-field last writer wins; boundary is a field, so concurrent boundary edits keep the later one and record the other in the change log |
| SiteLevel | name, elevation_m, height_m, order, indoor flag, partial flag | Site | yes | per-field last writer wins |
| BaseLayer | kind, file ref, transform (affine into the site-local frame), residual_m, opacity | Site or SiteLevel; file in [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import>) | metadata yes; the file is part of the offline pack | calibration is one field: last writer wins; residual recomputed on server |
| SiteMap | name, status (draft, issued, archived), current_revision, template flag | Site; optional Event and Phase (F1); has many MapLayer | yes | status changes only through actions; server rejects an offline status change that skips a state |
| MapLayer | name, kind (facilities, fencing, power, routes, zones, vendor plot, ops, custom), order, audience (role list), locked, ydoc_id | SiteMap; one Yjs document per layer | metadata yes; the Yjs doc only to users whose role is in the audience | per-field last writer wins; lock wins over an offline edit: updates pushed to a locked layer are rejected at sync and the client rolls them back with a notice |
| Layer canvas (Yjs doc) | features as a Yjs `Map` keyed by feature id: geometry, style, label, z | MapLayer | yes, CRDT | Yjs merge. Each feature is a nested Yjs `Map`, so edits to different fields of one feature both survive. Concurrent writes to the same field resolve to the same value on every client by Yjs ordering (logical clock, then client id), not by wall-clock time, so an old offline move can win over a newer online one; the editor shows a notice when a synced update changes a feature the user moved in the last 5 minutes. A delete concurrent with an edit deletes, because edits inside a deleted nested map are dropped. |
| MapFeature (record mirror) | feature_id, layer_id, kind, symbol_id, label, centroid, bbox, length_m, area_m2, linked entity (type, id), attributes, as_built position | derived by the server from the layer doc after each accepted update | yes | server-derived, read-only to clients; the Yjs doc is the source of truth for geometry, the record for links and queries |
| SymbolLibrary, Symbol | name, footprint, category, default attributes, icon, inventory item type ref (F6) | tenant library plus a shipped starter library | yes | per-field last writer wins |
| Zone | feature_id, capacity_mode, density_per_m2, usable_area_m2, capacity, access rule refs (F8) | MapFeature | yes | per-field last writer wins; capacity recomputed on server |
| Route | feature_id, kind, min_width_m, measured_min_width_m | MapFeature | yes | as Zone |
| CheckRuleSet, CheckFinding | rules (JSON schema), severity; findings per run | SiteMap | yes | findings are recomputed, never merged |
| MapRevision | number, purpose, snapshot (frozen layer docs and records), issued_by, issued_at, exports | SiteMap | yes (read-only) | immutable |
| Approval | revision, approver (user or share link), decision, comment | MapRevision | yes | append-only |
| ShareLink | token hash, scope (revision or live), layers, expiry, password hash, can_comment, can_approve, revoked_at | MapRevision or SiteMap | no (server only) | server only |
| PublicMap | revision, public layers, points of interest, published_at | MapRevision; read by F14 sites | yes (public, cached) | immutable per publish |
| MapTemplate | source map, layer set, parametric rules | tenant | yes | per-field last writer wins |
| OfflinePack | map, bbox, zoom range, tile set version, size | SiteMap | device-local manifest | rebuilt, not merged |
| LayerSource | id, owner module, mode (external, live), read action, stream, staleness rule, style, audience | registered at module activation | metadata yes; live values online only | registry, not merged |

Positions: F10 stores no positions. F7 (<issue id="81e5a26e-791e-4891-bb97-c481901f11d7" label="EVE-181" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-181/f710-build-live-unit-positions-on-the-event-map-with-consent-and" />, `ops.position.report`) is Eventiva's single location collector for units and opted-in rostered crew; F10 shows them through live layer sources (agreed with F7 on 2026-11-01). As-built reports from a phone carry the reported accuracy radius: phone GPS is about 5 m in open sky and unreliable indoors, so a report worse than the tenant setting (default 10 m) is flagged for review instead of moving the feature, and indoor reports pick a room or level instead of a GPS point.

Documents embedded in records (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />): each MapLayer owns one Yjs document, so authorization at sync is per layer and a vendor never receives another vendor's plot. A SiteMap is the record that versions, permissions and syncs its layer documents; a revision freezes all of them together.

Coordinates: every Site has a site-local frame (origin at the site anchor, x east and y north, in metres). Feature geometry is stored in that frame, which is the contract F1 and others place elements in; pure conversion functions to and from WGS84 live in the shared contracts package and are used for rendering on imagery and for GeoJSON export. Indoor or unsurveyed plans are calibrated into the same frame. A `plan` site works entirely in that frame with no basemap, and can be anchored to a real location later without moving any feature.

Venues and buildings (<issue id="7a4bb64d-c3c5-44aa-9209-9fc139348225" label="EVE-238" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-238/f1012-venue-and-building-plans-arenas-halls-custom-structures-and" />): building elements are feature kinds (wall, room, door or opening, column, stair, ramp, lift, escalator, seating section, arena bowl, stage, rigging point, service point, loading dock); stairs, ramps, lifts and escalators are vertical connectors between levels; any footprint feature (marquee, building, container stage) can open its own interior child map. An F1 Space links to a room or zone by feature id.

External layer registry: other modules register `external` (record-backed) or `live` (stream-backed) layer sources at activation; F10 renders them and applies audience rules, the owning module owns the data (F10.2). Public ids for other modules: SiteMap, MapLayer, MapFeature, and Zone (a Zone id is its feature id).

## 7. Agent behaviour

When asked:

* "Lay out the show phase for 8,000 standing": `layout.draft` from the brief and the tenant rule set onto a new draft layer, then `check.run`, then present quantities; applying needs the person's confirm.
* "Move the bar 20 m north", "add a 2 m fence along the east boundary", "where is generator 3": the matching feature actions or `sitemap.find`.
* "Is the main arena over capacity?" or "do we have enough toilets?": `zone.define` results, `check.run` and the facility ratios in the rule set, compared with F8 ticket sales.
* "Send the plan to the council": prepare `revision.issue` and `share.create`; both need a person's approval.

Proactively (behind the agent's notification settings, never acting without being asked):

* After any accepted edit batch, run checks and surface new blocking findings (blocked emergency route, item outside boundary, zone over capacity).
* When F8 sales or F1 attendance forecasts change, flag zones and facility ratios that no longer meet the rule set.
* When F6 cannot supply a quantity, flag the affected symbols on the map.
* On the day, flag a live subject whose position is stale beyond the session threshold.

Always need approval: `revision.issue`, `share.create`, `public.publish`, `quantities.sendToInventory`, `feature.removeMany` above 10 items, `feature.placeMany` above 50 items, `template.apply` onto a non-empty map, archiving a site.

The agent never reads position history beyond the live window, and never invents positions: unknown is shown as unknown.

## 8. Integrations

Each vendor sits behind a neutral Effect service in its own integration package (<issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> porting rule 4).

| Port | Purpose | Candidates (approval needed per issue) |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `MapEngine` (client) | Render base tiles, layers and editing on React Native and web | MapLibre (MapLibre Native through maplibre-react-native on device, maplibre-gl-js on web), see decision D-F10-1. Checked 2026-11-08: maplibre-react-native v11 (v11.5.0, October 2026) supports only the React Native new architecture, needs React Native 0.80 or later and a development build, and has no web target, so the two renderers share one style spec behind the port. Neither ships editing tools on device: drag, rotate and vertex handles are Eventiva's own gesture layer; Terra Draw is a candidate on web only. |
| `BasemapTiles` | Street and terrain vector tiles, downloadable as offline packs | Self-hosted Protomaps PMTiles built from OpenStreetMap (no vendor), or a hosted tile vendor. Protomaps builds stop at zoom 15 and are overzoomed beyond it. An offline pack is a per-site PMTiles extract (`pmtiles extract` with a bounding box) that MapLibre Native opens as a local file (`pmtiles://file://`, Android 11.7 and later), not the tile-by-tile offline manager; on web the extract sits in a service worker cache. |
| `ImageryTiles` | Satellite imagery | A hosted imagery vendor, online only by default. Checked 2026-11-08: Mapbox allows offline imagery only through its own SDKs from its own servers; exported Esri World Imagery tiles are for use within ArcGIS only; MapTiler sells self-hosted high-resolution imagery only as an on-prem add-on through sales. Offline packs therefore carry the OpenStreetMap basemap plus the tenant's own calibrated layers (plans, drone or survey orthophotos), and imagery joins packs only once a vendor licence allows it (D-F10-6). |
| `Geocoder` | Find a site by address | Behind the same vendor as imagery, or OpenStreetMap Nominatim self-hosted |
| `DrawingImport` | PDF, DXF and GeoTIFF orthophotos to a raster or vector reference layer. DWG is not read directly (the open readers are GPL and the ODA converter needs its own licence), so a DWG upload asks for a DXF or PDF export, which every CAD tool produces | Server-side conversion inside an integration package, for example GDAL (MIT; reads DXF and GeoTIFF) and PDFium or pdf.js for PDF pages; AGPL renderers such as MuPDF are excluded; library chosen in F10.1 with approval |
| `PrintRenderer` | PDF export at scale up to A0 | Server-side rendering of the map engine output with the MapLibre Native Node renderer. It renders raster, so A0 at 300 dpi (about 14,000 by 9,900 px) is rendered in tiles and assembled into the PDF; vector PDF output is out of scope for v1 |

## 11. Compliance

* Personal data: crew positions are personal data (UK GDPR and EU GDPR; employee monitoring guidance). F10 collects and stores none; consent, retention (30 days), the DPIA and purge live with F7's single collector (<issue id="81e5a26e-791e-4891-bb97-c481901f11d7" label="EVE-181" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-181/f710-build-live-unit-positions-on-the-event-map-with-consent-and" />). F10 applies viewer rules and never sends attendee location to the server.
* Crowd capacity and facility ratios are planning aids, not certification. Default rule sets cite their source and hold only figures the source publishes openly or the tenant enters. The Purple Guide is subscription-only, so its starter rules hold the ratios from its public sanitation introduction (one female toilet per 100 attendees, one male toilet per 500 plus one urinal per 150, at least one accessible toilet) and the tenant adds the rest from their own copy. The Green Guide is a sports-ground guide whose safe capacity is the lowest of holding, entry, exit and emergency exit capacity, adjusted by its P and S factors, so zones compute holding capacity, checks compute exit capacity from route widths and the tenant's flow rates, and the zone shows the lower figure. US starter rules use the occupant load factors the jurisdiction adopts (IBC Table 1004.5 or NFPA 101 Table 7.3.1.2, for example 7 net sq ft per person for chairs only and 5 for standing space). Every capacity figure in exports carries "calculated estimate, verify with your safety adviser".
* Map data licences: OpenStreetMap data needs ODbL attribution on screen and on prints; imagery vendors' terms on caching, printing and offline use apply and are checked before choosing (D-F10-1, D-F10-6). Verified 2026-11-08 with [MapLibre React Native v11 notes](<https://maplibre.org/maplibre-react-native/docs/setup/migrations/v11>), [MapLibre Native PMTiles](<https://maplibre.org/maplibre-native/android/examples/data/PMTiles/>), [Protomaps downloads](<https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/downloads>), [Mapbox offline terms](<https://docs.mapbox.com/android/maps/guides/offline/concepts/>), [Esri imagery export](<https://www.esri.com/arcgis-blog/products/arcgis-living-atlas/imagery/wayback-export>), [MapTiler data plans](<https://maptiler.com/data/pricing/>), [Yjs map conflict discussion](<https://discuss.yjs.dev/t/y-map-conflict-resolution-which-side-wins/1952>), [SGSA safe capacity](<https://sgsa.org.uk/calculating-safe-capacity>), [Purple Guide sanitation](<https://www.thepurpleguide.co.uk/sanitation>), [Martyn's Law summary](<https://www.protectuk.police.uk/sites/default/files/2025-09/31.187_HO_Martyns%20Law_1_pager_Web_1.pdf>), [IMDF OGC standard](<https://docs.ogc.org/cs/20-094/>).
* Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA. The map is not the only way to get information: the POI list, quantities table and findings list are text equivalents; keyboard placement and movement in the editor; colour is never the only legend signal.
* Share links: tokens hashed at rest, expiry required (default 30 days), password optional, revocation immediate.
* Martyn's Law (UK Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025, passed 3 April 2025, implementation period of at least 24 months, regulated by the SIA): premises and events for 200 to 799 people are standard tier and 800 or more are enhanced tier, and enhanced-tier events must document their public protection measures. The `ops` layer kind carries evacuation, invacuation and lockdown routes and points and exports with an issued revision; statutory guidance is not out yet, so no export format is fixed.

## 12. Acceptance

* A person and the agent each create a site from imagery, calibrate an uploaded PDF plan to under 0.5 m residual on a test site, and place, move and delete the same kinds of items through the same actions; the audit log shows both.
* Two people and the agent edit one map concurrently, one person offline, and all converge after reconnect; a push to a locked layer is rejected and rolled back on the client.
* A vendor receives only the public layers and their plot; a placement outside the plot is rejected at sync.
* Bill of quantities for a fixture map matches a hand count, and sending it to F6 creates the reservation request.
* Checks find every seeded fault in a fixture map (overlap, outside boundary, narrow emergency route, over-capacity zone, short facility ratio).
* A three-level arena and a `plan` site with no basemap are drawn, checked across levels and published, as well as an outdoor festival with a marquee interior plan.
* An issued revision exports to PDF at A0 1:1000 with scale bar, north arrow, legend and attribution; the share link expires and revokes.
* The crew map works in airplane mode on Android from an offline pack, including search.
* With `f10-live-positions` on, a crew member's position from F7 appears on the live map within 5 s online and shows stale after 2 minutes; viewers outside the department see nothing.
* The public map renders on the event website (F14) and in the app, and its POI list passes axe with no serious issues.
* Every action passes the [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema>) parity check and every editor control is bound ([EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>)).

## 13. Out of scope

* 3D models, walkthroughs and rendering (multi-level 2D plans with level heights are in scope, <issue id="7a4bb64d-c3c5-44aa-9209-9fc139348225" label="EVE-238" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-238/f1012-venue-and-building-plans-arenas-halls-custom-structures-and" />).
* Rigging calculations, truss loading, lighting plots and focus charts (F1 production planning or a later production design set).
* CAD authoring and DXF export (DXF is import-only).
* Turn-by-turn navigation for attendees or vehicles.
* Indoor positioning (beacons, UWB) and vehicle tracker hardware (F7 owns trackers).
* Seat maps, seat inventory and seat sales (F8 owns them, including its own seat map editor <issue id="3682ce53-f6e7-41d9-a911-2fb44d73f7c6" label="EVE-211" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-211/f811-build-the-seat-map-editor-and-reserved-seating-in-f8" />; F8 may show an F10 map of a Space as a read-only backdrop).
* Dispatch, incidents and vehicle positions (F7: <issue id="acc43644-11f0-4a63-b850-f1099ce4626c" label="EVE-147" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-147/f77-build-the-incident-control-log-and-dispatch-for-live-events" />, <issue id="81e5a26e-791e-4891-bb97-c481901f11d7" label="EVE-181" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-181/f710-build-live-unit-positions-on-the-event-map-with-consent-and" />; F10 provides the map surface and the live layer registry only).

## 14. Dependencies

* Phase-1: [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema>) (actions), [EVE-41](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials>) (settings for rule sets and retention), [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state>) (storage and tenant guards), [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and>) (roles, external users, audit), [EVE-44](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor>) (telemetry and flags), [EVE-45](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change>) (change feed for derived records and checks), [EVE-46](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action>) (HTTP and typed client), [EVE-48](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-48/p19-build-inbound-mcp-from-the-action-inventory>) (MCP), [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>) (screen awareness), [EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and>) (Yjs layer docs and record sync), [EVE-52](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools>) (agent loop), [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow>) (durable runs for exports and layout drafts).
* Spikes: [EVE-16](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web>) (Expo and federation stack), [EVE-17](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and>) (sync engine).
* Port-later: [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import>) (files for base layers and exports), [EVE-26](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-26/port-search-and-embeddings-across-every-resource>) (search for `sitemap.find`), [EVE-27](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-27/port-comments-mentions-and-review-suggestions-on-any-resource>) (comments on features and revisions), [EVE-24](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email>) (notifications for approvals and findings), [EVE-30](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits>) (dashboards showing map widgets), [EVE-33](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters>) (scheduling, for posts on the map).
* Feature sets: F1 <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> (Event, Phase, Space, ProductionPlan, DesignElement), F7 <issue id="37310611-807d-43de-a5fb-ff53dc3a494e" label="EVE-71" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71/f7-fleet-and-live-operations-vehicles-maintenance-units-dispatch-and" /> (incidents, unit positions), F2 (posts and rosters), F3 (tasks on the map), F5 (Venue), F6 (inventory item types and reservations), F7 (vehicles and trackers), F8 (gates, access zones, seat inventory), F9 (sales points), F14 (public map embed).

## 15. Decisions for Jonathan

Recommended options stand as the default unless Jonathan picks another.

* **D-F10-1 Map engine**: decided by Jonathan 2026-11-08: MapLibre on device and web with self-hosted OpenStreetMap vector tiles and one imagery vendor behind a port, confirmed by the <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" /> spike before real use. F8 seat maps (<issue id="3682ce53-f6e7-41d9-a911-2fb44d73f7c6" label="EVE-211" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-211/f811-build-the-seat-map-editor-and-reserved-seating-in-f8" />) use the same engine.
* **D-F10-2 Granularity of permissions on the canvas**: one Yjs document per layer (recommended, lets sync hide layers) / one document per map with client-side hiding (simpler, leaks data).
* **D-F10-3 Seating**: decided by Jonathan 2026-11-08 in F8: F8 builds its own seat map editor (<issue id="3682ce53-f6e7-41d9-a911-2fb44d73f7c6" label="EVE-211" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-211/f811-build-the-seat-map-editor-and-reserved-seating-in-f8" />) on the same rendering engine F10 picks in D-F10-1; F10 has no seat objects.
* **D-F10-4 Live positions**: F7 is the single location collector and F10 shows crew and units as live layers (recommended, agreed with F7) / each set collects its own.
* **D-F10-5 Base layer imports**: images, GeoTIFF orthophotos, PDF and DXF as reference layers, with DWG handled by asking for a DXF or PDF export (recommended) / images and PDF only.
* **D-F10-6 Satellite imagery offline**: decided by Jonathan 2026-11-08: imagery online only; offline packs carry the open basemap and the tenant's own plans and drone orthophotos. No paid self-hosted imagery licence.

## 16. Child issues

In build order, each in the <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> format with blockers linked:

 1. [EVE-120](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo>) F10.0 Spike: map engine with offline tiles and Yjs-bound editing on Expo web and Android
 2. [EVE-146](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-146/f101-sites-levels-base-layers-and-calibration>) F10.1 Sites, levels, base layers and calibration
 3. [EVE-152](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record>) F10.2 Site maps and layers as Yjs documents with a feature record mirror
 4. [EVE-178](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-178/f103-map-editor-screen-with-screen-awareness>) F10.3 Map editor screen with screen awareness
 5. [EVE-180](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-180/f104-symbol-library-and-linked-placements>) F10.4 Symbol library and linked placements
 6. [EVE-183](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-183/f105-measurements-zones-routes-and-rule-checks>) F10.5 Measurements, zones, routes and rule checks
 7. [EVE-199](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-199/f106-bill-of-quantities-and-exports>) F10.6 Bill of quantities and exports
 8. [EVE-200](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-200/f107-revisions-approvals-and-share-links>) F10.7 Revisions, approvals and share links
 9. [EVE-202](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-202/f108-offline-map-packs-and-the-crew-map>) F10.8 Offline map packs and the crew map
10. [EVE-205](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-205/f109-live-positions-and-as-built-reporting>) F10.9 Crew positions layer and as-built reporting
11. [EVE-207](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-207/f1010-public-attendee-map-and-website-embed>) F10.10 Public attendee map and website embed
12. <issue id="7a4bb64d-c3c5-44aa-9209-9fc139348225" label="EVE-238" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-238/f1012-venue-and-building-plans-arenas-halls-custom-structures-and" /> F10.12 Venue and building plans: arenas, halls, custom structures and festival builds (after <issue id="c2c22f6e-0703-449c-a01d-0a6552d1d9fc" label="EVE-178" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-178/f103-map-editor-screen-with-screen-awareness" />, before <issue id="0a770823-74c2-43b8-849a-45631c15d9e5" label="EVE-183" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-183/f105-measurements-zones-routes-and-rule-checks" /> cross-level checks)

comments.body:
Verification pass, 2026-11-08 (Jonathan asked for the spec to be researched and confirmed). Desk research only: no code was run and no vendor was contacted.

Confirmed as written: MapLibre on device and web, self-hosted Protomaps PMTiles from OpenStreetMap under ODbL with attribution, PMTiles readable by MapLibre Native as local files, IMDF as an OGC Community Standard, one Yjs document per layer for permissions, the site-local metric frame, F7 as the single location collector, and the OnePlan and Vectorworks comparisons.

Corrected:
1. Prismm dates: events on or after 1 October 2026 must use Cvent Event Diagramming, and Prismm becomes view-only that day (the old text said August 2026 and June 2027). Cvent now also drafts diagrams with AI.
2. Yjs conflicts: concurrent moves resolve by Yjs ordering, not by time, so an old offline move can win. The conflict rule and the EVE-120 spike now say so and add a change notice.
3. BaseLayer transform goes into the site-local frame, not WGS84.
4. Offline imagery: Mapbox and Esri imagery cannot go into MapLibre offline packs, and MapTiler self-hosted imagery is sales-only. Imagery is now online only by default, with tenant orthophotos offline (new D-F10-6).
5. Offline packs are per-site PMTiles extracts, and the basemap stops at zoom 15 (overzoomed above). EVE-202 is updated.
6. Capacity: area times density is only holding capacity. EVE-183 now also computes exit capacity from route widths and reports the lower figure, as in the Green Guide method.
7. Purple Guide is subscription-only, so starter rules hold only its public ratios.

Added:
- maplibre-react-native v11 needs the new architecture, React Native 0.80+ and a development build, and has no web target or editing tools.
- GeoTIFF orthophoto import. DWG asks for a DXF or PDF export.
- Tiled A0 print rendering.
- An accuracy radius on as-built reports.
- Martyn's Law (enhanced tier from 800 people).
- Mappedin in the market check.

The sources are linked in sections 3 and 11.

issues.title: F3.8 Build guest assignees so vendors and freelancers see only their tasks
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08, <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decisions). Planning only until Jonathan asks for implementation. Depends on <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decision 5 (guests in F3).

## Goal

An organiser assigns a task to a vendor or freelancer who is not a member, and that person sees and completes only their own tasks in the same app.

## Context

* Parent spec: <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> sections 4 (`guest.inviteToTask`), 9 (guest row), 11 (guest terms and data limits).
* Guest principals and scoped access come from <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />; sync-time authorization and revocation from <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />; invite email from <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.
* F4 will own Contacts; until it lands, a guest is identified by email only, and F4 links the contact later without data migration (guest keeps the same principal id).

## Scope

1. Guest principal type in the tenant (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />), scoped to a set of task ids, no member list and no other Event data beyond the Event name and the task's dates.
2. Action `guest.inviteToTask` (external side effect, confirm): sends an invite, creates or reuses the guest, assigns the task. `guest.revoke` removes access.
3. Guests sign in with the same app (one app rule from the project brief); their navigation shows only My tasks and Task detail.
4. Sync filter: a guest device receives only assigned tasks, their checklists and comments on them; revoke removes them on next sync.
5. Guest terms acceptance on first sign-in, recorded.
6. Flag `tasks-guests`, default off.

## Acceptance criteria

* A guest assigned 2 of 50 tasks on an Event sees exactly those 2 through UI, HTTP and MCP; listing other tasks returns nothing, not an error that leaks counts.
* Revoking the guest removes both tasks from their device on next sync.
* A guest can complete their task and tick its checklist, and cannot reassign it or see other assignees' names beyond the organiser.
* An agent acting for a guest has the same limits.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no auth SaaS lock-in beyond what <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> decides; whitelabel invite copy; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the isolation and revocation tests green.

## Blockers

<issue id="d63643eb-423b-4502-b0a5-e4b99c887f54" label="EVE-64" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-64/f31-build-task-lists-and-tasks-as-synced-records-with-actions" /> (F3.1), <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />; F4 for contact linking later (not blocking).

issues.title: F3.9 Build agent behaviour for tasks: planning, blockers, digests and rescheduling
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08, <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decisions). Planning only until Jonathan asks for implementation. Depends on <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> decision 6 (agent write policy).

## Goal

The agent plans, chases and reschedules event work for people, using only the task actions and approvals a person has, and tells them when it cannot act offline.

## Context

* Parent spec: <issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> section 7 (agent behaviour) and section 4 (approval policies).
* Agent turn loop and durable runs from <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" /> and <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />; screen context from F3.5 (<issue id="1bd1df6b-b667-44f0-a5c5-5c560cec94e4" label="EVE-86" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-86/f35-build-the-task-screens-with-screen-projections-on-web-and-mobile" />).
* No agent-only path: everything below is composed from existing task actions; this issue adds agent instructions (skills), evaluation cases and scheduled runs, not new data paths.

## Scope

1. Task skill for the agent: descriptions and examples for every task action, plus guidance on approvals (never sign off, confirm before assigning others, confirm bulk over 10 and template creation over 25).
2. On request: "plan this Event from this brief" (draft list, preview, then create with confirm), "what is blocking X" (`dependency.blockers`), "move everything after load-in by a day" (`task.reschedule` preview then confirm), "reassign Sam's tasks to Alex" (confirm), "make a checklist from this PDF" ([EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import>) import then `checklist.addItem`).
3. Proactive, opt-in per user behind `tasks-agent-proactive`: a daily digest of the user's overdue and due-soon tasks; a warning when a dependency chain makes a due date impossible; a nudge when a checklist is incomplete at its Segment anchor (F1, <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />). Proactive runs only read and suggest; proposed writes wait for the user.
4. Offline: the on-device agent can run local task actions; anything needing a remote model returns an "offline, will run when connected" message instead of pretending.
5. Evaluation cases ([EVE-29](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets>) when ported; local fixtures until then) for the scenarios above, including refusal of sign-off and of assigning outside permissions.

## Acceptance criteria

* Each on-request scenario passes an evaluation run with the right actions called and the right confirms raised.
* The agent acting for a crew member refuses to assign someone else and explains why.
* The digest for a user with 3 overdue tasks lists exactly those 3 and makes no writes.
* With the device offline and no local model, the agent says the plan request is queued and creates nothing.
* Success metric wired: share of agent task writes not undone within 24 hours (<issue id="4e19a499-139f-4016-88c4-264d3a0f7c33" label="EVE-62" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-62/f3-tasks-task-lists-assignments-dependencies-and-checklists-per-event" /> section 10).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; Effect AI per <issue id="07c58289-6f1c-488e-a130-5f718b473fce" label="EVE-14" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-14/s1-prove-one-effect-action-serves-ui-mcp-and-ai-sdk-from-one-inventory" /> decision, no zod; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with evaluation results posted here.

## Blockers

<issue id="d63643eb-423b-4502-b0a5-e4b99c887f54" label="EVE-64" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-64/f31-build-task-lists-and-tasks-as-synced-records-with-actions" />, <issue id="b092122b-6aea-4fec-b8c4-e1baf084c342" label="EVE-72" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-72/f33-build-subtasks-and-finish-to-start-dependencies-with-blocker" />, <issue id="5a6f845d-5c7a-450c-8e8d-cef1b7ddbc80" label="EVE-84" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-84/f34-build-event-relative-due-dates-task-templates-and-reschedule" />, <issue id="1bd1df6b-b667-44f0-a5c5-5c560cec94e4" label="EVE-86" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-86/f35-build-the-task-screens-with-screen-projections-on-web-and-mobile" /> (F3.1, F3.3, F3.4, F3.5), <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />.

issues.title: F14: Website builder and in-app customisation
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08, Jonathan chose "Approve all as recommended" on the F14 decision card: D1 a, D2 a, D3 a, D4 a, D5 a, D6 a). Planning only until Jonathan asks for implementation: no code, no new dependency, no vendor sign-up. Follows the template in [Feature set spec template and list](<https://linear.app/resnovas/document/feature-set-spec-template-and-list-26b9f78cf17a>). F1 entities are referenced by the names fixed in <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> section 5 (Event, EventSeries, Phase, Segment, RunOfShow, Space, TeamMember, Department, Cue, Itinerary, EquipmentRequirement) and owned by F1.

F14 has two halves that share one engine: **Studio** (organisations change Eventiva itself: fields, record types, views, automations) and **Sites** (organisations publish public websites built from blocks bound to their live Eventiva data). Both are documents of declarative definitions, edited by people or the agent through the same actions, versioned as change sets, and published deliberately.

## 1. Goal

An organisation can reshape Eventiva to the way it works and publish branded event, venue and vendor websites from its own live data, by hand, with AI help, or by asking the agent, without writing code or installing another app.

## 2. Users and jobs

| User | Jobs |
| -- | -- |
| Organiser (site editor) | Build an event site from a template or a brief, drag blocks, bind the schedule and ticket blocks to the F1 Event, preview, publish, fix a typo on a phone at the venue |
| Organisation admin (studio designer) | Add fields to records (for example "dietary requirements" on a crew booking), create record types the product lacks, rearrange forms and lists, build an automation ("when a ticket order is refunded, notify the box office"), approve and publish changes |
| Marketing | Landing pages, SEO, translations, sign-up forms that land in F4 contacts, campaign redirects |
| Vendor or venue (external) | Edit their own public directory profile page (F5) within the layout the directory allows |
| Crew | See the extra fields and views the organisation set up; never edits customisations |
| Attendee or public visitor | Reads published sites, buys tickets through F8/F9 blocks, submits forms; never signs in to view |
| Finance | Custom fields on bills and invoices (F11) that flow into exports |
| Agent | Generates a site from a brief, edits pages by instruction, proposes and drafts customisations from a plain-language request, runs automations, explains what a customisation does |

## 3. Market check

As publicly documented at 2026-11; not tested hands-on. Names stay out of customer-facing copy.

| Tool | What it does | Eventiva matches | Eventiva differs |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Webflow | Visual designer with full CSS box-model control, CMS collections bound to template pages, hosting, custom domains, localisation, AI site generation | Collection pages (one template page per F1 Event), hosting, custom domains, localisation | No raw CSS: design comes from brand tokens and block properties so output stays accessible and renders on native too |
| Framer | Canvas-first editor, prompt-to-page AI, CMS, AI translation, fast hosted sites | Prompt-to-site, AI translation, instant preview | The agent edits through the same actions as people and every AI change arrives as a reviewable diff; content is live business data, not a separate CMS |
| Wix Studio (with its events and stores apps) | AI site creation, responsive editor, built-in ticketing and stores on the site | Ticket and product blocks on the site | Tickets, stock, crew and accounting live in the same records, so a sold-out tier updates the site and the warehouse at once |
| Odoo Studio and Odoo Website | Custom fields and models, form/list/kanban/calendar/pivot/map views, automation rules, approval rules, PDF report editor, export as a module, AI fields; website builder with blocks bound to ERP data | Fields, record types, views, automations, approvals, export package, AI fields, blocks bound to data | Customisations are versioned change sets with preview and one-click rollback; view changes are named patches against declared slots, not XPath edits that break on upgrade; everything is an action the agent can run; works offline for drafting |
| Puck (MIT, open source) | Embeddable React visual editor: JSON page data, component config, AI plugin | Same idea: a JSON block tree of registered components with typed props | DOM only, so it is a design reference, not a dependency (D6) |

Learning from the climb-group-odoo work (docs/learnings/odoo-extensions-reference.md): customers had to custom-build ecommerce hooks and redirects on stock Odoo, so both are in scope from the start here, and customisations must extend the unified models rather than create parallel ones.

## 4. Capabilities as actions

Every operation is an inventory action (<issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />) with Effect Schema input and output, typed errors, one permission, an approval policy and a change record with undo. Approval: none, confirm (the user confirms the agent's call), always (a second person or explicit confirmation every time).

### Studio

| Action | Input | Output | Permission | Approval (agent) |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `studio.describe` | entityType? | Field, view and automation definitions in effect | studio:read | none |
| `studio.changesets.open` | title | ChangeSet (draft) | studio:design | none |
| `studio.fields.define` | changeSetId, entityType, key, label, type, options, required, default, pii, indexed, help | FieldDefinition (draft) | studio:design | none |
| `studio.fields.update` | changeSetId, fieldId, patch | FieldDefinition | studio:design | none |
| `studio.fields.archive` | changeSetId, fieldId | FieldDefinition (hidden, data kept) | studio:design | confirm |
| `studio.fields.purge` | fieldId | PurgeReceipt (values deleted) | studio:admin | always |
| `studio.entities.define` / `.update` / `.archive` | changeSetId, key, labels, icon, fields, record title template, ownership scope | EntityTypeDefinition | studio:design | none / none / confirm |
| `records.custom.create` / `.update` / `.delete` / `.get` / `.list` | entityType, values or id or query | CustomRecord or page | per entity type grant (records:{type}:write or read) | none / none / confirm / none / none |
| `studio.views.define` | changeSetId, entityType, kind (list, form, board, calendar, timeline, map, gallery), layout | ViewDefinition | studio:design | none |
| `studio.views.patch` | changeSetId, baseViewId, ops (insert, hide, move, relabel, setDefault) | ViewPatch | studio:design | none |
| Automations: the `rule.*` actions of the shared rules engine (<issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" />): `rule.create`, `.update`, `.enable`, `.disable`, `.delete`, `.list`, `.get`, `.preview`, `.runs` | as <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" /> | Rule, RuleRun | `tasks:rules` for task rules; `studio:automate` for rules on other sets' triggers | as <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" /> (confirm on `rule.enable`) |
| `rule.runNow`, `rule.runs.cancel` (added to the engine by F14.5) | ruleId, recordId? / runId | RuleRun | studio:automate | confirm / none |
| `studio.changesets.preview` | changeSetId | PreviewReport (schema diff, affected screens, data migration counts, permission impact) | studio:design | none |
| `studio.changesets.publish` | changeSetId | PublishedVersion | studio:publish | confirm |
| `studio.changesets.rollback` | versionId | PublishedVersion | studio:publish | confirm |
| `studio.packages.export` | versionId or changeSetId | CustomisationPackage (signed JSON) | studio:design | none |
| `studio.packages.import` | package | ChangeSet (draft) | studio:design | confirm |
| `studio.propose` | request (plain language), scope | ChangeSet (draft, agent-authored) | studio:design | none (it only drafts) |

### Sites

| Action | Input | Output | Permission | Approval (agent) |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `sites.create` / `.update` / `.archive` / `.get` / `.list` | name, kind (event, organisation, venue, vendor), brandKitId, locales, subdomain | Site | sites:manage (read: sites:read) | none / none / confirm / none / none |
| `sites.generate` | brief, sourceRecords (for example an F1 Event), templateId?, locales | Site draft plus GenerationReport | sites:edit | none (draft only) |
| `pages.create` / `.update` / `.move` / `.duplicate` / `.delete` | siteId, path, title, seo, parentId, binding (static or collection) | Page | sites:edit | none / none / none / none / confirm |
| `pages.blocks.insert` / `.update` / `.move` / `.remove` | pageId, blockType, props, target position | BlockRef (Yjs update applied) | sites:edit | none |
| `pages.generate` | pageId or siteId, instruction | Draft diff against the page | sites:edit | none (diff is reviewed) |
| `sites.menus.update` | siteId, menu tree | Menu | sites:edit | none |
| `sites.preview` | siteId, versionId? | Expiring preview link | sites:edit | none |
| `sites.publish` | siteId, note | SiteVersion (immutable) | sites:publish | confirm |
| `sites.rollback` | siteId, versionId | SiteVersion | sites:publish | confirm |
| `sites.versions.list` / `.diff` | siteId / two versionIds | versions / VersionDiff | sites:read | none |
| `domains.add` / `.verify` / `.setPrimary` / `.remove` | siteId, hostname | SiteDomain with DNS records and status | sites:domains | confirm / none / confirm / always |
| `redirects.create` / `.delete` / `.import` | siteId, from, to, status (301, 302) or CSV | Redirect(s) | sites:edit | none / none / confirm |
| `forms.define` | siteId, fields, target action (for example F4 `contacts.create`), consent text, notify | FormDefinition | sites:edit | none |
| `forms.submit` | formId, values, consent, challenge token | Submission receipt | public (anonymous principal, rate limited) | n/a |
| `forms.submissions.list` / `.export` / `.delete` | formId, filter | page / file / receipt | sites:submissions | none / confirm / confirm |
| `sites.seo.update` | siteId or pageId, title, description, image, indexable | SeoSettings | sites:edit | none |
| `sites.translations.generate` | siteId, targetLocale | Translation draft | sites:edit | none (draft) |
| `templates.list` / `.apply` / `.saveFromSite` | kind / siteId, templateId / siteId, name | templates / Site draft / Template | sites:read / sites:edit / sites:manage | none |
| `sites.reportAbuse` | hostname, reason | Report receipt | public | n/a |

## 5. Data model

All tables carry `org_id` (tenant guard, <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />) and standard audit fields. "Doc" means a Yjs document embedded in the record (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />): the record holds metadata and permissions, the doc holds collaborative content.

### Studio

* **ChangeSet**: id, title, status (draft, previewed, published, rolled back, discarded), author (person or agent run), items, baseVersion. Syncs offline: yes (drafts). Conflict: per item last writer wins; publishing is server-only and rejects a stale baseVersion.
* **CustomisationVersion**: immutable, monotonically numbered per org; the compiled set of all definitions. Read-only offline copy.
* **FieldDefinition**: entityType, key (stable, never reused), label (localised), type (text, rich text, number, money, date, datetime, duration, boolean, select, multi-select, reference to any entity, person, file, location, computed, AI), validation, default, pii flag, indexed flag, help. Values live in the target entity's `custom` column (D3). Conflict on values: per key last writer wins, like built-in scalar fields; rich text values are docs.
* **EntityTypeDefinition**: key, labels, icon, title template, ownership scope (org, team, event), fields. Records live in **CustomRecord** (entityType, values, optional parent link to any entity such as an F1 Event).
* **ViewDefinition** and **ViewPatch**: layout tree of field widgets and sections; patches reference named nodes and slots on base screens. Conflict: per definition last writer wins inside a draft.
* **Automations are Rules** in the shared, domain-agnostic `rules` package owned by F3 (<issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" />: Rule, RuleRun, RuleRunStep; triggers from the <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" /> event inventory; actions from <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> that the registering module marks rule-safe; runs as the owner with permissions checked at run time; durable on Effect Cluster). F14 does not define a second engine. F14.5 registers every other set's triggers and rule-safe actions, custom field and custom record events, schedule, webhook and form triggers, and adds wait, approval, branch and agent steps to the engine. Rules referenced by a change set are versioned with it.
* **CustomisationPackage**: exported JSON with format version and content hash.

### Sites

* **Site**: kind, name, subdomain, primaryDomainId, brandKitId ([EVE-30](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits>)), locales, status, owner. Syncs offline: yes.
* **Page**: siteId, path, title, seo, parentId, binding (static, or collection: entity type plus filter plus slug field, for example every published F1 Event), plus a doc holding the block tree. Doc conflicts merge by CRDT; path uniqueness is checked at publish.
* **Block tree** (inside the doc): nodes of blockType, props (validated against the block's Effect Schema), children, bindings (a data path or a read action with its input; never a data snapshot, so it re-runs under the viewer's permissions, as in [EVE-30](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits>) panels).
* **BlockType**: code, not data: a registry in a Rambo-UI site-blocks package plus Eventiva data-bound blocks (public schedule from Event, Phase and Segment where Segment.audience = public in a published RunOfShow (F1), ticket selector F8, product grid F9, directory listing F5, site map F10, form, gallery, rich text, hero, columns, embed). Federated modules can register more ([EVE-16](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web>) manifest).
* **SiteVersion**: immutable snapshot of resolved page trees, menus, redirects and assets, content hash, publishedBy, note. Server-only.
* **SiteDomain**: hostname, verification token, DNS status, certificate status. Server-only; online only.
* **Redirect**, **Menu**, **FormDefinition** (synced), **FormSubmission** (server-only; contains personal data; retention set per form), **Template** (global or org).

### Offline rules

* Drafting offline: pages, menus, forms, field/view/automation drafts can all be edited offline and merge on reconnect.
* Online only: publish, rollback, domain operations, package import, automation enable and runs, AI generation (shows its offline limit instead of pretending, per <issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" />), form submissions from the public.
* A device keeps the last published CustomisationVersion and renders with it offline; a newer version applies on reconnect at the next screen change, never mid-edit.

## 6. Screens

Every screen declares its screen-context projection (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />) and binds every control to an action above. Components come from Rambo-UI; new components needed are marked (new).

| Screen | Rambo-UI components | Projection | Actions behind controls |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Studio home | List, Card, Badge, Button | open change sets, published version, automations with failing runs | `studio.changesets.open`, `studio.describe` |
| Field designer | Form, Select, Switch, TextField, Sheet | entity type, its fields, selected field | `studio.fields.*` |
| Record type designer | Form, List, IconPicker (new) | type definition, fields | `studio.entities.*` |
| View designer | Canvas surface (new), LayersTree (new), PropertyInspector (new), live preview | view kind, layout tree, selected node, base slots | `studio.views.define`, `studio.views.patch` |
| Automation builder | the <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" /> rule editor, extended with cross-set triggers and the new step kinds | trigger, conditions, steps, selected step, last runs | `rule.*` |
| Change set review | DiffViewer (new), Table, Button | schema diff, impact counts, author | `studio.changesets.preview`, `.publish`, `.rollback` |
| Custom record list and form | the generated list/form views | records shown, filters, selection | `records.custom.*`, `navigation.open` |
| Sites list | List, Card | sites, status, domains | `sites.create`, `sites.list`, `templates.list` |
| Page editor | Canvas surface (new), LayersTree (new), PropertyInspector (new), BlockPalette (new), Presence avatars, agent panel | site, page, block tree, selected block, viewport, collaborators | `pages.blocks.*`, `pages.update`, `pages.generate`, `sites.preview`, `sites.publish` |
| Site settings | Form, Table | domains and status, SEO, redirects, locales | `domains.*`, `redirects.*`, `sites.seo.update` |
| Version history | Timeline, DiffViewer (new) | versions, selected pair | `sites.versions.*`, `sites.rollback` |
| Form submissions | Table, Button | form, submissions page (masked per permission) | `forms.submissions.*` |
| Template gallery | Grid, Card, Preview | templates, filter | `templates.apply` |

Phone layout: the page editor and view designer switch to a structured editor (block list with reorder handles plus a property sheet) instead of free canvas drag; every operation is the same action. Drag-and-drop canvas on web, tablet and desktop.

Public sites are not app screens: they render published SiteVersions server-side (D2) with no app shell, WCAG 2.2 AA, and work without client JavaScript except for interactive blocks (ticket selector, forms, maps).

## 7. Agent behaviour

* When asked: build a site from a brief and an F1 Event; rewrite a section; translate; add a block; propose a customisation from a sentence ("we need to track wristband colour per ticket type") as a draft change set with an explanation; explain why a field exists and what uses it; debug a failed automation run from its log.
* Proactively (suggestions only, never applied): flag a published page whose bound F1 Event changed date or venue since publish; flag broken links and missing alt text before publish; suggest an index when a custom field is filtered on often; notice repeated manual edits and suggest an automation.
* Approval: the agent may draft anything; publishing a site or a change set, rollbacks, domain changes, enabling an automation, archiving fields, import and export of submissions are `confirm`; purging field data and removing a domain are `always`.
* All AI generation goes through the agent (<issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" />: UIs never call models directly) using the user's selected engine (<issue id="5f3d064c-7dfa-45f3-b0a2-67d5ad9d3aca" label="EVE-53" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-53/p18b-build-model-engines-model-selection-and-user-owned-subscriptions" />). Generated images and text are marked as AI-generated in the version record.
* AI fields: a field whose value an agent step computes (for example "summary of crew notes"), run as an automation step with its own budget; the value is stored and labelled as AI output.

## 8. Integrations

Each behind a neutral Effect port in its own integration package; switching vendor changes composition only.

| Port | Need | First adapter (proposal, needs approval on its slice) |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `SiteHosting` | Serve published versions at the edge, cache purge on publish | D4 |
| `DomainProvisioning` | Custom hostname verification and TLS certificates | D4 (same vendor as hosting) |
| `MediaStore` | Images and files for blocks | <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> storage port |
| `ImageTransform` | Responsive image sizes | Same as hosting where it offers it, otherwise none |
| `BotChallenge` | Spam protection on public forms | Proposal at F14.9; privacy-friendly challenge |
| `Translation` | Machine translation | The agent (no extra vendor) |
| Analytics | Site visits and conversions | PostHog through the tracking port (<issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />), consent-gated |

## 9. Permissions and roles

Default role bundles (organisations can edit them once F14 ships): **Studio designer** (studio:read, design, automate), **Studio publisher** (adds studio:publish), **Studio admin** (adds studio:admin), **Site editor** (sites:read, edit), **Site publisher** (adds sites:publish), **Site manager** (adds manage, domains, submissions).

* Customisations never widen access: a custom field inherits its entity's read/write rule unless the designer restricts it further; pii fields are masked in lists, telemetry and agent context unless the viewer holds the entity's pii grant.
* Custom record types get their own grants (records:{type}:read/write) assigned through [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and>).
* Automations are rules (<issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" />) and run as their owner with permissions checked at run time; if the owner loses access the rule pauses and the owner and an admin are told.
* External vendors and venues edit only their own F5 profile page and only the blocks the directory template unlocks.
* Public visitors are anonymous principals with `forms.submit` and `sites.reportAbuse` only, rate limited per IP and form.
* The agent holds exactly the invoking user's permissions.
* Protected actions cannot be customised away: F1 show safety rules (`show.arm` human only, `show.stopAll` always available, `rigging.signOff` human only) cannot be removed, hidden, relabelled to mislead, or invoked by custom views, view patches or automations. Any feature set can mark an action or control `protected`; F14 refuses view patches that touch one, and a protected action is never registered as rule-safe in the <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" /> engine.

## 10. Telemetry and flags

* Flags (PostHog, safe default off): `f14-studio`, `f14-studio-automations`, `f14-sites`, `f14-sites-ai-generate`, `f14-sites-custom-domains`.
* Events: `studio_changeset_published`, `studio_changeset_rolled_back`, `studio_field_defined`, `automation_run_completed` (status), `site_created` (source: blank, template, generated), `site_published`, `site_rolled_back`, `page_generated` (accepted share), `domain_verified`, `form_submitted` (no field values).
* Spans: every action (<issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />); public renders carry site and version ids, not visitor identity.
* Success metrics: median time from site creation to first publish under 30 minutes; 40% of active orgs publish at least one change set within 60 days; AI-generated page drafts accepted with under 20% of blocks changed; zero rollbacks caused by a change set breaking a base screen.

## 11. Compliance

* Personal data (UK GDPR / EU GDPR): form submissions and pii custom fields carry purpose, retention and deletion; export and erasure requests cover custom fields and submissions; the pii flag drives masking.
* Cookies and tracking (PECR / ePrivacy): published sites load analytics only after consent; the consent banner is a platform block that cannot be removed while analytics is on.
* Accessibility: published sites meet WCAG 2.2 AA; ticket and shop sites fall under the European Accessibility Act (in force from 2025-06-28 for ecommerce). The publish step blocks on missing alt text, heading order and contrast failures.
* Abuse: hosting tenant sites on our domains invites phishing; publish runs content checks (credential forms, known-bad links), and `sites.reportAbuse` feeds a takedown queue.
* Copyright: uploaded and AI-generated media record their source; takedown follows the same queue.
* Customisation audit: every published change set is in the audit log (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />) with author and approver.

## 12. Acceptance

* An org admin adds a field to an F1 Event, a new record type linked to it, and a board view, publishes, and a crew member sees them on web and Android; rollback restores the previous screens with data intact.
* The agent turns "track wristband colour per ticket type and alert me when a type has none" into a draft change set with a field and an automation; the human publishes it; the automation fires on the next ticket type created without one.
* A custom field appears in the action inventory for that tenant, the agent can read and write it, and the parity check passes; a second tenant does not see it.
* An organiser generates a site from an F1 Event, edits it on desktop while a colleague edits on a phone, publishes, and the schedule block updates when the run of show changes without republishing.
* The site is served at a custom domain with TLS; a form submission creates an F4 contact; analytics fires only after consent.
* Published pages score at least 95 for accessibility in Lighthouse and pass axe with no serious issues.
* Offline: a page and a field draft edited offline on two devices converge after reconnect; publish is refused offline with a clear message.

## 13. Out of scope

* User-written code in customisations (scripts, custom server logic); revisit as its own spike porting upstream `extensions` (D5).
* A general blog or newsletter product and email campaign builder (email templates come with <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />).
* Building native mobile apps for customers.
* Full ecommerce checkout design: F9 owns checkout; sites embed it.
* Arbitrary CSS or HTML editing; a sandboxed embed block is the escape hatch.
* A public template marketplace with payments (templates are global or per org here).

* Feature sets: F1 (Event and run of show for bound pages), F4 (contacts as form targets), F5 (directory profile pages), F8 (ticket selector block), F9 (product block and checkout), F10 (site map block); every other set gains custom fields and views from Studio.

## 15. Decisions for Jonathan

Decided 2026-11-08: all six as recommended (option a in each). D2 is re-checked by the Lighthouse gate in F14.10 and D4's vendor sign-up still needs approval on F14.11 when that slice starts.

* **D1 Build order**: (a) Studio core first, then Sites \[recommended: every other feature set gains custom fields and views, and Sites reuses field definitions for forms and bindings\]; (b) Sites first; (c) interleave.
* **D2 Public site renderer**: (a) the same Rambo-UI site blocks rendered server-side through react-native-web, with a no-JS HTML output check and Lighthouse gate \[recommended: one block registry for editor, app preview and public site\]; (b) a separate web-only HTML renderer per block.
* **D3 Custom field storage**: (a) one `custom` JSONB column (JSON text on SQLite) per extensible table with expression indexes for indexed fields \[recommended: no per-tenant migrations, syncs like any field\]; (b) an entity-attribute-value table; (c) real columns through per-tenant migrations.
* **D4 Hosting and custom domains**: (a) Vercel behind `SiteHosting` and `DomainProvisioning` \[recommended: house preference\]; (b) Cloudflare for SaaS; (c) self-run edge with ACME certificates. No sign-up until its slice starts.
* **D5 Code in customisations**: (a) declarative only in F14, sandboxed code as a later spike \[recommended: keeps the security surface small\]; (b) sandboxed scripts now.
* **D6 Editor foundation**: (a) build the canvas, layers and inspector in Rambo-UI, using Puck's data model as a reference only \[recommended: works on native and web\]; (b) adopt Puck for web and a separate native editor.

issues.title: F8.1 Build the ticket catalogue: ticket types, capacity pools, sales windows and access codes
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

An organiser (or the agent on their behalf) can define what is for sale on an F1 Event: ticket types, nested capacity pools per admission scope (the Event, or a Phase, Space or public Segment of it), sales windows and access codes, all as inventory actions with screens bound to them.

## Context

* Parent [EVE-76](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning>) sections 4, 5 and 6. F1 (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />) owns Event, Phase, Space and Segment; F5 owns Venue; this issue references them by id.
* Price is stored as tiers (amount in minor units, currency, valid from and to); F9 computes the all-in price shown to buyers (fees, tax).

## Scope

1. Extension package `ticketing` (Nx tags per [EVE-22](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-22/correct-boundary-docs-to-match-lint-use-colon-tags-and-fix-the-house>)) with Drizzle schema for TicketType, CapacityPool and AccessCode on Postgres and SQLite, tenant guards ([EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state>)).
2. Actions: ticketing.ticketType.create, update, publish, unpublish, archive; ticketing.pool.create, update; ticketing.salesWindow.set; ticketing.accessCode.create, revoke; navigation actions for the screens below. Approval policies as in [EVE-76](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning>) section 4.
3. State machine for TicketType status: draft, on sale, paused, sold out, closed, archived; publish fails with a typed error when the type has no pool, no price tier or a window that has ended.
4. Validation: pool capacity cannot exceed the F1 Space or F5 Venue safe capacity when one is set; child pool sums may exceed a parent (shared capacity) but sales are always bound by every ancestor.
5. TicketType description as an embedded Yjs document ([EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and>)); attendee questions as a schema (text, choice, checkbox, date; required flag).
6. Screens: Event tickets tab, Ticket type editor, Capacity board (read counters as zero until F8.2), each with its screen-context projection.

## Acceptance criteria

* Each action has a test for success, the permission denial and each typed error; publishing an incomplete type fails with `TicketTypeIncomplete`.
* Lowering a pool below its sold count fails with `CapacityBelowSold`.
* A member without ticketing:manage gets a denial from UI, HTTP and MCP alike (one test per surface).
* The agent, asked to "set up early bird and standard tickets, 500 capacity" for a sample event, creates drafts and asks before publishing (agent test with a scripted model).
* Parity and UI-binding checks pass.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI components; behind flag `ticketing` (default off); no new dependency or vendor without Jonathan approving it on this issue; whitelabel ASCII copy; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, tests green, and a comment here listing the actions and the screens with their projection schemas.

## Blockers

[EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema>), [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state>), [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and>), [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>); F1 Event, Phase, Space and Segment entities (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />).

issues.title: F5.5 Build the public directory web section for anonymous visitors and search engines
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01), part of <issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" /> (F5 Directory and marketplace).

## Goal

Anyone can browse published listings on the open web, and search engines can index them, without signing in or installing anything.

## Context

* Decision D5-5 default: a public, indexable directory section on its own subdomain (<issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> allows web sections on separate subdomains with independent updates).
* Reads go through the same actions (`directory.search`, `directory.listing.get`, `directory.availability.check`) over the HTTP API from <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" />, as an anonymous principal with public permissions only.
* The same React Native screens render on web through react-native-web (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> decision); this section adds server rendering for anonymous pages.

## Scope

1. A web app section for the directory with routes: category landing, search results, listing detail, ranking parameters page, report content page.
2. Server-side rendering of listing detail and category pages with canonical URLs, structured data ([schema.org](<http://schema.org>) LocalBusiness or EventVenue as appropriate), sitemap and robots rules; unpublished or suspended listings return 410.
3. Anonymous principal in <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> with read-only public permissions and rate limits.
4. "Start an enquiry" for anonymous visitors routes to sign-in or sign-up, then to the enquiry composer in the app with the listing preselected.
5. Cookie and analytics consent banner before any PostHog capture on this section; telemetry: false honoured.
6. Lighthouse budgets: performance 90, accessibility 100 on listing detail.

## Acceptance criteria

* Listing detail renders without JavaScript enabled and passes axe with no violations (report attached).
* A suspended listing returns 410 within one change-feed cycle.
* No private field reaches the HTML (test reads the rendered page for every field marked private).
* Anonymous calls cannot reach any non-public action (negative test on the HTTP surface).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 for server code; Rambo-UI; whitelabel ASCII copy; sub-flag `directory-public-web` default off; no new dependency (for example a server-rendering framework) without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with Lighthouse and axe results recorded, and the subdomain routing documented (no production DNS change without Jonathan's go-ahead).

## Blockers

F5.3 (only verified listings publish), F5.4 (search), <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" /> (HTTP API), decision D5-5.
