issues.title: F8.2 Build the capacity engine: oversell-proof holds on a cluster entity per pool
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

Capacity can never be oversold, even with thousands of buyers at on-sale time, because every hold, sale and release for a pool goes through one serialised owner.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> sections 4 and 5. F9 line-provider contract (agreed with the F9 thread 2026-11-01): F9 calls reserve on add to cart, commit on order paid, release on cart expiry, cancel or refund. For kind "ticket" these map to ticketing.hold.create, ticketing.ticket.issueForOrder (F8.3) and ticketing.hold.release or ticketing.ticket.void. F9 cart TTL defaults: checkout 15 minutes, POS 5 minutes after last touch; hold TTL must be at least the cart TTL.
* Sharding evidence and gaps: <issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" /> (S5), <issue id="2f9fdfdc-7e1d-4c27-9557-77465a22e3a9" label="EVE-38" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-38/cut-runner-loss-failover-from-36s-and-expose-the-cluster-settings-in" /> failover, <issue id="1b79a257-9ea0-40b5-a8f7-23e1c09221be" label="EVE-39" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39/make-every-entity-action-idempotent-and-persisted-by-default" /> idempotent persisted entity actions.

## Scope

1. A `CapacityPool` Effect Cluster entity keyed by pool id, owning held, sold and admitted counters; it checks every ancestor pool (parent entities) before granting. Messages are persisted and idempotent by request id (<issue id="1b79a257-9ea0-40b5-a8f7-23e1c09221be" label="EVE-39" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39/make-every-entity-action-idempotent-and-persisted-by-default" />).
2. Actions: ticketing.hold.create, release, extend; ticketing.pool.availability. Hold purposes: checkout, manual, offline-quota. Holds expire on a durable timer and emit hold_expired.
3. Register ticketing as an F9 line provider for kind "ticket" with reserve, commit and release.
4. On-sale queue: when a sales window has the queue on, requests before and at open time get a queue position and are admitted to hold.create at a configured rate; the queue state is visible to the buyer as position and estimate.
5. Change feed events (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />) for availability so screens and the public picker update live; availability served from a read model, not from the entity, for public reads.
6. Capacity board shows live counters.

## Acceptance criteria

* Load test: 10,000 concurrent hold requests on a 1,000-capacity pool across two runners grant exactly 1,000 units; repeat during a runner drain and a runner kill (<issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" /> scenarios) with no oversell and no lost hold.
* Nested pools: a sale is refused when the child has room but the parent is full.
* A replayed hold request with the same id returns the original hold.
* Expired holds return capacity within 5 seconds of expiry.
* Availability read p95 under 50 ms from the read model under the same load.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Effect Cluster as decided (<issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" />); no database row locks as the primary guard; behind flag `ticketing`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` and load-test output pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, load-test report attached here, and F9 thread confirms the line-provider handshake works against its cart.

## Blockers

F8.1, <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />, <issue id="1b79a257-9ea0-40b5-a8f7-23e1c09221be" label="EVE-39" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39/make-every-entity-action-idempotent-and-persisted-by-default" />, <issue id="2f9fdfdc-7e1d-4c27-9557-77465a22e3a9" label="EVE-38" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-38/cut-runner-loss-failover-from-36s-and-expose-the-cluster-settings-in" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />; F9 line-provider contract.

issues.title: F5.6 Build shortlists of suppliers per event
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01), part of <issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" /> (F5 Directory and marketplace).

## Goal

An organiser collects candidate suppliers for an event, compares them side by side with notes, and starts one enquiry to the chosen ones.

## Context

* <issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" /> sections 4 (`directory.shortlist.*`) and 6 (Shortlist screen).
* A shortlist may reference an F1 Event by id; F5 does not redefine the Event.
* Shortlists are private to the organiser tenant and work fully offline.

## Scope

1. Shortlist and ShortlistItem tables (organiser tenant scope), optional eventId, item note, added by.
2. Actions `directory.shortlist.create`, `.rename`, `.delete`, `.add`, `.remove`, all write class, no approval.
3. Shortlist screen: comparison table (kind, distance from the event location, capacity fit, price from, rating, response time), per-item notes, select items, "Enquire selected" which opens the F5.7 composer with recipients prefilled.
4. A shortlist panel on the F1 Event screen (the panel is a component F1 embeds; F5 ships it).
5. Offline: shortlists sync fully; listing summaries are cached copies refreshed on reconnect, with a stale marker when a listing was unpublished.
6. Projection: shortlist id, items with comparison values, selected ids.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests for each action, tenant isolation, and offline add then reconnect.
* An unpublished listing in a shortlist shows as unavailable and cannot be enquired.
* The agent builds a shortlist from a search and explains each item, using only these actions.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; Rambo-UI; flag `directory-marketplace`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green and the F1 panel component exported.

## Blockers

F5.4 (search), <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> (screen awareness), F1 Event existing for the event link (shortlists without an event can ship first).

issues.title: F13.2 Build the sensitive profile with field masking, reveal audit and retention
issues.description:
## Goal

Personal and special category data about a worker (legal name, date of birth, tax or national insurance id, address, bank details, nationality, health and access needs, optional diversity data, emergency contacts) is stored encrypted, masked everywhere by default, revealed only for a recorded purpose, exportable to the worker and purged on schedule.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />, sections 4 (Sensitive profile), 5, 9 and 11 (UK GDPR and EU GDPR). Builds on F13.1 (<issue id="7cc5c061-dd2d-4963-8e03-f0175a4f12b9" label="EVE-98" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-98/f131-build-worker-records-engagements-and-organisation-structure" />).
* Encryption keys and secret-marked fields from <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />; audit and approvals from <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />; telemetry redaction from <issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />; screen projections and masking from <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />; agent memory exclusion from <issue id="e00f04b6-a68b-41ed-8aa3-263fb8721b32" label="EVE-56" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-56/p18e-build-the-agent-harness-outbound-acp-agent-memory-and-context" />; private files from <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.

## Scope

1. SensitiveProfile and EmergencyContact tables with field-level encryption at rest, keys per tenant from <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />; special category fields (health, diversity) in a separate table with their own grant.
2. Actions `hr.sensitive.get` (fields, purpose; confirm for HR, none for self), `hr.sensitive.update` (no values echoed), `hr.emergencyContacts.set`, `hr.dataExport.subject`, `hr.retention.purge`.
3. A masking rule in the screen-context projection (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />): sensitive fields appear as typed placeholders unless revealed; reveal expires when the screen closes; each reveal writes an audit row with purpose.
4. Sensitive values are marked secret in the action schema, so they never enter spans, PostHog events, prompts or agent memory (<issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />, <issue id="e00f04b6-a68b-41ed-8aa3-263fb8721b32" label="EVE-56" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-56/p18e-build-the-agent-harness-outbound-acp-agent-memory-and-context" />); a test asserts this for every field.
5. Sync rule: sensitive rows never sync to a device other than the worker's own; emergency contact name and phone sync to a site supervisor's device only for workers rostered on their F1 Event that day.
6. Retention policies per record kind (configurable, UK defaults from <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" /> section 11), a durable scheduled purge run (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />) that produces a purge report, and an always-approve gate.
7. Subject export: one file (<issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />) holding every HR record about the worker, in a readable format plus JSON.

## Acceptance criteria

* A crew coordinator, a line manager and the agent acting for either cannot read any sensitive field through UI, HTTP, MCP or ACP (negative tests per surface).
* An HR admin reveal records who, which fields, purpose and time; the reveal is gone after the screen closes.
* No sensitive value appears in captured spans, events or the agent context in a full test run (assertion over exported telemetry).
* A purge after the retention date removes the fields and files and leaves an audit row without the values.
* The worker can export all their data from `me.profile` with no HR step.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; no new dependency (encryption uses what <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> provides) without Jonathan approving it on this issue; behind `hr-module`; ship to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here. Compliance wording to be checked with an adviser before launch.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the negative-test matrix green and a comment here listing every sensitive field, its grant and its retention default.

## Blockers

<issue id="7cc5c061-dd2d-4963-8e03-f0175a4f12b9" label="EVE-98" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-98/f131-build-worker-records-engagements-and-organisation-structure" /> (F13.1), <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />, <issue id="e00f04b6-a68b-41ed-8aa3-263fb8721b32" label="EVE-56" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-56/p18e-build-the-agent-harness-outbound-acp-agent-memory-and-context" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.

## APPROVED cross-tenant retention policy reference

Jonathan approved the EVE-250/EVE-251 revocation, retention and lawful-erasure policy. Revoked grants stop new exchange and ordinary access immediately; legally required contractual/payment/audit evidence remains purpose-limited and audited; separable PII is erased/anonymized where lawful; valid holds suspend deletion; crypto-shredding waits for all applicable obligations. Schedules remain record-, jurisdiction-, purpose- and law-specific. See [EVE-251](https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-251/decide-marketplace-service-attestation-and-cryptographic-trust). No implementation is authorized.

issues.title: F8.3 Build ticket issuance and delivery: signed tickets from paid orders, comps, voids and reissue
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

Every paid ticket line becomes a ticket with a code that any registered device can verify offline, delivered to the holder in-app, by email and as a PDF, and voided the moment it is refunded.

## Context

* Parent [EVE-76](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning>) sections 4, 5 and decisions D2 and D5.
* Code format: a compact payload (ticket id, ticket type id, event id, admission scope id, payload version, issued at) signed with a per-event Ed25519 key held in the secrets service ([EVE-41](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials>)); the device holds only public keys. The random 128-bit secret is kept server-side to allow revocation lists.

## Scope

1. Ticket schema and status machine (valid, void, transferred-out).
2. Actions: ticketing.ticket.issueForOrder (system, called by F9 commit; idempotent per order line), issueComp (always approval for agents), get, list, search (masked by role), updateHolder, void, reissue, deliver.
3. Per-event signing keys: create on first issue, rotate on demand, publish public keys to devices; key material never leaves the secrets service.
4. Delivery: in-app ticket card with QR, email through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> with the QR and a PDF from <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />. QR rendering and PDF libraries are new dependencies: propose them here for approval first.
5. F9 refund or cancel calls void for that line only; voids publish to the change feed so devices learn of them on next sync.
6. Attendee list and Ticket detail screens with projections; gate-staff role masking (name and type only).

## Acceptance criteria

* Paying an F9 order with three ticket lines issues three tickets once even if the paid event is delivered twice.
* A signature check in a test using only the public key accepts a real ticket and rejects one with a changed byte.
* Refunding one line voids exactly that ticket; scan of it after sync is rejected with reason void.
* Gate staff calling ticket.get via HTTP and MCP sees no email, answers or order id.
* Email and PDF render in the test harness with the code readable by a decoder.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no key material in logs, telemetry or action payloads; behind flag `ticketing`; QR and PDF libraries need Jonathan's approval here; whitelabel ASCII email copy; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, tests green, and a comment here with the payload format and its version number.

## Blockers

F8.2, <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />; F9 order paid and refund events.

issues.title: F6.3 Build the serialised asset register, containers and labels
issues.description:
## Goal

Every serialised item and every road case has its own identity, tag code, history and printed label, so crews and the agent can find and track it.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> sections 4 and 5 (Asset, containers, `inventory.label.print`). An Asset belongs to a Product with tracking `serialised` (F6.1); its location is derived from its last movement (F6.2).
* Containers (road cases, racks, dollies) are assets that hold other assets; packing a case moves its contents with it, as in the market check.
* Label printing goes through a neutral port; phase 1 renders PDF labels with no vendor. Photos and purchase documents use <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.

## Scope

1. Table `inventory_asset`: product, serial, tag code (unique per org; barcode Code 128 or QR payload), cost, purchase ref (F6.8 receipt line, nullable), in-service date, condition (`good`, `worn`, `damaged`), quarantine flag (F6.6), retired reason. Location is derived, never stored.
2. Containers: `inventory_container_content` (container asset, content asset or bulk product with qty). `inventory.container.pack` and `unpack` write movements so contents follow the container; moving a container writes one movement per content line in the same transaction; nesting allowed, cycles rejected (`ContainerCycle`).
3. Actions `inventory.asset.register` (single and batch), `get` (by id or tag code), `history` (movement timeline, inspections when F6.7 lands), `retire` (confirm; writes a movement to the virtual lost or scrap location).
4. Label port `LabelRenderer` (Effect service) with a PDF adapter; `inventory.label.print` renders asset and bin labels from a template (name, tag code as barcode and QR, org name). Network printer adapters are a later issue.
5. Screen Asset detail (Rambo-UI Card, Timeline, Badge) with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* Registering an asset with a tag code already used in the org fails with `DuplicateTagCode`.
* Packing 6 fixtures into a case and moving the case to a vehicle location shows all 6 at the vehicle; unpacking one at an event-site location leaves 5 in the case.
* A retired asset no longer counts in levels or availability and its history is still readable.
* `inventory.label.print` for 20 assets returns one PDF whose barcodes decode to the tag codes (test decodes them).
* Asking the agent "where is case 0412" answers from `asset.get` with its location and contents.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-inventory`; a barcode or PDF generation library is a new dependency and needs Jonathan's approval on this issue before use; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with tests green and a sample label PDF attached here.

issues.title: F5.7 Build cross-tenant enquiries (RFPs) and private message threads
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01), part of <issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" /> (F5 Directory and marketplace).

## Goal

An organiser sends one brief to several suppliers, and each supplier gets a private thread with that organiser that nobody else can see.

## Context

* <issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" /> sections 4, 5 (Enquiry, EnquiryRecipient, Message) and 9 (cross-tenant rule).
* This is the first record type shared between two tenants. <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> isolates tenants; this issue adds a two-party authorization rule there: the principal belongs to the organiser tenant or the vendor tenant of the EnquiryRecipient row and holds the enquiry permission in that tenant. It must be reviewed with <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />'s owner before code.
* Notifications go through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />; the vendor inbox updates from the change feed (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />).

## Scope

 1. Enquiry (organiser tenant), EnquiryRecipient (both tenant ids), Message (append-only) tables.
 2. Actions `directory.enquiry.draft`, `.send`, `.withdraw`, `.message`, `.decline`. Approvals: send is confirm, always when more than 5 recipients; message is confirm when the caller is an agent.
 3. The brief: dates, headcount, location, budget range (optional, visible to recipients only if the organiser opts in), requirements text, attachments ([EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import>)), optional F1 Event id. Prefill from the F1 Event when given.
 4. Recipient privacy: recipients never see each other's identity or messages; the organiser sees all threads.
 5. EnquiryRecipient state machine: new, viewed, responded, declined, quoted, won, lost, expired; enquiries auto-expire after a configurable period (default 30 days, configuration via [EVE-41](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials>)).
 6. Screens: enquiry composer (organiser), enquiry inbox and thread (vendor), enquiry overview with per-recipient status (organiser). Projections mark other-tenant text as untrusted for the agent.
 7. Offline: drafts and messages queue offline and are authorized on reconnect; the UI shows queued, never sent.
 8. Anti-spam: per-tenant daily send limit, and a listing can opt out of enquiries from unverified organisers.
 9. Response-time statistic per listing computed from first vendor response.
10. CRM capture: on send, call crm.enquiry.capture (<issue id="aa5aaa4a-23e6-4982-bde3-b771cf4bf000" label="EVE-137" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-137/f46-capture-enquiries-and-track-opportunities-through-a-pipeline-into" />) in the vendor tenant through the action inventory (acting as the system for that tenant, audited) and store the returned id as crmEnquiryRef; the organiser side links the supplier to an F4 Organisation (find or create). If F4 is not built yet, record the capture as pending and replay it when it ships.
11. Unclaimed recipients: a recipient listing that is unclaimed gets status `awaiting claim`; F5.13 (<issue id="0c66a703-79d5-407a-a0c0-69ab5efdc31b" label="EVE-236" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-236/f513-build-seeded-listings-claiming-claim-disputes-and-removal" />) sends the claim invitation, and the recipient becomes a normal thread when the listing is claimed. The organiser sees the unclaimed label in the composer before sending.

## Acceptance criteria

* Negative test matrix: recipient A cannot read recipient B's thread; vendor cannot list the organiser's other enquiries; organiser member without enquiry:read cannot read threads; agent for a viewer cannot send.
* A queued offline message is sent once on reconnect (dedupe test) and an enquiry withdrawn meanwhile rejects it with a typed error.
* An instruction inside a vendor message is not executed by the agent (agent eval fixture via <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> when available, unit test of the untrusted marker now).
* Audit rows on both tenants for every send.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no zod; flag `directory-marketplace`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the negative matrix green and the two-party authorization rule documented in the <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> ai-docs.

## Blockers

F5.1, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> (authorization and approvals), <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" /> (change feed), <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> (notifications; in-app badges only until it lands), <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> (attachments).

### D5-12 coordination (2026-11-13) - selective supplier enquiries and varied procurement workflows

* F5.7 must support one or multiple **individually selected** suppliers in an organiser-initiated approved batch, not assume every invited supplier gets each revision. A single authorised bulk action can release a batch, but maintain distinct per-supplier version-locked request snapshots, recipients, approval records, send status and idempotent retry, with no cross-supplier price/brief leakage.
* Suppliers and sourcing packages may use different enquiry workflows: prescriptive item/quantity RFQ, supplier-designed/specification-led proposal (e.g. video wall), alternatives, or combined multi-discipline scope (e.g. video + audio). The same requirement may have multiple candidate suppliers; one supplier may address many requirements/categories in one response. Preserve mappings and separate supplier-visible brief versions from exploratory plan revisions.
* Organisers can pause/skip a supplier once a preferred provider emerges, without deleting quote/RFP history or forcing re-contact. Changes to grouping or internal comparison views must never send supplier communications.
* Pricing/document response and grouping ownership stays in <issue id="f08bafe4-f32d-4906-9e87-5d69df56d6a0" label="EVE-124" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-124/f58-build-quotes-quote-comparison-and-the-acceptance-handoff-to-the" />. Original supplier proposal is immutable; F5.7 sends and tracks authorised briefs and private threads, not inferred partial bundle prices. Follow D5-11's manual release gate and <issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> shared agent-native actions.

### Planning decision - convey exact/functional scope and allow supplier alternatives (2026-11-13; D5-13 in <issue id="f08bafe4-f32d-4906-9e87-5d69df56d6a0" label="EVE-124" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-124/f58-build-quotes-quote-comparison-and-the-acceptance-handoff-to-the" />)

* Version-locked supplier enquiry briefs expose buyer's per-requirement policy: 'Exact item required' with exact manufacturer/model/variant and rider/source constraints, or 'Function-based - recommend suitable product' with intended use, hard/soft criteria, quantity and any exclusions. Never collapse requirements into unqualified free text or assume all briefs require a manufacturer SKU.
* Supplier responses may provide a named proposed product, specification and evidence linked to a requirement ID, one or several options, or a design-led solution. For exact requirements, alternate proposals are explicitly 'deviation requiring approval', separate from a compliant exact quotation. Capture omissions, exceptions, accessories and price terms without changing the originating event requirement.
* Do not contact suppliers automatically when policies, requirement criteria or selected alternatives change internally: use D5-11's manual reviewed consolidated release gate; supplier-specific request baselines, isolation and multiple-supplier selection from D5-12 still apply.

### Planning coordination D5-14 - supplier selection/import at quoting (2026-11-13)

Suppliers may answer an RFQ by selecting a known model/kit from F6 and linking their own stock SKU, or by uploading a product specification/datasheet and submitting a new product for controlled intake. Quote can proceed with incompletely verified specifications, flagged for review rather than falsely equivalenced. Preserve original quote, supplier-selected model and evidence version; never replace it retroactively when catalogue records change. Cross-tenant availability is a consented, freshness-labelled projection, not raw F6 stock. No automatic external supplier messages based on inventory changes.

issues.title: F10.0 Spike: map engine with offline tiles and Yjs-bound editing on Expo web and Android
issues.description:
Decided 2026-11-08 (Jonathan): D-F10-1 is MapLibre with open map tiles. This spike now confirms it; it falls back to the alternatives only if a criterion fails.

## Goal

Prove, on a throwaway `spike/*` branch, that one map engine renders a geo-referenced site with editable features on Expo web and an Android device, works offline from a downloaded region, and keeps feature edits in a Yjs document that two clients share.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> (F10), decision D-F10-1 (map engine). Recommended engine: MapLibre (maplibre-react-native on device, maplibre-gl-js on web) with Protomaps PMTiles built from OpenStreetMap, imagery from one vendor behind a port.
* Builds on the <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" /> Expo and Re.Pack stack and the <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> sync result (PowerSync for records plus Yjs for documents, web passed, device test pending).
* Alternatives to measure against if MapLibre fails a criterion: a custom Skia canvas, or react-native-svg.

## Scope

1. Expo development build (not Expo Go) with the engine on Android and web from one React Native component tree. maplibre-react-native v11 needs the new architecture and React Native 0.80 or later, and has no web target, so web uses maplibre-gl-js behind the same MapEngine port with one shared style spec (checked 2026-11-08).
2. A fixture site: 1 km2 OpenStreetMap PMTiles extract served locally, one raster imagery source, one calibrated PNG plan overlay.
3. 2,000 fixture features (points with symbols, fence lines, zone polygons) in one Yjs document per layer; drag, rotate and delete update Yjs, and Yjs updates redraw the map.
4. Two clients (web and Android) on a local y-websocket or the <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> stack; one goes offline, both edit, both converge.
5. Offline: download the region as a per-site PMTiles extract opened with `pmtiles://file://` (not the tile-by-tile offline manager), plus overlay and layer docs; switch to airplane mode, restart the app, edit. On web, prove the same extract works from a service worker cache after a reload with the network off.
   5a. Editing handles: neither MapLibre client ships editing tools on device, so build the drag, rotate and vertex handles as an Eventiva gesture layer and measure it; test Terra Draw on web only.
   5b. Concurrent edits: an offline client moves a feature, an online client moves it later; record which wins (Yjs orders by logical clock and client id, not time) and show the change notice.
6. Record frame time while panning with 2,000 features on a mid-range Android device, and bundle size added on web.
7. Plan-only mode (<issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> scope note, 2026-11-08): with the basemap off, render a three-level building fixture (walls, rooms, doors, stairs) in the site-local metric frame, switch levels, and show the level below ghosted; measure frame time with 10,000 plan features. If MapLibre cannot do this well, record the gap and test a Skia renderer for plan-only sites behind the same MapEngine port.
8. Check the tile and imagery licences for offline caching and printing, and record the result. Desk check done 2026-11-08 (<issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> section 8): Mapbox and Esri imagery cannot go into MapLibre offline packs, MapTiler self-hosted imagery is sales-only; the spike uses a local orthophoto fixture as the offline imagery layer (D-F10-6).

## Acceptance criteria

* Screen recording of web and Android showing the fixture, an edit on each converging, and the offline restart.
* Frame-time numbers (median and p95) and web bundle delta in the issue.
* A pass or fail per criterion for MapLibre, and for the fallback if MapLibre fails any.
* A recommendation comment that confirms or changes D-F10-1.

## Constraints

Spike only: no merge to main; spike dependencies are listed in a comment for Jonathan to approve before any real use; no vendor sign-up (use a free development key only if a vendor allows it without a contract, otherwise imagery is a local fixture); no real customer data.

## Done signal

Comment with the evidence and recommendation, artefacts in the project files folder, and D-F10-1 marked decided by Jonathan.

## Blockers

<issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" /> (Expo stack), <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> (sync engine).

issues.title: F13.3 Build HR documents, templates and built-in e-signature
issues.description:
## Goal

HR can write contract and policy templates together, generate a document for a worker with their details merged in, send it for signature and get back a signed copy with evidence that holds up, without an external e-signature vendor in phase one.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />, sections 4 (Documents and signatures), 5, 8 (`ESignature` port) and 11 (written statement of particulars, e-signature evidence). Decision 4 on <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" /> recommends a built-in simple electronic signature.
* Template bodies are collaborative documents attached to a record (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />); files are private attachments (<issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />); signing reminders go through notifications (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />).

## Scope

1. Tables DocumentTemplate (versioned, body as Yjs document), HrDocument, SignatureRequest, SignatureEvent, Policy, Acknowledgement.
2. Actions `hr.documentTemplates.create` / `.update`, `hr.documents.generate`, `hr.documents.upload`, `hr.signatures.request`, `.sign`, `.decline`, `.void`, `hr.policies.publish`, `hr.policies.acknowledge`.
3. Merge fields drawn from Worker, Engagement, Position and the tenant (F4 Organisation), validated by Schema; a template with an unknown field fails to publish.
4. Rendering a generated document to PDF as the signing copy; the document hash is stored before signing.
5. `ESignature` port with a built-in adapter: signer identity from the authenticated session (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />), explicit consent text, typed or drawn signature, timestamp, device and network details, document hash before and after, and a sealed evidence page appended to the PDF.
6. `hr.signatures.sign` and `hr.policies.acknowledge` are human-only: the agent can prepare and send, never sign or acknowledge (action metadata enforces it on every surface).
7. Signing needs connectivity; offline the screen says so and queues nothing.
8. Starter templates (whitelabel, ASCII): written statement of particulars, freelancer agreement, volunteer agreement, 48-hour opt-out, confidentiality agreement.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two HR users edit a template at once and converge (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />); publishing creates a new version and documents keep the version they were generated from.
* A generated contract signed by the worker and the company signatory produces a PDF whose evidence page matches the stored hashes; altering one byte fails verification.
* The agent, asked to sign on someone's behalf, is refused on UI, MCP and ACP with a typed `HumanOnlyAction` error.
* Unsigned documents past due date appear in `hr.reports.compliance` and produce a reminder.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; PDF rendering uses a library only after Jonathan approves it on this issue; behind `hr-module`; ship to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, a signed sample contract and its verification output attached here.

## Blockers

<issue id="7cc5c061-dd2d-4963-8e03-f0175a4f12b9" label="EVE-98" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-98/f131-build-worker-records-engagements-and-organisation-structure" /> (F13.1), <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.

issues.title: F8.4 Build the attendee view: my tickets, holder details and transfers in the one app
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

A ticket holder opens the same Eventiva app the organiser uses, sees only their own tickets, shows the code at the gate even offline, fills in details and passes a ticket to someone else when the organiser allows it.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> sections 2, 6, 9 and decision D4. One app for every role (project goal); the attendee view is a role-adapted set of screens, not a separate app.
* Holders may not have an org membership: they are external users with holder rights on their own tickets (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />).

## Scope

1. My tickets screen and ticket card with QR; tickets cached on device for offline display (record sync, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />) and refreshed on reconnect.
2. Actions: ticketing.transfer.offer, accept, cancel; ticket.updateHolder for own ticket when the type allows; navigation actions.
3. Transfer flow: offer to an email, recipient accepts and gets a new ticket (old one becomes transferred-out and its code stops working); blocked when the type is not transferable or within a cut-off before doors set per type (default 2 hours).
4. Attendee questions completion prompt when answers are missing.
5. Sign-in for holders by email link (through <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> identity), including claiming tickets bought as a guest.

## Acceptance criteria

* A holder sees only their tickets via UI, HTTP and MCP; another holder's ticket id returns not found.
* After a transfer, the old code is rejected at the next online scan and after the next device sync; the new holder's code admits.
* Tickets display with the device in airplane mode after one prior sync.
* The agent, acting for the holder, can transfer a ticket only after the holder confirms.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Rambo-UI components; WCAG 2.2 AA; behind flag `ticketing`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, tests green, recorded run on web and Android showing offline ticket display and a transfer.

## Blockers

F8.3, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />.

issues.title: F6.4 Build availability and reservations against events, carts and production plans
issues.description:
## Goal

A production manager, a sales channel or the agent can see what is free for a date range and hold it for an event or a cart, and shortages appear the moment they happen, including after offline edits sync.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> sections 4, 5 and 8. F1 names are fixed in <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> section 5: Reservation attaches to an `Event` and optionally a `Phase`; event-site locations reference the `Event` or a `Space`.
* `inventory.reservation.fromPlan` reads F1 `EquipmentRequirement` rows (event_id, phase_id, department_id, catalogue_ref = F6 Product id, quantity, needed_from, needed_to, source, source_element_ids), filtered by event and phase. F1's `requirement.sendToWarehouse` (confirm approval) triggers it.
* F9 contract (<issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> section 8): line kind `stock` calls `reservation.create` on cart add (with expiry), `commit` on payment, `release` on expiry, cancel or refund with restock.
* Time windows reuse the <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" /> scheduling primitives where they fit.

## Scope

1. Tables `inventory_reservation` (event, phase, window out and return due, status `hold`, `confirmed`, `picking`, `out`, `returned`, `cancelled`, `conflict`, source `manual`, `plan`, `sales`, expiry for sales holds) and `inventory_reservation_line` (product qty or specific asset, requirement ref).
2. Availability per product per day: owned stock in the warehouse minus confirmed and held reservations overlapping the window, minus quarantined and retired assets, plus inbound purchase receipts and sub-hires due before the window (F6.8 and F6.9 add these terms when they land). Kits expand to components.
3. Actions `inventory.availability.query`, `inventory.reservation.create`, `update`, `cancel`, `fromPlan`, `commit`, `release`, `inventory.shortage.list` (each shortage with options: sub-hire, purchase, substitute product in the same category, transfer from another warehouse).
4. Server re-check on sync: when a reservation made offline overbooks, its lines take status `conflict`, a `inventory:shortage_detected` event is emitted, and nothing is dropped.
5. Sales holds expire automatically (Effect schedule on the server) and emit `inventory:reservation_released`.
6. Screens Availability calendar and Event equipment (a tab on the F1 Event screen) with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projections and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* With 10 owned units, holds of 6 and 5 overlapping on one day give availability -1 and one shortage listing all four option types.
* `fromPlan` on an event with 3 EquipmentRequirement rows across 2 phases creates one draft reservation with 3 lines and windows from needed_from and needed_to; re-running it updates rather than duplicates.
* Two offline devices each reserve the last 4 units for different events; after sync one is `confirmed`, the later one is `conflict`, and a shortage event exists.
* A sales hold not committed before expiry is released and availability returns.
* `commit` writes movements to the customer location for a sale; `release` with restock writes the reverse movement.
* The agent answers "what am I short for Saturday" from `shortage.list`.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-inventory`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the offline overbooking test green and its output pasted here.
