issues.title: F2.4 Build assignments, offers and roster confirmation
issues.description:
## Goal

Schedulers put people on shifts, send them offers, and see accepts and declines arrive, ending with a confirmed roster everyone can rely on.

## Context

* Slice 4 of F2 (<issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> sections 4 and 5). Assignment is an <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" /> Booking with an F2 state machine (<issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />).
* Offers go out through the notifications port (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />).

## Scope

1. Assignment state machine: proposed, offered, accepted, declined, confirmed, cancelled, completed; illegal transitions are typed errors.
2. Actions `roster.assign` (runs `rules.check`, blocks unless overridden), `roster.unassign` (approval always once confirmed), `offer.send` (agent confirm; batch; expiry), `offer.respond`, `offer.withdraw`, `roster.confirm` (approval always).
3. Offline: transitions replay in order at sync; accept after withdraw is rejected and shown to both sides; an offline double booking is kept, flagged on both assignments and blocks `offer.send` for them until resolved.
4. Reminders: unanswered offers produce a reminder draft after a configurable time (default 24 hours); sending it is `offer.send`.
5. Engagement type (employee, freelancer, agency) recorded on each assignment for F12. On accept, link the Assignment to the person's F1 TeamMember on the Event (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />), creating it through F1's action with the external flag for freelancers.
6. My schedule screen for crew (offers inbox, upcoming shifts) with projection.

## Acceptance criteria

* Assign, offer, accept, confirm round trip through UI and through MCP gives identical records and audit entries.
* Two offline devices double-book one person; after reconnect both assignments show a conflict and `offer.send` on them fails with `UnresolvedConflict`.
* An agent calling `roster.confirm` produces an approval request instead of confirming.
* Expired offers move to declined with reason `expired`.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; behind flag `f2-scheduling`; no new dependency without approval here; whitelabel ASCII message copy; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, tests green, and a comment here with the check output and the state diagram.

## Blockers

F2.2, F2.3, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />.

issues.title: F2.5 Build external crew access and offer links
issues.description:
## Goal

Freelancers who are not org members can answer availability requests and offers in one tap from a link, and use the same app with a guest account if they install it.

## Context

* Slice 5 of F2 (<issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> section 9, decision 5 recommended option a). One application per device: a guest account is the same app with a guest scope, never a separate crew app.
* Identity and guest scopes come from <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />; links are served through the HTTP surface (<issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" />).

## Scope

1. Guest identity: invite by email or phone creates a guest member scoped to assignments and requests addressed to them, across orgs if several invite them.
2. Signed single-use links for `offer.respond` and `availability.request.respond`, bound to the recipient, expiring with the offer, invalid after use or on revoke.
3. A web response page (react-native-web) with no install and no sign-in required for the single action; any other screen needs the guest sign-in.
4. Revoking guest access stops sync, invalidates links and ICS feeds at once.
5. Guest view filters: only their own assignments and the published call sheets for days they work; masked contact details for everyone else.

## Acceptance criteria

* A link accepts an offer once; a second use, a forwarded use after accept, and use after revoke all fail with typed errors and audit records.
* A guest signed in sees no other person's assignments (negative test on HTTP, MCP and sync).
* The response page passes axe with no WCAG 2.2 AA violations.
* A guest invited by two orgs sees both without data crossing between them.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; link tokens never logged or put in telemetry; behind flag `f2-scheduling`; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, security tests green, and a comment here with the check output and the token threat notes.

## Blockers

F2.4, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" />.

issues.title: F14.1 Custom fields on any entity, in the action inventory
issues.description:
## Goal

An organisation adds its own fields to any extensible record (for example an F1 Event or a crew booking), and those fields are read, written, filtered, synced offline and available to the agent exactly like built-in fields, for that tenant only.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> (F14), sections 4 (Studio actions), 5 (FieldDefinition) and decision D3 (one `custom` JSONB column).
* Upstream reference at 6b5cf68: `app-config/`, `settings/` (schema-declared settings) and `data-programs/` (agent-authored data definitions), read for behaviour only.
* <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> builds a static inventory. Custom fields need the inventory to be augmented per tenant at runtime: the entity's write actions (for example F1 `events.update`) accept a `custom` object whose Effect Schema is compiled from the tenant's published FieldDefinitions, and the provider-safe JSON Schema the agent sees is generated per tenant.
* <issue id="62f3bba8-9275-4ff1-98bf-62b95f432b37" label="EVE-32" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-32/port-settings-profiles-navigation-command-menu-and-onboarding" /> generates settings screens from Effect Schema; the same generator renders custom fields on forms.

## Scope

1. `FieldDefinition` table and Effect Schema; field types: text, rich text (Yjs doc via <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />), number, money (amount plus currency), date, datetime, duration, boolean, select, multi-select, reference (any entity type, tenant-scoped), person, file (<issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> handle), location, computed (declarative expression over the same record), AI (value filled by an automation step, F14.6).
2. Extensible tables declare themselves with a `custom` column helper in the shared schema package (<issue id="c31b6b08-1532-4a7a-945f-24a70bbab765" label="EVE-23" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23/split-core-into-portable-contracts-and-backend-runtime-with-a-shared" /> / D6): JSONB on Postgres, JSON text on SQLite. `indexed: true` creates an expression index through a generated migration owned by the platform, not by the tenant.
3. A `CustomSchemaRegistry` service (`Context.Tag`) that compiles a tenant's published definitions to Effect Schema, caches per CustomisationVersion, and augments entity actions' input and output.
4. Per-tenant JSON Schema for MCP, HTTP and AI tools; the parity check (<issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> target) covers augmented actions with a fixture tenant.
5. Actions `studio.describe`, `studio.fields.define`, `.update`, `.archive`, `.purge` (drafts land in a change set; until F14.4 lands, a minimal publish that applies immediately behind the flag).
6. Field-level permission: inherit the entity rule; optional stricter read/write grant; `pii` fields masked in lists, telemetry and agent context without the pii grant (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />).
7. Offline: definitions sync as read-only data; values sync per key with last writer wins; rich text values merge by CRDT.
8. Field screens in the Field designer (section 6), and custom fields rendered on the generated form section of every extensible screen with screen-context projection entries.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tenant A adds `wristband_colour` (select) to F1 Event; the agent reads and sets it through `events.update`; tenant B's JSON Schema for the same action has no such field (test).
* Writing an invalid option fails with a typed `CustomFieldInvalid` error on every surface (UI, HTTP, MCP).
* Two devices edit different custom keys offline on the same record and both survive reconnect; the same key resolves by last writer wins (test).
* A pii field is masked for a viewer without the grant in UI, agent context and spans (test).
* Archiving hides the field and keeps values; purge deletes values and leaves an audit record.
* The parity target passes with augmented actions.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; WCAG 2.2 AA for UI; behind `f14-studio` (default off); keys are immutable once published; no per-tenant DDL; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, the acceptance tests green, and a comment here describing the `custom` column helper and the registry API so F1 to F13 can adopt them.

issues.title: F2.7 Build call sheets
issues.description:
## Goal

Every person on an event day gets one call sheet with their call time, place, contacts and the day's schedule, readable offline, and the production team knows who has read it.

## Context

* Slice 7 of F2 (<issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> sections 4 to 6). Draws from F1 Event, Itinerary and Run of show, and from confirmed Assignments.
* Notes are a Yjs document embedded in the CallSheet record (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />); PDF export through files (<issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />).

## Scope

1. `callsheet.generate` builds a draft for an Event and date: venue and address, parking and access notes, weather placeholder, Run of show for the day, per-person call times grouped by department, key contacts, emergency info.
2. `callsheet.update` edits sections; notes are collaborative.
3. `callsheet.publish` (agent confirm) freezes an immutable CallSheetVersion and notifies recipients; republish creates a new version with a change summary.
4. `callsheet.acknowledge` records read receipts; production sees who has not acknowledged.
5. `callsheet.export` to PDF; each person's PDF highlights their own call time.
6. Offline: assignees download published versions for the next 14 days; viewing works in airplane mode.
7. Contact details shown only to people working that day.

## Acceptance criteria

* Generate, edit with two people, publish, acknowledge: version history shows both versions and the diff summary.
* A crew member opens the latest version offline on Android and web.
* A person not on the day cannot read it (negative test on every surface).
* The agent builds tomorrow's call sheet on request and asks before publishing.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; whitelabel ASCII templates; localization-ready strings (<issue id="338aae77-d10e-4f8a-9189-fe3655bd3572" label="EVE-28" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-28/port-localization-for-people-and-for-the-agent" />); behind flag `f2-scheduling`; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, offline checks recorded here.

## Blockers

F2.4, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, F1 Itinerary and Run of show.

issues.title: F2.8 Build open shifts and shift swaps
issues.description:
## Goal

Crew can pick up open shifts and hand over or swap shifts with each other, with the scheduler approving and the rules still enforced.

## Context

* Slice 8 of F2 (<issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> section 4). Uses the assignment state machine (F2.4) and rules engine (F2.3).

## Scope

1. `shift.open.post` publishes an unfilled shift to eligible people (role and qualifications match, rules pass); `shift.open.claim` creates a proposed assignment, first valid claim wins, server authoritative.
2. `swap.request` (to a named person or open), `swap.offer`, `swap.accept`, `swap.approve` (approval always, crew chief or `roster:approve`).
3. Rules run on both sides of a swap; a swap that breaks a block rule cannot be approved without an override.
4. Notifications to eligible people and to the approver through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.
5. Open shifts and swaps screen with projection.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two people claim one open shift at once; exactly one gets it, the other gets a typed `AlreadyClaimed` result.
* A swap leaving one person under 11 hours rest shows the block and needs an override.
* The agent can request a swap for the user but cannot approve it.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; behind flag `f2-scheduling`; no new dependency without approval here; WCAG 2.2 AA; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, tests green, check output here.

issues.title: F4.6 Capture enquiries and track opportunities through a pipeline into events
issues.description:
## Goal

An enquiry from a website form, email or phone call becomes a tracked opportunity that moves through stages and, when won, becomes an event with its client and contacts already attached.

## Context

* Parent [EVE-65](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history>) sections 4 (enquiry, opportunity, pipeline actions), 6 (Pipeline board, Enquiry inbox) and decision D2 (pipeline lives in F4; recommended). If Jonathan picks D2 B, this issue moves to F9 unchanged.
* Event and event templates are F1 entities; `convertToEvent` calls F1's create action, it does not write F1 tables.
* Proposals, quotes and deposits are F9 and F11; an Opportunity only carries an estimated value.
* Public forms come from the F14 website builder later; this issue ships a hosted form endpoint and an embeddable snippet with a per-tenant token.
* F5 directory (<issue id="b22fbb0d-100b-47a3-8c32-eeacadc4c9fe" label="EVE-66" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-66/f5-directory-and-marketplace-vendor-venue-and-professional-listings" />, <issue id="03bd23d1-9da5-4272-8f2e-0b0bf4f7f846" label="EVE-119" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-119/f57-build-cross-tenant-enquiries-rfps-and-private-message-threads" /> item 10, <issue id="f08bafe4-f32d-4906-9e87-5d69df56d6a0" label="EVE-124" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-124/f58-build-quotes-quote-comparison-and-the-acceptance-handoff-to-the" />) calls `crm.enquiry.capture` as a system principal acting for the vendor tenant, stores the returned id as `crmEnquiryRef`, and calls `crm.enquiry.resolve` on quote acceptance or decline. The system principal is scoped to `crm.enquiry.capture` and `crm.enquiry.resolve` in that tenant only, and every call is audited with the F5 thread id as source.

## Scope

1. Tables `enquiry`, `pipeline`, `stage` (order, probability, won or lost flag), `opportunity`.
2. Actions `crm.enquiry.capture` (public token, rate limited, spam checked by honeypot and time-to-submit, no vendor captcha), `crm.enquiry.qualify` / `discard` / `match` / `resolve` (outcome won or lost with reason; if the enquiry has an opportunity, it also calls `markWon` or `markLost` on it; status gains won and lost), `crm.opportunity.create` / `update` / `moveStage` / `markWon` / `markLost` / `convertToEvent` (confirm), `crm.pipeline.define` / `update`.
3. Default pipeline per tenant: New enquiry, Qualified, Site visit, Proposal sent, Negotiation, Won, Lost (editable).
4. Stage conflict rule from the parent (server order; stale won or lost rejected back to the user).
5. Convert to event: creates the F1 Event from a chosen template with `Event.client_ref` set to the opportunity's party ([EVE-73](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show>)), adds the opportunity's other contacts as EventRoles (F4.2), links the opportunity, logs an Interaction (F4.3).
6. Screens: Enquiry inbox, Pipeline board, Opportunities tab on detail pages. Flag `crm-pipeline`.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: a form post creates an Enquiry and matches an existing person by email; a system principal for tenant A can capture and resolve in A and is denied in tenant B and on every other CRM action; resolve won on an enquiry with an opportunity marks the opportunity won; a stale offline move to won is rejected with a typed error; convert creates exactly one event even when retried.
* The agent turns "Sarah from Acme rang about a 200 person launch in March" into a person, organisation, enquiry and opportunity, and asks before converting.
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; public endpoint rate limited and audited; whitelabel form copy; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green and a recorded demo of enquiry to event on web.

## Blockers

<issue id="2e57e1c4-1d58-43b1-bc1e-be0c74986f29" label="EVE-91" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-91/f42-link-contacts-to-events-with-roles-and-to-each-other-with" /> (F4.2), <issue id="c3695c62-5106-4bd6-8ce1-c7dff1d14427" label="EVE-95" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-95/f43-build-the-activity-timeline-interactions-notes-and-history-from" /> (F4.3), <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" /> for the public endpoint, F1 Event create action.

issues.title: F2.9 Build time capture and timesheets
issues.description:
## Goal

Crew clock in and out against their shift, even with no signal, and approvers sign off accurate hours that payroll and costing can trust.

## Context

* Slice 9 of F2 (<issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> sections 4, 5 and 11). Decision 1 (recommended a): F2 owns time capture and approval; F12 consumes approved timesheets; F11 reads hours per event.

## Scope

1. TimeEntry append-only: clock in, break start, break end, clock out, with device time and server time stamped at sync; crew chief can clock on behalf with reason.
2. Optional location stamp at clock events only (flag `f2-geo-clock`, opt-in per org and person, 90-day retention).
3. Timesheet per person per period built from entries, with variance against rostered times; `timesheet.submit`, `timesheet.adjust` (reason, agent confirm), `timesheet.approve` and `timesheet.reject` (approval always), approved is locked.
4. `timesheet.export` produces a versioned batch for F12 and a CSV; exports are idempotent per period.
5. Clock and Timesheet review screens with projections.
6. Payroll contract (agreed with F12, which closed <issue id="e08704c6-b901-4fc2-8753-73aaf09f694f" label="EVE-83" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-83/f122-build-time-capture-clock-in-and-out-and-time-entries-offline" /> and <issue id="6d951ef7-861e-43b3-aaa8-3f2ba0d53f56" label="EVE-85" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-85/f123-build-timesheets-draft-from-roster-submit-and-approve" /> as duplicates of this issue): approver scope per Event (and Department where granted); an approval made offline against a timesheet that changed or was locked meanwhile is rejected at sync as stale; export lines carry Event, Phase, Department, engagement type and source refs (assignment, time entry ids) plus rostered and actual times; `timesheet.lock` (called by F12 when a pay run locks a period) makes the covered timesheets immutable, after which `timesheet.adjust` fails with `PeriodLocked`. Allowances (meal, travel, late finish) stay in F12 (<issue id="f734b33a-bc05-42ca-85ac-186863c86523" label="EVE-87" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-87/f124-build-pay-run-calculation-on-durable-runs" />).

## Acceptance criteria

* Clock in offline at 07:58 device time, reconnect at 10:00: entry keeps 07:58 device time and 10:00 server time; variance shown.
* Editing an approved timesheet fails without `timesheet.adjust`; adjustments appear in audit.
* Export of the same period twice returns the same batch id.
* No location is stored when the flag or consent is off (test).
* An offline approval of a timesheet edited online in the meantime is rejected as stale on sync.
* After `timesheet.lock`, adjust and approve fail with `PeriodLocked`; export lines include every field F12 listed.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; personal data rules in <issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> section 11; behind flag `f2-scheduling`; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, offline clock test recorded on Android and web, check output here.

## Blockers

F2.4, <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />.

comments.body:
Payroll (F12, EVE-61) agrees F2 owns time capture and timesheets. EVE-83 and EVE-85 are closed as duplicates of this issue. Please carry these payroll needs here:

* Clock events are append-only with an idempotency key, device time and server time, so two offline devices never overwrite each other. Flag clock skew over 5 minutes.
* Show the variance between clocked and rostered time per entry, with an org threshold (default 15 minutes).
* An approval queued offline against a timesheet that changed since is rejected on sync and flagged.
* Approver scope is per event or team. A timesheet that spans two events needs each event's approver.
* Clock-in location is an org opt-in, recorded only at clock in and out (F12 decision D5).
* `timesheet.export` lines carry Event, Phase and Department where known, the engagement type, and a source ref per entry, so `payroll.run.explainLine` can trace pay back to the time it came from.
* Timesheets move to locked only when a payroll run locks them (EVE-87), through an action F2 exposes.

Pay allowances (meal, travel, late finish) stay in F12 (EVE-87), not in F2.

issues.title: F4.7 Sync mailbox and calendar history into the contact timeline
issues.description:
## Goal

Emails and meetings with known contacts appear on their timeline without anyone logging them, and follow-ups can be sent from the user's own mailbox.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" /> sections 8 (MailboxSync, CalendarSync ports), 11 (mailbox compliance) and decision D3 (recommended A: ports plus Google and Microsoft adapters, forwarding address first).
* Credentials live in <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />, never in records, prompts or telemetry. Sync jobs are durable (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />).
* No adapter dependency or vendor app registration happens until Jonathan approves it on this issue; list the exact packages and the provider terms for API use here first.

## Scope

1. Neutral ports `MailboxSync` (list since cursor, fetch message, send) and `CalendarSync` (list events since cursor) as Effect services in `integrations/crm-mail`; domain code depends only on the ports.
2. No-vendor first step: a per-tenant forwarding address (through the <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> inbound path) that turns forwarded or BCC'd mail into Interactions for matched parties.
3. Adapters, after approval: Google (Gmail and Calendar APIs) and Microsoft (Graph mail and calendar), OAuth with least scopes (read metadata and bodies, send), per member.
4. Actions `crm.mailbox.connect` (confirm) / `disconnect` / `sync` / `status`; matching rules (only messages with at least one known party are stored; internal-only threads skipped; per-member exclusion list).
5. Sync job: incremental by cursor, idempotent by external message id, backoff on provider limits, revocation stops the job at the next step.
6. Send: `crm.followUp.send` drafts by agent or person, sends through the member's mailbox after confirm, logged as an outbound Interaction; marketing sends refuse without consent (F4.8 check).
7. Screen: Mailbox connections in settings with status and last sync. Flag `crm-mailbox-sync`.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests with fake port implementations: duplicate delivery stores one Interaction; an unknown sender is not stored; revoking a connection stops a running sync; a token never appears in logs, spans or the audit payload.
* With approved adapters: a real test mailbox syncs 100 messages and 10 meetings into the right timelines (evidence pasted here).
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; vendor SDK calls only inside the integration package behind `Effect.tryPromise` with `// effect-boundary:`; no new dependency or vendor sign-up without Jonathan approving it here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Forwarding address and ports merged with tests green; adapters merged after approval with the real mailbox evidence.

## Blockers

issues.title: F2.10 Build personal calendar feeds
issues.description:
## Goal

Crew see their Eventiva shifts in the calendar they already use, with no vendor integration needed.

## Context

* Slice 10 of F2 (<issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> section 8, decision 6 recommended a). ## Scope

1. `calendar.feed.issue` returns a secret ICS URL per person with scope (confirmed only, or confirmed plus offered); `calendar.feed.revoke` rotates it.
2. Feed served from the HTTP surface (<issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" />) with call time, location and a deep link to the shift in the app; no other people's data.

5. `CalendarSync` port interface defined with no adapter.

## Acceptance criteria

* Feed validates against RFC 5545 and imports into a standard calendar client with correct times across a DST change.
* Changing a shift time updates the same event, not a new one.
* A revoked URL returns 404 within one request.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; feed token never logged; no vendor and no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

Merged to main, validator output and check output here.

issues.title: F4.9 Let external contacts manage their own details and consent in a portal
issues.description:
## Goal

A client, vendor, artist or attendee can sign in to the same Eventiva app, see only their own record and the events they are on, keep their details current and control their consent, without the tenant giving them staff access.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" /> sections 2 (external users), 6 (Portal profile), 9 (external principals) and 7 (portal invite needs confirm).
* One application for every role (<issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" />): the portal is a permission-scoped view in the same app, not a separate app.
* External principals come from <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />; this issue only links a principal to one Person and defines its policy.

## Scope

1. Actions `crm.portal.invite` (confirm; sends a magic link through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />) / `revoke` / `list`, `crm.self.get` / `update` (allowed fields only: names, preferred name, pronouns, language, time zone, own contact points), `crm.self.consent.update`, `crm.self.privacy.request`.
2. Policy: an external principal reads and writes only its linked Person, reads the names, dates and its own role of events it holds an EventRole on, and nothing else in F4. A vendor organisation admin (flag on Affiliation) can manage people affiliated with that organisation.
3. Changes made by an external principal show in the timeline as source `self` and can be reviewed by the owner.
4. Screens: Portal profile, Portal events list, Consent toggles. Flag `crm-portal`.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: an external principal cannot read another person, cannot list contacts, cannot call any `crm:read` action through HTTP or MCP; revoking access ends an open session at the next call; a vendor admin edits a colleague but not a person from another organisation.
* The agent, acting for an external principal, can update that person's phone and nothing else.
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; WCAG 2.2 AA; whitelabel copy; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with the negative test matrix green and a recorded portal walkthrough on web and Android.

## Blockers

<issue id="4b6f8805-b1b2-40f7-99e9-089c9adb8002" label="EVE-105" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-105/f48-record-consent-and-fulfil-privacy-requests-for-contacts" /> (F4.8), <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> for invitations.

issues.title: F2.11 Build auto-roster proposals and agent staffing
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent can staff an event on request: it proposes a full roster that respects every rule, explains its choices, and a person applies what they agree with.

## Context

* Slice 11 of F2 (<issue id="1c8c53a0-396b-43a7-8fb9-c138dbbc70b2" label="EVE-67" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-67/f2-scheduling-and-rosters-crew-availability-shifts-offers-call-sheets" /> section 7, decision 3 recommended a). The solver is deterministic plain TypeScript using the pure rules engine (F2.3); large scopes run as a sharded Effect Cluster entity (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />, <issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" /> result) and must not block the entity's other messages (<issue id="6b15bbbd-3da3-4ccf-9d05-e64298b03556" label="EVE-35" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-35/keep-a-long-agent-run-from-blocking-its-entitys-other-messages" />).

## Scope

1. `roster.propose`: input scope (event, phases, requirements), objective weights (fill rate, fairness of hours, travel, cost tier, preferences), locked assignments; output RosterProposal with per-item reasons, unfilled items with why, and a score. Greedy construction plus local search with a time budget; same input and seed give the same output.
2. `roster.proposal.apply` (agent confirm) applies selected items as proposed assignments; offers are still a separate `offer.send`.
3. Agent skills: "staff X", "fill the gaps", "who should replace Sam", with explanations drawn from the proposal reasons.
4. Proactive behaviours behind `f2-agent-proactive`, off by default: unfilled 72 hours before call, offer chasers, Run of show change impact, missing clock-in alert.
5. Offline: `roster.propose` runs locally for small scopes (under 50 positions); larger scopes say they need connectivity.

## Acceptance criteria

* For a 20-person, 3-day fixture, the proposal fills every fillable position with zero block-rule breaches and returns identical output on rerun.
* A 500-position proposal finishes within 30 seconds on a runner and survives a runner drain without restarting from scratch (<issue id="ae557bfe-e194-4268-93e7-e68ee250a84a" label="EVE-34" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-34/agent-runs-restart-from-scratch-when-their-shard-moves" /> behaviour checked).
* The agent cannot apply or send offers without the user's confirmation, and cannot confirm the roster at all.
* PostHog `roster_proposal_applied` records the share of items applied.

## Constraints

Solver stays pure plain TypeScript; orchestration in Effect; no optimisation library or other new dependency without approval here; behind flag `f2-auto-roster`; ships to main with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, fixture results and check output here.

## Blockers

F2.3, F2.4, <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />, <issue id="6b15bbbd-3da3-4ccf-9d05-e64298b03556" label="EVE-35" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-35/keep-a-long-agent-run-from-blocking-its-entitys-other-messages" />.

issues.title: F7.5 Build maintenance schedules, work orders, fuel, mileage and cost export
issues.description:
## Goal

Every vehicle has its services planned by date or mileage, repairs run as work orders with an internal mechanic or an external garage, fuel and mileage are logged from the phone, and finance can see what each vehicle and each event cost.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) actions `fleet.service.schedule`, `fleet.workOrder.*`, `fleet.fuel.log`, `fleet.odometer.record`, `fleet.costs.exportForEvent`; entities ServiceSchedule, WorkOrder, FuelEntry, OdometerReading; screen Maintenance board.
* Parts used are F6 Products ([EVE-81](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-81>)); consuming them is `inventory.stock.move` from the warehouse to the virtual consumption location with a ref to the work order (F6 spec [EVE-63](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing>) models vehicles as stock locations; parts consumption is a stock movement owned by F6). Garages are F4 Organisations. Costs leave as F11 Cost lines.
* Due reminders run as durable scheduled work ([EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>)).

## Scope

1. ServiceSchedule per vehicle or vehicle type: interval by days and/or distance, next due computed from the last completed service and latest odometer.
2. WorkOrder: tasks, assigned mechanic or garage, parts (F6 Product ids and quantities; completing the order calls `inventory.stock.move`), labour, cost, attachments; states open, in progress, waiting parts, complete (terminal). Opening from a Defect (F7.4) links them; completing closes the defect after confirm.
3. FuelEntry and OdometerReading: offline append-only from the phone, receipt photo, litres or kWh, cost; lower odometer flagged.
4. `fleet.costs.exportForEvent`: fuel, work orders and hire costs for vehicles booked on an F1 Event, as F11 Cost lines; until F11 exists, a CSV export.
5. Maintenance board (Kanban by state) and a Vehicle detail maintenance tab; garage external view sees only its work orders.
6. Durable job: daily check that emits "service due in 14 days or 500 km" suggestions (consumed by F7.12).

## Acceptance criteria

* Next due recalculates after a completed service and after a new odometer reading (tests for date-only, distance-only and both, whichever first).
* A garage user cannot see vehicles or work orders not assigned to it.
* Cost export for a sample event totals fuel, repair and hire lines correctly against a fixture.
* The due-check job survives a runner restart without duplicate suggestions (idempotent by vehicle and due date).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-fleet`; money as integer minor units with currency; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, schedule and export tests green, comment here with a sample export.

## Blockers

[EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42>), [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>); F7.1, F7.4; F6 Products and stock moves for parts, F11 for the ledger export (CSV fallback until then).

issues.title: F4.10 Give the agent CRM skills: summaries, follow-up suggestions and health checks
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent keeps relationships moving: it summarises any contact with sources, suggests the next follow-up, spots gaps before an event, and never acts on people outside the user's permissions or without the approvals in the parent.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" /> section 7 (agent behaviour and approvals). All behaviour uses existing F4 actions as tools (<issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />); no new data access path and no agent SQL.
* Follow-ups are Task (F3) records created through F3's action; this issue does not define tasks.
* Scheduled checks run as durable runs (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />); evaluations go to <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> when it exists.

## Scope

1. Action `crm.relationship.summarise` (party; returns summary text plus cited timeline entry ids; online only, states the offline limitation).
2. Action `crm.followUp.schedule` (creates an F3 Task linked to the party and opportunity).
3. Daily suggestion run per tenant, each suggestion an item the user accepts or dismisses (`crm.suggestion.accept` / `dismiss`): stale opportunity (no interaction for N days, default 14, tenant setting); event in the next 7 days with no venue contact; new duplicate candidates; privacy request due within 7 days.
4. Agent skill descriptions for the CRM actions (written for the agent, per <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />), and screen projections that let the agent answer "what am I looking at" on every F4 screen.
5. Suggestion surface: a Suggestions panel on the CRM home and on detail pages, each control bound to an action.

## Acceptance criteria

* Tests: a suggestion never runs its action until accepted; a user without `crm:read` gets no CRM suggestions; summaries include only entries the user can read, with every claim mapped to a cited id.
* Evaluation set of 20 relationship questions with expected cited entries passes at 18 or more (dataset committed; linked to <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> when available).
* `node --run check` green.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; UIs never call models directly; prompts and outputs carry no secrets and are redacted in telemetry; no new dependency without approval here; ship to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests and the evaluation result pasted here.

## Blockers

<issue id="c3695c62-5106-4bd6-8ce1-c7dff1d14427" label="EVE-95" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-95/f43-build-the-activity-timeline-interactions-notes-and-history-from" /> (F4.3), <issue id="7692d04c-3444-4989-b2aa-b73a1a69ab02" label="EVE-99" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-99/f44-find-and-merge-duplicate-contacts-and-import-and-export-them" /> (F4.4), <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />; F3 Task create action for follow-ups.

issues.title: F7.6 Build units and operational status with an ordered offline queue
issues.description:
## Goal

For each live event, control can form units (a vehicle with its crew, or a foot team) with call signs, and every unit's status is always known, including updates sent while a crew had no signal.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) actions `ops.unit.*`, `ops.status.define`, `ops.unit.setStatus`; entities Unit, StatusCode, StatusChange; ordering and safety paragraph in section 5; journey J4.
* Unit members are F13 Workers (<issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />), optionally prefilled from F2 Shifts for the event; vehicle from F7.1. F1 Event is referenced by id.
* Each live event's dispatch board is one Effect Cluster entity keyed by event id ([EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>)), with idempotent persisted messages ([EVE-39](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39>)). This issue creates that entity; F7.7 adds incidents to it.

## Scope

1. StatusCode configuration per tenant with event override: code, label, colour, meaning (available, committed, unavailable). Default set: Available, En route, On scene, Returning, At base, Unavailable, Off duty.
2. Unit: call sign (unique per event), members, vehicle, capabilities (first aid, tow, 4x4, wheelchair), active from/to.
3. `ops.unit.setStatus(unit, code, deviceTime, commandId, location?)`: queued offline on the device, sent in order on reconnect. The DispatchBoard entity applies StatusChanges append-only; current status = latest by device time, except a controller change with server time after that device time wins.
4. Unit board component (part of the Control screen) with live updates through the change feed ([EVE-45](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45>)); projection lists units, statuses, staleness (time since last update).
5. Metrics: status update delay (device to server) histogram, bounded cardinality (no unit ids as labels).

## Acceptance criteria

* Device offline: three status changes queued, then reconnect; server applies them in device order, and replaying the same commands is a no-op.
* Controller sets a unit to Unavailable while the device is offline with an older queued En route: the controller's status stands; the crew sees why.
* Runner kill during a burst of status changes (<issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" /> harness): no lost or duplicated changes after recovery.
* Call sign clash in one event fails with a typed error.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-live-ops`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, offline ordering and runner-kill tests green, comment here with the evidence logs.

## Blockers

[EVE-17](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17>), [EVE-39](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39>), [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-42](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42>), [EVE-45](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45>), [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>); F7.1; F1 Event; F2 Shifts (optional prefill).

issues.title: F10.1 Sites, levels, base layers and calibration
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser or the agent creates a site, adds indoor levels, and lays satellite imagery, an uploaded image, a PDF or a DXF drawing under it, calibrated so every later measurement is in true metres.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> sections 4 and 5 (Site, SiteLevel, BaseLayer). Engine from <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" /> (D-F10-1); imports per D-F10-5.
* A Site may link to a Venue from F5; it never redefines it.
* F1 (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />) places Spaces and DesignElements in metres from a site origin, so the site-local frame below is a public contract.

## Scope

1. Tables `sitemap_site`, `sitemap_site_level`, `sitemap_base_layer` in a `type:extension` package with Drizzle schema through the shared schema package (<issue id="c31b6b08-1532-4a7a-945f-24a70bbab765" label="EVE-23" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23/split-core-into-portable-contracts-and-backend-runtime-with-a-shared" />), `tenant_id` on every row, synced per <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> record sync.
2. Actions: `sitemap.site.create`, `.update`, `.archive`; `sitemap.level.add`, `.update`, `.remove`; `sitemap.baseLayer.add`, `.calibrate`, `.remove`. Each with Effect Schema input and output and tagged errors (`SiteNotFound`, `CalibrationUnderdetermined`, `CalibrationResidualTooHigh`, `UnsupportedDrawing`).
3. Site-local frame: origin = site anchor, x east and y north in metres, with pure conversion functions to and from WGS84 (local transverse Mercator around the anchor) in the shared contracts package, so F1 and others can import them on client and server.
4. Calibration: affine transform from two or more control points (two points: similarity; three or more: least-squares affine), residual in metres; the residual is fit quality only, so the screen also states that absolute accuracy is limited by the imagery or survey control it was fitted to; reject above a tenant setting (default 1.0 m, <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />).
5. `DrawingImport` port with a neutral Effect service: PDF page to raster tiles, DXF to GeoJSON lines in drawing units, GeoTIFF orthophotos (drone or survey) to georeferenced raster tiles; a DWG upload is refused with a request for a DXF or PDF export (open DWG readers are GPL, the ODA converter needs its own licence); candidates are GDAL (MIT) and PDFium or pdf.js, never AGPL renderers; the implementing library is proposed in a comment here for approval before use. Runs server-side as a durable job (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />).
6. `BasemapTiles` and `ImageryTiles` ports with the providers chosen in <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" />; tile URLs and keys come from config (<issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />), never source.
7. Geocode an address to a site anchor through the `Geocoder` port.

## Acceptance criteria

* Property tests: WGS84 to local and back round-trips within 1 mm across a 5 km radius; calibration of a synthetic plan with known transform recovers it within 0.05 m.
* A PDF fixture and a DXF fixture import and calibrate; the residual is shown and stored.
* A second tenant cannot read the site (tenant guard test); a vendor role cannot call `site.update` (permission test).
* Each action passes the <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> parity check and is callable over HTTP and MCP with the same result.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; geometry math stays pure TypeScript in shared contracts; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here; feature flag `f10-site-maps`.

## Done signal

Merged to main, tests green, a comment listing the public actions and the site-local frame contract, and a note to F1 (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />) that the contract is live.

## Blockers

<issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" /> (engine), <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />, <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> (files for uploads).

issues.title: F7.7 Build the incident control log and dispatch for live events
issues.description:
## BINDING owner decision — 15 November 2026: human-in-the-loop for ALL operational emergency actions

**Never automatically actuate a show-control or operational response from an incident, alarm, emergency sensor, issue classification, agent interpretation, integration alert or rules-engine event.** An alarm/event may be ingested, classified, displayed, logged, correlated, escalated to people, propose a configured SOP or preset, and notify designated staff; it must NOT automatically GO/hold/pause/mute audio, set venue lights/DMX, trigger PA/media/announcements, start emergency scene/preset, dispatch units or carry out other consequential incident-response operations. The possibility of false alarms and resulting public panic/harm is the rationale. This is an unconditional product policy for **operational incidents and alarms**, not an admin-configurable bypass or an exception for 'tested integration'. A permissioned, accountable **human must deliberately initiate** the approved action following assessment; log initiator, confirmation, linked incident, preset/version, result, and failures. Provide quick incident-linked actions but not default-on automatic acceptance.

**Differentiate ordinary show automation:** separately programmed and human-armed cue stacks, playback sequences, lighting console input, MIDI/OSC/MSC and timecode may continue to start permitted *non-emergency show cues* according to show programming; that is not authority for automatically activating an incident/emergency response. Incoming external signals claiming to be alarms are treated as alerts for human evaluation even if received over a show-control protocol. An external operator deliberately firing an authorized ordinary cue is still allowed, subject to arming and permissions.

**System-of-systems boundary:** independent certified fire alarms, evacuation/voice alarm, emergency lighting and physical overrides retain their own mandatory automatic functions. Eventiva's human-in-the-loop restriction is for Eventiva-initiated control actions and must not inhibit certified systems, lawful fire-panel interlocks, or physical emergency interventions. Do not call for an extra Eventiva confirmation where it could delay or prevent those independent measures. Any proposed direct control of safety-certified hardware requires separate safety engineering and approval.

**Acceptance criteria:** simulate a false fire/heat alarm and a mistakenly classified crowd incident: both notify MDT with a proposed response and initiate **zero** show/lighting/audio/PA/dispatch outputs without a deliberate authorized human action; no auto approval through agents, tenant rules or remote console input marked as emergency. Authorized manual response from MDT executes only the selected versioned preset and clearly reports partial success/failure. Ordinary human-armed playback and mapped external non-emergency cue input still work independently. Test no deferred/replayed emergency output after reconnect.

Implementation and dependencies remain unapproved.

## Control-room to show actions — scope clarification 15 November 2026

In addition to incident/dispatch, the authorized controller needs an **incident-linked action for invoking a selected, version-pinned, preapproved show-control emergency preset** through the F1 bridge/local engine. Show operator permission, armed target/snapshot and tested venue mapping, plus request/endpoint/observed status and failure recovery; record a correlated append-only entry to incident and show logs. External trusted device events may create an incident or alert when mapping/permission policy allows. An incident arriving does not itself auto-fire emergency cues. Detailed requirements/acceptance: <issue id="e6838c83-005e-4ec5-bc2f-931de6cd0cb8" label="EVE-256" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-256/connect-mdt-incidents-and-external-controls-to-live-show-cues-and" />; no duplicated F7 playback transport.

## Goal

A controller logs every job and incident on a live event, assigns units, sees each acknowledgement, and ends the day with a complete, timestamped control log that can be exported for safety review.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) actions `ops.incident.*`, `ops.dispatch.*`, `ops.assignment.*`, `ops.controlLog.export`; entities Incident, IncidentLogEntry, IncidentAssignment; screens Control and Incident detail; journey J3; decision D4 (recommended: no assignment while control is offline).
* Runs inside the DispatchBoard cluster entity from F7.6, so assignments for one event are serialised.
* Location may be free text, a map point, or an F10 Zone id. Not an emergency service (parent section 11): the Control screen shows that notice.

## Scope

1. Incident: kind (configurable: medical, security, lost person, logistics, welfare, other), priority (1 to 4), location, caller, state (open, assigned, in progress, closed, reopened), summary as Yjs text ([EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51>)).
2. IncidentLogEntry append-only with device and server time and author (human, crew, agent); corrections are new entries. Every state change and assignment writes a log entry automatically.
3. Dispatch: `ops.dispatch.suggestUnits` ranks units by status Available, capabilities matching kind, distance (if F7.10 positions exist) and time since last job, each with reasons; `assign` and `unassign` are online only, serialised in the entity; a unit already committed returns UnitCommitted unless the controller confirms a reassign.
4. Assignment acknowledgement and decline from the crew (F7.8), queued offline; an unacknowledged assignment after N seconds (default 120, event setting) raises a suggestion.
5. Control offline (D4 a): the screen becomes read-only with a banner; incidents and log entries can still be written locally and sync later; assign is disabled.
6. `ops.controlLog.export` as CSV and PDF via [EVE-25](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25>), with every entry and both timestamps.
7. Agent dispatch always requires controller approval through the approval policy of [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>).

## Acceptance criteria

* Two controllers assign the same Available unit to two incidents at once: one succeeds, the other gets UnitCommitted.
* Agent `assign` without approval is refused; with approval it is logged as agent-proposed, controller-approved.
* Log entries cannot be edited or deleted through any surface (negative tests).
* Export of a test event contains every entry in server order with both timestamps.
* Control offline: assign disabled, log entries written offline appear in order after reconnect.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-live-ops`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs including the not-an-emergency-service notice; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here; whitelabel ASCII copy.

## Done signal

Merged to main, concurrency and approval tests green, comment here with an exported sample log.

## Blockers

[EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43>), [EVE-45](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45>), [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50>), [EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51>), [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>); F7.6; F10 Zones (optional).

comments.body: Coordination note from Jonathan's 13 Nov 2026 CAD requirements: Routine **pre-scheduled production work** defaults to automatic release to the preassigned crew, while controller approval before release is an optional policy. A task must **never activate just because its start time arrives** if any required predecessor is unfinished: e.g. power rigging must complete before lighting rigging activates. Keep it visible as Blocked/Waiting and, if late, flag the delay and affected downstream jobs in both CAD and MDT. When eligible, release automatically in the automatic mode, or queue for controller approval in manual mode. This applies to planned tasks flowing into dispatch; preserve explicit controller approval for agent-proposed incident dispatch and all safety-sensitive actions. EVE-62 owns canonical task dependencies and readiness; don't create a parallel incident/task status engine. Full decision recorded on EVE-62 and EVE-71.

Jonathan approved A2–A4 and S2–S4 on 2026-11-15. issues.title: F7.8 Build crew MDT mode in the one app
issues.description:
## MDT emergency action surface — clarified 15 November 2026

For **authorized control-room/MDT roles** (not automatically every active crew member), surface venue-configured show-control emergency presets and relevant hold/pause controls linked to the active incident, with conspicuous connectivity, approval state, output status and manual fallback. Actions route to the local F1 show command path via <issue id="e6838c83-005e-4ec5-bc2f-931de6cd0cb8" label="EVE-256" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-256/connect-mdt-incidents-and-external-controls-to-live-show-cues-and" />; they do not issue hardware outputs directly or queue stale live commands while disconnected. Keep quick operation accessible under stress, permission-gated and auditable. Ordinary crew MDT remains least-privileged and must not gain show arming or unrestricted show control by being in MDT mode.

## Goal

A crew member on an active unit opens the same Eventiva app and gets a glanceable, gloves-friendly screen for their status, current job, messages and vehicle checks, which keeps working when signal drops.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) screen Crew MDT mode; journeys J3 and J4. <issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> one-app rule: this is a layout of the one app chosen by role and context, not a separate app.
* Uses actions from F7.4 (inspection, defect), F7.6 (setStatus), F7.7 (acknowledge, decline, log) and F7.9 (messages). Navigation is an action ([EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50>)); app shell and navigation come from [EVE-32](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-32>).

## Scope

1. Mode switch: when the signed-in person is a member of a unit active now on a live event, the app offers MDT mode (remembered per device); leaving the unit ends it.
2. Layout: large status buttons (one tap, undo for 5 seconds), current job card (kind, priority, location, notes, acknowledge or decline), message list with unread count, quick actions (log entry, defect, fuel), offline banner with queued count and last sync time.
3. Navigation hand-off: open the device's maps app with the job location (platform deep link, no SDK).
4. Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA, minimum 48 dp targets, high-contrast theme for night, screen-reader labels; works one-handed.
5. Screen-context projection: my unit, status, current job, unread messages, queued updates, connectivity.
6. Keep screen awake option while on a job; battery note in docs.

## Acceptance criteria

* On Android and web, a crew member receives an assignment, acknowledges, sets En route and On scene while offline, and the server receives all three in order on reconnect (recorded device run).
* The agent, asked by the crew member "mark us on scene", performs the same action as the button.
* axe or Lighthouse accessibility check on the web build passes with no serious issues; manual TalkBack check recorded.
* A person with no active unit never sees MDT mode.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-live-ops`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here; whitelabel ASCII copy.

## Done signal

Merged to main, device run evidence attached, comment here with screenshots.

## Blockers

[EVE-17](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17>), [EVE-32](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-32>), [EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50>); F7.6, F7.7; F7.9 for messages (screen ships without the panel if F7.9 is later).

issues.title: F6.5 Build prep, pick lists and offline scan out and scan in
issues.description:
## Goal

Warehouse and event crews prep, load and return kit by scanning, on a phone or a hardware scanner, with or without signal, and the record is correct afterwards.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> decisions D3 (camera barcode and QR plus hardware scanners in keyboard mode; RFID later) and D4 (offline scan of an item already out is accepted and becomes a `double-checkout` discrepancy on sync).
* Scans are movements (F6.2), so two devices scanning the same pick list merge without conflict; line counts are derived.
* ScannerView is a new Rambo-UI component; the Expo stack comes from <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" />. Camera barcode reading on Expo needs a new dependency (for example the Expo camera module); that is listed here for Jonathan's approval and is not to be added before it.
* Pick list assignees are F2 rostered people.

## Scope

1. Tables `inventory_pick_list` (reservation, assignees, status `open`, `in-progress`, `complete`) and `inventory_pick_line` (reservation line, expected qty or asset; scanned counts derived from movements).
2. Actions `inventory.prep.createPickList` (from a confirmed reservation; kits expand to components; containers pack lists), `assign`, `scanOut` (asset tag code or product plus qty; writes a movement from the warehouse to the event-site or vehicle location), `scanIn` (reverse), `complete` (confirm when variances exist; emits `inventory:pick_completed` with variance counts).
3. Scan rules: scanning a container scans its contents; scanning an asset not on the list warns and records it as `extra`; scanning a quarantined asset or one with an overdue required inspection (F6.7) is refused with `AssetNotFitForUse` online and offline (the device holds the due dates).
4. Rambo-UI `ScannerView`: camera input behind a `Scanner` port, hardware scanner keyboard input with no dependency, manual entry fallback, haptic and sound confirmation, large targets for gloved use.
5. Screens Prep and pick, and Check-in, with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projections (pick list, expected vs scanned, last scan, focused line) and bound controls.
6. Telemetry: `inventory_scan_recorded` with offline flag; scan-to-confirm latency metric.

## Acceptance criteria

* A 40-line pick list scanned by two offline phones at once completes with correct counts after both reconnect.
* Scanning the same serialised asset out on two offline devices leaves two movements and one `double-checkout` discrepancy after sync.
* A quarantined asset is refused offline with `AssetNotFitForUse`.
* Median scan-to-confirm under 300 ms on a mid-range Android device, measured and pasted here.
* The agent, asked "check in everything from the festival that is on this truck", runs `scanIn` for the vehicle contents and reports what is still missing.
* Web and Android both pass the <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> unbound-control check.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA (scanner mode needs non-camera alternatives); flag `f6-inventory`; camera dependency needs Jonathan's approval on this issue first; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the two-phone offline test recorded on a real device and the commands and results pasted here.

issues.title: F6.6 Build discrepancies, damage reports and asset quarantine
issues.description:
## Goal

Anything missing, extra, damaged or double-booked is captured once, with evidence, and resolved by a person, so the stock record stays trustworthy.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> sections 5 and 7. Sources: scans (F6.5), negative levels after merge (F6.2 event `inventory:negative_stock`), offline POS oversell (F9), stock counts (F6.10), crew reports.
* Notes are Yjs text on the record (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />); photos use <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />; discussion uses comments (<issue id="b7f17f15-c893-46e9-9b3b-2aefae473802" label="EVE-27" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-27/port-comments-mentions-and-review-suggestions-on-any-resource" />).
* Quarantine is monotonic offline: a quarantine set on any device wins over a release until a person releases it online.

## Scope

1. Table `inventory_discrepancy`: type (`missing`, `extra`, `damaged`, `wrong-item`, `double-checkout`, `negative-stock`), refs (asset, product, location, movements, pick list, event), notes doc, photos, assignee, status, resolution (`found`, `lost`, `repaired`, `written-off`, `adjusted`, `duplicate-scan`).
2. Actions `inventory.discrepancy.raise`, `assign`, `resolve`. Resolving as `lost` or `written-off` needs confirm and writes a movement to the virtual lost or scrap location; `adjusted` writes an adjustment movement; `duplicate-scan` writes nothing.
3. Automatic raising from `inventory:negative_stock`, double checkout and pick variances, deduplicated per cause.
4. Actions `inventory.asset.quarantine` and `release` (release needs confirm, is online only, and is refused while a failed safety inspection stands, F6.7). Damaged reports quarantine the asset by default.
5. Screen Discrepancies (inbox and detail) with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* A negative level after an offline merge creates exactly one `negative-stock` discrepancy, even when merged twice.
* A damage report with a photo quarantines the asset; the asset leaves availability immediately.
* Quarantine on device A offline and release on device B offline leave the asset quarantined after sync.
* Resolving as `lost` moves the asset to the lost location and emits a write-off for F11.
* The agent can raise and propose a resolution but `lost` and `written-off` stop for confirm.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-inventory`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with tests green and the quarantine convergence test output pasted here.

issues.title: F6.7 Build maintenance, repairs and safety inspections for lifting and electrical equipment
issues.description:
## Goal

No asset goes out unfit for use: inspections and services are scheduled, recorded with evidence, and enforced at check-out, and only qualified people can sign them off.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> section 11. UK first, as per-jurisdiction configuration in <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> settings: lifting equipment thorough examination under LOLER 1998 (6 months for equipment lifting people and for lifting accessories, 12 months for other lifting equipment), work equipment under PUWER 1998, portable electrical in-service inspection and testing (IET Code of Practice). Verify the intervals against current HSE and IET guidance before build and record the source here.
* Required inspection types come from the Product (F6.1). Qualification to inspect comes from F13 (until F13 exists, a permission `inventory:inspection:release` granted per person).
* Certificates are files (<issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />). Vehicle maintenance is F7, not here.

## Scope

1. Tables `inventory_inspection_type` (code, name, interval, jurisdiction, blocks check-out when overdue yes or no), `inventory_inspection` (asset, type, result pass or fail, inspector person, evidence files, notes, next due; append-only) and `inventory_maintenance_job` (asset, kind service or repair, due, status, parts used as consumable movements, cost).
2. Actions `inventory.maintenance.schedule`, `log`, `inventory.inspection.record`, plus a read `inventory.inspection.due` (assets due or overdue in a window, optionally only those reserved).
3. Enforcement: a failed inspection quarantines the asset (F6.6); an overdue blocking inspection makes `scanOut` refuse with `AssetNotFitForUse`; release after a fail requires a later pass by a person holding `inventory:inspection:release`. The agent can never record a pass or release.
4. Seed UK inspection types (lifting people, lifting accessory, lifting other, portable electrical) with sources cited.
5. Screen Maintenance (calendar, list, inspection form) with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* A chain hoist with a lifting examination 1 day overdue is refused at scan-out, online and offline.
* A failed electrical test quarantines the asset; a later pass by a qualified person releases it; the agent's attempt to record a pass is refused with `PermissionDenied`.
* `inspection.due` for next month lists every asset due, flags the ones reserved for events, and the agent offers to schedule them before each out date.
* Intervals and blocking are configurable per jurisdiction without code changes.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-maintenance`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated with the legal sources; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the enforcement tests green and the cited guidance links pasted here.
