issues.title: F14.3 Views: generated screens and patches over base screens
issues.description:
## Goal

An organisation designs list, form, board, calendar, timeline, map and gallery views for any record type, and changes the product's own screens (add a section, hide a field, move a column) in a way that survives product upgrades and stays fully visible and operable by the agent.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`studio.views.define`, `studio.views.patch`), 5 (ViewDefinition, ViewPatch), 6 (View designer) and 9 (protected actions).
* <issue id="62f3bba8-9275-4ff1-98bf-62b95f432b37" label="EVE-32" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-32/port-settings-profiles-navigation-command-menu-and-onboarding" /> generates settings screens from Effect Schema; this slice generalises that generator to record views.
* <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />: every generated control must bind to an inventory action and every view must publish a screen-context projection; generated views get both for free because they are built only from field widgets and existing actions.
* Odoo lesson: XPath view inheritance breaks on upgrade. Base screens here expose named nodes and slots; patches target names, never structure.
* F1 constraint (from <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />): `show.arm` and `rigging.signOff` are human only and `show.stopAll` is always available; patches cannot hide, move off-screen, relabel or bind automation to protected controls.

## Scope

1. `ViewDefinition` schema: kind, entity type, layout tree (sections, columns, field widgets, related lists, action buttons bound to existing inventory actions, dashboard panels from <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" />), default sort and filters, visibility rules (declarative expression on the record and viewer roles).
2. A renderer in Rambo-UI terms that turns a ViewDefinition into a screen on web, iOS and Android, emitting the <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection and action bindings automatically.
3. Base-screen extensibility contract: every feature-set screen declares named nodes and slots (`@slot("event.header.after")`); a lint rule fails a screen with a form or list that declares no slots.
4. `ViewPatch` ops: insert (at a slot), hide (named node), move (between slots), relabel, setDefault (make a custom view the default for a role). Patches against a node removed by an upgrade are reported in the change set preview and skipped, never crash the screen.
5. Protected nodes: feature sets mark controls `protected`; patch validation refuses ops on them with a typed `ProtectedTargetError`.
6. View designer screen (canvas on wide screens, structured list on phones) with live preview using real records the designer can see.
7. Saved personal views (filters, columns) per user, separate from org views, without studio permission.

## Acceptance criteria

* A board view of Events grouped by a custom select field works on web and Android; the agent answers "what is on this board" from the projection and moves a card via the same action as the drag (test).
* A patch inserts a custom field section into the Event screen; after a simulated base-screen upgrade that renames another node, the patch still applies and the preview lists the skipped op.
* A patch that hides `show.stopAll` is refused with `ProtectedTargetError` (test).
* An unbound control in a generated view is impossible: the renderer test fails a fixture view that names an unknown action.
* Visibility rules hide a field for crew and show it for organisers.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; WCAG 2.2 AA (generated views must keep heading order and labels); behind `f14-studio`; D6 (editor surfaces built in Rambo-UI; Puck only as a reference); no new dependency without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged; generated views running on web and Android with recorded checks; the slot contract documented for F1 to F13 in a comment here.

issues.title: F1.3 Build the run of show: segments, fixed and relative timing, department columns and publishing
issues.description:
## Goal

A production manager builds the timed running order of a phase, with each department's notes in its own column, and publishes it to the team, clients and (for public segments) attendees.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> sections 4, 5 (RunOfShow, Segment), 6 (Run of show editor), decision D3 (fixed and relative timing with live drift).
* Market reference: collaborative rundowns with segment durations, over and under run, department columns and read-only shares (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> section 3).
* Live calling of the run of show is F1.12; this slice is planning and publishing only.

## Scope

1. Tables `run_of_show` (event_id, phase_id, status: draft, published, locked; version) and `segment` (title, sort_key, timing kind: fixed start or after previous; start, duration, space_id, owner member, department columns as a map keyed by department_id, audience: internal or public, script as a Yjs text document).
2. Timing engine as a pure function: computes planned start and end of every segment from fixed and relative timings, flags overlaps, gaps and total overrun against the phase end. Plain TypeScript, no IO, fully unit tested.
3. Actions: `runOfShow.create`, `runOfShow.publish` (confirm; snapshots a numbered version and notifies through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />), `runOfShow.lock`, `segment.create`, `segment.update`, `segment.move`, `segment.delete`.
4. Read-only share: a published version can be shared by link to clients, and public segments feed F14's public schedule.
5. Agent: builds a run of show from a brief, re-times it to fit a new phase length, and flags overrun; changes appear as normal actions.
6. Screen: Run of show editor (sortable grid, department columns shown per viewer's departments, timing bar with overrun) with projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* Timing engine tests cover fixed only, relative only, mixed, a fixed segment that collides with a relative chain, and timezone and daylight-saving change during a phase.
* Two offline editors insert segments in the same place; both survive in a stable order after sync.
* Publishing creates version N, notifies subscribed team members, and later edits do not change version N.
* A client link shows only the published version; a public segment appears in the public schedule feed.
* The agent turns "two hour conference, opening, three panels with a 20 minute break, close" into a valid run of show with no overrun.
* Screen passes the unbound-control check and axe.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules (the timing engine is pure and stays plain TypeScript); every operation is an inventory action (<issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />) with one permission check (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />), audit and change record; UI from Rambo-UI, WCAG 2.2 AA; behind PostHog flag `f1-events-core`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; whitelabel ASCII copy; people docs and ai-docs in the same commit; ships to main with `node --run check` results here.

## Done signal

Merged with the timing, sync and publish tests green and a sample run of show screenshot on web and Android attached here.

## Blockers

F1.1, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.

issues.title: F9.1 Build money, tax categories and the sales catalogue
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser can build a catalogue of products and variants with prices per price list and a tax category, attached to F1 Events, and every surface (UI, agent, MCP, HTTP) reads and writes it through the same actions.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4 and 5. First F9 slice; everything else builds on it.
* Money type shared across Eventiva: `Money { amountMinor: integer, currency: ISO 4217 }` with Effect Schema, safe add, subtract, multiply by quantity and allocate (split a total across lines without losing a minor unit). Lives in the shared schema package from <issue id="c31b6b08-1532-4a7a-945f-24a70bbab765" label="EVE-23" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23/split-core-into-portable-contracts-and-backend-runtime-with-a-shared" /> so F8, F11 and others reuse it.
* Tax codes and rates belong to F11 (<issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />). F9 stores a TaxCategory per product and maps it to an F11 tax code id per region.
* Products may link to an F6 Product (<issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" />) for stock or hire; F9 never stores stock levels.

## Scope

1. `Money` schema and pure helpers with property tests (allocation never loses or gains a minor unit).
2. Drizzle tables (Postgres and SQLite) with tenant guards: Product, Variant, PriceList, Price, TaxCategory, ProductEvent link. Product status state machine: draft, active, archived (<issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" /> state machines).
3. Actions: sales.product.create, update, archive, list, get; sales.price.set; sales.priceList.create; sales.taxRate.resolve (category plus region plus date to F11 code and rate; until F11 ships, a fixture adapter behind a `TaxCodeSource` service).
4. Price resolution: given channel, variant and time, return the price and whether it is tax inclusive; tax inclusive and exclusive both supported with rounding per line (half up, documented).
5. Product description as Yjs rich text through <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />; all other fields record-synced with per-field last writer wins.
6. Catalogue and Product editor screens with projections (<issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />); every control bound to an action.

## Acceptance criteria

* A product with two variants, two price lists (GBP inclusive, EUR exclusive) and a reduced tax category resolves correct prices and tax for a UK and an EU channel; snapshot tests.
* Archiving a product used by an open channel needs confirmation; agent calls get the approval prompt.
* Tenant isolation test: org B cannot list org A products through any surface.
* Parity check passes for all new actions; both screens pass the unbound-control check.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules (Schema, typed errors with Data.TaggedError, Layers, @effect/vitest); no zod; money in integer minor units only; behind the `f9-sales` flag; whitelabel ASCII customer text; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with tests green, a comment listing the actions and tables, and the Money helpers referenced from the shared schema package README.

## Blockers

<issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> action contract, <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" /> storage and tenant guards, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> permissions, <issue id="1b79a257-9ea0-40b5-a8f7-23e1c09221be" label="EVE-39" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39/make-every-entity-action-idempotent-and-persisted-by-default" /> idempotent actions; <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> for the rich-text description (the rest can land first); <issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" /> F11 tax codes for the real TaxCodeSource.

issues.title: F1.4 Build itineraries: per-person and per-group schedules generated from the event and published
issues.description:
## Goal

Every person on an event gets one schedule of where to be and when (calls, travel, hotel, meals, their segments and shifts), generated from the event and kept up to date, readable offline and in their own calendar.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> sections 4, 5 (Itinerary, ItineraryItem), 6 (Itinerary screen), 11 (personal data).
* Sources: F1.1 phases and team, F1.3 segments the person owns, F2 shifts (ItineraryItem kind `shift`, read through F2's published actions when F2 exists), F7 travel. Until F2 and F7 exist, those items are entered by hand.
* Scheduling primitives come from <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />.

## Scope

1. Tables `itinerary` (event_id, audience: team member or group of members, published_version) and `itinerary_item` (kind: call, travel, hotel, meal, segment, shift, custom; starts_at, ends_at, location text or Space, source ref, notes).
2. Actions: `itinerary.generate` (builds or refreshes items from sources without overwriting hand-edited items), `itinerary.update`, `itinerary.publish` (confirm; versioned; notifies through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />).
3. Calendar: a per-itinerary ICS feed link with a revocable token.
4. Personal data: dietary and access needs are opt-in fields with purpose text, visible only to production manager and above; deleted with the event retention period from the org configuration schema.
5. Agent: generates itineraries for a group, flags overlapping items for the same person, and answers "where should Sam be at 14:00 on load-in day".
6. Screen: Itinerary (agenda by day, filter per person or group, publish) with projection and bound controls; crew see only their own.

## Acceptance criteria

* Generating twice is idempotent; a hand-edited item survives regeneration.
* A crew member sees only their itinerary, offline, after one sync.
* The ICS feed opens in a standard calendar client and stops working after the token is revoked.
* Overlap check flags two items for the same person; the agent's suggestion only applies on confirmation.
* Health-related fields are hidden from crew and vendors in a permission test.
* Screen passes the unbound-control check and axe.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; every operation is an inventory action (<issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />) with one permission check (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />), audit and change record; UI from Rambo-UI, WCAG 2.2 AA; behind PostHog flag `f1-events-core`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue (ICS writing is plain text, no library needed); whitelabel ASCII copy; people docs and ai-docs in the same commit; ships to main with `node --run check` results here.

## Done signal

Merged with idempotency, permission and ICS tests green.

## Blockers

F1.1, F1.3, <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />.

issues.title: F9.2 Build carts, orders and the line provider contract
issues.description:
## Goal

One cart and order model sells any line kind (product, ticket, stock, hire, service, fee) through a line provider contract, with orders that can be created offline and uploaded exactly once.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4, 5 and the agreed boundary at the end of section 16.
* F8 ticketing implements kind `ticket` (ticketing.hold.create, ticketing.ticket.issueForOrder, ticketing.ticket.void). F6 (<issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" />) implements kinds `stock` and `hire` (inventory.reservation.create, commit, release).
* Orders attach to an F1 Event and optionally a Phase and Space (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />).

## Scope

1. `LineProvider` registration (sales.lineProvider.register at module activation, removed on disposal per <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" />): line kind, reserve, commit and release action names, offline mode (`online-only`, `allocation`, `deltas`).
2. Cart: create, addLine (calls the provider's reserve, stores reservation id and expiry), updateLine, removeLine (release), totals with tax from F9.1, expiry (online default 15 minutes, POS 5 minutes after last change; config via <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />) with a durable timer that releases reservations.
3. Order state machine: draft, placed, paid, partially refunded, refunded, cancelled. Transitions only through actions. On paid, call each line's commit; on cancel, release.
4. Client-generated UUIDv7 ids, a client order id and an idempotency key; [sales.order.place](<http://sales.order.place>) is idempotent so a replayed offline upload returns the same order.
5. Offline placement: for kinds with offline mode `deltas` or `allocation` the POS creates the order locally and syncs it; for `online-only` the line is blocked offline with a clear message.
6. Domain events on the change feed (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />): sales:order_placed, sales:order_paid, sales:order_cancelled with lines (net, F11 tax code id, tax amount, currency).
7. Orders list and Order detail screens with projections.

## Acceptance criteria

* A cart with one ticket line (fake provider) and one stock line (fake provider) reserves both, commits both on paid and releases both on cancel; test with fake providers implementing the contract.
* Cart expiry releases reservations exactly once, including after a runner restart (durable timer).
* Uploading the same offline order three times yields one order (idempotency test).
* An online-only line kind cannot be added to an offline cart; typed error.
* Change feed events match the schema F11 consumes.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; money in integer minor units; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; the line provider contract published as a schema in the shared package with a one-page agent doc; F8 and F6 threads told the contract is live.

## Blockers

F9.1; <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />, <issue id="e4fa521d-c5d2-4f24-ab86-ed41def53953" label="EVE-42" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-42/p13-build-the-storage-layer-drizzle-on-postgres-and-sqlite-state" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" /> change feed, <issue id="1b79a257-9ea0-40b5-a8f7-23e1c09221be" label="EVE-39" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39/make-every-entity-action-idempotent-and-persisted-by-default" /> idempotency, <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> sync engine choice; <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" /> durable runs for the expiry timer.

issues.title: F1.5 Build department cue lists with numbering, segment links and console exports
issues.description:
## Goal

Each department writes its numbered cue list against the run of show, and exports it as paperwork or as a file its console or playback system imports.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> sections 4, 5 (Cue, CueList), 6 (Cue list screen), 8 (`ConsoleExport` port).
* Cues are planning data here. Firing them live is F1.13; timecode placement is F1.12.

## Scope

1. Tables `cue_list` (event_id, department_id, name, numbering scheme) and `cue` (number as a decimal string such as `12`, `12.5`; label; segment_id; trigger: manual, follow with delay, timecode; target action ref for F1.13; notes; sort by number then sort_key).
2. Actions: `cueList.create`, `cue.create`, `cue.update`, `cue.renumber` (explicit, never automatic), `cue.delete`, `cue.export`.
3. Duplicate cue numbers created offline both survive and are flagged; export refuses while duplicates exist.
4. `ConsoleExport` port with these first adapters: CSV (number, label, segment, notes), PDF paperwork through <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />, and an OSC command script (one line per cue). Console-specific import formats are listed as follow-up adapters after the first real console is named by a user; each one is its own issue.
5. Agent: drafts cue lists from segment notes, flags cues pointing at deleted segments.
6. Screen: Cue list (numbered list, linked segment, trigger and target columns, export menu) with projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* Point cues sort correctly (`1`, `1.5`, `2`, `10`).
* Two offline creates of cue `5` both survive and are flagged; export fails with a typed error until renumbered.
* CSV and PDF exports match committed snapshots.
* The agent drafts a lighting cue list for a 10 segment run of show; every cue links to an existing segment.
* Screen passes the unbound-control check and axe.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules (the cue number comparator is pure TypeScript); every operation is an inventory action with one permission check, audit and change record; UI from Rambo-UI, WCAG 2.2 AA; behind PostHog flag `f1-production-plans`; PDF rendering uses whatever <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> provides, no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; whitelabel ASCII copy; people docs and ai-docs in the same commit; ships to main with `node --run check` results here.

## Done signal

Merged with sorting, duplicate and export snapshot tests green.

## Blockers

F1.1, F1.3, <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" />, <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.

issues.title: F9.3 Build the payment gateway port and online card payments
issues.description:
## Goal

Orders can be paid online by card through a neutral PaymentGateway port, with each tenant connected as its own merchant, verified webhooks, and no card data ever touching Eventiva.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 8 and 11, decision D2 (recommended: Stripe with Connect, tenant as merchant of record). Do not sign up or add the SDK until Jonathan approves D2 and the dependency on this issue.
* Webhook endpoint served by <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" /> HTTP API; provider secrets through <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> credentials, never in actions, logs or agent context.

## Scope

1. `PaymentGateway` Effect service (integration package `integrations/payments-<vendor>`): createPaymentSession (hosted fields or hosted page, 3DS), capture, void, refund, getPayment, verifyWebhook, connected account onboarding link and status, listPayouts. Typed errors: Declined, AuthenticationRequired, ProviderUnavailable, InvalidRequest.
2. A fake gateway Layer for tests and local development (no network), used by every other F9 slice.
3. First vendor adapter per D2.
4. Actions: sales.payment.create, capture, void, recordWebhook; sales.settings.connectProvider, disconnectProvider (approval always).
5. Payment state machine: pending, authorised, captured, failed, voided; webhooks are the authority; replayed webhooks change nothing (stored event ids).
6. Payments settings screen showing connection status only.

## Acceptance criteria

* With the fake gateway: pay, 3DS required then completed, decline, provider outage (retry with backoff, order stays placed), webhook replay; all tests green.
* Sandbox test against the real adapter (once approved): one payment, one refund, one webhook, recorded in a comment with ids redacted.
* Secret scan shows no provider keys in the repo; telemetry inspection shows no card data or emails.
* Disconnecting the provider blocks new payments with a typed error and leaves existing orders readable.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; vendor SDK only inside the integration package with `// effect-boundary:` comments; PCI scope SAQ A (hosted fields only); behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency or vendor account without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with fake and real adapters, sandbox evidence pasted here, and D2 marked approved on <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" />.

## Blockers

F9.2; <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> secrets, <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" /> HTTP API, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" /> change feed, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> audit; decision D2.

issues.title: F9.4 Build the online storefront and checkout
issues.description:
## Goal

An attendee browses an event's store on the web or in the app, checks out as a guest or signed in, pays, and gets a confirmation, with the store usable for browsing offline from cache.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 6 and 11. Storefront blocks are embedded in F14 sites; F9 owns the catalogue view, cart and checkout, F14 owns page layout.
* Public reads use sales:catalogue:read on an open online channel without sign-in.

## Scope

1. Storefront screens: product list and detail for one channel, cart drawer, checkout (contact details, fulfilment choice from F9.7, consent, refund policy text, pay with the hosted payment field from F9.3).
2. Guest checkout creating or matching an F4 contact by email; signed-in checkout using the user's contact.
3. Consumer law text per product (14-day cancellation for goods; exemption for dated leisure services and tickets), marketing consent unticked and separate.
4. Confirmation screen and email through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />; order status page for the customer (own orders only).
5. Catalogue and images cached for offline browsing; checkout clearly marked as needing connection.
6. Exposed as F14 blocks (product grid, product detail, cart, checkout) with a neutral block contract.
7. Telemetry: sales_checkout_started, sales_order_placed, sales_payment_failed.

## Acceptance criteria

* Playwright run on web: guest buys two products with the fake gateway, gets confirmation, sees the order on the status page; an axe check passes WCAG 2.2 AA on every storefront screen.
* Same flow on Android development build.
* Offline: product list renders from cache; checkout button shows the offline message and does not attempt payment.
* A customer cannot read another customer's order by id through UI, HTTP or MCP.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Rambo-UI components only; whitelabel ASCII customer text; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; screenshots and the Playwright and axe output pasted here; F14 thread told the blocks exist.

## Blockers

F9.3; <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" /> HTTP API, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> screen awareness, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> notifications, <issue id="338aae77-d10e-4f8a-9189-fe3655bd3572" label="EVE-28" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-28/port-localization-for-people-and-for-the-agent" /> localization (currency formats), <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> files for images.

issues.title: F9.5 Build the point of sale register, cash sessions and offline sales
issues.description:
## Goal

A cashier with the right role turns any phone, tablet or desktop running Eventiva into a register for an event booth or box office, sells fast with cash or card, and keeps selling through a loss of connectivity and a device restart.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 2, 5, 6 and decision D3 (offline card) and D6 (offline capacity per line kind).
* Channels attach to an F1 Event and optionally a Phase and Space (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />). Same app for every role; the register appears only with sales:register:operate.
* Card readers are F9.6; this slice delivers cash, the register itself and the offline queue, with card through the fake terminal.

## Scope

1. Channels screen: sales.channel.create, open, close for kinds register, box office and booth, including per-device daily and per-order offline card limits (default 0).
2. Register pairing (sales.register.pair, unpair) binding a device to a channel; register session open with opening float, cash in and out, close with counted cash and variance (sales:register_session_closed event to F11).
3. Register screen: product tile grid, search and barcode input (scanner as keyboard), cart panel, number pad, discounts, park and recall a sale, payment sheet (cash with change due, card via CardTerminal port, split tender).
4. Offline: catalogue, prices and tax snapshot cached on the device; orders, payments and cash movements written to local SQLite and queued; upload through [sales.order.place](<http://sales.order.place>) idempotently on reconnect; queue survives restart; connectivity and queue size shown on screen and in the projection.
5. Offline limit enforcement before taking an offline card payment; online-only line kinds blocked offline.
6. Age-restricted product prompt.
7. Revoked cashier: queued sales still upload but are flagged for review.

## Acceptance criteria

* Scripted outage test: 50 offline sales (cash and fake card) across a device restart upload once each on reconnect, in order, with correct session totals.
* Per-order and daily offline limits block the sale that would exceed them; typed error and clear message.
* Median single-line sale under 20 seconds in a timed manual run on Android, recorded here.
* Cash session close produces the variance and the event F11 consumes.
* Agent on the register can ring up a cash sale through the same actions and says that card confirmation waits for connection.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Rambo-UI components; the `f9-sales` flag and `f9-pos-offline-card` for offline card; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; outage test and timed run evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

F9.2; <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> sync, <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> sync engine, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> screen awareness, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> permissions; D3 and D6 decisions.

issues.title: F7.9 Build control and crew messaging with acknowledgement
issues.description:
## Goal

Control can message one unit, a group or every unit on an event, mark a message urgent, and see who has read and acknowledged it; crews reply from MDT mode, and every message is part of the event's record.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) actions `ops.message.send`, `broadcast`, `acknowledge`; decision D2 (recommended: in-app text only in v1; push to talk and radio bridges are later issues).
* Channels, delivery and push come from [EVE-24](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24>); this issue adds the ops channel types and acknowledgement rules on top.

## Scope

1. Channel per live event: control to unit, control to group (by capability or custom group), all units; unit to control.
2. Message: text, priority (normal, urgent), optional link to an Incident; urgent messages require acknowledgement and re-alert every 60 seconds (event setting) until acknowledged.
3. Read and acknowledged receipts per recipient; control sees a per-message receipt list.
4. Offline: outgoing messages queue on the device and send in order; incoming messages fetched on reconnect; the sender sees queued state.
5. Messages linked to an incident also write an IncidentLogEntry (F7.7).
6. Agent: may draft messages; `broadcast` by the agent always needs controller approval.
7. Later issues to file when this lands (not in scope here): in-app push to talk; radio bridge port.

## Acceptance criteria

* Urgent message to two units: re-alerts until both acknowledge; receipts show times.
* A crew member cannot message another event's channel (negative test).
* Message sent offline arrives in order after reconnect, exactly once (command id dedupe).
* Agent broadcast without approval is refused.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-live-ops`; push vendor only through the <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> port; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here; whitelabel ASCII copy.

## Done signal

Merged to main, acknowledgement and offline tests green, comment here with evidence and the two follow-up issues filed.

## Blockers

[EVE-24](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24>), [EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>); F7.6, F7.7.

issues.title: F10.3 Map editor screen with screen awareness
issues.description:
## Goal

A person edits a site map on web, desktop, tablet or phone with mouse, touch or keyboard, and the agent sees exactly what they see and can press every control they can.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> section 6 (Map editor, Site setup, Sites list). Screen awareness contract from <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />; components from Rambo-UI (D8), which stays free of Eventiva dependencies and exposes neutral interaction hooks.
* Engine wrapped by the `MapEngine` port from <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" />.

## Scope

1. Rambo-UI components (in Resnovas/Rambo-UI, proposed there as their own issue if missing): `MapCanvas` (wraps the engine through a neutral adapter prop), `LayerList`, `SymbolPalette`, `Inspector`, `Toolbar`, `PointPairPicker`.
2. Eventiva screens: Sites list, Site setup and calibration, Map editor, with every control bound to the action ids in <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> section 6.
3. Screen-context projection `sitemap.editor.v1`: map id, phase, viewport bbox and zoom in site-local metres, visible and locked layers, active tool, selection (feature ids, labels, symbol, linked entity), the latest check findings count. Selection and viewport changes publish to application state; the projection is filtered by layer audience.
4. Tools: select, pan, place symbol, draw line, draw polygon, measure, multi-select, snap to grid and to other features, nudge with arrow keys (0.1 m, 1 m with shift), rotate with handles or keys.
5. Navigation actions `nav.open sitemap.site` and `nav.open sitemap.map` with an optional viewport, shared with the command menu.
6. Responsive: inspector as side panel on wide screens, bottom sheet on phones.

## Acceptance criteria

* On web and Android, the agent answers "what am I looking at" from the projection (layers, selection, area in view) and performs placement, move and delete by action id with the same result as the gesture.
* An unbound editor control fails the <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> check on a fixture.
* Keyboard-only placement, selection, move and delete work on web; axe reports no serious issues; focus is visible on every control.
* Frame time stays under 16 ms median with 2,000 features on the <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" /> reference device.

## Constraints

WCAG 2.2 AA; Effect-TS v3 for anything with IO; UI components in Rambo-UI, screens in Eventiva; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with check results; flag `f10-site-maps`.

## Done signal

Merged with web and Android recordings and the axe report attached here.

issues.title: F13.7 Build leave policies, the leave ledger, requests and absence
issues.description:
## Goal

Workers see a correct leave balance and book time off from any device, managers approve with roster clashes in front of them, approved leave blocks availability for rostering, and payroll gets the absence it needs.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />, sections 4 (Leave and absence), 5, 11 (UK holiday rules) and decision 6 (UK statutory rule pack first, recommended).
* Approved leave becomes an availability block in the scheduling engine (<issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />) used by F2; clashes are checked against F2 rosters and F1 Event dates; F12 reads approved leave and absence for pay runs. Offline request queuing follows the sync engine from <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" />.

## Scope

1. Tables LeavePolicy (versioned: leaveType, jurisdictionRule, accrual method fixed, pro rata or per hours worked, carry-over, year start), policy assignments, LeaveLedgerEntry (append-only: accrual, taken, adjustment, carry-over, expiry), LeaveRequest, AbsenceRecord.
2. Balance is always the ledger sum as of a date (pure function, plain TypeScript); no stored balance column.
3. UK rule pack behind a `LeaveJurisdictionRule` port: 5.6 weeks statutory minimum pro rata for part-time; irregular-hours and part-year accrual at 12.07 percent of hours worked for leave years starting on or after 1 April 2024; bank holidays per policy (included or on top). Other jurisdictions use configurable policies only.
4. `PublicHolidays` port with a cached public open-data feed per region (no account needed); `hr.publicHolidays.sync`.
5. Actions `hr.leavePolicies.*`, `hr.leave.balance`, `.request`, `.approve`, `.reject`, `.cancel`, `.adjust`, `hr.absence.record`, `hr.leave.calendar`, per <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" /> section 4.
6. Request creation works offline; approval is online and re-checks balance, overlapping requests and clashes with F2 roster assignments and F1 Event dates; approval writes a taken ledger entry and an <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" /> availability block in one transaction; cancel reverses both.
7. Approval routing to the line manager (F13.1 reporting lines) with fallback to HR; optional tenant auto-approve rules (for example under one day with no clash).
8. Self-reported sickness through `hr.absence.record`, fit note upload via <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.
9. `hr.leave` and `me.leave` screens with projections and bound controls per <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" /> section 6.

## Acceptance criteria

* A full-time worker on a UK policy with an April year start has 28 days including bank holidays on day one of the year; an irregular-hours worker who works 100 hours accrues 12.07 hours.
* A request made offline syncs, and on approval the balance drops, the ledger has one taken entry and <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" /> rejects a booking in the leave period.
* Approving leave that clashes with an existing F2 roster assignment shows the clash to the approver and still needs explicit approval.
* The agent asked "book me Friday off" creates a request, never approves its own user's request, and reports the pending status.
* Cancelling approved leave restores the balance and removes the availability block.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; ledger and accrual maths are pure plain TypeScript with property tests; no zod; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; behind `hr-module`; ship to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here. UK rule values checked with an adviser before launch.

## Done signal

Merged to main and a comment here with the UK rule pack test table.

## Blockers

<issue id="7cc5c061-dd2d-4963-8e03-f0175a4f12b9" label="EVE-98" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-98/f131-build-worker-records-engagements-and-organisation-structure" /> (F13.1), <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />, <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />; F2 roster assignments for the clash check (stubbed until F2 exists).

issues.title: F10.4 Symbol library and linked placements
issues.description:
## Goal

Organisers place real, to-scale things (tents, stages, fence panels, toilets, generators, bars, gates) from a library, and each placement can link to the record it represents so the map and the business data stay one.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> sections 4 and 5 (SymbolLibrary, Symbol, MapFeature links).
* Link targets are owned by other sets and referenced by type and id only: F1 Space and DesignElement, F2 post or shift, F3 task, F6 inventory item type and asset, F7 vehicle, F8 gate and access zone, F9 sales point. A link needs read permission on the target.

## Scope

1. Tables `sitemap_symbol_library`, `sitemap_symbol`; a shipped starter library of about 60 symbols with real footprints (marquees 3x3 m to 20x40 m, stage decks, Heras-style fence panel 3.5 m, crowd barrier 1 m, toilet unit, accessible toilet, generator sizes, bar, food unit 3x3 and 6x3 m, first aid, info point, gate, tower, screen, cable ramp), each with metric defaults and an optional F6 inventory item type ref.
2. Actions: `sitemap.symbol.create`, `.update`, `.archive`; `sitemap.feature.link`, `.unlink` (from F10.2) with a link registry: other sets register a link target type with a read action and a display projection, so F10 never imports their packages.
3. Line symbols: fences and barriers placed along a polyline compute their unit count from length and panel width.
4. Linked feature card in the inspector: shows the target's projection and opens it by navigation action.
5. Broken links: when a target is deleted or the viewer loses access, the feature shows "unavailable" without leaking the target's name.

## Acceptance criteria

* A 350 m fence line with 3.5 m panels counts 100 panels.
* Linking a generator to an F6 asset shows the asset card; a user without F6 read sees the generator but not the asset details.
* Registering a link type from a test extension needs no change to F10 code (module boundary test).
* All actions pass the parity check; starter library loads offline.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; module boundaries per eslint (extensions talk through registered contracts, not imports); no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green and the starter library listed in docs.

## Blockers

<issue id="82fab111-6d01-4616-85c7-1e4ff88ca469" label="EVE-152" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record" />.

issues.title: F7.10 Build live unit positions on the event map with consent and retention
issues.description:
## Goal

Control sees where every active unit is on the event's site map, the dispatch suggestions use distance, and location is collected only while a person is on an active unit, or is rostered on a live event's current F2 Shift and has opted in (for example stewards on foot), with a visible indicator and short retention. This is the single location collector in Eventiva; F10.9 (<issue id="65408e38-c1f0-4c12-bb84-250acaadf65d" label="EVE-205" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-205/f109-crew-positions-layer-and-as-built-reporting" />) renders its Crew layer from this stream.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) actions `ops.position.report`, `ops.position.list`; entity PositionFix; section 11 compliance; decision D3 (recommended: phone GPS first, telematics port in F7.11, no adapter).
* The map, layers and zones are F10 (Site map, Layer, Zone); F7 adds a unit-positions layer and does not own map rendering or geocoding.
* Positions are a live stream through the DispatchBoard entity, not records in the offline sync engine.

## Scope

1. Device reporter: while MDT mode is on and the unit is active, or while the person is on a current Shift of a live event and has opted in (opt-in is per event, revocable at any time, off by default), report position every 15 seconds when moving, every 2 minutes when still (event settings), using the platform location API already available to Expo builds; check whether the needed Expo module is already a dependency and, if not, ask for approval on this issue before adding it.
2. `ops.position.report` validated and rate-limited per device; `ops.position.list` returns latest per unit with age and accuracy.
3. Retention: history kept 30 days by default (tenant can shorten, not extend beyond 90), then deleted by a durable job; last known only after that.
4. Consent and transparency: indicator in the app while reporting, a stop button that sets the unit status to Unavailable, and a tenant DPIA template in the docs.
5. Map layer for F10: register at module activation with `sitemap.layerSource.register` (F10.2, [EVE-152](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record>), scope 6), mode `live`, giving `ops.position.list` as the read action, the position stream subscription, staleness 2 minutes and a style (unit markers coloured by status, stale greyed). F10 renders and applies audience rules; F7 owns the data and consent. Positions are sent as WGS84 lon/lat; F10 shared contracts convert to the site-local frame. Crews see other units only if the event setting allows.
6. One collector: `ops.position.report` is the only place device location is collected in Eventiva, for people on active units and for opted-in crew on a current Shift; F10.9 ([EVE-205](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-205/f109-live-positions-and-as-built-reporting>)) crew positions read from this stream rather than collecting separately, so there is one consent path and one retention rule.
7. Feed distance into `ops.dispatch.suggestUnits` (F7.7).

## Acceptance criteria

* No position is accepted for a person who is neither on an active unit nor on a current Shift with opt-in (negative tests for each, and for opt-in revoked mid-shift).
* Positions carry a source (unit or crew) so F10 can render Unit and Crew layers separately.
* Retention job deletes history older than the setting, verified with a fixture.
* Stale positions show as stale on the map and are not used for distance ranking.
* No coordinates reach analytics or logs; spans carry only counts.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI; behind `eventiva-live-ops`; UK GDPR / EU GDPR data minimisation; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, device run on Android with positions shown on the web control map, comment here with evidence.

## Blockers

[EVE-40](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40>), [EVE-43](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43>), [EVE-44](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44>), [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>); F7.6, F7.8; F10 Site map and layers (<issue id="82fab111-6d01-4616-85c7-1e4ff88ca469" label="EVE-152" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record" />); F2 Shifts for crew eligibility.

issues.title: F13.8 Build self-service and the offline site check screens
issues.description:
## Goal

Every worker, freelancer, volunteer and supplying agency manages their own HR data in the same Eventiva app on phone, desktop and web, and a site supervisor can check crew eligibility at the venue with no signal.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-80](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave>), sections 6 (Screens), 9 (roles including supplying agency) and 12 (offline site check acceptance).
* Screens use Rambo-UI components and declare screen-context projections with every control bound to an action ([EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>)). The settings and profile shell comes from [EVE-32](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-32/port-settings-profiles-navigation-command-menu-and-onboarding>). Screens ship as a federated module with a bundled fallback ([EVE-16](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web>)) so they work offline.
* Blocked by F13.4 (<issue id="576185f3-f438-43c7-b694-e5afff0605e7" label="EVE-153" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-153/f134-build-onboarding-and-offboarding-runs" />), F13.5 (<issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" />) and F13.7 (<issue id="5ca54321-0f0a-461c-ade1-89cf3197dc48" label="EVE-179" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-179/f137-build-leave-policies-the-leave-ledger-requests-and-absence" />) for the actions these screens call.

## Scope

1. `me.profile` (own non-sensitive and sensitive fields, emergency contacts, data export), `me.documents` (to sign, signed, upload), `me.qualifications` (add with photo or file, see expiry), `me.leave` (balance, request, history).
2. Supplying agency view: list of their supplied workers, add and update qualifications and documents for them, see eligibility only for them.
3. HR screens from <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" /> section 6 not already built in earlier slices: `hr.people`, `hr.worker`, `hr.orgChart`, `hr.qualifications` matrix, `hr.compliance`.
4. `hr.siteCheck`: search or scan a worker code, show eligibility and induction status for the supervisor's current F1 Event as of last sync, record induction; clear offline banner with the last sync time.
5. A scannable worker code (QR) on `me.profile` that carries an opaque id only, no personal data.
6. Each screen's projection registered on module activation and removed on disposal; a CI fixture with an unbound control fails the check.
7. Accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA (house `web-accessibility` skill); localisation-ready strings (<issue id="338aae77-d10e-4f8a-9189-fe3655bd3572" label="EVE-28" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-28/port-localization-for-people-and-for-the-agent" />).

## Acceptance criteria

* A freelancer completes their onboarding entirely from a phone: signs two documents, uploads a certificate, sets emergency contacts.
* An agency user sees only their own supplied workers (negative test).
* With the network off, a supervisor scans a worker code, sees eligible or not with reasons and the last sync time, records an induction, and it syncs on reconnect.
* The agent reading `hr.qualifications` sees the same visible cells as the user and can perform every visible control through its action.
* axe reports no serious or critical issues on each screen on web.

## Constraints

Rambo-UI components only (request missing ones in Rambo-UI rather than building local copies); Effect-TS v3 house rules for any data access; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; behind `hr-module`; ship to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with screenshots of each screen on Android and web and the offline site check recording attached here.

## Blockers

[EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen>), [EVE-16](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web>), [EVE-32](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-32/port-settings-profiles-navigation-command-menu-and-onboarding>), [EVE-153](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-153/f134-build-onboarding-and-offboarding-runs>) (F13.4), [EVE-154](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check>) (F13.5), <issue id="5ca54321-0f0a-461c-ade1-89cf3197dc48" label="EVE-179" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-179/f137-build-leave-policies-the-leave-ledger-requests-and-absence" /> (F13.7); Rambo-UI components (DataTable, Calendar, SignaturePad, Scanner, FileDropzone, Matrix).

issues.title: F10.5 Measurements, zones, routes and rule checks
issues.description:
## Goal

The map tells organisers and the agent how big things are, how many people fit, whether routes are wide enough and clear, and which rules the layout breaks, before anyone builds it.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> sections 4, 5, 7 and 11 (capacity figures are planning aids, not certification).
* F1 `Space.site_map_zone_ref` points at Zones defined here (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />); F8 access zones may reference them too.

## Scope

1. `sitemap.measure`: length, area, perimeter, bearing in site-local metres (pure functions in shared contracts).
2. `sitemap.zone.define`: polygon feature becomes a Zone with usable area (area minus contained obstacle footprints), capacity mode (computed from density per m2, or fixed), access rule refs. Recomputed by the mirror on every change. This is holding capacity only: the zone also shows exit capacity (sum of clear widths of the routes leaving it, times the rule set's flow rate per metre per minute, times the evacuation time) and reports the lower of the two, as the Green Guide's safe capacity is the lowest of holding, entry, exit and emergency exit capacity.
3. `sitemap.route.define`: line feature becomes a Route (emergency, vehicle, pedestrian, accessible) with minimum width; the measured clear width is the narrowest gap between obstacles along the route.
4. Rule sets in settings (<issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />), Effect Schema validated: facility ratios (for example toilets per 100 attendees by duration), minimum route widths, density limits, clearance distances (for example generator to tent), boundary containment. Starter rule sets cite their source documents in their description, editable per tenant, and hold only openly published figures: Purple Guide public ratios (one female toilet per 100, one male per 500 plus one urinal per 150, at least one accessible toilet; the full guide is subscription-only), Green Guide capacity method with tenant-entered flow rates and P and S factors, IBC Table 1004.5 or NFPA 101 occupant load factors (7 net sq ft per person chairs only, 5 standing).
5. `sitemap.check.run` returns findings with severity, rule id, feature ids and a human sentence; runs automatically (debounced) after edits through the change feed.
6. Attendance input comes from F1 Event attendance or F8 sales, read through registered contracts.

## Acceptance criteria

* A fixture map with seeded faults (overlap, item outside boundary, 2.1 m emergency route where 3.0 m is required, zone over capacity, toilets short by ratio, generator too close to a tent) returns exactly those findings.
* Capacity of a 1,000 m2 zone at 2 persons per m2 with 100 m2 of obstacles is 1,800; with one 2 m exit route at a fixture flow rate of 60 persons per metre per minute and 8 minutes it is 960, and the zone reports 960 with exit capacity as the limit.
* Every exported capacity figure carries the "calculated estimate" note.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; geometry pure TypeScript; no new dependency without approval here (a geometry library such as a polygon clipper needs approval on this issue); ships to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with fixture tests green and rule-set docs for people and agents.

## Blockers

<issue id="82fab111-6d01-4616-85c7-1e4ff88ca469" label="EVE-152" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record" />, <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />.

issues.title: F7.11 Define the telematics port with a test adapter
issues.description:
## Goal

Eventiva has one neutral contract for vehicle telematics (position, odometer, fault codes), so a provider can be added later by composition only, without touching fleet or dispatch code.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) section 8; decision D3 (recommended: port only in v1, no provider adapter until a customer needs one and Jonathan approves the vendor).
* House rule: vendors sit behind an integration package with a neutral Effect service; credentials through config and secrets ([EVE-41](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41>)).

## Scope

1. `TelematicsPort` Effect service (Context.Tag): `linkVehicle(vehicleId, providerRef)`, `streamPositions`, `latestOdometer`, `faultCodes`, each with typed errors (ProviderUnavailable, NotLinked, RateLimited).
2. TelematicsLink entity: vehicle, provider key, external id, linked by, status.
3. A fixture adapter that replays a recorded route, used in tests and demos.
4. Wiring: positions from the port feed the same stream as F7.10 (source = telematics); odometer readings land as OdometerReading (F7.5) with source telematics.
5. Docs for people and agents: how to add an adapter package, what it must implement, conformance tests to pass.

## Acceptance criteria

* Conformance suite runs against the fixture adapter and passes.
* Swapping the fixture adapter for a second stub changes only the Layer composition (test proves no domain import of adapter code; Nx boundary lint passes).
* No credentials in logs, spans or action payloads.

## Constraints

issues.title: F14.4 Change sets: draft, preview, publish, rollback and packages
issues.description:
## Goal

Every customisation, by a person or the agent, is drafted in a change set, previewed with its full impact, published deliberately as a numbered version, and can be rolled back in one step or moved to another organisation as a package.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`studio.changesets.*`, `studio.packages.*`), 5 (ChangeSet, CustomisationVersion, CustomisationPackage) and offline rules.
* F14.1 to F14.3 ship with an interim "apply immediately" publish behind the flag; this slice replaces it.
* Agent approval (section 7): publish and rollback are `confirm`; import is `confirm`.

## Scope

1. `ChangeSet` with items (field, entity type, view, patch, automation definitions) and a `baseVersion`; several open change sets per org; drafts sync offline.
2. `studio.changesets.preview`: schema diff, affected screens and actions, data effects (records touched, values that will fail new validation, index builds), permission impact (new grants, widened visibility), protected-target refusals, skipped patches.
3. `studio.changesets.publish`: server-only; validates against the current version, refuses a stale `baseVersion` with `ChangeSetStale` and offers a rebase; compiles a new immutable `CustomisationVersion`; invalidates the F14.1 schema cache; emits `studio.version.published` on the change feed; audit record with author and approver.
4. Value migrations on publish are additive only: new fields get defaults lazily; type changes that lose data are refused (archive and add a new field instead).
5. `studio.changesets.rollback`: publishes a new version equal to an earlier one; data written to fields added after it is kept but hidden.
6. Clients pick up a new version at the next screen change, never mid-edit; offline devices keep the last version.
7. `studio.packages.export` (signed JSON with format version and content hash) and `studio.packages.import` (creates a draft change set; references to missing entities are reported in preview).
8. Change set review screen with DiffViewer; comments via <issue id="b7f17f15-c893-46e9-9b3b-2aefae473802" label="EVE-27" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-27/port-comments-mentions-and-review-suggestions-on-any-resource" /> when available.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two admins edit different change sets; publishing the second after the first returns `ChangeSetStale`, rebase succeeds and both changes are present (test).
* Preview of a change that makes a field required reports the count of existing records missing a value.
* Rollback restores the previous screens on web and Android while keeping data entered in the meantime.
* Export from org A and import into org B produces an equivalent draft; publishing it gives the same screens.
* The agent's `studio.changesets.publish` call asks for confirmation; without it nothing changes (test).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; behind `f14-studio`; publish runs as a durable workflow on Effect Cluster (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" /> pattern); no new dependency without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged; the interim publish path removed; the acceptance tests green.

issues.title: F7.12 Build agent assist for fleet and dispatch with approvals
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent watches the fleet and live operations and offers the right next step at the right time (expiring documents, services due, clashes, unacknowledged jobs, silent units), and can carry out any fleet or dispatch task a user asks for, always with approval where the parent spec requires it.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-71](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-71>) section 7 (agent behaviour) and the approval column of section 4.
* The agent uses the same inventory actions as the UI ([EVE-52](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52>)), reads screen projections ([EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50>)), runs durable watchers ([EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>)) and posts into threads ([EVE-55](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-55>)).

## Scope

1. Watchers (durable, idempotent by subject and day): documents expiring within 30 days (F7.1); service due (F7.5); booking clashes, off-road vehicles with bookings, ineligible drivers (F7.2, F7.3, F7.4); incident unacknowledged after the event setting (F7.7); unit with no status or position update for the event setting (F7.6, F7.10).
2. Each watcher posts a suggestion with the proposed action and its input pre-filled; accepting runs the action as the user, with the approval policy applied.
3. On request: plan vehicles for an event from its F1 Phases and EquipmentRequirements, summarise the control log, answer unit status and location questions, draft hire requests and messages.
4. Approval-required list enforced by tests: dispatch assign and unassign, broadcast, hire request to a vendor, vehicle back on road, reassign on a live event; the agent never closes an incident.
5. Agent evaluation set (later linked through [EVE-29](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29>)): 20 scripted scenarios with expected actions.

## Acceptance criteria

* Each watcher fires once per subject per day in a fixture run and survives a runner restart without duplicates.
* Every approval-required action called by the agent without approval is refused (one test per action).
* For journey J3, the agent's top suggested unit matches the deterministic ranking from F7.7.
* Offline: the agent answers from local data and says plainly when a live action needs connection.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; behind `eventiva-live-ops` (dispatch watchers) and `eventiva-fleet` (fleet watchers); no prompts or incident text in analytics by default; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; tests with `@effect/vitest`; docs; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, watcher and approval tests green, evaluation scenarios committed, comment here with results.

## Blockers

[EVE-50](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50>), [EVE-52](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52>), [EVE-54](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54>), [EVE-55](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-55>); F7.1 to F7.10.
