issues.title: F6.8 Build purchasing: supplier products, requests, orders, receiving and reorder points
issues.description:
## Goal

The company buys what it needs through approved requests and orders, receives it into stock by scanning, and finance can match every supplier bill to what arrived.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> decision D5 (recommended): F6 owns requests, orders, receiving and reorder points; F11 (<issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />) owns supplier bills and postings. Agreed with the F11 thread 2026-11-01.
* Suppliers are F4 organisations; referenced by the F4 Contact id. Tax codes are F11's (`accounting.tax.code.*`); F6 stores F11 tax code ids, never its own rates. Amounts are integer minor units with a currency code.
* Orders go to suppliers by email with a PDF through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, plus a scoped supplier link to confirm. EDI and punchout are out of scope.

## Scope

1. Tables `purchasing_supplier_product` (supplier contact id, product, supplier sku, unit price minor units, currency, lead time days, min order qty), `purchasing_request` and lines (reason, event ref, status `draft`, `submitted`, `approved`, `rejected`), `purchasing_order` and lines (supplier, delivery location, expected date, tax code id per line, status `draft`, `sent`, `confirmed`, `part-received`, `received`, `cancelled`), `purchasing_receipt` and lines.
2. Actions `purchasing.supplierProduct.upsert`, `purchasing.request.create`, `approve` (confirm; approval limits per role from <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> settings), `reject`, `purchasing.order.create`, `update`, `send` (always needs approval; online only), `cancel` (always needs approval once sent), `purchasing.receipt.record`, `purchasing.reorder.evaluate`.
3. Receiving: `receipt.record` writes movements from the `supplier` location to the delivery location, registers serialised assets on receipt (F6.3, with cost from the order line), and emits one change-feed event per receipt `inventory:goods_received` with PO id, PO line ids, quantities, unit cost in minor units, currency, F1 Event id when present and supplier F4 Contact id, so F11 can three-way match and post goods received not invoiced at the time.
4. Reorder points per consumable product per warehouse (min, reorder qty); `reorder.evaluate` drafts requests grouped by preferred supplier.
5. Inbound open order lines add to availability from their expected date (F6.4 term).
6. Screens Suppliers and purchase orders, Goods receipt (scanner) with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projections and bound controls; supplier link page shows only that order.

## Acceptance criteria

* A request over the purchaser's limit needs finance approval; under it, the purchaser's confirm is enough.
* The agent drafting and sending an order stops for approval before `send`; after approval the supplier receives the email with PDF (test adapter).
* Receiving 2 of 5 lines marks the order `part-received`, writes movements, registers serialised assets with cost, and emits two `inventory:goods_received` events if done in two receipts.
* A consumable below its reorder point produces a draft request on `reorder.evaluate`, and the agent suggests it proactively (F6.12).
* Supplier prices are masked for roles without `inventory:valuation:read`.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-purchasing`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, the F11 thread or issue confirms the `inventory:goods_received` payload, and tests are green.

issues.title: F6.9 Build sub-hire: renting in equipment from other suppliers for an event
issues.description:
## Goal

When the company is short, it can hire equipment in from another supplier for the event dates, track it like its own stock, and send it back complete.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> sections 4, 5 and 7. Sub-hire is the most common answer to a shortage in the market check.
* Sub-hired items live in stock while held, from a `supplier` location to the warehouse or straight to the event-site, and must go back by the return date. Costs flow to F11 as a purchase (F6.8 order with a hire period).

## Scope

1. Table `inventory_subhire` and lines (supplier F4 Contact id, event, window collect and return, product qty or supplier serials, purchase order ref, status `draft`, `sent`, `confirmed`, `received`, `returned`, `cancelled`).
2. Actions `inventory.subhire.create` (from a shortage, prefilled), `send` (always needs approval; creates or sends the linked F6.8 purchase order with the hire period), `receive` (movements in; serialised items get temporary asset records flagged `subhired`, with the supplier's tag codes), `return` (movements out; missing items raise discrepancies).
3. Availability (F6.4) adds confirmed sub-hire lines for their window only; sub-hired assets are never offered beyond the window.
4. Agent: from `shortage.list`, proposes a sub-hire with the preferred supplier (lowest price then shortest lead time from F6.8 supplier products) and a draft order, then stops for approval.
5. Screen Sub-hire with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection and bound controls; the Event equipment tab shows sub-hired lines with a badge.

## Acceptance criteria

* A shortage of 4 moving heads becomes a sub-hire for the event window; after approval and receipt, availability for that window shows no shortage and outside the window is unchanged.
* Returning 3 of 4 raises one `missing` discrepancy against the sub-hire.
* "Hire in what we are missing for Saturday" run by the agent ends at an approval prompt with the supplier, items, window and cost shown.
* Temporary asset records are retired automatically after return.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-subhire`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the shortage-to-return test green.

issues.title: F6.10 Build stock counts and cycle counts with offline counting
issues.description:
## Goal

The warehouse can count a bin, zone or whole site, on several devices at once and offline, and turn the differences into reviewed adjustments.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> sections 4 and 5. Counts compare a snapshot of derived levels (F6.2) with what was counted; differences become adjustment movements only on finalise.
* Movements that happen during a count (for example a late return) must not be counted as differences.

## Scope

1. Tables `inventory_count` (scope location, mode `full` or `cycle`, snapshot time, status `open`, `review`, `finalised`) and `inventory_count_line` (product or asset, counted qty, device, counter person).
2. Actions `inventory.count.start` (takes the snapshot), `record` (per device; offline allowed), `finalise` (online only, confirm; writes adjustment movements to or from the virtual adjustment location and raises discrepancies for serialised assets not found).
3. Difference = counted minus (snapshot level plus movements into or out of the scope after the snapshot).
4. Cycle counts: a schedule per location (from <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> settings) and a read listing locations due; the agent suggests the next count.
5. Screen Stock count (scanner list) with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two devices count the same zone offline; counts sum per line after sync with no double counting of the same serialised asset.
* A return scanned in after the snapshot does not show as a difference.
* Finalise writes one adjustment per differing bulk line and one `missing` discrepancy per serialised asset not counted, and needs confirm for person and agent alike.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-inventory`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the two-device count test green.

issues.title: F6.11 Build stock valuation, asset depreciation and the per-period export to accounting
issues.description:
## Goal

Finance can see what the equipment and stock are worth at any date, and every period's value changes reach accounting once, balanced against the movement ledger.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> decision D6 (recommended): cost per serialised asset with straight-line depreciation; average cost for bulk and consumables. Boundary agreed with the F11 thread (<issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />) 2026-11-01: goods received are emitted per receipt by F6.8; this issue covers the per-period export.
* Amounts in integer minor units with currency; F11 tax and currency settings.

## Scope

1. Depreciation settings per product category (useful life months, residual percent) in <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> settings; per-asset override.
2. Average cost per bulk and consumable product per org, updated on each receipt; consumption and write-offs valued at the average at the time.
3. Actions `inventory.valuation.report` (as-of date, by category, location, method) and `inventory.valuation.exportToAccounts` (period; confirm; idempotent per period; emits `inventory:valuation_exported` on the change feed with lines for depreciation, average-cost consumption, asset additions and retirements, and write-offs from lost or scrapped items).
4. A reconciliation check: the export's quantity totals equal the movement ledger for the period, else the export fails with `ValuationOutOfBalance`.
5. Screen Valuation (report table and chart) with <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> projection; visible only with `inventory:valuation:read`.

## Acceptance criteria

* An asset costing 120000 minor units with a 60-month life and 0 residual depreciates 2000 per month; retiring it in month 13 exports a retirement with net book value 96000.
* Exporting the same period twice produces one event.
* A deliberately inserted unbalanced test movement makes the export fail with `ValuationOutOfBalance`.
* The agent can produce the report for a person with finance access and is refused for warehouse crew.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; Rambo-UI with WCAG 2.2 AA; flag `f6-valuation`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main, F11 confirms the `inventory:valuation_exported` payload, tests green.

issues.title: F14.5 Automations: extend the F3 rules engine across every feature set
issues.description:
## Goal

An organisation automates workflows across the whole product ("when a ticket order is refunded, notify the box office and reopen the seat") without code, using the one rules engine F3 builds, so there is a single rule builder, a single run log and a single permission model.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (automations row), 5 (Automations are Rules), 9 (protected actions) and decision D5 (declarative only).
* Changed 2026-11-08: Jonathan approved a "when X then Y" rule builder inside F3, specced in <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" /> as a domain-agnostic `rules` package (triggers from the <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" /> event inventory, actions from <issue id="dc89a6af-338c-417b-a352-80cbfb05ec1e" label="EVE-40" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40/p11-build-the-action-contract-and-inventory-in-effect-schema" /> marked rule-safe by the registering module, runs as the owner with permissions checked at run time, durable on Effect Cluster, loop guard at depth 5, `rule.preview` dry run). F14 extends that engine and does not build a second one. This issue replaces the earlier F14 automation engine design (service principals and a separate `studio.automations.*` action family are dropped).
* F1 constraint (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />): `show.arm` and `rigging.signOff` are human only, `show.stopAll` always available; they are never rule-safe.

## Scope

1. Registration contract for feature sets: a short guide and helper so each set registers its triggers and rule-safe actions with the `rules` package (F1, F4, F6, F8, F9 and the rest as they land); a protected action can never be marked rule-safe, enforced by a check that fails registration.
2. F14 triggers: custom field changed (F14.1), custom record created, updated, deleted (F14.2), form submitted (F14.9), site published (F14.10), schedule (cron with time zone), inbound webhook (tokenised URL, signature check, 64 KB cap); F14 rule-safe actions: `records.custom.create`, `records.custom.update`, custom field set on any extensible entity.
3. Engine extensions proposed back to the `rules` package, built here with the F3 owner's agreement: wait steps (duration or until a date field), approval steps (pause until a named role approves, reusing the action approval path), branch on condition, agent step (prompt plus an allowed-actions list, budgeted, used by F14.6 AI fields), `rule.runNow` and `rule.runs.cancel`.
4. Rule scope and permission: rules on non-task triggers need `studio:automate`; task rules keep `tasks:rules` per <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" />.
5. Change sets: rules can be drafted inside a Studio change set (F14.4) and are enabled when it publishes; rollback disables rules added after the target version.
6. Rule editor: extend the <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" /> screen with a trigger picker grouped by feature set and the new step kinds; projections and action bindings per <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />.

## Acceptance criteria

* "Ticket order refunded then notify box office" built on F8 and F14 registrations fires once per refund, survives a runner restart mid-run and does not double-notify (<issue id="37a1be99-529e-478c-a187-48c120672aeb" label="EVE-18" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-18/s5-verify-sharding-across-two-independent-runners-with-drain-and" /> two-runner setup).
* Registering `show.arm` as rule-safe fails the registration check (test).
* A rule with an approval step pauses until an organiser approves, then completes; a cancelled run stops at the next step.
* A rule drafted in a change set does nothing until the change set publishes and is disabled again by rollback.
* There is exactly one rules package and one run log in the codebase (dependency check).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; condition evaluation stays the <issue id="cbcfb707-a7d4-4089-8e84-d9e2a2bd4d94" label="EVE-235" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-235/f310-build-the-task-rule-builder-when-x-then-y-on-a-generic-rule" /> pure TypeScript filter; behind `f14-studio-automations` (on top of `tasks-rules`); no user code (D5); no new dependency without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the cross-set trigger, protected-action and approval-step tests green and the registration guide published in ai-docs.

## Blockers

issues.title: F8.6 Build offline scanning: validity snapshots, local scan ledger, sync and duplicate alerts
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

When the venue network fails, every registered scanner keeps admitting and rejecting correctly, and after reconnect the server reconciles all scans with no lost entries and clear alerts for any double entry.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> section 5 conflict table and decision D2 (signed tickets plus snapshot plus append-only ledger).
* Market reference: pretix keeps a local copy and syncs in the background; Eventiva adds signature checks so tickets issued after the last sync still verify.
* Offline transport comes from the <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" /> sync engine decision and <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> record sync; this issue must not pick a different engine.

## Scope

1. ticketing.device.snapshot: per device and list, a signed snapshot of ticket validity (id, type, status, holder name, secret hash) plus event public keys and a revocation list; delta refresh every 30 seconds online; expiry per list (default 24 hours).
2. Local scan ledger in SQLite: append-only, queued for upload, each scan with device clock, monotonic counter and offline flag.
3. Device-side validation using the shared function from F8.5; unknown ticket with a valid signature and no void in the snapshot is admitted with a warning (issued after last sync).
4. Peer-free consistency: no device-to-device sync in this slice; devices at the same gate converge through the server on reconnect.
5. Server reconciliation: union of ledgers, ordering by server receive time then device counter; for single-entry lists later admits become duplicate-entry alerts; admits of tickets voided before the scan become void-admit alerts. Alerts are change-feed events shown on devices and in the agent thread.
6. Device revocation: a revoked device's uploads are accepted for audit but marked, and its snapshot stops refreshing.
7. Offline indicator, queued count and last sync time on the Scanner screen.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two devices offline for 30 minutes scan 2,000 fixture tickets including 20 deliberate cross-device duplicates: after reconnect, zero lost scans, exactly 20 duplicate alerts, admitted counter correct.
* A ticket issued after a device's last sync admits offline with a warning; a forged payload is rejected offline.
* A ticket voided before the device went offline is rejected offline; one voided while it was offline raises a void-admit alert after sync.
* Device restart while offline keeps the queue (persisted) and the snapshot.
* Offline scan to result p95 under 300 ms on a mid-range Android device.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; snapshot holds no email, answers or order data; no private keys on devices; behind flags `ticketing` and `ticketing-offline-scan`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, the 30-minute two-device test recorded on real Android devices and attached here.

## Blockers

F8.5 (<issue id="57212326-6c0e-4711-a80a-d34efa6ffd87" label="EVE-162" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-162/f85-build-check-in-lists-and-online-scanning-in-the-app" />), <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="60101c56-d4e4-4e4f-b7c8-b4c40f44ada0" label="EVE-17" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-17/s4-choose-the-offline-sync-engine-for-record-edits-and-live-text-and" />, <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />.

issues.title: F8.7 Build the box office: in-person ticket sales, reprints and offline quota sales
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

Box office staff sell, print or send tickets at the door through F9 point of sale, look up and reissue tickets, and keep selling from a fixed per-device quota when offline without any risk of overselling.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> sections 4 and 5; F9 thread agreed (2026-11-01) that kind "ticket" is not online-only and uses a pre-allocated per-device allocation from a capacity pool for offline POS.
* F9 owns the POS cart, payment and receipt; F8 owns the holds, ticket issue and print or send.

## Scope

1. Box office screen: ticket type grid with live availability, F9 cart, holder form, print, email or show-on-screen delivery, lookup and reissue.
2. ticketing.boxOffice.allocateOfflineQuota: reserves a hold (purpose offline-quota) for a device and ticket type; returning the device or ending the shift releases the unused part.
3. Offline sale: device issues provisional tickets from its quota, signed with a per-device sub-key certified by the event key (so scanners verify them offline); on reconnect F9 posts the orders and F8 converts provisional tickets to normal ones keeping the same code.
4. Print through the OS print path (PDF from <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />); native printer SDKs only on approval.
5. Shift summary: sold, comps, reissues, quota left, handed to F9 for cash-up.

## Acceptance criteria

* An offline device with a quota of 50 refuses the 51st sale with QuotaExhausted.
* Provisional tickets sold offline admit at an offline scanner and stay valid after sync with the same code.
* Ending a shift releases unused quota back to the pool within 5 seconds of reconnect.
* Sales made offline reconcile exactly with F9 orders (count and value) in an integration test.
* Agent can prepare a quota allocation but needs confirmation; it cannot sell at the box office.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; device sub-keys only from the secrets service (<issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />), revocable; behind flags `ticketing` and `ticketing-box-office`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, tests green, recorded offline box office sale and scan on Android.

## Blockers

F8.5 (<issue id="57212326-6c0e-4711-a80a-d34efa6ffd87" label="EVE-162" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-162/f85-build-check-in-lists-and-online-scanning-in-the-app" />), F8.6 for offline scan of provisional tickets, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />; F9 point of sale and offline POS.

issues.title: F8.8 Build the waiting list and face-value resale
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

When an event sells out, fans join a waiting list, and returned or resold tickets go to the next person at face value, so organisers fill every place and touts gain nothing.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> decision D4; market reference: DICE resells returns at face value through its waiting list.
* Compliance: UK Consumer Rights Act 2015 s.90 to 95 information duties for resale; prices never above face value plus the organiser's stated fee (<issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> section 11).

## Scope

1. WaitlistEntry and ResaleListing schemas.
2. Actions: ticketing.waitlist.join, leave, offer; ticketing.resale.list, withdraw.
3. Automatic mode (organiser setting): when capacity frees (hold expiry, refund, resale listing) the next entry gets an offer with a hold for a set time (default 30 minutes), notified via <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />; manual mode uses waitlist.offer.
4. Resale: holder lists a ticket; when a waiting buyer pays through F9 at face value, F9 refunds the seller (minus the organiser's resale fee if set), F8 voids the old ticket and issues a new one to the buyer, all in one durable workflow with compensation on failure.
5. Waiting list screen for organisers; join and resale controls on My tickets and the public ticket picker.

## Acceptance criteria

* Refund of one ticket in a sold-out pool sends an offer to the first entry within 10 seconds; unanswered offers pass to the next entry after expiry.
* A resale completes with buyer ticket valid, seller ticket void and seller refunded; a failure after payment rolls back to the seller keeping a valid ticket and the buyer refunded.
* Resale price cannot exceed face value plus the stated fee (typed error).
* Agent can recommend offers and run waitlist.offer only with confirmation.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; durable workflow on Effect Cluster (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />); behind flags `ticketing` and `ticketing-waitlist-resale`; whitelabel ASCII notification copy; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, tests green, and a comment here with the resale workflow steps and compensations.

## Blockers

F8.4 (<issue id="b11d671d-2a5f-4e92-a9a4-da4d61c3d64d" label="EVE-122" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-122/f84-build-the-attendee-view-my-tickets-holder-details-and-transfers-in" />), F8.2, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />; F9 refunds.

issues.title: F8.9 Build ticketing reports, the sales dashboard and attendee exports
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

Organisers, finance and safety officers see sales, sell-through and live admissions per Event and admission scope, and can export attendee lists within the data rules.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> sections 4, 6, 10, 11. Revenue truth lives in F9 orders and F11 ledgers; F8 reports units and face value and links to F9 for money.

## Scope

1. Actions: ticketing.report.sales (units, face value, by ticket type, channel, day), ticketing.report.admissions (admitted by gate and time bucket, no-shows), ticketing.export.attendees (CSV via <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />, chosen fields, always logged in audit).
2. Read models fed from the change feed (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />) so reports do not load the pool entities.
3. Sales dashboard with <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" /> widgets: sell-through against capacity and target, pace curve, live admitted count per gate for safety.
4. Retention job: attendee personal data on a finished Event is minimised after the configured period (default 12 months), keeping aggregate counts.

## Acceptance criteria

* Report totals equal the sum of tickets in a fixture event; admissions match the scan ledger.
* Export by a role without ticketing:manage is denied on every surface; each export writes an audit record with the field list.
* Retention job removes holder names, emails and answers after the period and leaves counts intact.
* Agent answers "how many people are in through gate B" from the admissions report with the same number the dashboard shows.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no personal data in PostHog; behind flag `ticketing`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, tests green, screenshot of the dashboard on a fixture event attached here.

## Blockers

F8.5 (<issue id="57212326-6c0e-4711-a80a-d34efa6ffd87" label="EVE-162" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-162/f85-build-check-in-lists-and-online-scanning-in-the-app" />), <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />.

issues.title: F13.9 Build HR agent playbooks and compliance reports
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent keeps HR compliant without being asked: it spots expiring certificates and checks before a show, chases overdue onboarding, flags leave clashes, reads uploaded certificates for a person to confirm, and HR has headcount, compliance and leave reports on one dashboard.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="253839bc-c987-416b-92ea-206c9e9e8d2e" label="EVE-80" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-80/f13-human-resources-worker-records-onboarding-qualifications-and-leave" />, sections 4 (Reports), 7 (Agent behaviour), 10 (flags `hr-agent-expiry-watch`, `hr-agent-roster-guard`, `hr-agent-evidence-reading`).
* Agent loop and tools from <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />; durable scheduled runs from <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />; evaluations from <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" />; dashboard widgets from <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" />; notifications from <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />. Uses actions from F13.4 (<issue id="576185f3-f438-43c7-b694-e5afff0605e7" label="EVE-153" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-153/f134-build-onboarding-and-offboarding-runs" />), F13.5 (<issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" />), F13.6 (<issue id="d9da9830-5771-4e7c-85be-f3c99aed92e6" label="EVE-156" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-156/f136-build-right-to-work-and-background-check-records" />) and F13.7 (<issue id="5ca54321-0f0a-461c-ade1-89cf3197dc48" label="EVE-179" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-179/f137-build-leave-policies-the-leave-ledger-requests-and-absence" />).

## Scope

1. Actions `hr.reports.headcount`, `hr.reports.compliance`, `hr.reports.leave` and the `hr.compliance` dashboard built from <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" /> widgets.
2. Expiry watch: a daily durable run per tenant listing qualifications and right-to-work follow-ups expiring within 60 days or before any rostered F1 Event date; drafts reminders to workers and agencies and flags affected F2 roster slots into a review queue for HR.
3. Roster guard: on F2 assignment, explains `NotEligible` reasons in plain words with the next step (upload, verify, request override).
4. Onboarding chase: morning summary of overdue steps with suggested reminders; nothing is sent without the HR user's confirmation unless the tenant enables auto-send.
5. Leave clash summary for approvers on each request.
6. Evidence reading: on certificate upload, the agent proposes type, issuer, reference, issue and expiry dates; the person confirms; `hr.qualifications.verify` stays human-only.
7. Agent descriptions for every HR action written for the agent, including which actions are human-only (sign, acknowledge, verify, approve leave, end engagement, offboard, revoke, override, purge).
8. Evaluations (<issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" />): at least 20 HR tasks (for example onboard 30 freelancers, find riggers for Saturday, book leave, explain why someone is ineligible) with expected action sequences and refusals.
9. Each proactive behaviour behind its own flag, default off.

## Acceptance criteria

* With a rigging competent person certificate expiring before a rostered Event, the expiry watch produces one review item linking the worker, the certificate and the roster slot.
* The agent never calls a human-only action in the evaluation set, and refuses with a clear message when asked to.
* Evidence reading on 10 sample certificates fills the right fields for at least 8, and every result waits for human confirmation.
* Sensitive fields never appear in agent context during the evaluation run (assertion from F13.2).
* The compliance dashboard counts match `hr.reports.compliance`.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; model calls only through the agent (<issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />), never from UI; no new dependency or model provider without Jonathan approving it on this issue; flags default off; ship to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the evaluation results linked here.

## Blockers

<issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />, <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" />, <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" />, <issue id="576185f3-f438-43c7-b694-e5afff0605e7" label="EVE-153" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-153/f134-build-onboarding-and-offboarding-runs" /> (F13.4), <issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" /> (F13.5), <issue id="d9da9830-5771-4e7c-85be-f3c99aed92e6" label="EVE-156" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-156/f136-build-right-to-work-and-background-check-records" /> (F13.6), <issue id="5ca54321-0f0a-461c-ade1-89cf3197dc48" label="EVE-179" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-179/f137-build-leave-policies-the-leave-ledger-requests-and-absence" /> (F13.7).

issues.title: F14.6 Agent-designed customisations and AI fields
issues.description:
## Goal

A user describes what they need in plain language and the agent drafts the fields, record types, views and automations as a change set they can review and publish; and organisations can add AI fields whose values the agent fills in under a budget.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`studio.propose`), 7 (agent behaviour) and 12 (the wristband acceptance case).
* The agent already has every Studio action as a tool (<issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />); this slice adds planning, explanation and safety so the result is reviewable, not a stream of tool calls.
* Odoo has AI fields (Odoo 19 documentation); here an AI field is a FieldDefinition of type AI whose value an automation agent step computes.

## Scope

1. `studio.propose`: input request plus scope (entity types the user is looking at, taken from the screen projection); output a draft change set with a rationale per item, reuse of existing fields where they fit (the agent must call `studio.describe` first), and the preview report. Never publishes.
2. Explain: `studio.describe` output rich enough for "why does this field exist, who added it, what uses it" (definitions, change set history, automations and views that reference it).
3. Debug: given an automation run id, the agent reads the run log and proposes a fix as a draft change set.
4. AI fields: type AI with prompt template over the record's fields, model selection through <issue id="5f3d064c-7dfa-45f3-b0a2-67d5ad9d3aca" label="EVE-53" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-53/p18b-build-model-engines-model-selection-and-user-owned-subscriptions" /> (the org's or user's engine; never a silent Eventiva-funded fallback), trigger (on change of named fields, or manual), per-field monthly budget, output schema (text, select, number), stored with `ai_generated` provenance and the prompt version.
5. Evaluation fixtures: ten plain-language requests with expected change set shapes, run through the <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> eval harness when it exists, otherwise as `@effect/vitest` tests with a recorded model.
6. Telemetry: proposal accepted, edited or discarded share; AI field cost per org.

## Acceptance criteria

* "Track wristband colour per ticket type and alert me when a type has none" yields a draft with one select field and one automation; nothing is live until a human publishes (test with a recorded model).
* When a suitable field already exists the proposal reuses it instead of adding a duplicate (fixture).
* An AI field "summary of crew notes" fills on change, stops at its budget with a visible state, and shows its provenance on the record.
* With no engine configured the AI field shows "not configured" and makes no call.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; Effect AI only (<issue id="07c58289-6f1c-488e-a130-5f718b473fce" label="EVE-14" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-14/s1-prove-one-effect-action-serves-ui-mcp-and-ai-sdk-from-one-inventory" /> decision); behind `f14-studio` and a sub-flag `f14-studio-ai-fields`; prompts and record contents are not sent to telemetry by default; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the fixture suite green and acceptance rates visible in PostHog.

issues.title: F6.12 Build the inventory agent behaviours: shortages, inspections due, reorders and overdue returns
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent watches stock for the user and brings ready-to-approve fixes (hire in, buy, schedule an inspection, chase a return) before a problem reaches an event.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> section 7. The agent loop and durable runs come from <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" /> and <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />; triggers come from change-feed events (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />): `inventory:shortage_detected`, `inventory:negative_stock`, `inventory:reservation_released`, `inventory:pick_completed`, plus a daily schedule.
* Suggestions are never silent writes: the agent drafts through the same actions and the approval rules in <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> section 7 apply. The agent can never release a failed safety inspection.

## Scope

1. Shortage responder: on `inventory:shortage_detected`, compute options (substitute in category, transfer between warehouses, sub-hire F6.9, purchase F6.8) ranked by cost then lead time, draft the best one, and post a suggestion to the event owner with one-tap approve.
2. Inspection planner: daily, list assets with inspections due before their next reservation's out date (F6.7) and propose maintenance jobs before each out date.
3. Reorder assistant: daily, run `purchasing.reorder.evaluate` and propose draft requests grouped by supplier.
4. Overdue returns: when return due has passed and assets are still at an event-site or vehicle location, draft discrepancies and a message to the crew lead (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />).
5. Prompted skills and descriptions for every F6 action so the agent can answer: "what am I short for Saturday", "where is case 0412", "which hoists are due this month", "reorder haze fluid", "hire in what we are missing".
6. Each suggestion records `inventory_agent_suggestion_accepted` or rejected for the success metric.

## Acceptance criteria

* A reservation that causes a shortage produces one suggestion within one change-feed cycle, with the draft prefilled; approving it sends the sub-hire or order; rejecting it writes nothing.
* The planner proposes an inspection for a hoist due 3 days before its next out date and none for assets not reserved.
* The five example requests above each complete in an eval (<issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> when available, otherwise `@effect/vitest` scripted turns) using only inventory actions, stopping at every approval.
* A user without purchasing permission never receives a purchase suggestion.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no zod; flag `f6-inventory` plus per-behaviour flags off by default; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; people and agent docs updated; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main with the five example requests passing and their transcripts linked here.

issues.title: F10.6 Bill of quantities and exports
issues.description:
## Goal

The plan produces the shopping list (counts, metres, areas per symbol) for hire, picking and costing, and prints or exports at a true scale that crew and authorities can rely on.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> sections 4 and 12. Quantities feed F6 (inventory reservations) and, through F6, F11 costs; F10 never writes F6 tables directly.
* Market check: OnePlan exports a bill of quantities to CSV or Excel and prints to A0; this is the parity bar.

## Scope

1. `sitemap.quantities.compute`: rows of symbol, category, count, total length, total area, linked F6 inventory item type, per layer and in total; result stored as a quantities snapshot.
2. `sitemap.quantities.sendToInventory` (approval: confirm): calls the F6 reservation action registered through the link registry, with the snapshot id for traceability.
3. `sitemap.export` as a durable job (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />): PDF and PNG at A4 to A0, portrait or landscape, at a chosen scale (1:200 to 1:5000) or fit-to-page, with title block (site, event, phase, revision, date, issuer), scale bar, north arrow, legend, grid reference, data attribution and the capacity note; CSV of quantities; GeoJSON of chosen layers in WGS84.
4. `PrintRenderer` port: server-side render of the same style spec the client uses, so prints match the screen. MapLibre renders raster, so A0 at 300 dpi (about 14,000 by 9,900 px, above common GPU texture limits) is rendered in tiles and stitched into the PDF; title block, scale bar and legend are vector PDF elements.
5. Exported files stored through <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> and attached to the map or revision.

## Acceptance criteria

* Quantities for a fixture map match a hand count, including fence panels from line lengths.
* A0 PDF at 1:1000: a 100 m reference line measures 100 mm on the printed page (checked in the PDF geometry) and attribution is present.
* GeoJSON round-trips into a standard GIS viewer within 0.1 m of the source positions.
* Sending quantities to F6 creates exactly one reservation request per snapshot (idempotent on retry).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; renderer library needs approval here before use; no new dependency without approval; ships to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with fixture exports attached here.

## Blockers

<issue id="ee3d76af-a2d7-404a-a74e-457d6a355df1" label="EVE-180" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-180/f104-symbol-library-and-linked-placements" /> (symbols), <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> (files), <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" /> (durable jobs).

issues.title: F10.7 Revisions, approvals and share links
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser issues a numbered, frozen revision of the plan, sends it to safety advisers and authorities through a secure expiring link, and collects their comments and approval on the record.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> sections 4, 5, 9 and 11. Comments from <issue id="b7f17f15-c893-46e9-9b3b-2aefae473802" label="EVE-27" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-27/port-comments-mentions-and-review-suggestions-on-any-resource" />, notifications from <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, external identities and audit from <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />.
* A revision freezes every layer document and record mirror of a map together.

## Scope

1. Tables `sitemap_revision`, `sitemap_approval`, `sitemap_share_link`.
2. `sitemap.revision.issue` (approval: always): snapshot of all layer documents (Yjs state vectors and encoded state) and mirror rows, numbered per map, with purpose (for comment, for approval, for construction, for event) and notes; generates the default PDF export (F10.6).
3. `sitemap.revision.approve` and `.reject` by account users with the permission or by share-link reviewers allowed to approve; append-only.
4. `sitemap.share.create` (approval: always) and `.revoke`: token stored as a hash, expiry required (default 30 days, maximum from settings), optional password, chosen layers, can comment, can approve. Share viewers get a read-only map, never the live editable documents.
5. Compare two revisions: features added, moved (with distance), removed, per layer.
6. Notifications to the issuer on comment, approval and rejection.

## Acceptance criteria

* An issued revision does not change when the live map is edited afterwards.
* A share link shows only its layers, stops working at expiry and immediately on revoke, and the password is checked server-side with rate limiting.
* An approval through a share link records the reviewer's entered name and email, the link id and time in the audit log.
* Compare lists a moved stage with the distance moved.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no new dependency without approval here; no viewer identity in PostHog events for share links; ships to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green and a recorded walkthrough of issue, share, comment, approve.

## Blockers

<issue id="82fab111-6d01-4616-85c7-1e4ff88ca469" label="EVE-152" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record" />, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, <issue id="b7f17f15-c893-46e9-9b3b-2aefae473802" label="EVE-27" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-27/port-comments-mentions-and-review-suggestions-on-any-resource" />, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.

issues.title: F1.6 Build production plans: a collaborative canvas per space and department over the site map, with MVR exchange
issues.description:
## Goal

Each department draws its plan of a space (where fixtures, truss, speakers, risers, screens and cable runs go) on top of the site map, together with others and the agent, and exchanges it with CAD and previsualisation tools.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-73](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show>) sections 4, 5 (ProductionPlan, DesignElement), 6 (Plan canvas), 8 (`SceneExchange`), decision D4 (GDTF and MVR).
* The base layer is F10's SiteMap (<issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" />), referenced by its UUIDv7 map id; `Space.site_map_zone_ref` stores an F10 Zone feature id. Positions use the F10 site-local frame: origin at the site anchor, x east and y north in metres, with WGS84 conversion from F10's shared contracts (<issue id="9b8adbfb-05a9-4f10-9c60-baa5bfcfd4fa" label="EVE-146" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-146/f101-sites-levels-base-layers-and-calibration" />). F1 owns DesignElements and registers them as an `external` layer source through `sitemap.layerSource.register` (<issue id="82fab111-6d01-4616-85c7-1e4ff88ca469" label="EVE-152" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record" />) so F10 renders them read only.
* Canvas data is a Yjs document per plan ([EVE-51](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and>)). DesignElement rows are the queryable record of what is drawn; the canvas holds geometry and annotations; the two are kept in step by one service, never written separately.

## Scope

1. Tables `production_plan` (event_id, space_id, layer kind: lighting, rigging, sound, staging, video, power, general; base map ref; canvas doc id) and `design_element` (kind, fixture_type_id, catalogue_ref to F6, position x y z in metres, rotation, unit number, weight_kg, power_w, department_id).
2. A `PlanService` that applies element actions to both the row and the canvas in one Effect, and rebuilds rows from the canvas on load if they diverge.
3. Actions: `plan.create`, `plan.update`, `element.place`, `element.update`, `element.remove`, `plan.importMvr`, `plan.exportMvr`.
4. `SceneExchange` port: MVR import creates elements and fixture types; MVR export writes positions, fixture types and patch (from F1.7). Parsing and writing MVR (zip plus XML) needs a dependency approved by Jonathan on this issue first; propose the smallest maintained zip and XML libraries with licence and size.
5. Layers from all departments can be shown together read only; edit only your department's layer unless you are production manager or above.
6. Screen: Plan canvas (map base, element palette from fixture types and F6 catalogue, inspector, layer toggles, warnings) with projection listing visible elements and selection, and every tool bound to an action.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two people and the agent place elements on the same plan, one offline; after sync the canvas and the rows agree and nothing is lost.
* The agent places "12 spots evenly along the front truss" through `element.place` and the projection shows them selected.
* An MVR file exported from a CAD tool imports with correct positions within 1 cm; exporting and re-importing is lossless for the fields above.
* A sound head cannot move a lighting element.
* Screen passes the unbound-control check and axe for the non-canvas controls; canvas tools are keyboard reachable.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; every operation is an inventory action with one permission check, audit and change record with undo; UI from Rambo-UI, WCAG 2.2 AA; behind PostHog flag `f1-production-plans`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; whitelabel ASCII copy; people docs and ai-docs in the same commit; ships to main with `node --run check` results here.

## Done signal

Merged with the convergence and MVR round-trip tests green and the sample MVR file committed as a fixture.

## Blockers

F1.1 (<issue id="43e4e4e4-42e9-4d64-8201-aa65787fe66c" label="EVE-166" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-166/f11-build-the-event-record-event-eventseries-phase-space-team-and" />), F10 site map ids (F10 thread), <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />.

issues.title: F10.8 Offline map packs and the crew map
issues.description:
## Goal

Crew on a muddy field with no signal open the map for their role, find their post and the nearest facility, and keep working; everything syncs when signal returns.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> sections 5 (OfflinePack), 6 (Crew map) and 12. Engine offline regions proven in <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" />. Search from <issue id="2cd1c920-450c-487e-b4c8-e860a382a6b0" label="EVE-26" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-26/port-search-and-embeddings-across-every-resource" />; posts from F2.

## Scope

1. `sitemap.offline.preparePack`: manifest for a map covering site bbox plus a margin, zoom range (default 14 to 20; the OpenStreetMap basemap extract stops at zoom 15 and is overzoomed above it), a per-site basemap PMTiles extract, imagery only where the licence allows (D-F10-6; by default imagery is online only and drone or survey orthophotos uploaded by the tenant stand in offline), calibrated base layers, the layer documents in the user's audience, symbols and the search index slice; size estimate before download.
2. Automatic pack download for rostered crew 48 hours before their first shift (setting), on Wi-Fi only by default.
3. Crew map screen (phone first): my layers, my post from F2, "near me" facilities by category, search by label or symbol; offline banner with pack age.
4. `sitemap.find` works offline against the local index and online against <issue id="2cd1c920-450c-487e-b4c8-e860a382a6b0" label="EVE-26" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-26/port-search-and-embeddings-across-every-resource" />.
5. Pack updates: when a new revision or layer change lands, download the delta (Yjs updates and changed tiles only).
6. Storage limits: warn above 500 MB, let the user remove packs.

## Acceptance criteria

* On Android in airplane mode after a cold restart: the map, layers and search work from the pack.
* An edit made offline syncs on reconnect and converges (<issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> path).
* A role change that removes a layer removes it from the pack on next sync.
* A delta update after a small edit downloads under 50 KB.

## Constraints

WCAG 2.2 AA; Effect-TS v3; tile licences as recorded in <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" />; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with an airplane-mode recording on a real Android device attached here.

## Blockers

<issue id="c2c22f6e-0703-449c-a01d-0a6552d1d9fc" label="EVE-178" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-178/f103-map-editor-screen-with-screen-awareness" /> (editor and engine wrapper), <issue id="2cd1c920-450c-487e-b4c8-e860a382a6b0" label="EVE-26" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-26/port-search-and-embeddings-across-every-resource" /> (search).

issues.title: F1.7 Build lighting: GDTF fixture library, fixture modes and DMX patch with conflict checks
issues.description:
## Goal

A lighting head imports the fixtures they use, places them on the plan, and gets a correct DMX patch (universe and address per fixture) with overlaps caught before anything reaches a console.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> sections 4, 5 (FixtureType, PatchEntry), 6 (Patch screen), 8 (`FixtureLibrary`), decision D4.
* GDTF (General Device Type Format, DIN SPEC 15800) is an open zip plus XML format describing a fixture's modes and channels. Users import files they have; an online lookup on the public GDTF share is a later adapter and needs its own approval.
* Uses DesignElement from F1.6.

## Scope

1. Table `fixture_type` (org-wide: manufacturer, model, modes with channel count and footprint, weight_kg, power_w, source file ref) and `patch_entry` (element_id, mode, universe 1 to 63999, address 1 to 512).
2. `FixtureLibrary` port with a GDTF file adapter that reads manufacturer, model, modes, channel counts, weight and power. Shares the zip and XML dependency approved on F1.6; if F1.6 is not approved yet, request it here.
3. Actions: `fixtureType.import`, `fixtureType.list`, `patch.assign`, `patch.autoPatch` (fills the next free addresses per universe in unit number order, respecting a start address and per-universe gaps), `patch.check` (overlaps, address beyond 512, unpatched fixtures, mode changes that broke a footprint).
4. Pure patch functions (footprint, overlap, auto patch) in plain TypeScript with exhaustive unit tests.
5. CSV patch export through the `ConsoleExport` port from F1.5; export refuses while `patch.check` reports a conflict.
6. Agent: proactively flags conflicts and offers an auto patch, applied only on confirmation.
7. Screen: Patch (grid per universe showing occupied ranges, conflict list, assign and auto patch) with projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* Importing three real GDTF files from the public share creates fixture types with correct mode channel counts (fixtures committed as test fixtures with their licence noted).
* Auto patch of 24 units in a 16 channel mode from 1/1 gives 1/1, 1/17, ... with no overlap and stops at 1/497 before wrapping to universe 2.
* Two offline patches to the same address both sync and `patch.check` reports the overlap; CSV export fails until resolved.
* Changing a fixture's mode to a larger footprint flags the new overlap.
* Screen passes the unbound-control check and axe.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules (patch maths is pure TypeScript); every operation is an inventory action with one permission check, audit and change record; UI from Rambo-UI, WCAG 2.2 AA; behind PostHog flag `f1-production-plans`; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; imported GDTF files keep their source attribution; whitelabel ASCII copy; people docs and ai-docs in the same commit; ships to main with `node --run check` results here.

## Done signal

Merged with GDTF import, auto patch and conflict tests green.

issues.title: F14.7 Site and page model with the block registry
issues.description:
## Goal

Sites, pages and their content exist as records and collaborative documents that people and the agent edit through the same block-level actions, with every block type defined once in Rambo-UI with a typed property schema.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`sites.*`, `pages.*`, `pages.blocks.*`, `sites.menus.update`), 5 (Site, Page, block tree, BlockType) and decisions D2 (one block registry for editor, app preview and public site) and D6 (build in Rambo-UI; Puck's JSON data model as a reference only).
* <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />: page content is a Yjs doc embedded in the Page record; the record holds metadata and permissions.
* <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" />: federated modules may register extra block types through the module manifest.
* Upstream reference at 6b5cf68: `brand-kit/`, `creative-context` package (Later rows tagged R-WEB) for behaviour only.

## Scope

1. Tables and schemas: Site (kind event, organisation, venue, vendor; subdomain unique across the platform; locales; brandKitId), Page (path unique per site and locale, parent, seo, binding), Menu.
2. Block tree inside the page doc: node id, blockType, props, children, bindings. A `BlockRegistry` service maps blockType to its Effect Schema for props, allowed children, editor hints (icon, category, which props are inline-editable) and a renderer.
3. A Rambo-UI `site-blocks` package (in Resnovas/Rambo-UI, no Eventiva dependency) with the static blocks: section, columns, heading, rich text, image, gallery, video embed, button, spacer, divider, accordion, tabs, card grid, hero, quote, map embed placeholder, custom embed (sandboxed iframe with an allow list). Data-bound blocks come in F14.9.
4. Actions `sites.create/update/archive/get/list`, `pages.create/update/move/duplicate/delete`, `pages.blocks.insert/update/move/remove`; block actions validate props against the registry and apply a Yjs update, so a block edit by the agent and a drag by a person are the same operation with undo (change record).
5. Migration of block props: each block schema is versioned; a stored node with an older version is upgraded by a pure migration on read.
6. Permissions `sites:read/edit/manage` via <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />; vendor and venue profile sites (F5) restrict editing to unlocked blocks.
7. Offline: sites, pages and menus sync; page docs merge by CRDT; path collisions detected at publish (F14.10), not at edit.

## Acceptance criteria

* Two clients and the agent insert, move and edit blocks on one page concurrently, one offline, and converge (test reusing the <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> harness).
* Inserting a block with invalid props fails with `BlockPropsInvalid` on UI, HTTP and MCP.
* A federated test module registers a block type on activation and removes it on disposal; pages using it show a placeholder while it is unavailable.
* Rambo-UI `site-blocks` has no import of any Eventiva package (lint).

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; no zod; WCAG 2.2 AA for every block (each block ships an axe test); behind `f14-sites`; no new dependency without approval here; Eventiva part ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here; the Rambo-UI part follows that repository's own pull request rules.

## Done signal

Merged in both repositories with the convergence test green and the block registry API documented in ai-docs.

issues.title: F10.9 Crew positions layer and as-built reporting
issues.description:
## Goal

On the day, managers see where crew are on the site map, and crew correct the map to where things were actually built, without the system ever pretending a stale position is current.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> sections 4, 5, 11 and decision D-F10-4.
* Single location collector (agreed with F7 on 2026-11-01): F7.10 (<issue id="81e5a26e-791e-4891-bb97-c481901f11d7" label="EVE-181" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-181/f710-build-live-unit-positions-on-the-event-map-with-consent-and" />) `ops.position.report` is the only place Eventiva collects device location, with one consent path, one in-app indicator and 30-day retention. F10 does not collect positions itself. F7 widens the collector's scope from people on active units to all rostered crew who opt in, so stewards on foot are covered.
* F10 shows positions through the layer source registry from F10.2 (<issue id="82fab111-6d01-4616-85c7-1e4ff88ca469" label="EVE-152" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-152/f102-site-maps-and-layers-as-yjs-documents-with-a-feature-record" />): F7 registers the unit layer; this issue adds a crew layer that reads the same stream filtered to the crew roles the viewer may see.
* Dispatch and incidents are F7 (<issue id="acc43644-11f0-4a63-b850-f1099ce4626c" label="EVE-147" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-147/f77-build-the-incident-control-log-and-dispatch-for-live-events" />).

## Scope

1. A `live` layer source "Crew" registered by F10 that reads F7's position stream for rostered crew of the map's event (F2 roster), filtered to positions whose source is `crew` (F7 tags each position `unit` or `crew`; collection covers crew on a current F2 Shift of a live event who opted in, per event, off by default), with staleness from the F7 rule (2 minutes) and age shown in text, never only by colour.
2. Live map screen: crew and unit layers together, filters by department, tap a person to see their post (F2) and last update age.
3. `sitemap.live.reportLocation`: crew mark where a feature actually is (as-built); stored on the feature mirror with audit; the planned geometry stays until a manager accepts the move (`sitemap.feature.move` with the as-built position).
4. Viewer rules: department leads see their team, production managers see all, crew see others only if the event setting allows.

## Acceptance criteria

* A crew position reported through F7 appears on the F10 live map within 5 s and shows stale with its age after 2 minutes.
* A viewer without permission for a department sees no positions from it (negative test).
* As-built reports are listed for a manager and accepting one moves the feature with an audit entry.
* With `f10-live-positions` off, the crew layer is not registered.

## Constraints

No second location collector; no positions in telemetry or agent memory; Effect-TS v3; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with tests green and a two-phone field test recorded here.

## Blockers

<issue id="81e5a26e-791e-4891-bb97-c481901f11d7" label="EVE-181" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-181/f710-build-live-unit-positions-on-the-event-map-with-consent-and" /> (F7 position collector, widened to rostered crew), <issue id="c2c22f6e-0703-449c-a01d-0a6552d1d9fc" label="EVE-178" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-178/f103-map-editor-screen-with-screen-awareness" />, <issue id="0ab161c4-ed9c-4581-86fe-91fa1f4216aa" label="EVE-46" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-46/p17-build-the-http-api-streaming-and-the-typed-client-from-the-action" />, <issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />.

issues.title: F1.8 Build rigging: points, loads, indicative load summary and competent-person sign-off
issues.description:
## Goal

A rigger sees every hanging point, what hangs on it and whether it is within its rated load, and a named competent person signs the plan off; any later change voids the sign-off.

## Context

* Parent: [EVE-73](<https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show>) sections 4, 5 (RiggingPoint, LoadAssignment, RiggingSignOff), 7 (human-only sign-off), 11 (LOLER, PUWER, BS 7906, ANSI E1.6), decision D5.
* Eventiva shows indicative sums only and never certifies. The competent-person qualification comes from F13 once it exists (agreed with the F13 thread); until then it is an org-level grant `f1:rigging:certify` given to named people. Once F13 ships, `rigging.signOff` also calls F13's `hr.qualifications.holds` (<issue id="9f305527-7de1-436f-89bd-27341f70624e" label="EVE-154" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-154/f135-build-qualifications-requirements-and-the-eligibility-check" />) with the signer's F4 party ref, type key `rigging-competent-person` and the signing date, and refuses unless `holds` is true; the returned qualificationId is stored on the sign-off.

## Scope

1. Tables `rigging_point` (plan_id, label, position, rated working load limit in kg, structure ref), `load_assignment` (point, element or manual load, weight_kg, dynamic factor default 1.0), `rigging_sign_off` (plan_id, load summary hash, signed_by, statement text, signed_at, void flag).
2. Pure load summary function: per point total static and factored load, utilisation percent, overloads; summary hash over all points and loads. Element weights default from FixtureType or F6 catalogue and can be overridden.
3. Actions: `rigging.addPoint`, `rigging.updatePoint`, `rigging.assignLoad`, `rigging.removeLoad`, `rigging.summarise`, `rigging.signOff`. `rigging.signOff` has approval `always`, the actor must be a person (agents refused with a typed error) holding `f1:rigging:certify`, and the statement text is shown and stored verbatim.
4. Void rule: any change to points or loads after a sign-off marks it void on the device that sees the hash mismatch, and the void syncs. A voided sign-off is kept for audit.
5. Exports: a load schedule PDF and CSV that state the figures are indicative and that a competent person must verify them.
6. Agent: summarises, flags overloads and voided sign-offs, drafts the statement; cannot sign.
7. Screen: Rigging (points table, load bar per point coloured and labelled by utilisation so colour is never the only signal, sign-off panel) with projection and bound controls.

## Acceptance criteria

* Load summary tests: single point, shared truss loads entered as manual loads per point, dynamic factor, overload at 101 percent.
* The agent calling `rigging.signOff` fails with a typed error and an audit entry.
* A person without `f1:rigging:certify` cannot sign; a person with it can, and the sign-off records the hash.
* Changing one load offline voids the sign-off after sync on both devices.
* Exports carry the indicative-figures statement.
* Screen passes the unbound-control check and axe.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules (load maths is pure TypeScript); every operation is an inventory action with one permission check, audit and change record; UI from Rambo-UI, WCAG 2.2 AA; behind PostHog flag `f1-production-plans`; no structural engineering beyond point sums; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; whitelabel ASCII copy; people docs and ai-docs in the same commit; ships to main with `node --run check` results here.

## Done signal

Merged with the load, permission and void tests green.

## Blockers

F1.1 (<issue id="43e4e4e4-42e9-4d64-8201-aa65787fe66c" label="EVE-166" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-166/f11-build-the-event-record-event-eventseries-phase-space-team-and" />), F1.6, <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" />, F13 qualification lookup (later, grant used until then).
