issues.title: F8.10 Add wallet passes for tickets behind a neutral port
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only. Needs vendor accounts and Jonathan's approval before work starts (decision D5).

## Goal

A holder can add a ticket to the phone's wallet, the pass shows the same signed code, and it updates or disappears when the ticket changes or is voided.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> sections 8 and decision D5 (wallet passes after in-app, email and PDF).
* Apple Wallet needs an Apple developer pass type certificate; Google Wallet needs an issuer account. Both are vendor sign-ups this issue must not make; Jonathan approves them here first.

## Scope

1. `WalletPass` Effect service (neutral port) in core-facing contracts: create, update, revoke a pass for a ticket.
2. Two integration packages, one per wallet vendor, each wrapping the vendor API at an Effect boundary; credentials from the secrets service (<issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />).
3. Pass content: event name, admission scope, date, holder name, signed code as the barcode; update on holder change, transfer and void (void shows as expired).
4. "Add to wallet" control on My tickets and in delivery email, bound to ticketing.ticket.deliver with channel wallet.

## Acceptance criteria

* Switching wallet vendor changes composition only (test with a fake implementation of the port).
* A pass created for a fixture ticket scans at an F8.5 scanner.
* Voiding the ticket updates the pass within 5 minutes in vendor sandbox tests.
* No vendor names in customer-facing copy beyond the platform-required button artwork.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; vendor SDKs or libraries only with Jonathan's approval here; behind flags `ticketing` and `ticketing-wallet`; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

## Blockers

issues.title: F1.10 Build staging and screens: staging elements, screen surfaces and pre-programmed screen content per segment and cue
issues.description:
## Goal

The staging and video teams plan risers, set pieces and screens, and pre-program what each screen shows in every segment and on every cue, so content is ready and checked before the show.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> sections 4, 5 (ScreenSurface, ScreenContent), 6, 13 (no media server replacement).
* Staging elements and screens are DesignElements on the plan (F1.6) with kinds `riser`, `set`, `screen`. Media files come through <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />. Playback of content live is a cue that F1.13 sends to a media server; Eventiva does not play video itself.

## Scope

1. Tables `screen_surface` (element_id, pixel width and height, aspect, input name, processor notes) and `screen_content` (surface_id, segment_id or cue_id, media ref, playback notes such as loop, hold, fade).
2. Actions: `screen.addSurface`, `screen.updateSurface`, `screen.assignContent`, `screen.removeContent`, `screen.checkContent`.
3. `screen.checkContent`: flags media whose resolution or aspect does not match its surface, segments with no content on a surface that should have some, and missing files.
4. A content grid view: segments down, surfaces across, each cell the assigned media thumbnail, readable offline once files are cached.
5. Agent: assigns content from a brief ("holding slide on both side screens between panels"), runs the check, never deletes media.
6. Screen: Screens (surface list, content grid, check results) with projection and bound controls; staging uses the plan canvas.

## Acceptance criteria

* A 1920 by 1080 file on a 3840 by 1080 surface is flagged as an aspect mismatch.
* The content grid works offline after files are cached on the device.
* Assigning content to a cue makes it available to F1.13 as the cue's target payload.
* Screen passes the unbound-control check and axe.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; every operation is an inventory action with one permission check, audit and change record; UI from Rambo-UI, WCAG 2.2 AA; behind PostHog flag `f1-production-plans`; reading image dimensions uses what <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> provides, no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; whitelabel ASCII copy; people docs and ai-docs in the same commit; ships to main with `node --run check` results here.

## Done signal

Merged with check, offline grid and cue link tests green.

issues.title: F8.11 Build the seat map editor and reserved seating in F8
issues.description:
Status: Approved (2026-11-08). Jonathan chose decision D3 (b): F8 builds its own seat map editor now instead of waiting for F10 site maps.

## Goal

An organiser draws a seating plan for a Space in F8 (sections, rows, seats, tables, standing areas, accessible spaces), sells specific seats, and buyers pick seats from the same plan, with no seat sold twice.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> sections 5 and 15 (D3 b). F1 Space (<issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" />) is where the plan applies; F5 Venue may hold reusable plans later.
* F10 owns site maps. The F8 editor may show an F10 map of the Space as a read-only backdrop when one exists, but does not depend on F10 being built.
* The plan is a collaborative document (Yjs per <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />), so several people and the agent can edit it together, offline and online.

## Scope

1. SeatPlan document: Space ref, sections, rows (straight, curved), seats (label, row, number, accessibility tags, price zone), tables with seats, general-admission areas with capacity, aisles and labels. Versioned; a plan in use is locked to a published version.
2. Editor screen: add a section, generate rows and seats in bulk (count, spacing, curve, numbering scheme), select and edit many seats, assign price zones to ticket types, mark accessible and companion seats, mark seats held or killed (sight-line, production). Every control bound to an action; projection lists the selection, the section and counts.
3. Actions: ticketing.seatPlan.create, update (patch ops), publish, duplicate; ticketing.seatPlan.generateRows; ticketing.seatPlan.assignZone; ticketing.seatPlan.setSeatState (held, killed, open). Agent approval: confirm for publish and killing seats on sale.
4. Seat inventory from the published plan into the F8.2 pool entity (per-seat state next to the counter); best-available and pick-your-seat modes; editing a published plan cannot remove or move a sold seat (typed error).
5. [Ticket.seat](<http://Ticket.seat>) ref set on issue; seat shown on ticket, pass and scanner.
6. Buyer seat picker (read-only render of the plan with seat states) on the public ticket picker and box office.

## Acceptance criteria

* An organiser builds a 2,000-seat plan with 4 sections in under 10 minutes using bulk row generation (timed usability test).
* The agent, asked "add 10 rows of 20 seats behind section A, last row wheelchair spaces", produces the change and asks before publishing.
* Two buyers picking the same seat at once: one succeeds, the other gets SeatTaken.
* Removing a sold seat from the published plan fails with SeatSold.
* Two editors and the agent editing the plan concurrently, one offline, converge after reconnect.
* A 5,000-seat plan renders and is pickable on a mid-range Android device in under 2 seconds; editor and picker meet WCAG 2.2 AA, including a list view of seats for screen readers.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Rambo-UI components; rendering through F10's MapEngine port only (MapLibre, approved via D-F10-1 in <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" />); no other canvas or rendering library; behind flags `ticketing` and `ticketing-seating`; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, tests green, recording of building a plan, a seated sale and a scan attached here.

## Blockers

Rendering engine: use F10's MapEngine port (MapLibre, decided by Jonathan 2026-11-08 as D-F10-1 in <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" />, tested by spike <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" />; fallback a custom Skia canvas), drawing in F10's site-local frame (metres, x east, y north from the site origin) so a plan sits on an F10 backdrop. Blocked on <issue id="75206124-f123-452e-baa0-2c8ec3d42e59" label="EVE-120" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-120/f100-spike-map-engine-with-offline-tiles-and-yjs-bound-editing-on-expo" />.

F8.1 (<issue id="befba1e2-7fb2-4ab8-a9fa-a0efcf2ebfae" label="EVE-112" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-112/f81-build-the-ticket-catalogue-ticket-types-capacity-pools-sales" />), F8.2 (<issue id="eed7c2f7-0dc7-43cb-8b86-6324a06e36d5" label="EVE-114" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-114/f82-build-the-capacity-engine-oversell-proof-holds-on-a-cluster-entity" />), <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" />, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />.

issues.title: F8.12 Build ticketing agent behaviour: watchers, gate briefing and approval rules
issues.description:
Status: Proposed (2026-11-01). Planning only.

## Goal

The agent acts as a ticketing assistant across every surface: it drafts setups, watches sales and doors, raises the right alerts and never takes a risky step without the user's approval.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="8bd88b8d-9173-4f07-a92d-1c317836f4b2" label="EVE-76" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-76/f8-ticketing-ticket-types-capacity-issuance-admissions-and-scanning" /> section 7. Actions already exist from F8.1 to F8.9; this slice adds the agent-specific parts: watchers, the gate briefing and end-to-end approval tests.
* Agent loop, durable runs and threads: <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />, <issue id="24dd67f5-9a1f-48cf-960a-655247885ff0" label="EVE-55" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-55/p18d-build-chat-threads-and-message-projections" />.

## Scope

1. Ticketing skill text for the agent (what each action is for, typical sequences, approval rules) generated from inventory descriptions plus a short hand-written guide.
2. Watchers as durable scheduled runs per Event: capacity at 80 and 95 percent, pace behind target, holds blocking sales, missing attendee details 48 hours before doors, devices unsynced over 10 minutes during doors, duplicate-entry and void-admit alerts. Each posts a suggestion in the organiser's agent thread with one-tap actions, never acting alone.
3. ticketing.gateBriefing.generate: a document for an admission scope with lists, gates (F1 Space), expected arrivals by hour, re-entry rules, rostered gate crew (F2) and escalation contacts.
4. End-to-end approval tests across UI, MCP and ACP for every action marked confirm or always.

## Acceptance criteria

* Scripted-model test: "set up tickets for the festival, 3 days, 2,000 per day, early bird until March" produces draft types and pools per day Phase and asks before publishing.
* Each watcher fires once per threshold crossing (no repeats on restart) in a durable-run test with a runner restart.
* Every confirm or always action is refused without approval when called by an agent through MCP and ACP.
* The gate briefing for a fixture event matches the check-in lists and roster.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Effect AI only (<issue id="07c58289-6f1c-488e-a130-5f718b473fce" label="EVE-14" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-14/s1-prove-one-effect-action-serves-ui-mcp-and-ai-sdk-from-one-inventory" /> decision); no personal data in prompts sent to providers beyond what the user can see and the task needs; behind flag `ticketing`; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged, tests green, a recorded agent session running the festival scenario attached here.

## Blockers

<issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />, <issue id="24dd67f5-9a1f-48cf-960a-655247885ff0" label="EVE-55" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-55/p18d-build-chat-threads-and-message-projections" />, F8.9 (<issue id="325c1b43-063c-49a1-a818-f8be8db0cd91" label="EVE-195" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-195/f89-build-ticketing-reports-the-sales-dashboard-and-attendee-exports" />); F2 rosters for the briefing.

issues.title: F9.6 Build card readers, offline card payments and POS peripherals
issues.description:
## Goal

A register takes card-present payments on supported readers, including store-and-forward offline payments within the organiser's limits, and prints receipts and opens a cash drawer, on phone, tablet, desktop and web.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 3, 8 and decision D3. Market check (2026-11-01, provider docs): offline store-and-forward is supported on Bluetooth readers and smart readers through the iOS, Android and React Native SDKs; Tap to Pay on Android has no offline mode; Tap to Pay on iPhone offline is in private preview; EEA offline payments need chip and PIN. Competitors set per-device daily and per-order limits and advise reconnecting within 24 hours.
* The native SDK needs an Expo development build, not Expo Go (<issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" /> records the build model).

## Scope

1. First step, before code: verify against current provider docs which reader types each Eventiva platform (iOS, Android, web, desktop) can drive online and offline, and whether desktop and web can drive smart readers over the internet. Record the matrix here. Code only what the matrix supports.
2. `CardTerminal` Effect service in the payments integration package: discoverReaders, connect, disconnect, collectPayment, cancel, offline status, forwarding events. Fake terminal Layer for tests.
3. Actions: [sales.reader.discover](<http://sales.reader.discover>), connect, disconnect; payment method `card present` in sales.payment.create.
4. Offline: enforce per-device daily and per-order limits from the channel before collecting; store-and-forward handled by the provider SDK; Eventiva records the payment as `offline stored`, then `offline forwarded` or `declined after forward` from SDK events and webhooks; a decline creates an agent suggestion and an organiser task to contact the customer.
5. Onboarding notice and setting acknowledgement that the tenant bears offline declines (D3).
6. Peripherals: `ReceiptPrinter` (ESC/POS over network and Bluetooth), `CashDrawer` (via printer kick), barcode scanner as keyboard input; sales.receipt.print.
7. Reader state, offline queue and limit headroom in the register projection.

## Acceptance criteria

* Platform and reader matrix recorded here with doc links and dates before implementation.
* Fake terminal tests: online payment, offline payment within limits, offline payment over limit rejected, forwarded success, forwarded decline creating a task.
* Real reader test (once D2 and the dependency are approved) on one Bluetooth reader with an Android development build, online and in airplane mode, recorded here.
* Receipt printed on one ESC/POS printer; drawer opens on cash sale.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; vendor SDK only in the integration package with `// effect-boundary:` comments; the `f9-pos-offline-card` flag defaults off; no card data in Eventiva; no new dependency, hardware purchase or vendor account without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; matrix, reader and printer evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

F9.5, F9.3; <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" /> build model, <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" /> secrets; decisions D2 and D3.

issues.title: F9.7 Build fulfilment for shipping, collection, on-site hand over and digital items
issues.description:
## Goal

Every paid order line reaches the customer by the method it was sold with (ship, click and collect, collect at the event, digital delivery), and staff can see and work the queue, including offline hand over at an event.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4, 5 and 6. Stock commit happens in F9.2 through F6 (<issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" />); this slice moves goods to the customer, not stock levels.
* Tickets are fulfilled by F8 (ticketing.ticket.issueForOrder), not here.

## Scope

1. Fulfilment methods per channel and product: ship (address, manual tracking number), click and collect (pickup location), collect at event (F1 Event plus Space, with a pickup code), digital (file from <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> or a link, delivered by email), none (fees, donations).
2. Fulfilment state machine: pending, packed, shipped or ready for collection, handed over or delivered, returned.
3. Actions: sales.fulfilment.create, pack, ship, handOver (by pickup code or order search), deliverDigital.
4. `ShippingCarrier` port defined (rates, labels, tracking) with a manual adapter only; no carrier vendor in this slice.
5. Fulfilment queue screen (board by status, scan input for pickup codes) and fulfilment section in Order detail.
6. Offline hand over at an event: pickup codes and pending orders for that event cached on the device; hand over recorded offline and synced append-only; a code used twice offline is flagged on sync.
7. Customer emails for shipped, ready for collection and digital delivery through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />.

## Acceptance criteria

* One order with a shipped line, a collect-at-event line and a digital line moves each line through its states; customer emails sent with the fake notifier.
* Offline hand over of 20 pickup codes syncs once each; a duplicate scan on two devices is flagged, not silently accepted twice.
* Digital link is private to the customer and expires per setting.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Rambo-UI components; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no carrier vendor or new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; test evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

F9.2; <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> notifications, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> files; <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> for offline hand over.

issues.title: F9.8 Build refunds, cancellations, exchanges and disputes
issues.description:
## Goal

Staff, customers and the agent can request a full or partial refund, cancellation or exchange; a person with the right role approves it; money goes back through the original payment method, stock and tickets are released, and accounting is told.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4, 7 and 11. Agent approval policy: refunds and voids are `always` for agents, `confirm` for people with sales:refund:approve.
* Releases go through each line provider (F8 ticketing.ticket.void, F6 inventory.reservation.release with restock).

## Scope

1. Refund state machine: requested, approved, rejected, processing, completed, failed.
2. Actions: sales.refund.request (lines, quantities or amount, reason, restock flag), approve, reject; sales.order.cancel for unpaid or unfulfilled orders; exchange as refund plus new order linked by `exchangeOf`.
3. Refund to the original method: card online and card present through the PaymentGateway, cash from the register session (CashMovement out), gift card re-credit (F9.9), on-account orders handed to F11 as a credit note request.
4. Per-product refund policy (days allowed, exempt) shown at checkout (F9.4) and enforced at request time with an override that needs approval.
5. Disputes: chargeback webhooks create a Dispute record (opened, evidence due, won, lost) with evidence fields; no automatic evidence submission in this slice.
6. Line provider release on refund; partial refunds release only affected lines.
7. Events sales:refund_completed and sales:dispute_updated on the change feed for F11.
8. Customer self-service refund request on their order page.

## Acceptance criteria

* Agent requests a partial refund on a two-line order; it waits for approval; a sales manager approves; the fake gateway refunds; the ticket line is voided and the stock line restocked; F11 event emitted.
* Refund outside the policy window is rejected unless overridden with approval.
* Cash refund changes the session's expected cash.
* Webhook replay of a dispute changes nothing.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; test evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

F9.3; <issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> approvals and audit, <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" /> agent loop for the agent path.

issues.title: F9.9 Build discounts, vouchers and gift cards
issues.description:
## Goal

Organisers run promotions (percentage, fixed, buy x get y, bundles, codes, automatic discounts) and sell or issue gift cards that work online and in person, with limits enforced even when registers were offline.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4 and 5. F8 access codes that unlock hidden ticket types stay in F8; this slice covers price reductions on any line kind, including tickets.

## Scope

1. Discount rules: percent, fixed amount, buy x get y, bundle price, free item; scope by product, variant, line kind, channel, F1 Event; start and end; per-customer and total usage limits; stackable flag and priority.
2. Discount codes (single or bulk generated) and automatic discounts.
3. Deterministic cart evaluation in F9.2 totals with an explanation per line (shown to people and the agent).
4. Offline: rules cached; usage counted as deltas; usage limits enforced on the server; over-use after offline sync flagged for review, never reverses the sale.
5. Gift cards: sell as a product kind or issue manually; code stored as a hash; balance ledger (issue, redeem, refund back, adjust); redeem online and at the register (online only, as in the market check); expiry per local law setting.
6. Actions: sales.discount.create, update, archive; sales.cart.applyDiscount; sales.giftCard.issue, adjust (confirm), redeem.
7. Discounts and gift cards screen.

## Acceptance criteria

* Table-driven tests for every rule kind and stacking order, including rounding with allocation from F9.1.
* A code with a limit of 10 used 12 times across two offline registers yields 12 sales and one review flag.
* Gift card partially redeemed online and then at a register shows the right balance; a refund returns value to the card.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; test evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

F9.2 (gift card redemption also needs F9.3).

issues.title: F14.8 Visual page editor: drag and drop on wide screens, structured editing on phones
issues.description:
## Goal

People build pages by dragging blocks on a live canvas on web, tablet and desktop, and edit the same pages comfortably on a phone, with presence, undo and the agent alongside, all driving the same block actions.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 6 (Page editor, phone layout) and decision D6 (build Canvas surface, LayersTree, PropertyInspector and BlockPalette in Rambo-UI; Puck as a reference only). The same components serve the F14.3 view designer.
* <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" />: the editor's projection must tell the agent the page, the selected block, the viewport and who else is present, and every control binds to `pages.blocks.*`, `pages.update`, `sites.preview`, `sites.publish`.
* <issue id="a1348819-43cc-4005-8e8d-a896a761af03" label="EVE-51" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-51/p112-build-collaboration-yjs-for-text-and-canvas-with-record-sync-and" /> supplies presence and undo for the page doc.

## Scope

1. Rambo-UI components (no Eventiva dependency): `CanvasSurface` (renders a block tree with selection outlines, drop indicators, keyboard move), `LayersTree` (outline with drag reorder), `PropertyInspector` (form generated from the block's Effect Schema props through neutral schema descriptors), `BlockPalette` (categories, search).
2. Drag and drop with pointer and touch on wide screens; full keyboard alternative (select, cut, paste, move up and down, into and out of containers) to meet WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.7 Dragging Movements.
3. Phone layout: structured editor (block list with reorder handles plus a bottom property sheet); same actions.
4. Inline text editing in rich text and heading blocks on the Yjs text type; image replace from <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> media.
5. Viewport preview toggles (phone, tablet, desktop) and locale switch.
6. Presence avatars and remote selections; per-user undo and redo.
7. Agent panel docked in the editor: instructions apply to the current selection or page (F14.12 supplies generation; this slice wires the panel and the projection).
8. Unsaved state does not exist: every change is a synced doc update; a "Draft" badge shows until publish.

## Acceptance criteria

* On web, drag a hero and a columns block, edit text inline, and undo three steps; on Android the same page is editable in the structured layout and both views converge live (test plus recorded device check).
* Every editor operation can be done with the keyboard only (axe and a scripted keyboard test).
* The agent reads "the selected block is the second card in the pricing section" from the projection and changes its button label through `pages.blocks.update`.
* The unbound-control check from <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> passes for the editor.

## Constraints

issues.title: F9.10 Build bookable services sold through checkout
issues.description:
## Goal

Organisers and vendors sell time-based services (a workshop slot, a meet and greet, a production service, an hour of a crew role) where the customer picks a time, the slot is held during checkout and confirmed when paid.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4 and 5. Availability and bookings are F2 scheduling, built on <issue id="97915f03-fb56-4efc-bb5a-15e8b62b96b2" label="EVE-33" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-33/port-scheduling-primitives-for-availability-bookings-and-rosters" />. F9 implements nothing about availability; it registers line kind `service` provided by F2.

## Scope

1. Agree with the F2 thread the three provider actions behind kind `service` (reserve a slot with expiry, confirm booking, cancel booking) and record their names here before coding.
2. Product kind `service` with duration, capacity per slot, resource or role link (F2), and price per slot or per hour.
3. Slot picker in the storefront and register (reads F2 availability), cart line with the slot as the reference id and the hold as the reservation id.
4. Paid order confirms the booking; refund or cancel cancels it per policy; reschedule as an exchange (F9.8).
5. Service lines are `online-only` offline mode unless F2 provides per-device allocation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A customer books and pays for a 30 minute slot; a second customer cannot take the same slot while it is held; expiry frees it.
* Cancelling the order cancels the booking in F2.
* Offline register blocks service lines with a clear message.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; F2 provider action names recorded; test evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

issues.title: F14.9 Data-bound blocks, collection pages and forms
issues.description:
## Goal

Sites show live Eventiva data (schedules, tickets, products, listings, maps) that updates without republishing, one template page can serve every Event, and public forms land submissions in the right records safely.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`forms.*`), 5 (Page binding, block bindings, FormDefinition, FormSubmission), 8 (`BotChallenge` port) and 11 (personal data, consent).
* F1 names from <issue id="fbcff205-decd-464a-b8ab-a1278e71fbe4" label="EVE-73" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-73/f1-events-and-production-planning-the-event-record-run-of-show" /> section 5: the public schedule comes from Event (anchor), Phase and Segment where `Segment.audience = public`, in a published RunOfShow. F14 reads these through F1's public read actions and never defines them.
* Bindings store a read action and its input, never a snapshot (the <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" /> panel rule), so data re-runs under the viewer: for a public site the viewer is the anonymous principal, which only sees fields the owning feature set marks public.
* Ticket (F8), product and checkout (F9), directory (F5) and site map (F10) blocks are thin wrappers over those sets' public actions; if a set's public action does not exist yet, its block ships disabled with a placeholder.

## Scope

1. Binding model: `{ action, input, fields }` with input values that may reference the page context (for a collection page, the current record id). Validation at edit time that the action is a public-safe read (side-effect class read, permission available to the anonymous principal).
2. Collection pages: a Page binding of entity type plus filter plus slug field generates one URL per record (for example `/events/{slug}` for every published Event in the site's EventSeries); 404 for records that stop matching.
3. Data blocks: event header, public schedule (Phase and public Segment, grouped by day and Space), countdown, ticket selector (F8), product grid (F9, links into F9 checkout), directory listing and profile (F5), site map (F10), list of any custom record type marked public (F14.2), single field value.
4. Forms: `forms.define` with fields (from the target action's input schema or custom fields), a target action (for example F4 `contacts.create`, or `records.custom.create`), consent text and purpose, retention days, notifications (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />), and an optional automation trigger (F14.5).
5. `forms.submit` for the anonymous principal: Effect Schema validation, rate limit per IP and form, `BotChallenge` port check, idempotency key, then the target action runs as the form's service principal with only that permission; submissions stored with retention and erasure.
6. `forms.submissions.list/export/delete` with pii masking; export is `confirm` for the agent.
7. Caching: data blocks render server-side with a short cache and revalidate on change-feed events (<issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />) for the bound records.

## Acceptance criteria

* Changing a public Segment time in the RunOfShow updates the published schedule within one minute with no republish; a Segment with audience crew never appears (test).
* One collection page serves three Events with correct URLs; unpublishing an Event returns 404 for its page.
* A form creates an F4 contact; a bot submission without a valid challenge and a burst over the rate limit are both refused (test); a submission is deleted when its retention expires.
* A binding to a write action or a non-public read is refused in the editor with `BindingNotPublic`.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; WCAG 2.2 AA for every block and form (labels, errors announced); behind `f14-sites`; `BotChallenge` vendor needs approval on this issue (proposal: a privacy-friendly challenge, chosen when this slice starts); no new dependency without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the live-update, public-only and form abuse tests green.

issues.title: F10.11 Agent layout drafting, templates and proactive checks
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent turns a brief ("8,000 standing, two stages, one day, licensed bar") into a draft layout a person can review and apply, reuses past layouts as templates, and warns when the plan stops meeting the rules.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="f8432c08-24bb-4690-a3e1-16ed79977eee" label="EVE-108" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-108/f10-interactive-site-maps" /> section 7 (agent behaviour and approvals). Uses the agent loop (<issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" />) and durable runs (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />); every placement goes through the F10.2 actions, so nothing here is agent-only.
* Inputs: rule sets and checks (<issue id="0a770823-74c2-43b8-849a-45631c15d9e5" label="EVE-183" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-183/f105-measurements-zones-routes-and-rule-checks" />), quantities (<issue id="3a9e684a-a2a4-46ff-b70f-250059ac2c14" label="EVE-199" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-199/f106-bill-of-quantities-and-exports" />), F1 Event attendance and Phase, F8 sales.

## Scope

1. `sitemap.layout.draft`: a durable run that reads the brief, the site boundary, existing locked layers and the rule set, and writes proposed placements to a new draft layer only; returns the draft layer id, a findings list and quantities. Deterministic placement helpers (along a line, grid, spacing, keep-clear buffers) are pure functions the model calls as tools; the model chooses, the helpers compute geometry.
2. Apply flow: the person reviews the draft layer, then `feature.placeMany` (confirm above 50) copies accepted items to target layers; reject deletes the draft layer.
3. `sitemap.template.save` and `.apply` (confirm on a non-empty map): templates are parametric (scale facility counts by attendance, anchor to boundary edges) so a festival layout adapts to a new field.
4. Proactive checks: on edit batches, F1 attendance changes and F8 sales milestones, run `check.run` and notify the owner of new blocking findings through <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, rate-limited to one digest per hour per map.
5. Agent skills doc (ai-docs): how to read the `sitemap.editor.v1` projection, which actions need approval, how to explain findings.
6. Evaluation set (with <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> when available): 10 briefs on 3 fixture sites, scored on zero blocking findings, quantities within 10 percent of a reference plan, and no edits outside the draft layer.

## Acceptance criteria

* For the 10 briefs, the draft never writes outside its draft layer, and at least 8 have zero blocking findings.
* Applying a draft is undoable in one step.
* A template saved from site A applied to site B scales facility counts with attendance and stays inside B's boundary.
* Proactive digest fires once for a seeded over-capacity change and not again within the hour.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; Effect AI only (<issue id="07c58289-6f1c-488e-a130-5f718b473fce" label="EVE-14" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-14/s1-prove-one-effect-action-serves-ui-mcp-and-ai-sdk-from-one-inventory" /> decision); model calls only through the agent, never from UI; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main with check results.

## Done signal

Merged with the evaluation results posted here.

## Blockers

<issue id="0a770823-74c2-43b8-849a-45631c15d9e5" label="EVE-183" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-183/f105-measurements-zones-routes-and-rule-checks" /> (checks), <issue id="3a9e684a-a2a4-46ff-b70f-250059ac2c14" label="EVE-199" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-199/f106-bill-of-quantities-and-exports" /> (quantities), <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" /> (agent loop), <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" /> (durable runs).

issues.title: F14.10 Publishing and public rendering
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser publishes a site as an immutable version that loads fast, works without client JavaScript for static content, meets WCAG 2.2 AA, can be previewed privately first and rolled back in one step.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`sites.preview`, `sites.publish`, `sites.rollback`, `sites.versions.*`), 5 (SiteVersion), 11 (accessibility and abuse checks) and decision D2 (same Rambo-UI blocks rendered server-side through react-native-web).
* D2 risk: react-native-web output may be heavier or less semantic than hand-written HTML. This slice owns the gate; if the gate fails on the reference site, stop and bring the measurements back to <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> for D2 option (b) rather than lowering the gate.

## Scope

1. `sites.publish` (server-only, durable workflow): resolve every page doc to a block tree, validate props and bindings, check path uniqueness, run the publish checks, write an immutable SiteVersion (content hash, publishedBy, note), hand it to the `SiteHosting` port (F14.11) and purge caches. Agent approval `confirm`.
2. Publish checks that block: axe serious or critical issues, missing alt text, skipped heading levels, contrast below AA against the brand kit, broken internal links, a form without consent text, content checks for credential-harvesting forms and known-bad links (abuse rule, section 11). Warnings that do not block: large images, missing SEO description.
3. Renderer service: server-side render of a SiteVersion page through react-native-web plus the `site-blocks` renderers; static HTML and CSS, with islands that hydrate only interactive blocks (ticket selector, form, map, accordion if needed). Data blocks fetched at render per F14.9 caching.
4. `sites.preview`: expiring signed link (default 7 days) rendering the current draft or a chosen version, `noindex`.
5. `sites.rollback`: make an earlier version live again (new version entry pointing to the old snapshot), `confirm`.
6. `sites.versions.list` and `.diff` (block-level diff with changed props) for the Version history screen.
7. Telemetry: `site_published`, `site_rolled_back`; render spans carry site and version ids only.

## Acceptance criteria

* A reference event site (home, schedule, tickets, form, five content pages) scores at least 95 for performance and accessibility in Lighthouse on mobile, passes axe with no serious issues, and its content pages render with JavaScript disabled (recorded here).
* Publishing a page with a missing alt text is refused with a list of failures; fixing it and republishing succeeds.
* A preview link shows the draft and stops working after expiry; it is never indexed (`noindex` header test).
* Rollback restores the previous version within one minute at the edge.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; WCAG 2.2 AA; behind `f14-sites`; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the reference-site measurements recorded here, confirming or reopening D2.

issues.title: F9.11 Build receipts, reconciliation, sales reporting and accounting events
issues.description:
## Goal

Every sale produces a correct receipt, every payment is matched to the provider's payouts, organisers see live sales per event, channel and Space, and accounting receives the events it posts from.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4, 10 and 11, and the boundary agreed with F11 (<issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />): F9 emits sales:order_paid, sales:refund_completed, sales:payment_fee_recorded, sales:payout_settled and sales:register_session_closed; F11 posts journals and owns invoices and tax codes; F11 emits accounting:invoice_settled for on-account orders.
* F4 (<issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" />): buyers are F4 Persons by Party id; order events name the party so they appear on the contact timeline through the TimelineContributor contract (<issue id="c3695c62-5106-4bd6-8ce1-c7dff1d14427" label="EVE-95" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-95/f43-build-the-activity-timeline-interactions-notes-and-history-from" />).

## Scope

1. Receipts: template per org (logo, legal name, tax number, F11 tax code and amount per line, payment method, refund policy), delivered by email or SMS (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />) or printed (F9.6); simplified VAT receipt on request; reprint.
2. sales.order.invoiceOnAccount hand-off to F11 and mark paid on accounting:invoice_settled.
3. Payout sync: sales.payout.list and get from the PaymentGateway; fees recorded per payment (sales:payment_fee_recorded).
4. Reconciliation: [sales.reconciliation.run](<http://sales.reconciliation.run>) matches orders, payments, refunds, payouts and cash sessions; reports unmatched, offline payments not forwarded within 24 hours, and cash variances. Nightly durable job (<issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />).
5. Reporting: sales.report.summary grouped by F1 Event, Phase, Space, channel, product, cashier and hour; sales dashboard with <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" /> widgets.
6. Timeline contribution of order and refund events to F4 contacts.
7. Event schemas published in the shared package and matched by a contract test that F11 also runs.

## Acceptance criteria

* Contract test: the five events validate against the shared schema; amounts sum to order totals in minor units.
* Reconciliation finds a seeded missing payout, an unforwarded offline payment and a cash variance.
* Dashboard numbers equal the report action's numbers for the same filters (the agent and the screen agree).
* A buyer's order appears on their F4 timeline.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; no amounts per person or emails in PostHog properties; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; F11 thread told the event schemas are live; evidence pasted here.

## Blockers

F9.3 (F9.5 for cash sessions); <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" /> change feed, <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> notifications, <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" /> dashboards, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" /> durable runs; F11 <issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" /> posting rules.

issues.title: F9.12 Build vendor sales at events with split payments
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser invites vendors from the directory (F5) to sell at an event, either on the organiser's registers and store or on their own, and each sale pays the vendor its share automatically, minus the organiser's commission.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> decision D5 (recommended: spec now, build after F9.3) and D2 (connected accounts make each tenant and vendor a merchant).
* Vendors are F5 directory listings linked to an F4 organisation; F9 does not redefine them.

## Scope

1. Vendor invitation to a channel with a SplitRule: commission percent or fixed per line, who is merchant of record for the vendor's lines (vendor recommended), payout timing.
2. Vendor role: external users limited to their own products and their own sales on channels they are invited to (<issue id="7f612e80-3332-4acf-a74c-d35db06fe4e8" label="EVE-43" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-43/p14-build-identity-and-access-orgs-authorization-user-profiles-and" /> scoped permissions).
3. Connected account onboarding for vendors through the PaymentGateway (approval always).
4. Mixed carts: lines from several vendors in one checkout; payment split per SplitRule at capture; refunds reverse the split proportionally.
5. Vendor dashboard: their sales, fees, commission and payouts.
6. Events for F11 carry vendor share and commission so the organiser books commission income only.
7. Behind `f9-vendor-splits` (default off).

## Directory quote payments (F5 contract, <issue id="7dba7530-e7b6-4259-be26-9924f9ebddcb" label="EVE-237" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-237/f514-build-quote-payments-with-commission-deducted-at-source" />)

Decided by Jonathan on 2026-11-08 in F5 (D5-6 b): organisers pay accepted directory quotes through Eventiva.

* The vendor tenant is merchant of record on its own connected account. Eventiva's commission is the platform fee on each capture, and Eventiva holds no balance.
* F5 creates one PaymentRequest per quote schedule line (deposit, balance) and calls [directory.payment.pay](<http://directory.payment.pay>). That opens an F9 checkout session through the PaymentGateway port (<issue id="382cab34-de6b-4524-8a47-241353c76b2b" label="EVE-174" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-174/f93-build-the-payment-gateway-port-and-online-card-payments" />) with destination = vendor connected account and application fee = commission. The commission base excludes VAT, the rate comes from the F5 CommissionPlan, and tests use 5 percent.
* F9 provides: capture, refund and dispute events on the change feed carrying the PaymentRequest id; refunds (<issue id="cc848306-1827-4682-a18a-e5c255970dd3" label="EVE-215" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-215/f98-build-refunds-cancellations-exchanges-and-disputes" />) that reverse the platform fee in proportion; and connected-account onboarding status per tenant, so F5 can block payment requests to vendors not yet onboarded.
* The monthly VAT invoice for commission comes from the operator tenant through F11 (<issue id="2ef1ed05-1c6a-4b1b-9b1c-04331398cac8" label="EVE-126" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-126/f114-build-sales-invoices-credit-notes-and-receivables" />), not from F9.

## Acceptance criteria

* One cart with an organiser line and two vendor lines pays out three ways in the fake gateway with correct commission; a partial refund on one vendor line reverses only that split.
* A vendor cannot see another vendor's or the organiser's sales through any surface.
* Sandbox evidence with the real adapter once D2 and D5 are approved.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; vendor SDK only in the integration package; no new dependency or vendor account without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; evidence pasted here; F5 thread told the vendor sales contract. Also: a directory quote PaymentRequest paid through [directory.payment.pay](<http://directory.payment.pay>) captures to the vendor connected account with a 5 percent application fee in the fake gateway; capture, refund and dispute events carry the PaymentRequest id; a partial refund reverses the platform fee in proportion; and a payment request to a vendor that is not onboarded is refused with a typed error (<issue id="7dba7530-e7b6-4259-be26-9924f9ebddcb" label="EVE-237" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-237/f514-build-quote-payments-with-commission-deducted-at-source" /> F5.14 tests green against this slice).

## Blockers

issues.title: F9.13 Build the sales agent behaviours and approvals
issues.description:
## Goal

The agent does every sales job a person with the same permissions can do, suggests the right thing at the right time, and never moves money without a person's approval.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> section 7. All behaviour uses existing F9 actions; no agent-only code path (<issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> parity rule). Screen awareness from <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> lets the agent act on what the user sees (the open order, the register cart).

## Scope

1. Skills and prompts for: build a catalogue from a pasted list, a spreadsheet or a supplier PDF (<issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> import) into draft products for review; set prices across a price list; open and close channels; answer sales questions with sales.report.summary; prepare refunds and exchanges for approval; draft customer messages for offline declines and failed payments (sent only with approval, F4 consent check for marketing).
2. Proactive suggestions (durable schedule, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" />), each a suggestion card, never a silent change: open channel with products out of stock, register near its offline limit, offline payments not forwarded after 12 hours, cash variance on session close, reconciliation mismatch, discount over its usage limit.
3. Approval wiring: refunds, voids, gift card adjustments, provider connection and split rules always ask a person; price changes on open channels and channel opening ask for confirmation.
4. Offline behaviour on a register: the agent reads the cached catalogue and can queue cash sales; it states that card confirmation and reports need connection.
5. Evaluations (<issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" />): ten scripted sales tasks with expected action sequences; the agent must pass all ten and never call a refund without the approval step.
6. Telemetry: agent-initiated action counts per sales action, suggestion accepted or dismissed.

## Acceptance criteria

* The ten evaluations pass; a red-team prompt asking the agent to refund without approval results in an approval request, not a refund.
* The agent, looking at an open order on screen, can answer "refund the second line" with a correct refund request for that line.
* Suggestions appear for each seeded condition and none change data on their own.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; Effect AI only per <issue id="07c58289-6f1c-488e-a130-5f718b473fce" label="EVE-14" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-14/s1-prove-one-effect-action-serves-ui-mcp-and-ai-sdk-from-one-inventory" />; behind the `f9-sales` flag; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; evaluation results pasted here.

## Blockers

F9.1 to F9.11 for the actions it uses; <issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" /> agent loop, <issue id="a626308a-598f-41ba-accd-4004cbbd9932" label="EVE-54" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-54/p18c-build-durable-agent-runs-on-effect-cluster-and-workflow" /> durable runs, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> screen awareness, <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> evaluations.

issues.title: F9.14 Build quotes, deposits and equipment hire orders
issues.description:
## Goal

A production company quotes a client for equipment hire, services and fees for an event, the client accepts online and pays a deposit, the hire is reserved for its dates, and the balance is paid or invoiced before the event.

## Context

* Parent <issue id="7d939472-20ba-4512-b231-c0f04c05574c" label="EVE-107" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-107/f9-online-and-in-person-sales-storefront-point-of-sale-orders-payments" /> sections 4 and 5. Agreed with F6 (<issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" />): F6 owns availability and reservations for hire (kind `hire`, inventory.reservation.create, commit, release with a period); F9 owns quotes and hire prices; F11 (<issue id="158ba369-976e-47ea-9f86-a8df608cb4d0" label="EVE-69" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-69/f11-accounting-ledgers-invoices-bills-event-budgets-and-tax" />) owns invoices. Agreed with F4 (<issue id="ad791a38-f528-4aec-9433-c36977bbe8e2" label="EVE-65" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-65/f4-contacts-and-crm-people-organisations-relationships-and-history" />): enquiries and opportunities sit in F4; proposals, quotes and deposits stay in F9 and F11.
* Quotes attach to an F1 Event and an F4 organisation or person.

## Scope

1. Quote entity and state machine: draft, sent, accepted, declined, expired; revisions (a sent quote is immutable; revise creates revision n+1).
2. Hire pricing: per day, per week or per event, with day multipliers (for example 1 day, 3 days priced as 2), minimum charge; hire lines carry a period; availability check through F6 before sending, and a reservation on accept.
3. Actions: sales.quote.create, revise, send (confirm), accept (by the customer through a signed link or by staff), decline; accept creates an Order with the quote's lines.
4. Deposits: deposit percent or amount on the quote; accept takes the deposit online (F9.3) or hands the order to F11 on account; balance due date; balance reminder (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />); balance by card or invoice.
5. Quote PDF and email to the client (<issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" />, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" />), whitelabel.
6. Hire returns and damage charges: F6 records the check-in; damage or late return adds a charge line to the order through sales.order.addCharge (approval confirm).
7. Quotes list and Quote editor screens with projections; the agent can draft a quote from an enquiry for a person to send.

## Acceptance criteria

* A quote for 3 days of hire plus a crew service is sent, accepted through the link, a 30 percent deposit is paid with the fake gateway, F6 reserves the equipment for the period, and the balance reminder is scheduled.
* Accepting after expiry fails with a typed error; a revised quote can be accepted.
* A late return adds a charge line after confirmation; F11 receives the event.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3 house rules; behind the `f9-sales` flag; whitelabel ASCII customer text; no new dependency without Jonathan approving it on this issue; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged to main; evidence pasted here; F6 and F11 threads told the hire flow is live.

## Blockers

F9.2, F9.3; <issue id="9aae6a50-4a43-4327-ae6a-51d18bc69b35" label="EVE-24" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-24/port-notifications-messaging-channels-and-transactional-email" /> notifications, <issue id="8d8d301b-d679-4dac-95bb-c24889179cd0" label="EVE-25" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-25/port-files-private-attachments-artifacts-and-document-import" /> files; F6 <issue id="928dc098-5cc9-4586-88bb-50abbe03071a" label="EVE-63" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-63/f6-warehousing-and-inventory-equipment-stock-availability-purchasing" /> hire reservations.

issues.title: F14.11 Domains, hosting, redirects and abuse handling
issues.description:
## Goal

Every site is live on a platform subdomain at once and on the organisation's own domain with TLS after a DNS check, old URLs redirect, and abusive sites can be reported and taken down quickly.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`domains.*`, `redirects.*`, `sites.reportAbuse`), 8 (`SiteHosting`, `DomainProvisioning`) and 11 (abuse) and decision D4 (first adapter Vercel, behind neutral ports; no sign-up until this slice starts and Jonathan approves it here).
* climb-group-odoo had to custom-build redirects (docs/learnings/odoo-extensions-reference.md); campaigns and old event sites need them from day one.
* Credentials live in config and secrets (<issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />), never in code or this issue.

## Scope

1. `SiteHosting` port (Effect service): deploy a SiteVersion, set the live version per hostname, purge cache by site or path, report status. `DomainProvisioning` port: add hostname, return required DNS records, verify, issue and renew certificates, remove. One integration package per vendor; switching vendor is composition only.
2. Platform subdomains `{subdomain}.{platform sites domain}` assigned at `sites.create`; reserved and offensive names refused.
3. `domains.add` (returns DNS records and a verification token), `domains.verify` (polls DNS through the port; durable retry for up to 72 hours), `domains.setPrimary` (others 301 to primary), `domains.remove` (`always` approval for the agent). Apex and `www` both supported.
4. Redirects: exact and prefix rules, 301 and 302, CSV import (`confirm`), loop detection, applied at the edge before rendering; automatic redirects when a page path changes after publish.
5. Abuse: `sites.reportAbuse` (public, rate limited) into a takedown queue; platform operators can suspend a site (serves a neutral suspended page) through an operator-only action; the publish content checks from F14.10 feed the same queue.
6. Site settings screen: domains with live status, redirects table, suspension banner.

## Acceptance criteria

* With the adapter in a sandbox account approved here: a site is reachable on its subdomain immediately after first publish, and a test custom domain gets a valid certificate after DNS verification (recorded here).
* Changing a published page path creates a 301 from the old path automatically; a redirect loop is refused at create time.
* An in-memory test adapter passes the same port conformance suite as the real adapter (so switching vendor is proven by tests).
* A suspended site serves the suspended page on every hostname within one minute.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; vendor SDK only inside its integration package with `// effect-boundary:` comments; behind `f14-sites-custom-domains` for custom domains; no vendor sign-up or new dependency until Jonathan approves on this issue; no production DNS changes without his go-ahead; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the port conformance suite green for both adapters and the sandbox domain test recorded.

issues.title: F14.12 AI site generation and editing by instruction
issues.description:
## Goal

An organiser gets a complete, on-brand, accessible draft site from a short brief and an Event in minutes, and can change any page by telling the agent what they want, always reviewing a diff before anything goes live.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`sites.generate`, `pages.generate`, `sites.translations.generate`), 7 (agent behaviour) and 10 (success metric: drafts accepted with under 20% of blocks changed).
* The agent edits only through `pages.blocks.*` and `pages.*` (<issue id="3deaef52-8db8-490c-8143-b293ab5656a8" label="EVE-52" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-52/p18a-build-the-agent-turn-loop-with-actions-as-tools" /> tools), so generation is a planned batch of ordinary actions in one change record with one undo, not a separate code path.
* Brand kits come from <issue id="1d65d374-8d06-4d69-a9c6-f3b66d565b47" label="EVE-30" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-30/port-data-widgets-saved-dashboards-and-brand-kits" />; the agent uses the org's or user's engine (<issue id="5f3d064c-7dfa-45f3-b0a2-67d5ad9d3aca" label="EVE-53" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-53/p18b-build-model-engines-model-selection-and-user-owned-subscriptions" />) and shows its offline limit when there is no connection.

## Scope

1. `sites.generate`: input brief, source records (an Event and its public data from F1, the org profile, optional F5 listing), template (optional), locales; output a draft site (pages, menus, blocks with bindings to the source records rather than copied text where data exists) plus a GenerationReport (what was created, what needs human input such as missing images).
2. `pages.generate`: instruction plus scope (selected block or page from the editor projection); output a proposed diff shown in the editor; accept applies it as one change record, reject discards it.
3. Generation rules: only registered block types with valid props; headings in order; alt text for every image (generated, flagged for review); brand kit colours only; placeholder images from the org's media first; no invented facts about the Event (dates, prices, venue come from bindings).
4. Image generation is out of this slice unless an image engine is already approved; otherwise use media library and placeholders.
5. `sites.translations.generate`: per-locale draft text for every text prop, flagged as machine-translated until a person edits or approves it.
6. Eval fixtures: five briefs with expected structure checks (page count, blocks bound to source data, accessibility checks pass), run through <issue id="bef04957-8bec-479e-85ee-5880dfc9fc8c" label="EVE-29" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-29/port-agent-evaluations-linked-to-posthog-datasets" /> when available, else recorded-model tests.

## Acceptance criteria

* From "two-day food festival in Leeds, family friendly, sell early bird tickets" plus an Event, the agent produces a draft site whose schedule and ticket blocks are bound to that Event, which passes the F14.10 publish checks without edits (recorded-model test).
* "Make the hero shorter and add a FAQ about parking" on a page produces a diff; accepting it is one undo step.
* With no connection, `sites.generate` returns `OfflineUnavailable` and the UI says so.
* Translations are marked machine-translated until approved.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; Effect AI only; behind `f14-sites-ai-generate`; record contents and prompts not sent to telemetry by default; no new dependency or model vendor without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with fixtures green and the acceptance-rate metric visible in PostHog.

issues.title: F14.13 SEO, agent-readable output, localisation and consent on published sites
issues.description:
## Goal

Published sites are found by search engines and AI assistants, read correctly in every enabled language, and only measure visitors who have consented.

## Context

* Parent: <issue id="d6f1d3a2-12a8-474b-abae-aa29b394d45d" label="EVE-111" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-111/f14-website-builder-and-in-app-customisation" /> sections 4 (`sites.seo.update`), 10 (telemetry) and 11 (PECR / ePrivacy, GDPR).
* Upstream reference at 6b5cf68: `agent-web/` (Later, R-WEB in the S2 map): agent-readable site output such as sitemaps and machine views; read for behaviour only.
* Localisation infrastructure comes from <issue id="338aae77-d10e-4f8a-9189-fe3655bd3572" label="EVE-28" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-28/port-localization-for-people-and-for-the-agent" />; analytics through the tracking port (<issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />) with PostHog as the default adapter.

## Scope

1. SEO settings per site and page: title, description, social image, canonical URL, `indexable`; generated `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt` per hostname; preview links always `noindex`.
2. Structured data: [schema.org](<http://schema.org>) `Event` (name, dates, location from F1 Event and Space, offers from F8 ticket types when public), `Organization`, `BreadcrumbList`, generated from bindings, never typed by hand.
3. Agent-readable output: `llms.txt` and a clean machine view per page (headings, text, links, structured data) from the same SiteVersion.
4. Localisation: per-locale page text, `hreflang` links, locale switcher block, locale-aware dates, times and currency; untranslated text falls back to the site default with a visible editor warning.
5. Consent: a platform consent block (cannot be removed while analytics or embeds are enabled), categories (necessary, analytics, embeds), stored consent per visitor, no analytics or third-party embed loads before consent; consent text editable within required wording.
6. Analytics: page views and conversions (`form_submitted`, ticket checkout started) through the tracking port after consent, pseudonymous visitor id, no form values.

## Acceptance criteria

* The reference event site's Event page validates as [schema.org](<http://schema.org>) Event in a structured-data validator (recorded here) and appears in `sitemap.xml`.
* With consent declined, no analytics request leaves the page (browser test); after consent, page views arrive in PostHog.
* A two-locale site serves correct `hreflang` pairs and falls back for one untranslated block with the editor warning shown.
* `llms.txt` lists every indexable page with its title and summary.

## Constraints

Effect-TS v3; WCAG 2.2 AA for the consent block and locale switcher; behind `f14-sites`; no new dependency without approval here; ships to main per the AGENTS.md delivery exception with `node --run check` results pasted here.

## Done signal

Merged with the structured data, consent and hreflang checks recorded here.
