Synchronous collection MUST NOT run arbitrary plugin code inside committed transactions; reliable notifications use outbox after commit, idempotent delivery and backpressure. Test authorization, field minimization, revocation, metadata leaks, tenant isolation, offline behavior, failure/retry/cancellation, shutdown/drain, upgrade recovery, exact-version compatibility, and PostgreSQL/SQLite gaps honestly. No unapproved dependencies, provisioning, payment activation, production migrations or settings changes. Code review, full checks, evidence and owner approval required before main integration. Details and gaps must remain self-contained in these Linear briefs even if Amp chat context disappears.

### Kernel and hook integration requirements

Lifecycle registration is independent of activation; define register/validate/install/activate/ready/deactivate/unregister/retire/upgrade/recover as controlled transitions with scoped subscriptions and reverse-order cleanup. Publish a versioned, discoverable hook registry/capability inventory; enforce permission and ownership, deterministic subscriber identity and ordering, handler quotas, idempotency and runtime generation leases. Disabling/replacing a module must not erase data, interrupt an active incident, or execute a side effect twice. `platform.ready` must be emitted only on a successful readiness transition; once per successful topology generation, with defined durable/event delivery as a separate gate. Add the archived word-art sample as a required integration fixture, not a cosmetic afterthought.

## New binding quality gate — circular dependencies and exact types (2026-11-15)

See <issue id="5dbfce34-6bca-46ef-937b-e475730e55a0" label="EVE-263" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-263/enforce-acyclic-moduledependency-graphs-and-exact-effect-ts-types" /> for full requirements and negative/positive acceptance fixtures. Never create circular static/runtime module dependencies, including indirect and type-only imports. Shared contracts belong in existing lower-level package C, imported by A and B with no reverse edge. Effects hooks/capabilities must permit cross-module extension without imports back to publishers. Reject dependency cycles at manifest admission and in Nx/import/type graph CI. Preserve precise Effect Schema/Context/Layer/action/hook/external dependency typing. No `any`, exposed `unknown`, invented `none` catch-all, unsafe casts, or ignored TS diagnostics as fixes. Validate external input at narrow schema adapters and escalate unavoidable vendor internal `unknown` to explicit review. Strict typecheck, boundary lint, type-level and runtime negative fixtures and evidence mandatory before sign-off.

## Escalation

Stop the blocked portion and report the exact missing contract, approved dependency/component, security evidence, provider approval or path conflict on this issue and in <issue id="b025ea11-9298-48b2-9bd4-d44decabcab4" label="EVE-261" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-261/integrate-the-modular-platform-and-prove-every-owner-required" /> review packet. Continue safe nonblocked isolated work. Do not guess a version/crypto provider, broaden scope, weaken security/tests or edit shared integration to make a check pass. Main push/merge and shared integration remain held for owner approval.

## Binding <issue id="5dbfce34-6bca-46ef-937b-e475730e55a0" label="EVE-263" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-263/enforce-acyclic-moduledependency-graphs-and-exact-effect-ts-types" /> integration appendix - 2026-11-15

Goal: satisfy the owner's strict acyclic, escape-free typing requirement before shared integration or main delivery. <issue id="5dbfce34-6bca-46ef-937b-e475730e55a0" label="EVE-263" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-263/enforce-acyclic-moduledependency-graphs-and-exact-effect-ts-types" /> is the source of truth; this appendix preserves this issue's existing scope and completion intent.

Context: canonical spec section 2.1/G15: [https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eventiva-modular-platform-b115f8c7-0edb-4b1b-9219-abf845e2f85c](<https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eventiva-modular-platform-b115f8c7-0edb-4b1b-9219-abf845e2f85c>) . Single review packet: [https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eve-261-integration-review-packet-79ccdbb8-374a-4c4f-bd42-6e43e14b975c](<https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eve-261-integration-review-packet-79ccdbb8-374a-4c4f-bd42-6e43e14b975c>) . All existing lanes were asked to audit their exact revision and record violations rather than treat earlier green tests as clearance.

Validation: Nx package boundaries/cycles plus TypeScript-resolved source graphs must cover value/type-only imports, relative paths, aliases, reexports, transitive and generated edges. Runtime manifest/provider graph rejects cycles before publication/admission. Show direct A->B->A and indirect A->B->C->A negatives, type-only/alias/reexport negatives, shared-contract A->C<-B and diamond A->B,C->D positives, and one-way hooks via registry. Shared versioned Effect Schema stays lower-level in contracts/schema; no reverse dependency or duplicated widened model. Strict compile/decode fixtures preserve precise input/output/error/environment and provider-swap types. CI must reject any, unauthorized explicit unknown, erased placeholders, unsafe/blind JSON casts, untyped bindings and suppression/disabled checks. Decode untrusted values at boundaries; an unavoidable vendor unknown is private, narrow, parsed before exposure, and requires explicit owner review.

Out of scope: no new dependencies, settings, source integration, export/shared-file edits, push/merge or weakening gates through this appendix. An isolated alias typecheck or process-local model is not full CI/durability proof.

Escalation: list exact revision/file:line, cycle path or type escape, command/exit/diagnostic, owner and blocked code/remediation. Existing violations are separate findings, not grandfathered. Review-before-main remains binding; no integration while unresolved <issue id="5dbfce34-6bca-46ef-937b-e475730e55a0" label="EVE-263" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-263/enforce-acyclic-moduledependency-graphs-and-exact-effect-ts-types" /> violations or approvals remain. Hook edges stay one-way; no inverse imports to observe a publisher.

Issue-specific audit continuity: Reported kernel audit: reachable 10-file static graph has no cycles/reverse-contract edge; 35 focused tests pass including direct/indirect manifest and indirect provider cycle negatives. NOT cleared: packages/runtime/src/kernel-runtime.ts:48 providers ReadonlyMap<string,unknown>, :58 ModuleDefinition.manifest unknown, :98 compose input unknown; private :121/:594 decode/compose explicit unknown. Frozen API/schema redesign is blocked for review, not an assumed vendor exception. Current signed checkpoint evidence remains separate from newer uncommitted audit tests.

issues.title: Implement the initial declarative UI module registry over approved native components
issues.description:
## Goal

Install/activate/deactivate an untrusted data-only UI module using already-installed, approved Expo/React Native/Rambo-UI components and authorized actions, without downloading arbitrary executable components.

## Context

Canonical spec [https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eventiva-modular-platform-b115f8c7-0edb-4b1b-9219-abf845e2f85c](<https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eventiva-modular-platform-b115f8c7-0edb-4b1b-9219-abf845e2f85c>); owner initial declarative-only extension direction 2026-11-15. <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" /> remains separate trusted executable federation/OTA/native proof, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> owns general agent screen awareness, <issue id="37509260-4197-48cc-9f7b-6261085926d1" label="EVE-168" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-168/f143-views-generated-screens-and-patches-over-base-screens" /> owns rich views/patch designer and <issue id="49ded863-d1c4-4230-9513-064664f76237" label="EVE-204" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-204/f147-site-and-page-model-with-the-block-registry" /> site block registry. Do not duplicate those product scopes or treat their unverified native stack as delivered. This narrow registry can be designed against current portable contracts while target-specific proof remains gated.

## Ownership

Proposed new files: packages/contracts/src/ui-module.ts (versioned data-only UiModuleDefinition/UiNode/UiActionBinding/UiProjection and UiModuleFailure), apps/client/src/modules/declarative-registry.ts, apps/client/src/modules/DeclarativeModule.tsx (registry/renderer orchestration, not a private component library), tests/ui-modules/src/declarative-module.spec.tsx, docs/declarative-modules.md, ai-docs/src/19_declarative-modules/index.md. Reserve these paths with coordinator before writing; Rambo-UI changes belong external repo and require that repo approval. Shared app entry/config/exports/package manifests remain coordinator-owned.

## Acceptance and evidence

1. Schema validates stable nodes/slots, namespaced localization keys/default bundles, terminology concepts, approved component/version references, action bindings/inputs, declared visible projection, offline fallback and feature flag. Reject functions/eval/raw executable strings, arbitrary RN/HTML/JS imports, unknown components/actions, duplicate nodes, undeclared providers, inaccessible layout and absent default translations before any route publication.
2. Data-only package is not a sandbox claim: host owns interpreter, trusted renderers and strict bindings. Eventiva catalogue review is not mandatory for tenant-private/community declarative imports; explicit capability consent and tenant authorization remain mandatory.
3. Bind navigation/control operations to the same authorized action inventory and mask screen projection to viewer; deliberate unbound control and denied action fail on UI and agent path. Tenant labels never change stable action/resource IDs. No UI-direct DB or arbitrary webhook execution.
4. Lifecycle registers routes/actions/projections/listeners atomically on activation and unregisters on deactivate/failure; in-flight work obeys kernel lease policy. Unknown/offline/stale module uses safe bundled/cached unavailable placeholder, not executable fallback.
5. Protected controls cannot be hidden/relabelled/rebound by extension or automation. Permission/approval/security floors cannot be weakened by visibility or flags.
6. Inspect actual rendered representative default/error/denied/offline states; keyboard/focus/labels/zoom/axe checks on web and actual native evidence for every claimed native target. Browser emulation is not Android/iOS proof. Small React Native test harness is not approval for new Rambo-UI/package versions.

## Done signal

Registry/renderer proof and constrained schema linked here; <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> reuses it for general screen awareness and product designers reuse it without a second registry. Unsupported target/dependency/Rambo capabilities are explicit blockers, not placeholder success.

## Constraints and delivery

Implement in the fresh main foundation, never the Examples archive. Effect v3 typed errors/Schema/Config/Context/Layer/Scope, existing authorized action path, explicit subpath exports and acyclic Nx boundaries. No unapproved dependencies, crypto choices, providers, production provisioning or settings changes. Secrets never enter payloads, errors, logs or issue evidence. Shared manifests/host/generated files are coordinator-owned until checkpoint. Feature rollout uses existing flag service with safe defaults, not environment switches. Record exact commands, decisive output and limitations here; satisfy people and agent docs, full verify and graph requirements before authorized integration. This brief was authored by Amp with AI assistance; it is not an implementation-completion claim.

## Owner continuity addendum — 2026-11-15 (binding implementation requirements)

This is part of the coordinated Eventiva modular-extension platform gate, not a completion claim. Original context: `Examples/preamp` historical extension/HookRegistry/onLoad/Effect.logInfo/structured annotations/Eventiva ASCII word-art; inspect exact archived source before implementing or copying artwork. Preserve original banner bytes/layout where compatible, do not fabricate an equivalent. User-approved directions: strict central typed database API for features; centrally approved declaration migrations; hybrid safe hot changes with controlled restarts; observational and additive hook events only (never mutation, veto, override, synchronous critical-path blockers); additional approval/security boundaries for accounting, payment, emergency and vault-protected operations. No module registration grants decryption rights. Existing security taxonomy Baseline/Sensitive/Restricted-Regulated/Vault-Zero-Knowledge and assurance A1-A5 take precedence; no competing independently granted hook trust taxonomy. Protected notifications only via explicitly authorized, minimized, audited boundary service, not arbitrary plugin callbacks inside protected execution.

Cross-cutting acceptance: install sample extension with manifest + lifecycle registration, receive platform.ready, print *exact archived Eventiva word art* through central structured console logging, emit OTel correlated spans/logs, observe execution and step events, provide an allowed declarative UI extension, and uninstall cleanly, all with NO modifications to host/core or original feature module. Verify hot enable/disable and replacement without listeners/leaks/duplicates; in-flight execution pinned to correct version, emergency operation never delayed; first-party/third-party boundary negative tests. Console and time/date-rotated file exporters, pluggable adapters, output routing and sanitation need explicit tests; UI extension telemetry must correlate actions, screen projections, hook delivery and errors under viewer permissions. Synchronous collection MUST NOT run arbitrary plugin code inside committed transactions; reliable notifications use outbox after commit, idempotent delivery and backpressure. Test authorization, field minimization, revocation, metadata leaks, tenant isolation, offline behavior, failure/retry/cancellation, shutdown/drain, upgrade recovery, exact-version compatibility, and PostgreSQL/SQLite gaps honestly. No unapproved dependencies, provisioning, payment activation, production migrations or settings changes. Code review, full checks, evidence and owner approval required before main integration. Details and gaps must remain self-contained in these Linear briefs even if Amp chat context disappears.

### UI-extension and UI telemetry requirements

Declarative extension-only registration for routes/screens/slots/actions/projections using approved components; lifecycle activate/deactivate atomically adds/removes UI contributions. Instrument renderer mounts/errors, screen-context projection, action invocation and navigation with parent execution correlation through central OTel and sanitized logging; no sensitive data or screen contents by default. All controls and agent-visible projections must use the same authorized action inventory, viewer field masking and screen-context registration. Test offline fallback, event duplication, denied controls, accessibility, untrusted input and deactivation without stale routes/listeners. No arbitrary executable third-party UI or runtime remote-code promise from declarative support alone.

## Escalation

Stop the blocked portion and report the exact missing contract, approved dependency/component, security evidence, provider approval or path conflict on this issue and in <issue id="b025ea11-9298-48b2-9bd4-d44decabcab4" label="EVE-261" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-261/integrate-the-modular-platform-and-prove-every-owner-required" /> review packet. Continue safe nonblocked isolated work. Do not guess a version/crypto provider, broaden scope, weaken security/tests or edit shared integration to make a check pass. Main push/merge and shared integration remain held for owner approval.

## Authorized isolated lane

Owner approved bounded continuation, no shared integration/push. OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol lane: [https://ampcode.com/threads/T-ed7d0408-f922-492a-b3c0-0458581052e1](<https://ampcode.com/threads/T-ed7d0408-f922-492a-b3c0-0458581052e1>) . Exclusive paths include tests/ui-modules/vitest.config.mts and tsconfig.json as well as listed schema/registry/renderer/test/docs. No Rambo-UI dependency in inspected client manifest: neutral/injected component proof is allowed but cannot claim real external Rambo/native support; new package/version requires approval. Word-art remains unlaunched until verified ready/telemetry seams. Record evidence in the linked single review packet.

issues.description:
## Goal

Integrate isolated modular-platform lanes through one coordinated shared-file window and publish reproducible evidence for every owner gate without claiming unit/type proof as distributed/native/security readiness.

## Context

Owner request 2026-11-15; single spec [https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eventiva-modular-platform-b115f8c7-0edb-4b1b-9219-abf845e2f85c](<https://ampcode.com/artifacts/eventiva-modular-platform-b115f8c7-0edb-4b1b-9219-abf845e2f85c>). <issue id="c31b6b08-1532-4a7a-945f-24a70bbab765" label="EVE-23" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23/split-core-into-portable-contracts-and-backend-runtime-with-a-shared" />/40/244 stay Done. <issue id="ceb453e5-ab8e-4566-bf54-47d742b0f425" label="EVE-257" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-257/implement-the-composable-module-kernel-and-safe-lifecycleprovider" /> and <issue id="555738cd-b6eb-4f45-b9d0-d1e590a75785" label="EVE-258" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-258/add-the-database-neutral-resources-api-and-privileged-tenant-migration" /> may checkpoint independently on local aliases before shared exports; full acceptance waits on security/config/hooks/telemetry/UI/reference extension. Existing broad issues remain responsible for their original product/adapter scope.

## Shared ownership and integration order

Coordinator alone edits package.json/pnpm workspace+lock/Nx/tsconfigs/eslint/root check scripts, packages/runtime/src/host.ts, schema manifest/resource compatibility adapters, apps/server/src/main.ts, apps/client entrypoint, existing shared tests, LLMS.md and graphify-out. No new dependencies or loosening boundaries.

1. Review contracts, migration metadata vs execution, error union, validate/compatibleWith, resource ports in contracts and no integration->runtime imports.
2. Add exact source/types/default subpaths @eventiva/contracts/module-manifest, @eventiva/contracts/module-policy, @eventiva/runtime/kernel-runtime, @eventiva/contracts/resource, @eventiva/runtime/resource, @eventiva/integrations.sql/resource. No root barrels, no new resource schema export.
3. Run isolated tests/typechecks/boundaries first; integrate authorized host/tenant Storage without replacing atomicity; wire standalone SQL reachability tool into root gate.
4. Integrate config/redaction/audit/telemetry bootstrap, durable hooks and leases/fencing, then declarative UI and reference extension.
5. Ensure ai-docs index.md for each section (README alone is ignored), regenerate LLMS once, run Nx sync as required and refresh graph without build output.

## Mandatory acceptance evidence

A. Two declarative platform compositions with unchanged feature source; provider swap plus concurrent independently named instances; negative missing/duplicate/cycle/ambiguous/undeclared dependencies.
B. TypeScript-resolved SQL reachability negatives for direct/type-only/re-export/transitive/relative/alias imports, including malicious bridge packages; positive adapter boundary.
C. Cross-module fields and privileged forward-only migration preserve old values, immutable record revisions/schema history; checksum/crash/retry/rollback atomicity proofs.
D. Every module and hook lifecycle, no duplicate finalizers/listeners/registrations, known-good candidate recovery and current runtime/generation platform.ready once; outbox replay one applied banner effect, not exactly-once delivery.
E. Active long-lived workflow blocks destructive/update mutation then resumes/retries safely; runner loss/restart proves persisted checkpoint/idempotency/fencing, not just local lease counter.
F. Protected Baseline/Sensitive/Restricted/Vault profiles with assurance floors and four independent decryption gates; zero plaintext in hooks, screen/agent projections, logs/errors or outbox; no automatic emergency actuation.
G. Valid/invalid Config+Schema tests; secrets are Redacted/handles and absent from JSON/string/Cause serialization.
H. Correlated Effect spans/logs from bootstrap through lifecycle/action/resource/hook, console and date-rotated local file capture plus test exporter; bootstrap failure persists diagnosable safe logs; bounded exporter outage/flush/opt-out with separate mandatory tamper-evident audit. No unapproved OTLP/PostHog ingestion.
I. Declarative-only UI renderer, every interaction bound/agent-visible; protected nodes immutable; real native proof only where executed; word-art demo only after verified ready.
J. node --run check and node --run verify, Nx lint/typecheck/test/build and smoke; people/agent docs and graph current. Capture command/output/version/target for each gate with explicit pass/fail/unrun.

## Constraints and done signal

No weakening protected security/authorization/boundary/test gates, no new packages/crypto/vendors without approval, no production provisioning. A checkpoint may integrate a verified subset but cannot close this issue while any owner gate is unrun/failed. This AI-authored plan does not claim code is delivered. Done only when the evidence ledger satisfies all gates and <issue id="5c7aeec2-d49c-4028-9eca-1bc641d3618c" label="EVE-13" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-13/establish-modular-core-foundations-for-database-adapters-expo-and" /> links exact revision/commands/limitations.

## Final resource wiring freeze

contracts/resource owns declarations/codec/evolution/plans and structural ResourceDriver/ResourceProvider. integrations.sql/resource imports contracts only and exports resourceProvider, planResourceMigrations, migrateResources on the captured SqlClient with Storage constructed on that exact client. runtime/resource imports contracts only and exports resourceRuntime(provider, authorize) Layer. App composition wires them; no Nx exception. Pure preflight returns restart-required before SQL acquisition for retained generations, declared restarts, staged changes or incompatible history. The three ./resource subpaths are the only new resource export maps.

## Integrated owner acceptance matrix (2026-11-15)

Gate successful evidence from <issue id="ceb453e5-ab8e-4566-bf54-47d742b0f425" label="EVE-257" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-257/implement-the-composable-module-kernel-and-safe-lifecycleprovider" />, <issue id="555738cd-b6eb-4f45-b9d0-d1e590a75785" label="EVE-258" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-258/add-the-database-neutral-resources-api-and-privileged-tenant-migration" />, <issue id="afb95d96-359d-4c0f-a462-a7ce41e2c988" label="EVE-262" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-262/implement-governed-observation-only-execution-and-lifecycle-hooks-with" />, <issue id="71b3a3b5-09a5-45f1-9c59-512c9368036e" label="EVE-259" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-260/build-the-clean-word-art-reference-extension-after-verified-platform" />, <issue id="a03acb76-125b-4ead-815e-10ec986d8413" label="EVE-44" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-44/p15-build-telemetry-opentelemetry-spans-on-every-call-and-a-vendor" />, <issue id="ee08644c-eb3c-4a46-aea7-745864ad4263" label="EVE-45" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-45/p16-build-the-change-flow-domain-events-and-a-durable-resource-change" />, <issue id="9d08c369-bac9-4eb7-b8a7-329b5ec9bff0" label="EVE-41" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-41/p12-build-app-config-settings-secrets-and-credentials" />, <issue id="91297309-acc4-4bb9-ad68-33fbc2720e5a" label="EVE-50" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-50/p111-build-screen-awareness-app-state-navigation-and-the-screen" /> plus <issue id="4f5ecaa3-aedf-446d-8993-0c07c98d4bb4" label="EVE-251" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-251/decide-marketplace-service-attestation-and-cryptographic-trust" /> security policy and <issue id="a7a66a5c-e747-4245-bc84-3232ef65a16c" label="EVE-16" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-16/s3-prove-runtime-loading-and-switching-of-a-remote-module-on-expo-web" />/<issue id="55c2d64a-d779-41d9-b74e-dcc7d062b86b" label="EVE-252" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-252/implement-effect-cluster-sharding-and-multi-runner-recovery-in-the" /> target-specific limitations. Run exact historic pre-Amp word-art ready hook and test clean install/activate/deactivate/hot-update/unregister under permissions. Verify source-free cross-module extension, resource migrations, direct SQL import denial, typed exact provider pins, on-demand views, OTel trace through UI/action/execution/step/hook, console+rotation, outbox crash/retry, revocation/tenant isolation, high-profile boundary redaction, emergency fast-path continuity, upgrade/drain and offline/native targets. Explicit failed/outstanding vs passing evidence per target; record exact CI/head, independent review and owner sign-off before main integration. No automatic claim of complete hot swaps, protected cryptography, multi-runner fencing or production readiness from isolated unit tests.

## New binding quality gate — circular dependencies and exact types (2026-11-15)

See <issue id="5dbfce34-6bca-46ef-937b-e475730e55a0" label="EVE-263" href="https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-263/enforce-acyclic-moduledependency-graphs-and-exact-effect-ts-types" /> for full requirements and negative/positive acceptance fixtures. Never create circular static/runtime module dependencies, including indirect and type-only imports. Shared contracts belong in existing lower-level package C, imported by A and B with no reverse edge. Effects hooks/capabilities must permit cross-module extension without imports back to publishers. Reject dependency cycles at manifest admission and in Nx/import/type graph CI. Preserve precise Effect Schema/Context/Layer/action/hook/external dependency typing. No `any`, exposed `unknown`, invented `none` catch-all, unsafe casts, or ignored TS diagnostics as fixes. Validate external input at narrow schema adapters and escalate unavoidable vendor internal `unknown` to explicit review. Strict typecheck, boundary lint, type-level and runtime negative fixtures and evidence mandatory before sign-off.

## Escalation

issues.title: Implement governed observation-only execution and lifecycle hooks with protected event gateway
issues.description:
# Eventiva observational extension-hooks platform — executable specification (2026-11-15)

## Intent, decisions and non-goals

A module must extend another existing module's runtime, workflow, execution steps, UI and logging using central registries and stable published contracts, with **no edits to the host or source feature**. User decision: hooks observe and add *separate authorized side effects only*; hooks cannot block, reject, rewrite, replace, intercept mutable state, impersonate original caller, bypass approvals, trigger unauthorized safety actions or alter the transaction outcome. Do not add guard/veto hooks under another name. Existing Baseline, Sensitive, Restricted/Regulated and Vault/Zero-Knowledge security profiles + A1–A5 assurance apply. Registration/manifest signature/trust do not automatically confer decrypt entitlement. The exact archived `Examples/preamp` HookRegistry/onLoad + `Effect.logInfo` + structured annotations Eventiva ASCII word-art is a mandatory reference fixture (verify actual bytes first).

## Public contracts

* A typed, versioned, discoverable HookDefinition: stable namespaced identifier, schema version, publisher/owner, classification, authorized visibility, payload schema, approved redaction/projection, delivery method, ordering guarantees, idempotency, compatibility, retention and event trigger.
* HookSubscription: module/version/generation, tenant and resource scope, minimal capability, optional bounded filtering on permitted fields, endpoint/handler reference, timeout/retries/backoff/dead-letter or explicit best-effort, trace correlation and isolated side-effect identity. Dynamic registration and unregistration must be audited, stateful, reversible and lease-aware.
* Separate internal event production, immutable event projection and external delivery; authenticated issuer from runtime, not supplied untrusted payload. Stable event ID, occurrence time, trace ID, tenant scope, aggregate ID/version and event schema; no secret content by default.
* Typed event families: platform.module.registered/validated/installed/activated/ready/deactivated/unregistered/updated/failed/recovered/retired; execution.created/started/suspended/resumed/completed/failed/cancelled; execution.step.started/completed/failed/retried/skipped/cancelled; resource.created/updated/deleted where authorized. Define whether each event fires before/after commit; no subscriber on transactional critical path. Events describing proposed activity are observations, not permission to interfere.
* Executions retain stable ID and exact workflow and extension generation/version; hook delivery must not require original module source changes. No arbitrary state mutation, direct DB connection or direct webhook outside separately authorized actions.

## Runtime architecture

Trusted execution emits immutable events into a central gateway after authorization. For authoritative operations, use atomic transaction/outbox with immutable event references; async worker projects minimal subscriber-specific payload *after commit*, checks currently valid grants, publishes side effects through permitted action services, retries idempotently and exposes status/dead letter. No arbitrary subscriber executes synchronously inside original transaction, and delivery failure never repeats original execution. Service-level queues have quotas, circuit breakers, bounded backpressure and monitoring; emergency/show control must remain independent and not wait on listeners. Ordering: per aggregate/stream when guaranteed, never falsely claim global order. Registration and removal use kernel scope/lease coordination; disable stops new dispatch, drains or safely cancels queued delivery per documented policy, no duplicate side effects. Runtime update pins active execution to compatible generation and proves no listener leaks.

## Security requirements

Baseline: scoped authorized subscriber minimal fields; Sensitive: purpose- and field-scoped visibility, redaction and audited grant; Restricted/Regulated: explicit owner and policy approval, assured workload, separately filtered event boundary, revocation and detailed audits; Vault/Zero-Knowledge: no ordinary plugin hook or decrypted payload; only specifically authorized policy-governed minimal boundary notification where allowed, otherwise none. Accounting/payment and emergency events must be separated from commands and control systems: never expose credentials, keys, bank data, vault plaintext, protected incident details or actionable show-control commands. Even timestamps/event existence may be classified; deny by default. Permissions checked on enrollment AND at delivery; revoke immediately stops future delivery. Verify tenant isolation, identity, A1–A5 enforcement, workload attestation when required, no leak through errors, traces, UI, retries, dead letters or console.

## Acceptance tests

1. Unmodified workflow publishes execution + per-step events. Separate sample extension subscribes, logs trace-correlated observations and performs one explicitly authorized additive notification. Disable, hot-upgrade, unregister and restart preserve correct behavior without duplicate processing or stale listeners.
2. Recovery after producer crash between committed step and delivery, consumer retry/crash, duplicate event, lag/queue overflow and cancellation: original state remains committed once, side effect idempotent, dead-letter recoverable.
3. Negative tests: attempts to mutate/veto original execution, subscribe without consent, read higher-classified fields, request decryption, bypass tenant scope, issue emergency show-control command, subscribe after revocation, depend on unsafe ordering, and run inside protected execution all fail closed.
4. Event schema/version compatibility and upgrade with active execution pinned. Clear distinctions between process-local proof, durable storage/outbox, multi-runner fencing and web/native proof.
5. Pre-Amp original Eventiva ASCII word-art (exact verified source) on platform.ready through Effect structured logging; one output per successful generation and no core feature edits. Validate console sink; telemetry/span correlation with UI module and step.
6. Effect/vitest focused and failure-injection test evidence, lint/Nx import isolation, docs for developers/agents, security review and replay-safe operational runbook. Publish sample manifest, event contracts, sequence diagrams and explicit incomplete platform targets. Full CI and independent review before owner-authorized integration to main.

## Dependencies and integration

issues.title: Enforce acyclic module/dependency graphs and exact Effect-TS types across the extension platform
issues.description:
## Binding architectural constraint — 2026-11-15: acyclic, strictly typed modules

Owner requires **no circular dependencies** (A -> B -> A, including longer transitive cycles) across Nx packages, runtime module manifests, capabilities/providers, extensions, UI/data/hook packages, TypeScript type-only imports, path aliases and generated entrypoints. Module admission MUST detect and reject cycle paths before registration/activation (with actionable cycle diagnostics), not hang or partially activate. Build CI MUST analyze both static import/re-export graph (value and type-only, barrels, aliases, indirect transitive edges) and runtime manifest dependency graph; include fixture A->B->A and A->B->C->A, valid shared-contract A->C<-B, and provider capability registration that allows observation without reverse imports. Dynamic hook subscriptions are one-way via central typed registry and must not create inverse module dependencies.

**Strong typing is a hard gate:** Do not use `any`, explicit `unknown`, an untyped `none` placeholder (or equivalent erased value), unsafe casts (`as any`, `as unknown as T`), `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-nocheck`, weakened eslint checks, blind JSON casts, or untyped external module bindings to sidestep dependency problems. Enable strict TS checks (`strict`, `noImplicitAny`, `strictNullChecks`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` as compatible with codebase) and typed ESLint checks. Public Effect action contracts, schemas, Context.Tag services/Layers, typed failures, providers, hook payloads, resource declarations, and external dependency imports must preserve precise inferred input/output/error/environment types. TypeScript's lowercase `none` is not a built-in type: use explicit domain unions/Option/Result where absence is required, not a catch-all placeholder.

For *inherently untrusted external input*, never claim it is statically validated: use Effect Schema decode/validation at the boundary before data reaches the typed domain; if a low-level vendor API forces `unknown`, isolate it privately in a narrow, reviewed adapter and expose only a parsed precise type. This is a proposed unavoidable exception requiring explicit owner review, not implicit approval to use `unknown` broadly. Prefer generic typed Schema.DecodeUnknown signatures where required by Effect library, but do not allow such unknown values to leak into module APIs. If a third-party package lacks accurate declarations, use an audited and tested typed adapter/declaration rather than any/unknown; escalate unresolved type incompatibility for decision instead of suppressing it.

Contract extraction: when A and B both require a shared type, place a *domain-neutral, versioned public contract* in dependency C (or existing @eventiva/contracts/@eventiva/schema), with one-direction edges A->C and B->C; do NOT create C->A/B, duplicate types, use interface structural widening that weakens schema invariants, or hide a cycle through dynamic imports. No unnecessary proliferation of C packages—prefer existing stable low-level packages. Generated types are validated against live Effect Schema and external version pins.

Acceptance: run affected project typechecks, strict lint, Nx dependency graph/cycle checker, import graph checks including type-only imports and indirect aliases, Effect Schema runtime/decode and type-level compile fixtures (tsd / expectTypeOf where available) and unchanged feature compile with swapped providers. Fail CI on a cycle, `any`/erased type escape, unauthorized `unknown`, unchecked external typing, or schema/type divergence. Show negative tests that genuinely fail, positive shared-contract graph, full baseline check, and report any existing violations separately (do not silently weaken rules). Owner approval required before changes to main/settings/dependencies/verification gates.
